jobs.description:
North America Account Manager

USA (Midwest Preferred) | Home-Based with Travel | Key Account Management | Automotive | Medical | Industrial Packaging

About Zotefoams

Zotefoams plc is a world leader in cellular materials technology, with manufacturing and commercial operations across the UK, USA, Poland and China. We develop and manufacture high-performance lightweight foams and advanced material solutions used in a wide range of sectors including automotive, healthcare, aviation, sports and leisure, industrial applications and packaging.

Our products help customers solve complex engineering and performance challenges through innovation, technical expertise and collaborative partnerships.

As a growing international business, we continue to invest in our people, technology and markets, creating exciting opportunities for ambitious professionals who want to make a real impact.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced North America Account Manager to manage a portfolio of strategically important customer accounts across the United States.

This is a highly visible, relationship-driven position focused on protecting, developing and growing existing business with large customers, distributors and fabricators. You will become the trusted commercial lead for your accounts, building strong relationships with key stakeholders, understanding customer objectives and coordinating internal resources to deliver outstanding service and long-term value.

Whilst this is primarily a key account management role rather than a pure business development position, you will be expected to identify opportunities for growth through new applications, programmes, facilities and customer contacts.

This role offers a genuine platform for future progression into broader business development, strategic growth or global OEM account management opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Account Management

• Own and develop a portfolio of large, complex and strategically important customer accounts across North America.

• Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders at multiple levels, acting as the primary commercial contact.

• Create and implement strategic account plans that support customer retention, revenue growth and margin improvement.

• Lead commercial discussions around pricing, contracts, forecasts, supply requirements and business planning.

• Develop a detailed understanding of customer organisations, applications, priorities, programmes and future opportunities.

• Maintain regular customer engagement through site visits, reviews and ongoing account management activities.

Customer Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Coordinate closely with technical, operations, supply chain, customer service and product teams to support customer success.

• Champion customer needs internally and ensure actions are delivered effectively.

• Support product qualification, development and commercialisation activities where required.

• Resolve complex customer issues professionally, proactively and collaboratively.

Business Growth

• Identify and develop growth opportunities within existing customer organisations.

• Support commercial planning through customer, market and competitor insights.

• Develop relationships and networks that support future growth initiatives across North America.

What You'll Need

• Significant experience in Key Account Management, Strategic Account Management or Customer Relationship Management within a manufacturing, materials, technical or industrial environment.

• Proven experience managing large, complex or high-value customer accounts.

• Strong commercial capability across account planning, pricing, negotiation, forecasting and contract discussions.

• Experience working with senior customer stakeholders and influencing decision-makers.

• Knowledge of at least one of the following sectors:

  • Automotive

  • Medical

  • Industrial Packaging

• Ability to work effectively across technical and commercial functions.

• Strong organisational skills with excellent follow-through and attention to detail.

• Willingness to travel regularly across North America to support customers and business objectives.

• Degree qualification or equivalent commercial or technical experience.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is:

• Relationship-focused and naturally skilled at building trust with customers.

• Commercially minded with a strong understanding of business priorities and customer needs.

• Curious, proactive and motivated to identify opportunities for growth.

• Comfortable operating independently whilst collaborating effectively across global teams.

• Professional, credible and confident when engaging with senior stakeholders.

• Organised, dependable and committed to delivering excellent customer experiences.

Why Join Zotefoams?

This is an opportunity to join a growing global materials technology business where customer relationships are at the heart of success.

You'll work with well-established strategic accounts, collaborate with experienced international teams and play an important role in supporting future growth across North America.

In return, you'll gain exposure to diverse markets, innovative products and long-term career development opportunities within a highly respected global organisation.

Our Values

Courage
The courage to take bold action to ensure that we succeed in tackling our challenges and opportunities.

Impact
Dedicated to making a significant and positive impact in everything we do.

Respect
Cultivate a respectful and inclusive environment where everyone is valued and collaboration is encouraged.

Zotefoams is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Specialist, Workers' Compensation
jobs.excerpt: About Us Martin is a leading, tech-enabled insurance advisory firm celebrating over 30 years of excellence.
jobs.description:
About Us

Martin is a leading, tech-enabled insurance advisory firm celebrating over 30 years of excellence. We partner with national, regional, and local insurance carriers and Managing General Agents (MGAs) across the U.S. to solve their most critical challenges. Our expertise spans Product Development, Actuarial Services, Regulatory Compliance, State Filings, and Data Analytics. Our mission is simple: build lasting partnerships and deliver technology-driven outcomes that fuel business success.

The Opportunity

As a Workers’ Compensation Specialist, you will be the senior subject matter expert on our Workers' Compensation (WC) Filings team. You'll own complex engagements end to end, from scoping and filing strategy through submission, objection resolution, and approval, and you'll serve as a trusted, client-facing advisor on state requirements and program design.
This is a senior individual contributor role for a seasoned WC professional who knows the nuances of NCCI and independent bureau states and has hands-on experience with large deductible programs, retrospective rating plans, and managed care arrangements. You'll take on the filings and objections that call for deep expertise and sound judgment, and you'll be a go-to resource for the analysts around you.

Key Responsibilities

Workers' Compensation Filing Ownership

  • End-to-End Ownership: Own the full lifecycle of Workers' Compensation rate, rule, and form filings across NCCI and independent bureau states, from scoping and filing strategy through drafting, submission, objection resolution, and approval.
  • Specialty Programs: Serve as the lead on filings involving large deductible programs, retrospective rating plans, managed care arrangements and credits, and other complex WC program elements.
  • State Nuances: Apply deep knowledge of state-specific WC rules, bureau requirements, and regulatory expectations to structure filings that anticipate regulator concerns and minimize objections.
  • Filing Deliverables: Prepare and review filing memoranda, explanatory exhibits, rule and form language, and transmittals, coordinating with actuarial and product teams on supporting documentation.

Objection Handling & Regulatory Strategy

  • Complex Objections: Lead responses to complex and escalated objections. Analyze regulator concerns, develop response strategy, draft responses, and drive them to resolution on time.
  • Regulator Engagement: Communicate directly with state insurance departments and rating bureaus to clarify requirements, negotiate approaches, and resolve open issues.
  • Regulatory Monitoring: Track NCCI and independent bureau circulars, loss cost and rate changes, and state legislative and regulatory developments, and translate them into practical guidance for clients and the team.

Client Partnership

  • Trusted Advisor: Serve as a primary client contact on WC filing engagements, advising carriers and MGAs on filing strategy, program design, and state requirements.
  • Scoping & Expectations: Partner with the WC Director and client teams to scope engagements, set realistic timelines, and keep clients informed of status and risks.
  • Client Deliverables: Own the quality and accuracy of client-facing work, delivering clear, polished, and well-reasoned recommendations.

Team Expertise & Quality

  • Subject Matter Expert: Act as the go-to WC resource for analysts navigating unusual state requirements, specialty programs, and tricky objections.
  • Peer Review: Review analysts' WC filings and objection responses for accuracy, completeness, and compliance, giving feedback that builds their independence.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to WC procedures, state reference guides, templates, and training materials that raise quality and consistency across the team.

Qualifications

Required

  • 8-10 + years of Workers' Compensation experience, including 5+ years of hands-on rate, rule, and form filing work.
  • Deep working knowledge of NCCI manuals and rules (including the Basic Manual, Experience Rating Plan, and Retrospective Rating Plan) and the requirements of independent bureau states.
  • Demonstrated experience with large deductible programs, retrospective rating plans, and managed care arrangements, including their state-specific filing and regulatory requirements.
  • A proven track record of independently leading complex, multi-state filings and resolving objections from start to finish.
  • Experience working directly with clients and regulators, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with SERFF and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Strong judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple engagements and deadlines independently.

Preferred

  • Experience at a WC carrier, rating bureau, state insurance department, or insurance consulting firm.
  • Familiarity with WC actuarial support (loss cost multipliers, deviations, schedule rating, and experience rating) and the ability to work closely with actuaries.
  • Professional designations such as CPCU, AINS, or similar.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, insurance, risk management, or a related field.

Why Join Us

  • Growth-Oriented Culture: Work with a leadership team committed to innovation and revenue expansion.
  • Competitive Earning Potential: Base salary plus bonus potential, profit sharing, and a comprehensive benefits package that rewards expertise and contributions.
  • Legacy of Excellence: Be part of a well-respected organization with over 30 years of leadership in the insurance industry.
  • Dynamic Team Culture: Work alongside talented colleagues who are passionate, driven, and committed to success.

Salary and Benefits

The base salary for this position is $100,000 to $130,000. Final salary offer will be based on several factors, including commensurate experience, qualifications, and skills. Our salaries are complemented by an extensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and work-life balance. These benefits include:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan options
  • Generous, flexible paid time off (PTO) policy

jobs.description:
Cloud Network Architect– Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a forward-thinking software development company dedicated to building innovative solutions that help businesses automate and optimize their operations. We leverage cutting-edge technologies to create scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications.
As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a skilled Cloud Network Architect to join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission of transforming business processes through technology.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Cloud Network Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary: $150,000–$180,000 Annually
Experience: 8+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a Cloud Network Architect to design strategies, reference architectures, and platform capabilities that span multiple cloud providers — AWS, Azure, GCP, and selectively OCI — for enterprises operating on more than one cloud by deliberate choice. The role focuses on portability, abstraction layers, federated identity, cross-cloud networking, and platform offerings that hide cloud-specific complexity from product teams. The ideal candidate has architected meaningful multi-cloud capabilities, understands the trade-offs between portability and cloud-native depth, and brings strong opinions grounded in production experience.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Define multi-cloud strategy, target-state architecture, and adoption guardrails across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI as relevant.
  • Design federated identity, SSO, and cross-cloud authorization patterns that let workloads and engineers move between providers without compromising on least-privilege, auditability, or operational simplicity.
  • Architect cross-cloud networking including transit hubs, private connectivity, and zero-trust patterns.
  • Establish reusable infrastructure-as-code patterns that abstract cloud-specific implementations where appropriate.
  • Define container, Kubernetes, and serverless strategies that work consistently across providers.
  • Design data architecture strategies for cross-cloud data movement, residency, and analytics.
  • Drive multi-cloud observability, security monitoring, and unified policy enforcement, designing approaches that work consistently across providers and avoid the complexity of fragmented per-cloud tooling stacks.
  • Establish FinOps practices that operate consistently across multiple cloud providers.
  • Lead disaster recovery and business continuity strategies that span clouds.
  • Partner with security architects on multi-cloud security models, KMS strategies, and key management.
  • Provide guidance to engineering teams on when to use cloud-agnostic versus cloud-native patterns.
  • Produce high-quality architecture artifacts — context diagrams, sequence diagrams, decision records, and reference designs — that capture key technical decisions clearly enough to be understood months or years later.
  • Engage with cloud providers and partners to evaluate roadmap alignment.
  • Stay current with multi-cloud platform and tooling developments, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team.
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in cloud architecture roles.
  • Hands-on architecture experience across at least two major cloud providers.
  • Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security across multiple providers.
  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code across clouds.
  • Experience designing federated identity and SSO across cloud platforms.
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes, container platforms, and managed cloud services.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Multiple cloud certifications across providers.
  • Track record of leading multi-cloud architecture initiatives.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with abstraction platforms (Crossplane, Pulumi, Terraform CDK).
  • Familiarity with cloud-agnostic observability platforms.
  • Experience driving large-scale cloud-to-cloud migrations.
  • Exposure to regulated industries with multi-cloud mandates.
  • Public talks or writing on multi-cloud architecture.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity?
For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 676-4399. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.
Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, transfer, leaves of absence, termination, layoffs, and recall.

BV Teck expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment or discrimination. Any improper interference with employees' ability to perform their job duties may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment.

jobs.title: Deputy CTO
jobs.excerpt: Have you ever had to make the tough call on what to build, what to buy, and what needs fixing now while keeping the business moving?
jobs.description:
Have you ever had to make the tough call on what to build, what to buy, and what needs fixing now while keeping the business moving? If you know how to balance great engineering with commercial reality, bring teams together, and turn a messy technology estate into something that can scale, we have a system for you to shape.

About Tiko

Tiko is a high-growth, award-winning African nonprofit on a mission to radically transform healthcare access. Recognized as an Audacious Project awardee and one of the fastest-growing NGOs in the sector, we are committed to strengthening the potential and resilience of adolescent girls across Africa. We address the “Triple Threat” of unintended pregnancy, HIV infection, and sexual and gender-based violence by building local health ecosystems that provide stigma-free, no-cost, quality-assured services.

Our model brings together key local actors: community-based organizations (CBO) with peer mobilisers who act as health companions to girls; public and private health clinics that deliver care; and retail partners that redeem Tiko Miles -our behaviour-change incentive programme that rewards service uptake and feedback.

We invest in partners by strengthening CBO capacity, training frontline workers and providers, supporting clinic quality improvement, and compensating partners based on performance. Our technology platform connects all actors by enabling referrals, verifying service delivery, facilitating payments, and generating real-time data.

Tiko operates in six countries: Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Burkina Faso, South Africa, and Nigeria, with additional offices in Portugal, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. For a clear overview of our work, we recommend watching this short video.

Globally, our team consists of +250 enthusiastic, international colleagues. Whether you are working from our biggest office in Nairobi, the fast-growing office in South Africa, or from home, our people are young, and our culture is global and dynamic. Our work environment is fast-paced, informal, and friendly.

For this position we will happily accept applicants from Portugal, Kenya or South Africa.

The Job

Reporting directly to the Chief Technology and Product Officer (CTPO), the Deputy Chief Technology Officer will take end-to-end operational and strategic ownership of roughly half our total tech organisation - leading 50 - 60 engineers, architects, and data professionals across four distinct teams. You will partner closely with your peer, the Deputy Chief Product Officer, to turn our technology vision into a resilient, scalable, and high-throughput reality.

This is not an advisory, fractional, or hands-off consulting role.

We are looking for an operational heavyweight who thrives in the weeds of engineering standards, architecture trade-offs, and ISO 27001 compliance, while building the conditions that make delivery predictable and sustainable. You will lead through directors, raise the bar for technical excellence, and serve as the ultimate arbitrator for build-vs-buy decisions across our platform, data, and infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering & Architecture Strategy

  • Own the overarching integrity of Tiko's technical architecture, setting cross-cutting principles and standards across engineering, data, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Arbitrate major build-vs-buy decisions, evaluating long-term operational costs, reliability, and platform growth against immediate business priorities.
  • Contribute technical initiatives directly to the joint product and tech roadmap, ensuring foundational platform health and tech-debt management are prioritised alongside feature delivery.
  • Stay ahead of emerging technologies and industry shifts to ensure Tiko's platform remains modern, secure, and fit for purpose across our operating regions.

Leadership & Operational Excellence

  • Directly manage, mentor, and develop senior leaders—including two Engineering Directors, a Data Architect, and a Software & Infrastructure Architect.
  • Scale and nurture a high-performing 50+ person engineering organisation, fostering a culture grounded in psychological safety, collaborative problem-solving, and continuous learning.
  • Establish metrics, SLAs, and KPIs to track platform health, delivery performance, and engineering effectiveness, using data to drive continuous optimisation.
  • Own the organisational conditions for predictable, low-toil delivery, empowering your Engineering Directors to execute individual projects with autonomy and accountability.

Governance, Risk & Security

  • Champion security, privacy, and regulatory compliance across all engineering practices, keeping our ecosystem strictly aligned with ISO 27001 standards and strict data protection obligations.
  • Identify, monitor, and mitigate technical, operational, and vendor risks, maintaining tested continuity and disaster-recovery plans across our platform.
  • Serve as the primary engineering and architecture interface for executive leadership, effectively translating technical debt, risk, and architectural choices into business outcomes.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration with product, operations, marketing, and MERL teams to break down silos and ensure seamless execution of company objectives.

About You

You are a grounded, low-ego technical leader who values organisational impact and real-world delivery far above corporate titles. You are energized by the systemic challenge of leading a multi-team engineering organisation through its next stage of scale. You combine deep, battle-tested software and data engineering fundamentals with the emotional intelligence needed to mentor directors, align cross-functional peers, and foster a growth-oriented, inclusive environment for girls and the communities we serve.

Requirements

  • Proven Scale Leadership: 8+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience, with a track record of directly or indirectly managing multi-team organisations of 40+ people (managing through directors, not just individual contributors or frontline managers).
  • Full-Time Operational Ownership: Demonstrated history of full-time, hands-on operational leadership in scaling product-led tech environments (fractional, part-time, or pure advisory experience will not fit this requirement).
  • Architectural Mastery: Deep experience defining enterprise architecture standards, managing complex distributed systems, and leading data infrastructure transformations.
  • Security & Compliance: Direct experience driving compliance, security governance, and data privacy frameworks (specifically ISO 27001 and local data protection regulations).
  • Communication & Alignment: Exceptional verbal and written European English communication skills, with a proven ability to act as an internal and external technical evangelist.

Bonus Points (The Differentiators):

  • Hands-on experience scaling technology platforms across emerging markets or lower-bandwidth environments in Africa.
  • Deep background in data engineering, analytics architectures, or financial/incentive payout systems at scale.
  • Direct experience partnering with executive leadership in a matrixed, cross-functional global non-profit or social enterprise.

Recruitment Process

Introductory call with recruiter | First Interview with Tech Team | Second Interview with Tech Team | Final interview with the Co-CEO

The Rewards

  • We offer a competitive salary based on experience, location and the agreed scope of the position
  • Benefits and allowances tailored to your location
  • Flexible work arrangements, including remote or hybrid options
  • A personal development budget to invest in your professional growth
  • Unlimited holiday days to use as you see fit - just coordinate with your team and take the time you need to recharge
  • The opportunity to shape a growing, impactful product and leave your mark on how we work
  • A culture built on trust - we believe you’ll do your best without the need for unnecessary rules or micromanagement

The Details

Interested? Click Apply for This Job! Want more information? Check out our website Tiko – Do more with Tiko.

We only accept applications through the apply links, not by email.

Important Recruitment Fraud Alert

Please be aware that Tiko maintains a professional and ethical recruitment process.

  • Zero Fees: We do not charge candidates any fees for applications, interviews, or processing at any stage of the hiring journey.
  • Fraud Prevention: If you receive a request for money, bank details, or "onboarding equipment" payments from someone claiming to represent us, this is not a legitimate request.
  • Official Channels: We only communicate through our verified company email domain (@tiko.org).

If you are approached by anyone asking for payment in our name, please ignore the request.

—

Tiko prioritizes integrity in our workplace and respects your privacy.

Tiko is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behaviour by its employees at work, including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity and financial misconduct. This is why we will do reference and background screening checks on successful candidates before hiring. Tiko also participates in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. As part of this scheme, we will request information from your previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during your employment, or incidents under investigation when you left employment. By applying for this position, you confirm you have read and understood these recruitment procedures.
We value your privacy and understand the importance of safeguarding your personal data. We invite you to review our privacy notice for the recruitment process to understand how we collect, use, and protect your personal data during the recruitment process. Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $125k - $145k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Madison, Alabama

Salary:

125K - 145K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services to patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Colorado and/or Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well. 

Salary: $125,000 – $145,000 / year

At FinDec, the Retirement Plan Administrator plays a critical role in delivering accurate, compliant, and high-quality retirement plan administration services. This role is responsible for the day-to-day administration of qualified retirement plans, including 401(k), Profit Sharing, Defined Benefit, and 403(b) plans, ensuring compliance with ERISA, IRS, and plan document provisions while contributing to operational excellence across teams.

DUTIES & ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

About us

Infinite Lambda is Europe’s fastest-growing data and AI consultancy. We empower leading companies to scale and become data-first through agile, cloud-native solutions and cutting-edge practices.

Together, we can grow, learn, and experiment with the cutting-edge data and AI technology (dbt and Snowflake among others) that we are all excited about.

About the role

Flowline moves enterprises off legacy ETL platforms onto a modern data stack. Coding agents write most of our code, so our pace depends on how quickly we decide what to build and how clearly we define "done". This role owns both. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. Product marketing sits outside it.

Mission: Decide what Flowline builds next and why, test ideas with working prototypes before engineering commits, and take the product from hands-on enterprise migrations to customers who can migrate on their own.

What you'll do

  • Write the definition of done for each feature in plain language, with examples of good and bad output. Engineers and coding agents should be able to test their work against it.

  • Own onboarding so a new user gets value without a call: in-product guidance, documentation, and a demo video generated automatically for every release.

  • Own the path to self-serve, so that smaller customers can run a migration on their own and pay for what they use.

  • Review AI-assisted work before it reaches a customer, and take responsibility for it once it ships.

  • Milestones delivered on the agreed date against their written definition of done.

  • Time from a new user's first login to their first migrated pipeline.

  • Share of shipped features with a demo video and release note within a week of release.

  • After self-serve launches, the share of small customers who complete a migration without our help.

  • In the first 90 days: one milestone delivered against its definition of done, and a feedback forum that FDEs and consulting engineers use.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in product management in B2B software, or in software engineering, data engineering, solutions or customer engineering with a move into product. You have taken a product from its first customers to repeatable use.

  • You spend real time with customers and turn what you learn into decisions.

  • You are comfortable with numbers and run your own analysis instead of waiting for a report.

Nice to have

  • A background in data or analytics, or exposure to Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran or legacy ETL tools.

  • Experience running a self-serve product alongside enterprise sales.

Why join Infinite Lambda

  • We support your growth with dedicated learning time, access to top-notch resources and a knowledge-sharing culture;

  • You work autonomously here in a wholesome environment and get as much paid holiday as you need;

  • The projects are diverse and give you plenty of opportunity to experiment with new tech;

Salesforce and GTM stack

Contract to cash

AI and automation

This role belongs to the Account Management Department, part of the broader Customer Success Division. AMs work cross-functionally with Engineering Excellence and Delivery Excellence teams, ensuring alignment between client goals and internal execution.

This role does not include direct reports but requires strong leadership through influence. You will collaborate with engineers, architects, analysts, project managers, and commercial teams to deliver measurable client outcomes and drive revenue growth.

Key Objectives

  • Drive sustainable, forecastable growth: Secure new business opportunities from assigned accounts, retain clients, and ensure their satisfaction through exceptional delivery.

  • Build enduring partnerships: Establish yourself as a trusted partner to clients, ensuring long-term collaboration and profitability.

You lead by example and foster a culture based on trust, empowerment, and excellence with your accounts and the teams you work with.

Detailed Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management

  • Develop and nurture strong relationships with assigned clients, serving as the main point of contact and advocate for their needs;

  • Understand each client’s business objectives, challenges, and strategic goals to deliver tailored solutions that align with their vision;

  • Proactively establish Infinite Lambda as a trusted partner, consistently delivering tangible value and maintain client engagement ;

  • Facilitate regular check-ins, quarterly business reviews, and strategic planning sessions to ensure alignment and promote long-term partnerships.

  • Act as a cultural ambassador, fostering trust-based relationships that reflect Infinite Lambda’s values and create a positive, lasting experience for both clients and colleagues;

  • Champion sustainable growth by aligning client success with long-term partnership and responsible use of data and AI technology.

Revenue Growth & Account Development

  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within client environments;

  • Drive renewals and contract discussions, with support from commercial leadership as needed;

  • Drive financial performance by meeting revenue targets, securing competitive pricing, and maintaining consistent growth in gross margins and profitability;

  • Proactively manage opportunity pipelines, converting opportunities into measurable revenue.

Strategic Account Planning

  • Define and implement account strategies in line with the direction provided by the Chief Customer Success Officer (CCO);

  • Collaborate with sales, marketing, and delivery teams to develop comprehensive account strategies that leverage Infinite Lambda’s offerings and expertise;

  • Analyse client industries, competitors, and market trends to identify growth opportunities and mitigate risks;

  • Contribute insights to product and service development based on client feedback and market needs.

Sales Handover & Onboarding

  • Take ownership of new accounts after contract signature;

  • Lead smooth client onboarding processes in coordination with delivery and sales.

Collaboration & Internal Alignment

  • Coordinate with project teams to ensure alignment on client deliverables, project timelines, and resource allocation;

  • Work closely with project teams to identify opportunities for innovation or new initiatives within accounts;

  • Act as the primary escalation point for client-related issues, ensuring swift and effective resolution while preserving relationships;

  • Provide regular updates and insights to internal stakeholders, ensuring company-wide visibility on account health and performance.

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain high standards across account efficiency, revenue performance, and client experience;

  • Track KPIs: revenue growth, NPS, forecast accuracy, GSS/FSS;

  • Produce at least two domain-relevant artefacts per year (e.g. case studies, blogs, market insights).

Compensation and Performance Targets

The compensation for the Account Manager role is composed of a base salary and a variable component tied directly to performance. The variable portion is determined by success in three key performance indicators (KPIs):

  • Financial Accuracy & Stability: Ensuring accounts are managed with precision, budgets are adhered to, and financial processes are stable and reliable;

  • Net Promoter Score (NPS): Driving client satisfaction and advocacy, as measured by their likelihood to recommend our services;

  • Account Revenue Growth and Sustain: Strategically fostering account growth through innovative solutions and long-term revenue stability.

This structure aligns rewards with results, ensuring performance excellence is recognised and incentivised.

Measurement Metrics

The success of the Account Manager role is evaluated based on the following categories:

Client Satisfaction

  • Client Feedback (NPS): Track satisfaction trends quarterly, ensuring consistent improvement from the baseline;

  • Referrals & Testimonials: Secure at least one public recommendation or referral per client.

Revenue Growth

  • Upselling/Cross-selling Revenue

  • Revenue Target Achievement

  • Gross Margin

  • Growth and Sustain Score (GSS)

  • Financial Stability Score (FSS)

Activity & Productivity

  • Client Interactions: Maintain consistent touchpoints through regular meetings and planning sessions.

  • Forecast Accuracy: Minimise the variance between initial forecasts and actual revenue.

  • Proven extensive experience in account management, client relationship development, and revenue growth;

Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. · Competitive Salary

· CEU reimbursement

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LICSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Pick your own schedule!

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

We are looking for a Site Observability Engineer to design and operate the metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting platforms that give engineering teams confidence in the systems they run. The role spans the full observability stack — from collection agents and pipelines to long-term storage, dashboards, and alerting workflows — with a strong focus on usability, signal quality, and operational ROI.   • Design distributed tracing pipelines and help teams use traces to diagnose latency and reliability issues.

  • Proficiency in at least one general-purpose language such as Go, Python, or Java.
  • Experience operating high-cardinality, high-throughput metrics and log pipelines.

jobs.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LICSW/LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

  • Support DocuSign, PandaDoc, and electronic intake workflows.
  • Coordinate with software vendors and technical support teams when needed.
  • Develop and maintain trackers, SOPs, checklists, and organized workflows.

  • Experience with medical billing systems, insurance portals, and eligibility verification.
  • Strong healthcare administrative experience, including scheduling, client communication, documentation, and follow-ups.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable using email, phone, text, WhatsApp, and video calls for communication and training.
  • Tech-savvy, resourceful, and able to learn new software and troubleshoot issues independently.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, reliability, and accountability.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience supporting an ABA therapy practice in both administrative and billing functions.
  • Experience with Office Ally, Motivity, and Availity.
  • Familiarity with Blue Shield, Health Net, and Cigna/Evernorth insurance workflows.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Outlook, Google Voice, DocuSign, or PandaDoc.
  • Experience coordinating client intake, referrals, and onboarding.
  • Background in recruitment coordination, staff onboarding, or healthcare practice operations.
  • Experience developing SOPs, maintaining trackers, and improving administrative workflows.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish is a plus, but not required.

Basic Requirements

  • Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
  • Must have relevant work experience.
  • Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available to attend video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.

  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

Position Description
As the Director of Sales, you will be responsible for driving new logo acquisition and revenue growth across health plans, employers, TPAs, consultants, and health systems.

The successful candidate will demonstrate a proven track record of exceeding sales quotas through proactive prospecting, executive relationship development, and disciplined execution of complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes.


This individual must be comfortable getting into the details of sophisticated healthcare benefit and virtual care solutions, working closely with internal business partners and external stakeholders to design solutions that meet client needs.


This position owns the entire customer acquisition lifecycle, from prospecting and opportunity development through contracting, implementation support, and formal transition to Client Success. Success requires close collaboration with Product, Clinical, Network, Operations, Finance, Legal, Implementation, Marketing, and Client Success teams to develop customized solutions and navigate complex organizational structures.


The ideal candidate is a highly motivated self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, learns quickly, maintains a positive and team-oriented mindset, and has the persistence and resilience necessary to win highly competitive enterprise opportunities.


Essential Job Functions

  • Drive net-new logo acquisition within an assigned territory through strategic prospecting, executive relationship development, and disciplined pipeline management to meet or exceed annual revenue quotas.

jobs.description:
Maintenance & Property Operations Coordinator

Company: Corporate Stays

Department: Operations

Job Type: Full-Time Freelancer

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Working Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Montreal time
Reports To: COO

About Corporate Stays

Corporate Stays provides furnished accommodations for business travelers, professionals, and extended stays. Our Canadian operations focus on delivering comfortable, well-maintained properties and a reliable guest experience.

We work with local technicians, contractors, building management teams, and internal departments to ensure our properties remain safe, functional, and ready for guests.

Position Overview

The Maintenance & Property Operations Coordinator will oversee maintenance requests and coordinate repair activities across Corporate Stays' Canadian property portfolio.

This role is responsible for coordinating local technicians and contractors, prioritizing urgent maintenance issues, tracking repair costs and deadlines, and verifying that work is completed to the required standards. The coordinator will also support preventive maintenance planning, maintain accurate maintenance records, and work closely with the Concierge Department and building management teams to minimize disruptions to guest stays.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, cost-conscious, and experienced in coordinating external service providers remotely.

Goal of the Position

To ensure maintenance issues across the Canadian portfolio are addressed promptly, repairs are completed efficiently and within budget, and properties remain in good operating condition while minimizing guest disruption and recurring maintenance problems.

Main Responsibilities

  • Monitor and manage maintenance requests across Corporate Stays' Canadian property portfolio.
  • Coordinate local technicians, contractors, and maintenance providers to ensure timely completion of repairs.
  • Ensure urgent maintenance issues receive immediate attention and are escalated when necessary.
  • Obtain, review, and compare contractor quotations to support cost-effective decisions.
  • Track repair costs, work progress, and completion deadlines.
  • Verify completed work through photographs, videos, or independent confirmation when necessary.
  • Coordinate with building management companies regarding access, keys, elevators, building regulations, and other property-related requirements.
  • Implement and maintain preventive maintenance schedules to reduce unexpected repairs.
  • Identify recurring technical problems and recommend permanent solutions to prevent repeated issues.
  • Develop and maintain a reliable database of contractors and service providers in each Canadian city.
  • Coordinate with the Concierge Department when maintenance issues may affect guest stays, check-ins, or the overall guest experience.
  • Track maintenance expenses and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
  • Maintain complete and accurate maintenance records in Breezeway or the designated operational system.
  • Follow up on open and overdue maintenance tickets to ensure accountability and timely resolution.
  • Provide regular updates on urgent incidents, outstanding repairs, contractor performance, and maintenance costs.
  • Ensure maintenance activities follow company procedures and applicable property requirements.

Performance Goals (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on the following indicators:

  • Urgent Maintenance Response Time: Average time taken to respond to urgent maintenance requests.
  • Maintenance Resolution Time: Average time required to resolve maintenance tickets.
  • On-Time Completion Rate: Percentage of maintenance tasks completed within the established SLA.
  • Recurring Maintenance Issues: Number of repeated technical or repair issues across the portfolio.
  • Maintenance Cost per Apartment: Average maintenance expenditure per apartment.
  • Overdue Maintenance Tickets: Number of maintenance requests that remain unresolved past their deadlines.

Qualifications

  • Experience in property management, facilities coordination, hospitality maintenance, or a similar role.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating external contractors and service providers remotely.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to prioritize urgent incidents and coordinate timely responses.
  • Experience using task management systems and property management software.
  • Understanding of basic building maintenance, repair processes, and contractor coordination.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to track expenses, compare quotations, and support cost-effective maintenance decisions.
  • Ability to manage multiple requests simultaneously while maintaining accurate records and clear communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with Breezeway, Hostaway, Guesty, or similar property management and operational platforms.
  • Experience coordinating maintenance across multiple properties or cities.
  • Familiarity with building management procedures, contractor scheduling, property access requirements, and preventive maintenance programs.
  • Experience working with hospitality or furnished rental operations.

Success Profile

The successful candidate is proactive, organized, resourceful, and comfortable managing multiple maintenance requests across different locations. They can distinguish urgent issues from routine repairs, coordinate reliable contractors, monitor costs, and ensure work is completed and properly documented.

Success in this role means faster maintenance response and resolution times, fewer overdue and recurring issues, better control of repair expenses, stronger contractor accountability, and minimal disruption to the guest experience.

jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Contáctica is the leading Martech Creative Agency in Puerto Rico, a strong challenger in Latin America, and a dynamic catalyst for growth in the U.S. mainland. For over 20 years, we have challenged the status quo and accelerated the evolution of visionary companies and their teams by delivering pioneering knowledge, transformative Martech solutions, and full-spectrum marketing agency services.

With headquarters in Puerto Rico and Colombia, and a closely integrated team working across ten countries, we are uniquely positioned to serve key industries such as Banking, Insurance, and Consumer Packaged Goods (CPGs), while tackling the most complex brand, product, and business challenges of today and tomorrow.

As we continue into a new era of Hyper-Evolution, we are passionately committed to driving growth and innovation by leveraging the Power of Humanity + Artificial Intelligence. Our unwavering focus remains unchanged: to deliver exceptional business outcomes through strategic thinking, creativity, and deep client insight, augmented by cutting-edge technologies.

If you share our beliefs—and are committed to acting on them fully—we invite you to review the requirements of this position and consider applying.

JOB DESCRIPTION

We are looking for a visionary, strategically minded, and technology-forward Creative Director to lead the conceptual, creative, and technological development of our assigned brands.

This role is responsible for transforming complex business and communication challenges into relevant, innovative, and executable ideas that deliver measurable value for our clients. The ideal candidate combines exceptional conceptual thinking, strong creative leadership, digital fluency, and a deep understanding of how Artificial Intelligence and emerging technologies are transforming the creative process.

The Creative Director will lead Associate Creative Directors, Copywriters, Content Creators, and strategic creative partners, while guiding multidisciplinary teams that may include Designers, Motion Designers, AI Specialists, Creative Developers, and Production Partners.

Working closely with the Chief Creative Officer, the Head of Art & AI Leader, and the Audiovisual General Producer & AI Leader, this person will turn the company’s creative vision into concrete solutions that combine strategic relevance, creative excellence, and technological feasibility.

This is not a role in which Artificial Intelligence is viewed solely as a production tool. We are looking for someone who understands that technology can also become the origin of an idea, an experience, a product, or a new business solution.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the conceptual development of integrated campaigns, content platforms, digital experiences, and special projects.
  • Transform business challenges, consumer insights, and strategic briefs into simple, relevant, memorable, and executable creative ideas.
  • Ensure the conceptual quality, creative consistency, and executional excellence of all work developed by the assigned teams.
  • Translate the creative vision established by the Chief Creative Officer into concrete solutions for clients and brands.
  • Incorporate Artificial Intelligence and emerging technologies from the earliest stages of the creative process.
  • Identify opportunities where AI can become an integral part of the concept, customer experience, product, or business solution—not only a tool for accelerating production.
  • Explore new technologies and creative methodologies that enable the development of ideas that would be difficult or impossible to execute through traditional processes.
  • Design and implement specialized AI agents to support creative research, insight generation, content development, production, workflow management, and knowledge sharing.
  • Develop and maintain reusable libraries of prompts, agents, methodologies, and automated workflows for the creative department.
  • Build intelligent workflows using automation platforms such as n8n, Make, or Zapier to improve productivity, consistency, and scalability.
  • Use AI-assisted research tools to accelerate benchmarking, competitive analysis, trend identification, cultural exploration, and insight discovery.
  • Lead the development of relevant creative insights, even when a project does not require a formal strategy workstream.
  • Create rapid prototypes and proof-of-concept executions to evaluate ideas before entering full production.
  • Understand how creativity connects across CRM, Social Media, Paid Media, Websites, E-commerce, Marketing Automation, Customer Journeys, and Conversational AI.
  • Collaborate closely with Strategy, Accounts, Media, Technology, Production, and Project Management teams to ensure that ideas are strategically relevant and operationally viable.
  • Partner with the Creative Intelligence Lead to strengthen brand platforms, communication frameworks, creative methodologies, and award narratives.
  • Build compelling stories and narratives for campaigns, products, content ecosystems, digital experiences, and client presentations.
  • Lead creative presentations and defend ideas with clarity, strategic reasoning, confidence, and the ability to inspire clients and internal teams.
  • Act as a trusted creative and innovation advisor for assigned clients and brands.
  • Anticipate creative, technological, operational, and reputational risks and address them with sound judgment and professionalism.
  • Lead, inspire, mentor, and develop Associate Creative Directors, Copywriters, Content Creators, and other multidisciplinary talent.
  • Provide clear, continuous, and actionable feedback that raises the quality of the work and supports professional growth.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, experimentation, continuous learning, and creative ambition.
  • Participate in talent selection, onboarding, development planning, and performance evaluation processes.
  • Coordinate and evaluate external specialists and strategic partners in creativity, Artificial Intelligence, automation, technology, development, and production.
  • Ensure that external partners meet the creative, technical, operational, and quality standards required by each project.
  • Document and share methodologies, experiments, prompts, agents, workflows, case studies, and best practices across the creative department.
  • Contribute to the development of new creative capabilities, technology-enabled services, and differentiated solutions for clients.
  • Participate actively in new business opportunities, pitches, and strategic proposals.
  • Identify campaigns and projects with the potential to become successful case studies or award submissions.
  • Collaborate on the conceptual development and storytelling of entries for national and international creative festivals.
  • Represent and live Contáctica’s values in every interaction with clients, teams, partners, and suppliers.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Proven experience as a Creative Director, Associate Creative Director, or in a comparable senior creative leadership role.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating outstanding conceptual thinking, integrated campaign development, storytelling, and creative execution.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams and developing creative talent.
  • Strong ability to transform business challenges, strategic briefs, consumer insights, and cultural trends into relevant creative solutions.
  • Solid understanding of branding, advertising, content, digital experiences, social platforms, and integrated marketing ecosystems.
  • Demonstrated experience incorporating Artificial Intelligence into creative research, ideation, content development, production, or workflow optimization.
  • Hands-on knowledge of leading generative AI and research platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway, Sora, and ElevenLabs.
  • Ability to determine which AI platform, model, or technological solution is most appropriate for a specific creative objective.
  • Experience designing advanced prompts, structured prompt systems, or conversational architectures that generate consistent and scalable results.
  • Experience designing, configuring, or implementing specialized AI agents for research, creativity, production, automation, or knowledge management.
  • Functional knowledge of automation platforms such as n8n, Make, or Zapier.
  • Understanding of how CRM, Social Media, Paid Media, Websites, E-commerce, Marketing Automation, Customer Journeys, and Conversational AI connect within a client’s digital ecosystem.
  • Ability to use AI-assisted research to conduct benchmarking, competitive analysis, trend exploration, and insight discovery.
  • Strong presentation, storytelling, communication, and idea-selling skills.
  • Ability to defend creative recommendations with strategic reasoning while remaining open to feedback and collaboration.
  • Strong client-facing skills and the ability to act as a trusted advisor in creativity, innovation, and emerging technology.
  • Experience working with external production partners, technology specialists, developers, and creative suppliers.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong interest in developing new services, products, methodologies, and client solutions.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, make sound decisions, and maintain creative excellence in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong curiosity and a continuous-learning mindset regarding creativity, culture, consumer behavior, Artificial Intelligence, technology, and innovation.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Advertising, Design, Communications, Marketing, Creative Technology, or a related field.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish, both written and spoken.

START THE JOURNEY

If you share our beliefs—and are committed to act on them fully—we invite you to apply to join our team and experience the thrill of working in a fast-paced, cutting-edge, mostly remote environment.

Apply here and start the journey. Please include a personal letter with your application explaining why you're the best person for this position.

We are Contáctica, a technology and creativity company tackling the most complex brand, product, and business challenges of today and tomorrow while serving key industries such as banking, insurance, and consumer packaged goods (CPGs).

Rust Developer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Rust Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Rust Developer to design, build, and optimize high-performance distributed systems, low-latency backend services, and cloud-native infrastructure components powering mission-critical enterprise platforms. This role focuses on developing highly concurrent, memory-safe applications using Rust while integrating with modern cloud environments, container orchestration platforms, and event-driven architectures.
You will work closely with platform engineers, distributed systems architects, DevOps teams, and product engineering groups to build scalable APIs, asynchronous processing pipelines, networking services, and infrastructure automation tools. The ideal candidate has strong systems programming expertise, deep knowledge of concurrent application development, and experience building production software where performance, reliability, and security are critical.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop high-performance backend services using Rust for large-scale distributed systems.
  • Build low-latency APIs, asynchronous processing services, and event-driven microservices.
  • Develop networking applications utilizing TCP, UDP, HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSockets, and QUIC protocols.
  • Build highly concurrent applications using Rust's async ecosystem including Tokio and async/await.

  • Integrate services with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis Streams, or other enterprise messaging platforms.
  • Develop secure APIs and authentication services supporting OAuth2, JWT, OpenID Connect, and mTLS.

  • Strong proficiency in Rust programming language, ownership model, borrowing, lifetimes, traits, generics, and macros.
  • Extensive experience with asynchronous Rust development using Tokio, async/await, Futures, and Actix or Axum.

  • Experience working with Linux production environments and command-line tooling.

You will be joining a platform engineering team responsible for building next-generation distributed infrastructure supporting enterprise-scale applications across cloud environments. Current initiatives include:
