jobs.description:
Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW/LICSW) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Campus Staff Minister - Puget Sound Area (Undergraduate Ministry)

Work Location:

Remote - USA

Job Type:

Full timeGod has called InterVarsity to plant and to build witnessing communities of students and faculty who follow Jesus on college and university campuses. Through these groups, we believe ever- increasing numbers of students and faculty from all ethnic groups and areas of the campus will be transformed by the Gospel. We expect to see campuses increasingly become places where people, ideas, and structures flourish to the glory of God. We confidently anticipate that our InterVarsity alumni will become change agents across the country and around the world. We pursue this calling by discerning and actively participating in what God is already doing on campus. This is the essence of being a Campus Staff Minister (CSM).

ESSENTIAL COMMITMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES

Spiritual Growth

As a Campus Staff Minister, you pursue maturity as a disciple of Jesus Christ so that your life and work increasingly reflecta growing love for God, God’s Word, God’s people of every ethnicity and culture, and God’s purposes in the world. To do this, you will:

  • Pursue a vibrant relationship with the triune God through engagement with Scripture, prayer, and worship, both individually and incommunity

  • Develop self-leadership (growing in self-awareness, self-management, relational integrity, andresiliency)

  • Embrace Scriptural standards for behavior andattitudes

CampusLeadership

As a Campus Staff Minister, you increase the number of witnessing communities, as well as the size, health, spiritual maturity, and campus-wide influence of existing witnessing communities of students and faculty by being a:

  • Visionary Guide:

You communicate and model InterVarsity’s vision to see students and faculty transformed, campuses renewed,and world changers developed

  • Create a culture of humble dependence on God and bold expectation in God’s intention to start new witnessing communities throughout the campus and on new campuses

  • Model – in person and through programs – InterVarsity’s vision and Core Values, including a biblically-defined commitment to engage every ethnic and social group on campus

  • Lead students and faculty – individually and collectively – through Scripture, prayer, teaching, and discipleship experiences, so that they articulate and align their ministry activities around this vision

  • Set annual goals through prayer, researchand reflection with your teams (students, faculty, and staff) for qualitative and quantitative growth, including conversions and leadershipdevelopment

  • Structural Architect:

You create, develop, align, and leverage ministry plans, programs, teams, and structures to close the gap between current reality and the aspirational goals.

  • Build leadership teams who trust and partner well with you and who demonstrate spiritual vitality, relational health, and missionalignment

  • Develop and execute plans to achieve annual goals, evaluating and modifyingthe plan as needed throughout the year

  • Increase momentum for the vision by aligning programs, structures, conferences, and teams around the goals

  • Mobilize students and faculty to engage their relational networks with the gospel and to start new missionalcommunities

  • Under the direction of the Area Director, may supervise Ministry Interns and Campus Ministry Interns as delegated

  • Missional Developer:

You intentionally gather, invite, and develop diverse groups of students and faculty sothattheynotonlyencounterandfollowJesusasSaviorandLordbutalsoadvance the mission on campus as participants andleaders.

  • Create ways for faculty and students to encounterand follow Jesus through Scripture, worship, prayer, mission experiences, conferences, etc.

  • Equip students and faculty so that they think strategically about campus engagement and so that they proclaim – in word, deed, and power – the good news of Jesus, regularly inviting students and faculty to follow him as Savior and Lord

  • Disciple students and faculty by equipping them to hear the Word, respond actively, and debrief and interpret the experience so that they grow in Christlikeness, reflect our Core Values, and develop ministryskills

  • Invite, coach, and equip students and faculty to become increasingly effective participants and leaders, including starting new witnessing communities on campuses

Organizational Collaboration

As a Campus Staff Minister, you have joined a national mission. Therefore, you work with a network of other local, area, regional, and national InterVarsity staff and volunteers so that our work reflects Biblical standards of excellence, integrity, and partnership.

  • Partner with and respond positively to the direction and coaching of your supervisors and nationalleaders

  • Contribute to collaborative and productive team meetings and relationships

  • Affiliate chapters under your care and submit Graduating Student Forms in order toincrease our partnership with current students and alumni

  • Use national ministry resources and tools, as requested, including recruiting and/or participatingin local, regional, or national conferences as required

  • Complete reporting, planningand review requirements in a timelyway so that you and your supervisors can assess and improve your work as a CSM

  • Comply with all InterVarsity policies and procedures

Ministry Partnership Development

As a Campus Staff Minister, you will develop a team of partners – churches and individuals (including alumni and community members) – who will resource the ministry financially, in prayer, or volunteer service that advances the mission.

  • Raise 100% of the financial budget assigned by yoursupervisor

  • Communicate regularly with your ministry partners, nurturing the relationship through visits, phone calls, emailsand regular prayer letters

  • Develop on-going, long-lasting partnership with alumni and volunteers

  • Comply with all Ministry PartnershipPolicies

  • Identify and invest in advocates who will build networks of volunteers and donors on InterVarsity’sbehalf

Accomplish all other assigned tasks as appropriate

QUALIFICATIONS (common to all levels of CSM)

  • Annually affirm InterVarsity’s Statement of Agreement (Doctrinal Basis and Purpose Statement). Abide by InterVarsity’s Code of Conduct. jobs.excerpt: Senior Director, Analyst - SAP AI and Technical Architecture, S/4HANA and AI UK, EU – remote.
jobs.description:
Senior Director, Analyst - SAP AI and Technical Architecture, S/4HANA and AI UK, EU – remote.

About the role:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Senior Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Senior Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.


We are looking for an experienced SAP technical architect, solution architect, integration architect, BTP architect, or senior technical consultant who can turn implementation experience into objective research and practical advice for technical and enterprise architects.


The analyst will research how embedded AI, generative AI, and AI agents affect SAP ERP architecture, development, integration, data, security, controls, and operating models. They will help technical professionals determine which AI capabilities to adopt, how to implement them safely, and when SAP-native, custom, or third-party approaches are most appropriate.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content
  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act
  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward
  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts
  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda
  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights
  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions
  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings
  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business
  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review
  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy
  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community
  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery
  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members
  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

What you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred
  • 12+ years of relevant field or industry experience
  • Familiarity with the architectural, security, data, and governance implications of integrating AI and autonomous agents with SAP transactions and processes.
  • Significant experience designing, implementing, modernizing, or governing complex SAP ERP environments, preferably in an SAP technical architect, SAP solution architect, SAP enterprise architect, SAP integration architect, SAP BTP architect, or senior SAP engineering role.
  • Understanding of SAP extensibility and clean-core principles, including the appropriate use of embedded capabilities, on-stack extensions, side-by-side extensions, SAP BTP, and external services.
  • Experience integrating SAP with cloud platforms, data platforms, AI services, SaaS applications, and non-SAP enterprise systems through APIs, events, messaging, integration middleware, and batch interfaces.
  • Ability to evaluate SAP AI capabilities objectively against hyperscaler, open ecosystem, and specialist third-party alternatives.
  • Strong understanding of identity, security, privacy, access control, segregation of duties, auditability, and governance in SAP environments.
  • Understanding of enterprise AI architecture, including large language models, generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, grounding, prompt management, model orchestration, AI agents, and model lifecycle management.
  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders
  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables
  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability
  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions
  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges
  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply
  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements

● Strong business and financial acumen

  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market
  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team
  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments
  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable )

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

jobs.description:

This role involves designing and operating highly scalable, secure, and efficient cloud infrastructures.
You will work closely with DevOps, SRE, and security teams to automate cloud operations and improve system reliability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deploy, manage, and optimize cloud environments in AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.
  • Implement cloud automation, scaling strategies, and cost optimization solutions.
  • Monitor cloud performance, security, and compliance using logging and monitoring tools.
  • Enhance cloud networking, storage, and compute configurations for efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot cloud incidents and optimize failure recovery mechanisms.
  • Improve CI/CD pipelines and automate software deployments across environments.
  • Implement security best practices in cloud deployments, including IAM, encryption, and compliance frameworks.
  • Collaborate with development and security teams to optimize cloud DevSecOps workflows.
  • Work with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes, ECS, AKS, or GKE).

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in CloudOps, DevOps, or Cloud Engineering.
  • Strong expertise in AWS, Azure, or GCP cloud services.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi).
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, ArgoCD).
  • Hands-on knowledge of monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch).
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, VPNs, VPC, and security best practices.
  • Experience with cloud cost management and optimization strategies.
  • Proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell scripting for automation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in highly dynamic cloud environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Cloud certifications (AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, Azure Administrator Associate, Google Cloud Associate Engineer).
  • Hands-on experience with serverless computing (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, Cloud Run).
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes, Helm, and service mesh technologies.
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud workloads and big data architectures.
  • Familiarity with incident response and disaster recovery for cloud environments.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Execution Specialist, Remote
jobs.excerpt: The Regional Sales Execution Specialist (RSES) is a strategic regional operator accountable for understanding the RSDs vision and goals and translating the region’s growth strategy into coordinated, measurable execution.
jobs.description:
The Regional Sales Execution Specialist (RSES) is a strategic regional operator accountable for understanding the RSDs vision and goals and translating the region’s growth strategy into coordinated, measurable execution. The RSES independently assesses priorities, establishes the regional operating cadence, and converts high-level objectives into weekly seller plans and field actions that increase physician engagement and accelerate growth.

Operating as the connective leader across Sales, Field Marketing, Legal, Operations, and participating practices, the RSES designs and drives the execution model that enables sellers to spend more time building physician relationships. This role exercises sound judgment in prioritizing opportunities, identifying execution risks to the RSD and POD, improving processes, and determining the actions required to move prospects and deals forward.

The RSES owns regional pipeline execution, high-impact roadshow and event strategy, deal readiness, contracting coordination, post-event conversion, and the performance insights needed to continuously improve regional results. The role serves as the primary regional liaison to Field Marketing and activates relationships with new signers and physician advocates to expand local momentum.

Success is measured by business outcomes, including increased physician-facing capacity for sellers, improved pipeline progression, faster and more predictable contract cycles, stronger conversion from strategic events, and sustained improvement in regional execution. This is an autonomous, outcomes-oriented role that leads through influence, operating discipline, and cross-functional accountability rather than administrative task support.
This individual will support the Atlantic region, encompassing the East Coast from NC up to ME. The Ideal candidate will be comfortable working remotely/work from home with travel as required.

Primary Duties:

  • Translate regional growth priorities into an integrated weekly execution plan for sellers, including pipeline priorities, call preparation, follow-up strategy, and measurable execution goals. Independently identify gaps, make recommendations, and adjust priorities as market conditions and opportunity needs evolve.
  • Own the regional operating rhythm and execution cadence, including advising on resource allocation and seller capacity, aligning team calendars to the highest-value activities, and using dashboards and performance indicators to drive accountability and informed decision-making.
  • Design and lead the regional roadshow strategy, from prospect segmentation and meeting objectives through asset planning, field coordination, execution, and post-roadshow evaluation. Determine the level of preparation and cross-functional support required for high-impact opportunities.
  • Own the strategy and execution of quarterly Centers of Excellence events. Build engagement plans with participating practices and physicians; lead the planning and delivery of open houses, individual prospect site visits, local panel events, and public-speaking opportunities; and evaluate results against regional growth objectives.
  • Drive deal readiness and contracting across the region by determining next steps, anticipating barriers, preparing and quality-checking offer materials, coordinating required documentation such as W-9s and PECOS information, managing redline workflows, and facilitating timely handoffs to Legal and Operations.
  • Serve as the regional Field Marketing liaison and execution partner. Align event strategy to growth priorities, shape pre-event prospecting and engagement plans, and lead post-event conversion activities to maximize pipeline progression and return on investment.
  • Own the analysis and communication of regional execution performance. Produce and interpret POD execution dashboards, monitor leading and lagging indicators, surface risks and opportunities, and advise regional leadership on actions to improve performance through collaboration with the broader team.
  • Define and lead the region’s AI strategy and execution, identifying practical opportunities to improve seller productivity, physician engagement, pipeline management, and operating visibility. Establish adoption priorities, guide implementation, and evaluate impact.
  • Lead cross-functional handoffs and resolve execution issues by clarifying ownership, sequencing work, and maintaining momentum across teams. Partner effectively with Sales Operations while respecting its ownership of systems, reporting infrastructure, training, and data governance.
  • Continuously improve the regional execution model by identifying patterns, testing improvements, documenting effective practices, and scaling approaches that strengthen seller effectiveness and regional growth.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, healthcare, operations, or a related field
  • 7+ years of experience in sales coordination, field operations, revenue operations, or relevant project management roles
  • Proven ability to translate strategic goals into actionable, high-quality field execution
  • Experience managing sales pipelines, event planning, and cross-functional handoffs
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills
  • Familiarity with contract workflows, CRM systems, and reporting tools
  • Required to travel regionally up to 50% as needed for in-field coordination

Preferred knowledge, skills, and/or abilities:

  • Knowledge of value-based care models, accountable care, and population health management
  • Proficiency in Salesforce CRM, sales engagement platforms (e.g., Gong Engage), sales enablement platforms, Learning Management Systems (LMS)
  • Expertise in developing and documenting key workflows, processes and best practices
    Effective at leveraging data to inform critical decisions, set goals, and evaluate the success
  • Collaborative, supportive, and candid approach with team and business partners; proactive in asking questions and eager to lend a helping hand
  • Excellent communications and active listening skills with a high EQ and an intrinsic drive to help people grow
  • Outstanding verbal and written communicator: you make the complex simple
  • Ability to forge relationships across internal organizations and build consensus amid competing priorities
  • Meticulous, highly-organized and can juggle several complex priorities
  • Ability to thrive within entrepreneurial, high-growth environments that require ingenuity, flexibility, and resilience

Physical Requirements:

  • Sitting for prolonged periods of time. Extensive use of computers and keyboard. Occasional walking and lifting may be required.
  • Travel 50%
  • Ability to lift 50 pounds

Who We Are:

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) $125k - $145k/year

Position Requirement: Full-Time

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Knoxville, Tennessee

Salary:

125K - 145K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services to patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure, Education & Experience:                                    

Licensure in Colorado and/or Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

This document represents the major duties, responsibilities, and authorities of this job, and is not intended to be a complete list of all tasks and functions. Other duties may be assigned as well. 

Salary: $125,000 – $145,000 / year

  • Une connaissance pratique de la production musicale et du flux de travail des artistes d'aujourd'hui (DAW, notions de base en mixage et en matriçage, sortie de musique en indépendant)
  • Une oreille aiguisée pour la culture pop et un vrai flair pour ce qui interpelle les jeunes créateur·trice·s de musique
  • Une parfaite maîtrise de la culture TikTok et Instagram Reels : accroches, rythme, tendances et ce qui fait qu'on arrête de défiler
  • La capacité de vulgariser des notions techniques sans les simplifier à l'excès
  • Une excellente maîtrise de l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit (nécessaire puisque notre contenu s'adresse majoritairement à un public anglophone et que le poste implique de travailler avec une équipe internationale, notamment au Canada, au Royaume-Uni et dans le reste de l'Europe)

Comment postuler : le test

  • En plus de votre candidature, veuillez soumettre une courte vidéo test.
  • Livrable : une vidéo verticale de 30 à 45 secondes, en anglais, dans le style de « LANDR Can Do That? », un format construit autour d'une fonctionnalité méconnue et du problème précis qu'elle règle pour les artistes.
  • Choisissez un élément de landr.com que vous trouvez intéressant ou utile (le partage des redevances en distribution, le mastering gratuit, l'ensemble de plugins, peu importe) et expliquez-le à la caméra comme si vous parliez à un·e ami·e d'une astuce que vous venez de découvrir, et non comme une marque qui ferait son pitch. Une accroche dans les trois premières secondes, une seule fonctionnalité, aucun jargon.
  • Un téléphone suffit. Envoyez-la sous forme de lien (YouTube non répertorié, Google Drive, ce qui vous convient le mieux) ou sous forme de fichier ci-dessous.

Chez LANDR, non seulement nous acceptons la diversité, mais nous la célébrons, nous la soutenons, et nous prospérons dans l’intérêt de nos employé.e.s, de nos produits et de notre communauté. LANDR s'efforce chaque jour de créer un lieu de travail plus diversifié. Nous encourageons vivement les personnes de couleur, les femmes, les personnes LGBTQ, les personnes de toutes religions, de tous les âges et de toutes les communautés marginalisées à postuler.

Nous acceptons les gens tels qu'ils sont et croyons fermement que la diversité est essentielle à notre succès! Si vous postulez chez LANDR, c’est parce que vous souhaitez contribuer à notre succès et à notre culture extraordinaire, et nous en sommes reconnaissants! Nous travaillons fort pour créer la meilleure expérience pour nos employé.e.s et nous aimerions que vous y joignez!

jobs.description:
Solutions Consultant

Who we are

Jellyvision is redefining how organizations experience benefits by bringing everything together in one modern, intelligent home. With ALEX Home, we combine our award-winning ALEX® decision support with a flexible benefits administration platform, giving employers and employees a simpler, smarter way to manage benefits year-round.

Our mission is to help organizations reduce complexity, lighten administrative burden, and drive real employee understanding and utilization without forcing rip-and-replace decisions. We meet teams where they are today and give them a clear path to what’s next.

The people behind Jellyvision are creative problem solvers who care deeply about getting it right. We debate ideas, give real feedback and sweat the details because those details are what turn complicated problems into great experiences for real humans.

We’re a human first company that trusts smart people to do great work. We value curiosity, kindness and willingness to try new things, learn fast and try again. You won’t just show up to do a job, you’ll help build what’s next, solve real problems and have some fun doing it.

What's the role?

As a Solution Consultant, you'll be a trusted advisor for the full ALEX Home suite and the Revenue and Renewal team's go-to product expert. You'll master our products, demo environment, system architecture, security and implementation requirements, customer needs and the sales process. You'll give consistent, high-quality solution support that speeds up deals and builds trust with buyers, brokers and partners. You'll also work with Marketing and Product to bring the voice of the market into our integrated benefits suite.

What you'll do to be successful

Sales execution and solution design

  • Partner with Account Executives on deal strategy for ALEX Home opportunities, and lead the solution side of complex and strategic deals
  • Model best-in-class discovery, demos and solution design for direct prospects, brokers and clients
  • Shape the proposed solution around each buyer's needs
  • Become a subject-matter expert in ALEX decision support, and help cross-train teammates
  • Answer solution information requests, design tailored solutions and deliver in-depth demos
  • Explain our integration capabilities, including APIs, file feeds and single sign-on (SSO), and how they fit each customer's architecture
  • Speak confidently to security and data-privacy topics in live conversations
  • Field questions and objections in real time, and show where our approach stands out against competitors
  • Partner with the Proposal & Deal Desk team, which owns RFPs, security questionnaires and plan analysis: provide expert input on RFPs and support plan design analysis to confirm product fit
  • Contribute to team revenue goals through win rate, deal velocity and solution quality

Training and enablement

  • Partner with Sales Enablement to create advanced solution collateral and roll out talk tracks for Benefits Administration and ALEX

Market insight

  • Partner with Marketing and Product to represent the voice of the market
  • Give input on sales strategy and solution planning for future products, working with SC leadership
  • Use your knowledge of customers' system and security landscapes to identify good fits for pilots and new products

Experience and skills you'll need

  • 5+ years in presales, solutions consulting, benefits consulting or implementation within benefits administration or HR technology
  • Experience designing and demoing complex enterprise solutions for C-level stakeholders
  • Experience with decision support or employee benefits engagement tools strongly preferred
  • Understanding of the broker and carrier ecosystem
  • Ability to absorb product and system details quickly and translate them for customers
  • Ability to create customer-facing collateral that addresses product and system concerns in plain language
  • History of collaborating closely across sales, marketing, legal, security and technology teams
  • Experience in a high-growth environment with new product launches
  • Strong communication skills: you present complex ideas in a way that's honest, compelling and empathetic
  • Up to 25% travel

The Details

  • Location: Remote
  • Salary Range: $125,000 - $145,000
  • Additional Compensation: Commission elgible

The compensation range listed for this role reflects what we expect to pay, but where someone lands within that range depends on a few things, like their skills, relevant experience, qualifications, and how the role fits within our overall compensation philosophy, including internal equity and the budget for the role.

This role is eligible for commission in addition to base salary. During the interview process, our team will share how the commission plan works, including target earnings and how performance is rewarded.

Compensation is more than just base salary. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you at work and outside of it. Check them out here!

Our Talent Acquisition team will walk you through the full package and answer any questions throughout the interview process, so you'll know exactly what to expect.

Our commitment

Jellyvision is committed to continuous evolution and to building a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work.

It doesn’t matter your race, ethnicity, religion, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity/expression, country of origin, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), criminal histories consistent with legal requirements or any other basis protected by law.

At the end of the day, we're looking for great people who are excited to learn and grow along with us. And while we’ve listed what we’re looking for in this role, we’re always looking to add other attributes, and skills that make Jellyvision even better. The point we’re getting at, we encourage you to apply - even if your background doesn't perfectly match every qualification.

A note on location: While our headquarters is based in Chicago, and employees are always welcome to work from the office whether they're local or just passing through, this role is also open to remote candidates residing in AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, IL, IN, KY, MA, MI, MN, NC, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA or WI.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleOnward Search is growing, and we are looking to hire an exceptional Sales Director, Manufacturing & Engineering Staffing to join our team in a 100% remote capacity.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Onward Search is growing, and we are looking to hire an exceptional Sales Director, Manufacturing & Engineering Staffing to join our team in a 100% remote capacity.

Onward Search is an award-winning recruitment and staffing agency with 19 years of experience connecting leading organizations across the country with exceptional talent. As we continue to expand our staffing capabilities within the Manufacturing & Engineering space, we are looking for an entrepreneurial, hands-on sales leader to help grow our client base, increase revenue, and support the continued growth of this vertical.

The Director of Business Development Managers will be responsible for managing and growing their own book of business while also leading a small team of Business Development Managers. This role is approximately 80% individual production and 20% or less of people management, making it ideal for someone who loves being in the weeds with clients, building new business, and closing deals while also coaching, mentoring and developing a high-performing sales team.

This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in scaling a growing vertical within Onward Search while working with innovative organizations across the manufacturing, engineering, industrial, and related sectors.

Key Responsibilities:

Business Development & Sales

  • Own and grow an individual book of business within the Manufacturing & Engineering staffing market.
  • Develop and execute a sales strategy to increase revenue and expand the client base.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities through market research, lead generation, networking, referrals, and other prospecting efforts.
  • Build relationships with key decision-makers and hiring leaders across manufacturing, engineering, industrial, and related organizations.
  • Develop a strong network of direct hiring manager relationships and continuously identify opportunities for account expansion.
  • Utilize our tools, AI, reporting system to research and identify a Focus 50 client list and target key clients and regions to prospect.
  • Understand client workforce challenges and provide strategic staffing solutions aligned with their hiring needs.
  • Negotiate and close new business while identifying opportunities to cross-sell Onward Search's additional services.
  • Consistently meet or exceed established sales, activity, revenue, and gross margin targets.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Manage, coach, and develop a small team of Business Development Managers.
  • Establish clear goals, KPIs, and performance expectations across the sales team and hold team accountable.
  • Provide ongoing coaching around prospecting, pipeline development, account strategy, negotiations, and closing.
  • Hold the team accountable to individual and overall business gross margin goals.
  • Foster a collaborative, entrepreneurial, performance-driven culture.
  • Partner with leadership to identify opportunities to grow the team as the Manufacturing & Engineering business scales

Client & Account Management

  • Serve as a strategic partner and primary point of contact for assigned client accounts.
  • Drive ongoing sales and account expansion activities across new and existing clients.
  • Partner with Client Services Managers, when assigned, to ensure strong client delivery while maintaining ownership of sales and account growth.
  • Participate in client intake calls to understand position requirements, hiring priorities, and expectations.
  • Manage client communication throughout the recruiting lifecycle, including candidate submissions, interviews, feedback, and offers.
  • Identify opportunities to increase job order volume and expand Onward Search's presence within existing accounts.
  • Maintain strong client relationships and consistently deliver an exceptional experience.
  • Recruiting & Delivery Partnership
  • Partner closely with recruiting teams to develop strong talent pipelines across specialized Manufacturing & Engineering positions.
  • Ensure recruiters have a clear understanding of client requirements, priorities, and expectations.
  • Evaluate and approve candidates for client submission when appropriate.
  • Monitor submittal, interview, placement, and start activity to ensure client needs are being met.
  • Leverage AI-enabled recruiting and sales workflows to improve sourcing, outreach, matching, pipeline management, and overall efficiency.
  • Partner with internal teams to identify strategies for hard-to-fill roles and priority skill sets.

Operational Excellence

  • Maintain accurate job, client, candidate, and placement information within Bullhorn and other internal systems.
  • Manage job entry, client intake, candidate submissions, interview coordination, offers, locks, assignment updates, and other account responsibilities when a Client Services Manager is not assigned.
  • Partner with clients and internal teams to resolve timecard, assignment, or account-related issues as needed.
  • Complete required quality check calls and maintain strong ongoing relationships with clients and placed talent.
  • Consistently deliver at or above established KPI targets.
  • Use sales, market, and performance data to identify opportunities to improve revenue, delivery, and account penetration.
  • Consistently demonstrate Onward Search's core values both internally and externally.

How Success Is Measured

  • Success in this role will be measured through a combination of individual production, team performance, and overall growth of the Manufacturing & Engineering business, including:
  • New client acquisition
  • Client and portfolio expansion
  • Job order volume
  • CV/submittal goal attainment
  • Interviews and placements
  • Weekly gross margin growth
  • FTE growth
  • Cross-selling of Onward Search services
  • Sales pipeline growth and conversion
  • Strong MSP scorecard and/or NPS performance if applicable
  • Team achievement against established sales and KPI goals

Requirements

  • Minimum of 5+ years of business development and sales experience, preferably within the staffing industry.
  • Minimum of 1+ years of leadership or management experience, preferably within staffing.
  • Proven track record of building and growing a staffing book of business and consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong preference for experience within Manufacturing & Engineering, technical, industrial, higher skilled trades, or related staffing markets.
  • Established network of client and/or direct hiring manager relationships within relevant industries strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of the staffing and recruitment lifecycle, including contingent and contract staffing.
  • Experience managing and developing sales professionals in a KPI-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to secure new clients, expand existing relationships, and grow revenue.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to balance individual production with team leadership.
  • Entrepreneurial, hands-on mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and growth-oriented environment.
  • Bachelor's degree required.

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to play a key role in growing and scaling Onward Search's Manufacturing & Engineering staffing business.
  • Highly visible role with the ability to directly influence revenue growth and the direction of the vertical.
  • Opportunity to maintain your own book of business while developing and leading a growing sales team.
  • Performance-driven environment with significant earning potential.
  • Collaborative and supportive culture built around entrepreneurial spirit, integrity, teamwork, and transparency.
  • 100% remote work environment.

Compensation

  • $100,000-$120,000, based on experience.
  • Commission eligible.
  • Comprehensive benefits and PTO package, including 401(k).

About Onward Group Holdings, LLC:

Onward Group Holdings, LLC is a platform of specialized talent and workforce solutions brands that connect leading organizations with expert talent across high-demand industries. The company combines deep domain expertise, proven infrastructure, and an expansive talent network to deliver solutions that go beyond traditional staffing.

With nearly 20 years in business, Onward Group Holdings partners with companies, schools, and organizations to help them build high-performing teams and thrive in the future of work. Its divisions include Onward Search (Marketing, Creative & Technology), Onward Accessibility (Digital Accessibility), Onward Education (K-12 Education), and Talera (Behavioral Health).

We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, and a 401(k) program for eligible full-time employees, along with resources designed to support well-being and career development.

We have built a culture fostered on entrepreneurial spirit, integrity, teamwork, and transparency. If you are energized by connecting people to opportunity, excited by emerging technologies, and motivated by measurable impact, you’ll fit in great with our team.

We’re committed to making every part of our hiring process accessible and inclusive. If there’s any adjustments we can make to support you as you apply and interview, please reach out to .

Applicants must be at least 18 years old to apply. 

Onward is an equal opportunity employer. We value a culture of inclusion and diversity within our workforce and are committed to maintaining a workplace free from prohibited employment conduct, including discrimination or harassment based on race, color, national origin, sex, age, religion, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, domestic partner status, civil partnership, status as a covered veteran, status in the Uniformed Services of the United States, citizenship and any other characteristic protected by State and Federal law.

jobs.excerpt: Sobre Nosotros:En Koltin, estamos rediseñando la forma en que cuidamos a nuestros papás, mamás, abuelos y abuelas, con el objetivo de ayudarles a mantenerse saludables, activos e independientes durante el mayor tiempo posible.
jobs.description:
Sobre Nosotros:

En Koltin, estamos rediseñando la forma en que cuidamos a nuestros papás, mamás, abuelos y abuelas, con el objetivo de ayudarles a mantenerse saludables, activos e independientes durante el mayor tiempo posible. Lo hacemos a través de nuestras membresías de salud, que integran:

  • Atención clínica enfocada en la prevención
  • Cobertura médica de gastos mayores
  • Programas de bienestar y comunidad

Somos la primera empresa en México que protege a personas adultas mayores, desde los 50 hasta los 84 años. Estamos creciendo rápidamente en todo el país, con un propósito claro: transformar la experiencia de salud para las Grandes Personas, haciéndola más humana, accesible y digna.

Sobre el puesto:

Como Guía Koltin, eres la primera persona de Koltin con la que habla un futuro miembro. Contactas a personas que ya mostraron interés, entiendes qué necesitan ellas y su familia, y las acompañas hasta elegir la membresía correcta y cerrar la venta: cobro y firma.

Para nosotros, una buena venta es una que el miembro entiende, usa y renueva. No buscamos a quien venda a toda costa, sino a quien asesora de verdad.

A quién buscamos:

Buscamos a alguien que no necesita que estén detrás de ella para dar resultados: que se toma su cartera como propia, cuida a cada persona con la que habla y siempre está buscando cómo hacerlo mejor.

  • Empática:Escucha antes de hablar y entiende lo que de verdad le preocupa a una persona y a su familia.
  • Organizada y estructurada: Tiene su agenda, su pipeline y sus pendientes bajo control; nada se le pasa.
  • Autónoma: Sabe qué tiene que hacer y lo hace, sin que nadie tenga que estar detrás. Siempre vas a tener acompañamiento, pero esperamos ownership.
  • Da seguimiento:Cierra los círculos que abre, con clientes y con su equipo.
  • Ambiciosa: Le gustan los retos y las metas, y siempre busca ir más allá de lo que se le pide.
  • Se adapta al cambio:En una empresa que crece rápido, los cambios le parecen oportunidades y no obstáculos.
  • Proactiva y de mejora continua: Ve lo que se puede hacer mejor y llega con propuestas a la mesa.

Lo que harás:

  • Contactar y dar seguimiento a tus leads por teléfono y WhatsApp, con disciplina en cada etapa del funnel.
  • Asesorar de forma consultiva: explicar la membresía con claridad y ayudar a elegir según necesidades, presupuesto y momento de vida.
  • Cerrar la venta (cobro y firma) y pasar al miembro al equipo de post-venta con toda la información en orden.
  • Registrar tu actividad en el CRM y cuidar la calidad de cada venta.
  • Compartir con tu equipo lo que funciona y proponer mejoras al proceso.

Requisitos:

  • Experiencia en ventas o atención a clientes.
  • Tener disponibilidad para trabajar de forma remota (para esta modalidad se excluyen los estados de CDMX, Edo. Mex, GDL y MTY)
  • Disponibilidad de tiempo completo e ingreso el primer lunes del mes de tu generación.
  • Uso de computadora, WhatsApp y herramientas digitales; experiencia con un CRM (HubSpot u otro) es un plus.

Beneficios:

🎓 Acceso a herramientas y beneficios para tu crecimiento profesional, como cursos, talleres, libros, etc
💊 Asistencia médica privada por videollamada (médico general, nutriólogo y psicólogo) ilimitado para ti y 3 familiares

jobs.description:
AI Technical Solutions Lead

12-month fixed-term contract | UK remote | Senior individual contributor | No direct reports

Quadmark designs and delivers technical training and enablement for some of the world’s leading technology and AI companies.

We’re looking for an AI Technical Solutions Lead to become a trusted technical authority for our AI work, helping us turn ambitious client ideas into technically credible solutions and ensuring the AI programmes we build and deliver are accurate, current and effective.

This is a hands-on role sitting at the intersection of AI, client consulting and technical enablement.

You might currently work in solutions engineering, applied AI, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering or technical pre-sales. Whatever your title, you’ll need to be comfortable moving between a conversation with a client’s technical stakeholders, briefing an internal team in straightforward language and getting hands-on with an API, prototype, lab or simulation to prove that something actually works.

What you'll be doing

Around half of your focus will be on new client opportunities. You’ll get underneath a brief to understand the real technical requirement, assess feasibility and risk, identify dependencies and translate your findings into a clear approach that our teams and specialist partners can deliver.

The other half will focus on technical quality and readiness across existing AI programmes. You’ll review content, labs, code examples and demonstrations, test technical exercises and equip our facilitators with the understanding they need to teach complex AI topics confidently.

You’ll also:

  • Act as a trusted AI technical advisor to our clients and internal teams.
  • Build and test lightweight prototypes, proofs of concept, labs, simulations and internal tools to validate ideas and reduce technical risk.
  • Work directly with AI models, APIs and developer tools to test whether proposed approaches work in practice.
  • Translate complex AI concepts and terminology into clear, actionable briefs for technical and non-technical teams.
  • Advise on the right AI tools and approaches for different client needs, including the trade-offs involved.
  • Identify where client expectations and technical reality diverge and navigate those conversations constructively.
  • Review technical content and demonstrations for accuracy before they reach learners.
  • Brief and support facilitators on complex AI concepts, demonstrations and likely client questions.
  • Keep pace with developments across AI models, developer tooling and implementation practices and turn them into practical recommendations.
  • Capture and share useful patterns so we don't solve the same technical problem twice.

What we're looking for

You'll need hands-on AI experience. We're looking for someone who has actually built, tested and troubleshot AI tools or applications, not someone whose experience is limited to talking about them.

You'll bring:

  • Hands-on experience building and testing AI tools, applications, labs, simulations, prototypes or API integrations.
  • Strong practical understanding of large language models and foundation models, including how they work, their limitations, context and data flows and multimodality.
  • Experience with common AI application patterns including RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering and fine-tuning.
  • Familiarity with agentic systems, tools and actions, workflows, orchestration and MCP.
  • Understanding of AI evaluation and safety, including evals, guardrails, moderation, human-in-the-loop approaches and observability.
  • Advisory, consulting, solutions engineering or similar experience helping others understand which AI tools or approaches to use and why.
  • Strong client-facing experience, including communicating confidently with senior and technical client stakeholders.
  • The ability to take complicated technical information and translate it into simple, precise language for different audiences and teams.
  • Strong problem decomposition: you can take a vague, high-stakes brief and create clarity without waiting for someone else to define the answer.

How you work

  • You'll thrive at Quadmark if you're proactive and take ownership. You'll follow an issue through rather than assuming someone else will pick it up and you'll care about the details because technical credibility matters.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and patient when helping other people understand complex ideas. At the same time, you're agile and able to move quickly in an environment where both priorities and AI technology can change fast.
  • You're precise about what technology can and can't do. You'd rather qualify a claim than oversell it, and you're comfortable constructively challenging an assumption when the evidence doesn't support it.
  • You'll also be someone who enjoys enabling other people to succeed. This role has no direct reports: your impact comes through your expertise, judgement, communication and ability to make the people around you more effective.

Bonus points

We'd particularly like to hear from you if you have:

  • A background in the technology industry.
  • Experience in solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineering, applied AI or technical pre-sales.
  • Experience in learning, enablement or consultancy.
  • Hands-on experience with current developer tools such as Codex, Claude Code or Cursor.
  • Experience working with major technology clients or partners.

The one thing

Make sure everything Quadmark scopes, builds and delivers in AI is technically sound, from the first client conversation to the last session delivered.

The practical details

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract and a remote-first UK role.

You must be eligible to work in the UK.

Quadmark offers flexible remote-first working, quarterly in-person team days, private medical insurance, travel insurance, EAP and mental health support, 25 days' UK annual leave and a three-day paid shutdown at the end of the year.

Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $62K-80K/yr

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LPC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice.
