Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

About the role

Rove Next is a new premium line from Rove Concepts, a Vancouver-based modern furniture brand selling direct to consumer across Canada and the US. Rove Next launches with improved versions of our best-selling pieces, and it needs its own marketing built from the ground up.

That's this role. You'll own how Rove Next reaches customers and keeps them, starting with email and lifecycle. The goal is a marketing function that scales through AI and systems rather than through headcount, and the advantage here is that you're building it clean rather than inheriting one.

This is not a coordination role. We need someone who takes a problem and builds the answer, and who catches things before they reach leadership.

Scope

Initially focused on Rove Next, with room to expand across the Rove Concepts group as the brand grows.

What you'll own

Email and lifecycle as our primary owned channel. Campaign calendar, flows, segmentation, deliverability, list health. We run on Klaviyo.

Quality control on everything that ships. Copy, creative, link destinations, offers, regional versions. If something goes out wrong, it was yours to catch.

Building AI into the daily work. Not proposing it, shipping it.

Working alongside our lifecycle and email team, our designers, and our external ads partner to keep the calendar moving.

Translating results into plain business language. What we spent, what we made, what we'd do differently.

Must-haves

Five or more years in ecommerce or DTC marketing with real ownership of email and lifecycle. Klaviyo or a comparable ESP.

Evidence that you build with AI yourself rather than assigning it. When you hit a wall, your instinct should be to build through it, not to raise a ticket and wait.

Fluent, native-level English, written and spoken. This one is non-negotiable. You will be writing copy that goes out to our customers under our name, so we need someone who can hear the difference between a line that sounds premium and one that sounds like a discount retailer.

A strong eye. You can look at an asset and tell whether the destination matches the promise, whether the tone is right, and whether the offer math actually adds up.

Comfortable being told when something isn't landing, and comfortable telling us the same.

Nice to have

Furniture, home, or another considered-purchase category with a long buying cycle. Shopify, GA4 and Meta Ads familiarity. Experience holding a team to brand guidelines.

What success looks like

Flow revenue grows as a share of total email revenue. Work stops reaching leadership with errors in it. AI is doing measurable work inside the function within 90 days, rather than sitting in a proposal.

Compensation

$3,500 to $4,500 USD per month depending on experience. Independent contractor.

How to apply

Send your CV to []. In a few lines, tell us two things:

One AI workflow or automation you built yourself in a real business. What it did, and what it saved.

One time you caught something before it shipped that nobody else had noticed.

Please also include a short voice note, around 60 seconds, introducing yourself and telling us what you'd want to know before writing your first email for us.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a short paid project.

jobs.excerpt: Title:Atlassian Platform & ITSM Engineer - SDLCNext Function:Architecture & Service Excellence | SDLCNext Support Team | PEO DHMS / Workforce 3.
jobs.description:
Title:

Atlassian Platform & ITSM Engineer - SDLCNext

Function:

Architecture & Service Excellence | SDLCNext Support Team | PEO DHMS / Workforce 3.0

Location:

Remote

Reports to:

Architecture & Service Excellence Lead

POSITION SUMMARY:

We are looking for an Atlassian Platform & ITSM Engineer to support the Architecture & Service Excellence SDLCNext Support Team within the Program Executive Office, Defense Healthcare Management Systems (PEO DHMS). This is a hands-on enterprise tooling role that combines Atlassian platform engineering and administration, business/process analysis, IT service management (ITSM), technical delivery, and customer-facing solution design within the SDLCNext environment.

The role will work directly with Government users, process owners, platform administrators and engineers, vendors, and Workforce 3.0 teammates to translate operational needs into scalable platform solutions. The individual will help manage the full lifecycle of SDLCNext enhancements and support - from requirements discovery, process design, configuration, testing, and implementation through user enablement, incident/problem resolution, reporting, and continuous improvement.

SDLCNext is an enterprise Atlassian environment supporting software-development-lifecycle and ITSM activities across PEO DHMS. Success in this role requires someone who can move comfortably between stakeholder conversations and hands-on platform work: clarify an ambiguous business problem, design a practical workflow, configure and validate the solution, coordinate approvals and release activities, communicate the change, and support users after deployment.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Lead solution consulting, requirements, and delivery

  • Partner directly with Government and contractor user groups to understand business processes, pain points, service needs, and platform requirements.
  • Translate requirements into clear process flows, solution options, implementation proposals, delivery timelines, risks, dependencies, and decision points.
  • Manage platform enhancements and process-improvement efforts from intake through design, configuration, testing, release, adoption, and closure.
  • Conduct gap analyses and assess proposed changes, new capabilities, and emerging technologies; provide concise recommendations grounded in user value, technical feasibility, governance, and operational impact.
  • Facilitate technical working sessions and maintain action, risk, issue, and decision follow-through across multiple simultaneous workstreams.

Administer and configure SDLCNext / Atlassian capabilities

  • Configure and maintain Jira, Jira Service Management (JSM), Confluence, and related SDLCNext capabilities in coordination with platform and application administrators.
  • Create and maintain projects/spaces, workflows, work and request types, fields, screens, schemes, roles, permissions, notifications, automations, dashboards, and other configuration artifacts.
  • Perform or coordinate user and access administration, applying role-based access and least-privilege principles appropriate to the environment.
  • Execute and validate configuration changes in test/sandbox and production environments using disciplined change, verification, and rollback practices.
  • Maintain configuration baselines and improve consistency across project areas, workflows, data attributes, and presentation standards; identify and remediate obsolete or duplicative configurations.

Support ITSM operations and platform reliability

  • Provide responsive Tier 1/2 support for service requests, access issues, workflow/configuration questions, defects, and other SDLCNext user needs; coordinate escalation when deeper platform or vendor support is required.
  • Support incident and problem management by documenting symptoms, reproducing issues, organizing evidence, identifying contributing factors, tracking corrective actions, and communicating status to stakeholders.
  • Prepare research packages and coordinate with software/system vendors and Tier-3 support for complex defects, product questions, and enhancement requests.
  • Plan and support releases, upgrades, patches, maintenance activities, and capability-adoption efforts while minimizing disruption to users and maintaining operational continuity.
  • Use service, incident, request, adoption, and platform data to identify recurring issues, prioritize improvements, and improve transparency of support performance.

Integrations, automation, reporting, and analytics

  • Facilitate integration requests and support the design, implementation, testing, and sustainment of integrations between SDLCNext and adjacent tools or services.
  • Use Jira Automation, REST APIs, scripting/plugins, or other fit-for-purpose methods to reduce manual work and improve workflow quality and consistency.
  • Develop and maintain queries, dashboards, reports, and metrics that provide useful operational and management insight.
  • Evaluate new Atlassian capabilities and add-ons for applicability, maintainability, security, and value before recommending adoption.

Drive adoption, documentation, and knowledge continuity

  • Create and maintain job aids, SOPs, configuration documentation, operating guidance, and other materials that make support processes repeatable and auditable.
  • Conduct new-user training, targeted user education, demonstrations, and knowledge-sharing sessions; tailor guidance to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Cross-train team members and administrators on design, configuration, troubleshooting, and monitoring practices to reduce single points of failure.
  • Support tool/platform transitions, contract transitions, and knowledge-transfer activities by documenting current-state configurations, open issues, dependencies, and operating procedures.

BASIC JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • 5+ years of combined experience in enterprise platform engineering or administration, business/process analysis, ITSM, software lifecycle tooling, technical delivery, or a closely related discipline.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience administering Jira and/or Jira Service Management in an enterprise environment, including workflows, fields, screens, schemes, permissions/roles, notifications, automations, and user access.
  • Experience supporting Confluence and integrating Atlassian tools with other enterprise systems; familiarity with REST APIs, ScriptRunner, marketplace applications, or similar extension mechanisms is strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of ITSM practices including service request, incident, problem, change, release, and configuration management.
  • Demonstrated ability to gather requirements, map processes, analyze gaps, develop solution recommendations, and manage technical changes through implementation and adoption.
  • Experience operating in a controlled production environment with disciplined testing, documentation, access control, change management, and stakeholder communications.
  • Prior federal, DoD, or other highly regulated technology experience; DHA / PEO DHMS / Military Health System experience is highly preferred.
  • Current CompTIA Security+ or equivalent DoD-aligned certification is strongly preferred and may be required for assigned administrative access.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Project Management, or a related field is preferred; equivalent relevant experience will be considered.
  • U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain a Common Access Card (CAC) and required access to DHA systems and environments.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE & CERTIFICATIONS:

  • Atlassian administration certification or advanced Jira/JSM administration training; experience with Atlassian Data Center is particularly valuable.
  • ITIL certification or practical experience applying ITIL-aligned service-management practices.
  • ITIL, Atlassian, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, PMP/CAPM, or comparable platform, service-management, or delivery certification.
  • Experience modernizing or migrating legacy ALM/ITSM environments (including IBM Jazz / Engineering Lifecycle Management) to Atlassian or another enterprise platform.
  • Experience with enterprise workflow automation, dashboarding/analytics, and platform-governance standardization.

KEY COMPETENCIES:

  • Hands-on problem solving: comfortable moving from user conversation to configuration detail, testing, troubleshooting, and follow-through.
  • Structured technical delivery: manages scope, timelines, dependencies, actions, risks, decisions, and communications without losing technical detail.
  • Customer orientation: translates user needs into practical solutions while setting appropriate expectations and protecting platform standards.
  • Technical judgment: understands when to configure, automate, integrate, escalate, or simplify rather than defaulting to unnecessary customization.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication with the ability to explain technical decisions to Government, business, and engineering stakeholders.
  • Strong collaboration and influence across Government, prime/subcontractor, platform, vendor, and end-user communities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail, documentation discipline, sound judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-moving environment.
Salary: $98hr, C2C available

If you’ve got the drive and you’re ready to launch your tech sales career, we’ll give you the coaching and support to get there.

In This Role, You’ll Get To

  • Reach 50 to 60 prospects a day by phone, voicemail and email, combining research, creativity and persistence

  • Own your daily, weekly and monthly activity goals, and track your results as you go

We’re looking for people who

  • Have some customer-facing experience: sales, retail, restaurants, call centres, sports coaching, anything where you had to win people over.

  • Are curious. You keep asking “why” until you understand.
  • Bounce back fast. A “no” doesn’t ruin your day, it just gets you to the next call.
  • Are coachable. You want feedback and you act on it.
  • Bring energy to the team, share what’s working, and celebrate other people’s wins.

Why You’ll Love Kimoby

  • Supportive culture: Collaboration and teamwork are at the heart of everything we do.

En tant que SDR chez Kimoby, tu vas appeler des concessionnaires automobiles partout en Amérique du Nord, lancer des conversations et décrocher les rencontres qui font avancer notre équipe de ventes. Pourquoi choisir Kimoby

Role Overview

The L3 DevOps / Cloud Engineer will act as a senior technical resource responsible for leading complex infrastructure and DevOps activities, driving automation, defining technical standards, and improving platform reliability.

The role requires strong hands-on expertise in AWS, Terraform, AWX/Ansible, ArgoCD, GitOps, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and Disaster Recovery.

    • DR planning
    • Restore testing
    • Failover/failback activities
    • Application and infrastructure recovery
    • DR validation
    • Runbook preparation and improvement
  • Design and implement infrastructure using Terraform.
  • Develop and maintain reusable Terraform modules.
  • Review Terraform code and infrastructure changes implemented by L1/L2 engineers.
  • Define Terraform coding standards, repository structure, and implementation best practices.

    • Patching
    • Application deployment
    • Infrastructure operations

  • Design and maintain ArgoCD-based deployments.
  • Implement and support GitOps practices for Kubernetes and application deployments.
  • Define GitOps repository structures and deployment standards.
  • Manage and troubleshoot ArgoCD:
    • Applications
    • Sync issues
    • Configuration drift
    • Deployment failures
    • Environment promotion
    • Rollback activities
  • Design and maintain Kubernetes workloads running on Amazon EKS.
  • Develop and maintain reusable Helm Charts.
  • Define standards for Helm values, templates, and environment-specific configurations.
  • Design and improve CI/CD deployment processes.
  • Support and improve Jenkins and other CI/CD automation.
  • Define deployment strategies and operational standards.
  • Lead automation initiatives across Cloud and DevOps platforms.
  • Develop automation using:
    • Terraform
    • Ansible / AWX
    • Bash
    • Python
    • CI/CD pipelines
  • Define and enforce technical standards for:
    • Infrastructure as Code
    • Terraform
    • GitOps
    • Kubernetes
    • Helm
    • CI/CD
    • Automation
    • Cloud operations
    • Patching
    • Deployment processes
  • Establish reusable templates, modules, pipelines, and automation frameworks.
  • Perform technical reviews for changes implemented by L1 and L2 engineers.
  • Lead complex production incidents and perform Root Cause Analysis.
  • Identify recurring issues and implement permanent automated solutions.
  • Improve monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational reliability.
  • Participate in architecture and technical design discussions.
  • Lead production deployments, infrastructure upgrades, patching, and maintenance activities.
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to L1 and L2 engineers.
  • Create and maintain:
    • SOPs
    • Runbooks
    • Technical standards
    • Architecture documentation
    • DR documentation
    • Operational procedures

Core Technical Skills

Strong hands-on expertise in:

  • AWS
  • Amazon EKS
  • Kubernetes
  • Terraform
  • Terragrunt
  • AWX
  • Ansible
  • ArgoCD
  • GitOps
  • Helm
  • Docker
  • Jenkins
  • CI/CD
  • Git
  • Linux
  • Windows
  • Bash / Python
  • SSL/TLS
  • Infrastructure Automation
  • Disaster Recovery
  • Monitoring & Logging
  • Production Troubleshooting
  • Root Cause Analysis

L3 Expectations

An L3 Engineer should be capable of:

  • Leading technical activities independently
  • Owning complex Cloud and DevOps changes
  • Designing and implementing automation
  • Leading Disaster Recovery activities
  • Implementing GitOps using ArgoCD
  • Building automation using AWX/Ansible
  • Developing and reviewing Terraform code
  • Defining technical standards and best practices
  • Driving operational improvements
  • Mentoring L1/L2 engineers

The L3 engineer should move beyond routine operational support and focus on engineering, automation, standardization, reliability, and technical leadership.

Rackspace Technology is the trusted operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference and agents in production.   • Design observability and monitoring frameworks at enterprise scale, defining standards for metrics, logs, and traces that work consistently across many teams and many production environments.
  • Define DevOps, CI/CD, and automation strategy across engineering teams and platforms.
  • Partner with executive leadership and product management on technology roadmap decisions.
  • Mentor Staff and Senior Engineers and contribute substantively to talent growth across the organization.
  • Drive innovation and continuously evaluate emerging technologies for strategic adoption.
  • Lead the resolution of critical system-level production issues that require deep architectural insight.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • Ten or more years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Proven expertise designing distributed, high-scale systems in production.
  • Advanced proficiency in Java, Go, C++, or similar backend languages.
  • Deep understanding of data modeling, system optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives across multiple business units.
  • Strong expertise in reliability engineering and distributed architectures.
  • Demonstrated leadership in architectural decision-making at enterprise scale.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Track record of mentoring senior engineers and shaping engineering culture.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Public technical contributions (papers, talks, OSS leadership).
  • Experience driving multi-year transformation programs.
  • Familiarity with FinOps and large-scale cost optimization.
  • Exposure to regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, government).
  • Advanced degree or equivalent industry recognition.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With two convenient locations in Colorado and growing, OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and work-site location(s). Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available location. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW) in the state of Colorado with the ability to practice independently is required.

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $60,000 – $85,000 / year

To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

jobs.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you'll be responsible for

As a Creative Producer, you’ll turn ambitious creative ideas into exceptional work in the world. You’ll lead production workstreams from concept through delivery, helping determine how ideas can best be realized across channels, formats, and production approaches. You’ll bring deep knowledge of traditional production methods alongside fluency in emerging approaches, including AI-enabled production, and have a continual drive and curiosity to explore the very latest ways to make great work. You’ll be responsible for staying at the forefront of cutting-edge AI production techniques, developing an informed point of view on what’s possible, and sharing that knowledge across the Creative & Design team to surface new creative opportunities. As a thought partner to Creative leadership, you’ll help determine the right approach, partners, tools, and resources for individual productions while maintaining an exceptionally high bar for craft. You’ll be the connective tissue when the team is in making mode—bringing creative teams, agency and production partners, and cross-functional stakeholders together to navigate complexity and deliver work that does justice to the idea.


What you'll work on

  • Lead production workstreams from concept through final delivery, translating ambitious ideas into exceptionally crafted work.
  • Stay at the forefront of evolving production techniques and use that knowledge to recommend the right approach for ideas across film, digital, social, experiential, immersive, and emerging formats.
  • Partner closely with Creative leadership and creative teams to assess feasibility, shape production approaches, solve complex challenges, and protect the integrity of the creative idea throughout execution.
  • Research, experiment with, and operationalize cutting-edge AI production techniques and tools, translating what you learn into practical opportunities and sharing what’s possible with the wider Creative & Design team.
  • Identify, engage, and manage agency and production partners for assigned workstreams, building collaborative relationships that help Circle produce its best work.
  • Manage production timelines, project budgets, workflows, dependencies, and communication, bringing clarity and momentum to complex projects involving multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • Champion exceptional executional quality across your productions, balancing creative ambition, craft, resources, constraints, and new ways of making without compromising what makes the idea great.

What you'll bring to Circle

Core Requirements

  • 10+ years of relevant creative production experience with a portfolio of exceptional, highly crafted work.
  • Demonstrated experience producing creative across multiple formats and surfaces, including film, digital, social, experiential, immersive, and other emerging channels.
  • Day-to-day fluency with modern AI-assisted production tools and workflows: you routinely use generative and assistive techniques (for ideation, asset generation, iteration, or post-production), apply prompt-engineering and iterative refinement, and translate model outputs into editorial and production decisions.
  • Practical familiarity with core AI/ML concepts (for example, generative models, synthetic media, model evaluation and iteration) and the judgment to know when to rely on AI-driven approaches versus traditional production methods.
  • Deep knowledge of the creative production process, with the judgment to recommend how an idea can best be made based on the creative ambition, audience, channel, resources, and constraints.
  • A track record of leading complex production workstreams from concept through delivery while maintaining an exceptionally high standard of creative execution.
  • Strong creative judgment and the ability to recognize a great idea, advocate for it, and ensure the production approach serves the idea rather than the technique or technology.
  • Experience partnering directly with creative teams, agencies, production companies, and other specialist partners to bring ambitious creative work to life.

Preferred Requirements

  • Hands-on experience experimenting with AI production tools and workflows, with a learn-by-making mindset and an informed perspective on emerging capabilities and broader industry developments.
  • Practical experience applying prompt design, model output curation, quality evaluation, and integration of AI-generated assets into production pipelines.
  • Experience working across both in-house creative teams and agency environments, with an understanding of how to get exceptional work made in each.
  • Experience producing creative within financial services, technology, or another highly regulated environment.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

  • Own the Data team's roadmap by collaborating with Product Management and business partners to set priorities, clarify requirements, and deliver long-term initiatives.

  • Lead, mentor, and support a team of data engineers and analysts through regular 1:1s, actionable feedback, and structured career growth.

  • Establish standards for data quality, reliability, documentation, and observability across pipelines and reporting to ensure business-wide trust in data.

  • Champion agile practices and explore the thoughtful adoption of AI tools within the team for building pipelines, analysis, reporting, and documentation.

  • Communicate technical trade-offs, progress, and risks in plain language to technical and non-technical stakeholders across the company.

🔍 What You Bring

Some of the qualities that help you thrive in this role:

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering or analytics, alongside 2+ years of experience leading engineering teams, managing performance, and supporting career growth.

  • Solid technical foundation in SQL, data modeling, data pipelines, and reporting tools to effectively review solutions and guide technical direction.

  • Demonstrated capability in roadmap planning, project scoping, and cross-functional stakeholder management.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of translating complex technical concepts for non-technical partners.

  • Comfort working independently and asynchronously, while also prioritizing collaboration and connection with people

  • Experience (or excitement for) working with AI and applying AI tools safely and effectively to data workflows

  • Bonus: Familiarity with SaaS data architectures, Snowflake, or the promotional products industry

💰 Compensation & Perks

We believe in fair, transparent compensation. Starting salary for this role is $150,000–$170,000, depending on previous experience and skillset, plus a 5% annual bonus opportunity based on company performance.

New hires are expected to come in at the midpoint of this range. However, if this role sounds perfect for you and your expectations are outside of this range, we encourage you to apply and let us know in your application about your ideal package. If we agree that it’s a good fit, we will have open discussion around what’s possible.

Plus:

  • Remote-first culture (with plenty of excellent in-person experiences sprinkled in)

  • Company-wide closure between December 25th and January 1st

  • Health and dental benefits, including a $1,000 healthcare spending account

  • RRSP/TFSA contributions up to $3,000 a year (no employee contribution required!)

  • Twice-yearly company wide summits (we call itHQandyou’ll love it)

  • A delightful team of smart people who are good at what they do

🌎 Location

This role is open to candidates eligible to work in Canada, with the exception of Quebec (we’re not set up to operate there yet — désolé!).

We’re remote-first, but if you’re based in Toronto, even better. That’s where we were founded and where we maintain our HQ today!

🌱 A Bit More About Us

commonskusupports hundreds of promotional products distributors and suppliers with technology that drive efficiency, growth, and connection. Our skummunity (commonsku + community = skummunity, get it?) is powered byevents,education, andshared knowledgeand is core to who we are.

We’ve grown by being“for promo by promo”and now, we’re scaling our impact to elevating an entire industry. We’d love your help doing it.

🤖 A Note About AI

We use AI every day at commonsku to be faster and better. If you use AI tools to help you draft your resume or cover letter, that’s totally fine — just make sure what you submit reflects you. We want to hear your authentic voice, not ChatGPT’s.

📬 How to Apply

If this role feels like a fit, apply now athttps://commonsku.com/careers!

We try our level best to review and respond to every application we receive. So, once you’ve applied, wait to hear from a member of our People team with an update. If it looks like a good fit, expect a phone interview as the first step.

By the way, you don’t need to meet 100% of the requirements — we value potential, learning, and diversity of thought. Tell us why you're excited, and let’s chat.

❤️ commonsku is an Equal Opportunity Employer

We’re committed to building a diverse team that reflects the skummunity we serve. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities.

jobs.excerpt: Job Title Cybersecurity Solution Architect Job Type: Full-Time PermanentLocation: Germany - must be based in Germany and have full right to work in within EU (we do not offer sponsorship) About UsIntegrity360 is a leading independent cybersecurity specialist, helping organisations across Europe, Africa, the Caribbean and North America manage and reduce cyber risk.
jobs.description:
Job Title Cybersecurity Solution Architect

Job Type: Full-Time Permanent

Location: Germany - must be based in Germany and have full right to work in within EU (we do not offer sponsorship)

About Us

Integrity360 is a leading independent cybersecurity specialist, helping organisations across Europe, Africa, the Caribbean and North America manage and reduce cyber risk.

With over 900 employees, including more than 600 dedicated cybersecurity professionals, Integrity360 delivers a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity services spanning advisory and consulting, cyber risk and assurance, security testing, professional services, managed security, incident response and cyber recovery.

We support more than 3,000 mid-market and enterprise organisations across sectors including financial services, insurance, government, healthcare, retail, telecommunications, manufacturing and critical infrastructure.

At Integrity360, our people are central to our success. We invest heavily in learning, technical development and career progression, creating an environment where people are encouraged to challenge thinking, share knowledge and develop innovative solutions to real customer security challenges.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced Cybersecurity Solution Architect to join our Solution Architecture team in Germany.

This is a senior customer-facing role, working closely with our Account Management, Professional Services, Managed Security Services, Product and specialist technical teams.

You will engage with customers ranging from security and technology teams through to CISOs, CIOs and other senior stakeholders, helping them understand their security challenges and translating those challenges into practical, commercially viable cybersecurity solutions.

The role goes beyond selecting technology. You will be expected to understand a customer's business objectives, security maturity, threat exposure, technology environment, and operating model, bringing these together to design solutions spanning technology, professional services and managed security services.

You will take technical ownership of opportunities throughout the sales lifecycle, from initial discovery and qualification through solution architecture, proposal development, and customer presentation, supporting a smooth transition into successful delivery.

Most importantly, you will become a trusted security advisor to our customers, helping them understand where to focus investment, improve security maturity and strengthen their overall cyber resilience.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Discovery & Advisory

  • Lead technical discovery sessions to understand customers' business objectives, security challenges, existing architecture, security maturity and risk priorities.
  • Engage confidently with stakeholders ranging from security engineers and architects through to CISO, CIO and executive leadership.
  • Translate technical and business challenges into clear security requirements and pragmatic improvement plans.
  • Help customers prioritise security investment based on risk, business outcomes and existing capabilities.
  • Build trusted advisory relationships, constructively challenging customer thinking where appropriate rather than simply responding to stated technical requirements.

Solution Architecture

  • Architect cybersecurity solutions combining technology, professional services and managed security services.
  • Develop high-level architectures, solution designs, bills of materials, licensing models and professional services scopes.
  • Design solutions across new and existing customer environments, identifying opportunities to consolidate, optimise and improve security capabilities.
  • Ensure proposed solutions are technically sound, commercially viable, operationally supportable and aligned with Integrity360's portfolio and delivery capabilities.
  • Work across multiple security technologies and vendors, selecting appropriate capabilities based on customer requirements rather than relying on a single technology stack.

Managed Security & Cyber Resilience

Design solutions incorporating a broad range of cybersecurity capabilities, including:

  • Managed Detection and Response (MDR)
  • SIEM, XDR and Security Operations
  • Endpoint Detection and Response
  • Incident Response and Cyber Resilience
  • Vulnerability and Exposure Management
  • Cloud Security
  • Identity Security
  • Network and Infrastructure Security
  • Email and Collaboration Security
  • Data Security
  • Security Testing and Assurance
  • Threat Intelligence and Digital Risk
  • Security Automation and Orchestration

You will be expected to understand how these technologies and capabilities fit into the customer's broader security architecture and operating model, rather than treating individual security products as standalone controls.

Proposals, Tenders & Complex Opportunities

  • Take technical ownership of cybersecurity opportunities throughout the sales lifecycle.
  • Produce compelling customer-facing proposals that clearly articulate the proposed solution, security outcomes, value and improvements being delivered.
  • Support and lead technical responses to RFIs, RFPs and complex cybersecurity tenders.
  • Work alongside Account Managers to develop technically accurate and commercially appropriate solutions.
  • Present and defend proposed architectures and services to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Support effective technical qualification and identify solution, delivery and commercial risks early in the sales process.
  • Ensure proposed solutions meet customer requirements while remaining deliverable and aligned with Integrity360's capabilities.

Collaboration & Service Development

  • Work closely with Professional Services and Managed Security Services teams to ensure an effective transition from pre-sales into implementation and ongoing service delivery.
  • Collaborate with other Solution Architects and subject matter experts on complex or multi-domain opportunities.
  • Engage with strategic technology partners and vendors to understand technology developments, roadmaps and emerging capabilities.
  • Provide customer and market feedback to Product Management to help shape the evolution of Integrity360's cybersecurity services.
  • Contribute to the development of new solutions, propositions and managed services.
  • Actively share knowledge, experience and best practice across the Solution Architecture team and wider business.

Skills & Experience

We don't expect candidates to be experts in every area of cybersecurity.

We are looking for someone with strong security architecture fundamentals, broad cybersecurity knowledge, commercial awareness and the curiosity to continually develop their expertise.

Ideally, you will have experience across several of the following areas:

Security Operations

  • Managed Detection and Response (MDR)
  • SIEM and security analytics
  • XDR and Endpoint Detection and Response
  • SOAR and security automation
  • Threat intelligence
  • Incident response and cyber resilience

Microsoft Security

Experience with the Microsoft security ecosystem would be particularly valuable, including areas such as:

  • Microsoft Defender XDR
  • Microsoft Sentinel
  • Microsoft Defender for Cloud
  • Microsoft Entra
  • Microsoft Purview

Network, Cloud & Infrastructure Security

  • Next-generation firewalls and network security
  • SASE / Security Service Edge (SSE)
  • Cloud security and CNAPP
  • Web application and API security
  • Email and collaboration security
  • Zero Trust architectures

Exposure, Risk & Assurance

  • Vulnerability and exposure management
  • Attack surface management
  • Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM)
  • Penetration testing and security assurance
  • Security posture and maturity assessments

Knowledge or experience in areas such as OT/ICS security, data security, AI security or digital risk protection would also be advantageous.

Security & Architecture Knowledge

You should have a good understanding of:

  • Modern cybersecurity threats, adversary behaviour and attack techniques
  • MITRE ATT&CK
  • Zero Trust principles
  • NIST Cybersecurity Framework
  • CIS Critical Security Controls
  • Cyber Essentials
  • Security architecture principles
  • Cloud and hybrid security architectures
  • The relationship between people, process and technology in building effective cybersecurity capabilities and security operations

You do not need to have worked with every technology or vendor within the Integrity360 portfolio.

The ability to understand customer requirements, learn new technologies quickly and apply sound architectural thinking is more important than expertise in a specific product.

About You

You'll be well suited to this role if you:

  • Have experience in cybersecurity solution architecture, pre-sales, security consulting or a similar customer-facing technical position.
  • Can lead a cybersecurity conversation rather than simply answer technical questions.
  • Are comfortable running discovery sessions and whiteboarding solutions collaboratively with customers.
  • Can translate complex technical subjects into clear business language for senior and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Can engage credibly with security practitioners, architects, CISOs, CIOs and executive stakeholders.
  • Understand the commercial realities of designing and delivering cybersecurity solutions.
  • Can balance customer requirements with security best practice, operational feasibility and cost.
  • Are comfortable presenting, explaining and defending your recommendations.
  • Can produce clear, credible customer proposals and technical responses.
  • Have experience contributing to, or leading technical responses for, complex cybersecurity tenders and RFPs.
  • Take ownership of opportunities and follow them through from discovery and design to successful handover.
  • Are naturally curious and keep pace with changes in cybersecurity technology, threats and customer priorities.
  • Enjoy working collaboratively and sharing knowledge with others.

The Person We're Looking For

Technical capability is important, but this isn't simply a technology role. We're looking for someone who can sit with a customer, understand what problem they are trying to solve, what risk they are trying to reduce, what capabilities they already have and what good looks like for their organisation, then design a credible and commercially sensible way to get them there. You should be comfortable operating independently with customers while also knowing when to bring in specialists from across Integrity360.

Most importantly, we're looking for a team player. Our Solution Architecture team works closely together, shares expertise and supports one another on complex opportunities. We work hard, but maintaining the collaboration, camaraderie and culture of the team is equally important to us.

If you're looking for a role where you can work across a broad cybersecurity portfolio, influence customer security strategy and help shape solutions from initial conversation through to delivery, we'd like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Overview

Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.

The American Heart Association has an excellent opportunity for a Data Warehouse Developer! This position can be home-based.

This is a full-time, benefits-eligible, grant-funded opportunity. Current funding will expire 12/31/2030 with the possibility of extension.

The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.

#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.

Responsibilities

  • Designs integration architectures, defines clinical data mappings from electronic health record data, develops data models, and consults with the infrastructure team on server and data storage services.
  • Formulates and recommends standards for achieving maximum performance, compliance and efficiency of the database and delivery to researchers in the American Heart Association Precision Medicine Platform.
  • Works as a part of a dynamic team of biomedical researchers, database designers, data scientists, statisticians, software developers, quality research and health IT team members, and clinical data experts to support the data pipeline, database management, and creation of new tools. Understands their data requirements and builds systems that streamline data workflow and support advanced analytics.
  • Supports team in the delivery of external grants by providing data science expertise.
  • Works with external team members to encourage cross-department connections including the development and maintenance of standard operating procedures.
  • Ensures accuracy and integrity of service-oriented architecture through analysis, coding, writing clear documentation and problem resolution.
  • Maintains in-depth current knowledge of standards, guidelines, and industry trends for Data Warehouse Architecture as it relates to reporting and operations. Evaluates new data sources for adherence to the organization's quality standards and ease of integration.
  • Fosters use of self-service analytics, data governance and visual discovery while guiding changes and limited reliance on manual data processes. Builds proof of concept and tangible results by sharing testing data.
  • Champions data quality, integrity, and reliability throughout the department by designing data flow models and promoting development best practices with best of breed automation tools, working cross-functionally to ensure that data is made available timely and securely.
  • Helps with the assessment of database performance and the identification of problem areas by holding regularly scheduled reviews of code and monitoring software.
  • Performs other duties as required or assigned which are reasonably within the scope and responsibility of the job level and family.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of Data Mapping and Extract/Transform/Load (ETL) design and development experience with clinical electronic health record data.
  • Experience with data modeling and Integration of architecture design and implementation with electronic health records.
  • Experience with Data Virtualization tools
  • Comprehensive knowledge in software development lifecycles/methodologies, i.e. agile.
  • Strong presentation and collaboration skills and can communicate all aspects of the job requirements, including the creation of formal documentation.
  • Fluent in relational database concepts and flat file processing concepts.
  • Strong problem solving, time management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to travel up to 10% local and overnight stay.

Here are some of the preferred skills we are looking for:

  • Experience with Electronic health records and image mapping.
  • Experience with Python, R, SQL.
  • Experience with Cloud offerings.
  • Experience with Amazon Web Services: S3, Glue, SageMaker, Lake Formation, Lambda, Athena, RedShift, EMR, etc.
  • ETL Technology: AWS Glue, SSIS, DataStage, Informatica.
  • Time series analysis, clustering, decision trees, and neural networks.
  • Database/Data Virtualization Technology: Snowflake, Apache Spark, Databricks, Hadoop, Cloudera, SQL Server, Oracle, Alteryx, Denodo.
  • Business Intelligence Technology: SSRS, Power BI, Tableau, MicroStrategy

Compensation & Benefits

The expected pay range will be $95,000 - $115,000. Pay is commensurate with experience; geographic differentials to the pay range may apply. The American Heart Association reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range. The American Heart Association invests in its people. Here are the main components of our total rewards package. Visit Rewards & Benefits to see more details.

  • Compensation – Our goal is to ensure you have a competitive base salary. That’s why we regularly review the market value of jobs and make adjustments, as needed.
  • Performance and Recognition – You are rewarded for achieving success through annual salary planning and incentive programs; eligibility for an incentive program is based on the type of position.
  • Benefits – We offer a wide array of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, along with a robust retirement program that includes an employer match and automatic contribution. As a mark of our commitment to employee well-being, we also offer an employee assistance program, employee wellness program and telemedicine, and medical consultation.
  • Professional Development – You can join one of our many Employee Resource Groups (ERG) or be a mentor/mentee in our professional mentoring program. Heart U is the Association’s national online university, with more than 100,000 resources designed to meet your needs and busy schedule.
  • Work-Life Harmonization – The Association offers Paid Time Off (PTO) at a minimum of 16 days per year for new employees. The number of days will increase based on seniority level. You will also have a total of 12 paid holidays off each year, which includes several days off at the end of the year.
  • Tuition Assistance - We support the career development of all employees. This program provides financial assistance to employees who wish to further their education and career in relation to their current duties and responsibilities, or for potential future positions in the organization.

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Join our Digital Technology organization as a Lead Application Architect and play a critical role in shaping the future of healthcare technology. This role provides strategic architectural leadership across complex enterprise initiatives, driving the design and implementation of scalable, secure, cloud-native solutions that improve member, provider, and associate experiences.

As a Lead Application Architect, you will define architecture strategies, establish engineering standards, and guide cross-functional teams in building API-first, event-driven, and microservices-based platforms leveraging Azure cloud technologies. You will partner with business and technology leaders to deliver resilient, high-performing digital solutions while mentoring engineering teams and fostering architectural excellence across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture & Technical Leadership
    • Lead architecture and design of enterprise-scale applications using microservices, domain-driven design, and cloud-native principles.
    • Define target-state architectures and modernization roadmaps for strategic business capabilities.
    • Establish architecture standards, reference architectures, and engineering best practices.
    • Drive API-first architecture and enterprise integration strategies.
    • Lead architecture reviews, design governance, and technology evaluations.
  • Cloud & Platform Engineering
    • Design and implement scalable, resilient, and secure solutions on Microsoft Azure.
    • Guide adoption of Azure-native services including AKS, App Services, API Management, Event Hub, Service Bus, Azure Functions, and Azure Storage.
    • Define cloud migration and modernization strategies for legacy applications.
  • Event-Driven & Integration Architecture
    • Design and govern event-driven architectures leveraging Apache Kafka and related streaming technologies.
    • Establish messaging patterns, event contracts, topic governance, and real-time integration strategies.
    • Ensure scalability, reliability, observability, and fault tolerance across distributed systems.
    • Drive asynchronous communication patterns across enterprise platforms.
  • DevSecOps & CI/CD Enablement
    • Champion DevSecOps practices and automation across engineering teams.
    • Design and implement CI/CD pipelines supporting automated testing, security scanning, deployment, and monitoring.
    • Collaborate with platform engineering teams to standardize deployment patterns.
    • Promote Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and GitOps methodologies.
    • Provide architectural guidance on Argo CD, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, and related automation platforms.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration
    • Partner with product, engineering, security, data, and business teams to align technical solutions with business goals.
    • Influence technology strategy and architecture decisions across multiple initiatives.
    • Present architecture recommendations and trade-off analyses to senior leadership.
  • Mentorship & Governance
    • Mentor architects, engineers, and technical leads on architecture principles and emerging technologies.
    • Lead architecture review boards and technical design sessions.
    • Ensure solutions adhere to security, compliance, performance, and scalability standards.
    • Foster a culture of innovation, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.


Use your skills to make an impact

  • Experience designing event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka or equivalent messaging platforms.
  • Strong understanding of application integration patterns and distributed systems.
  • Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Hands-on experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices.
  • Strong knowledge of security, scalability, resiliency, and observability best practices.

jobs.description:
Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!
