lDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

Position: Building Information Modeling (BIM) Coordinator

Salary: 55K-80K

Above Group Overview

We offer you the opportunity to put your passion and your God given talents and abilities to use. Our goal is to attract and develop skilled, called, and passionate people to impact our devoted customers and our team. We want to attract immensely creative employees with an ability to inspire, motivate, and challenge others.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package that supports the well-being of our team. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; employer-funded HSA contributions; and an annual profit-sharing bonus that reflects our organization’s success as a result of our team’s collective achievements across projects.

For more information, see www.abovegroupinc.com.

Our People Strategy

We believe in a people strategy to be the fundamental driver of our organization.

While we can never reach a perfect organizational model, we can certainly strive towards it in our daily efforts and mission. With that vision comes a focus of key initiatives we are working on, listed here, with the indicators of what it should look like as we approach:

Shared Direction: A collective understanding of what the organization stands for, where it is going, and how we will get there. Indicators: a clear inspiring vision, well-executed strategies, clear aligned goals.

Authentic Values: Deeply held principles guiding all decisions and relationships and reflected in the conduct of everyone at all times. Indicators: high levels of trust and communication, uncompromising integrity and ethics, socially responsible practices.

Productive Relationships: Open, collaborative relationships that recognize and honor the commitments that people make to themselves, each other, their work, and the organization. Indicators: respect for all individuals, effective problem solving and decision-making, clear accountability, effective teamwork at all levels.

Liberating Processes: Flexible structures, processes, and technologies that allow people to do their best work and to collaborate effectively across boundaries. Indicators: clear organizational design, collective knowledge, the right tools and technologies, the right people for the right jobs.

Outcome Learning: Results-focused learning that strengthens individual and organizational capacity to cope with the present and define the future. Indicators: continuous teaching and learning, effective knowledge and skills development, leadership development at all levels.

Motivating Metrics: Fair, meaningful performance requirements, measures and rewards that reinforce high performance and manage poor performance. Indicators: clear and energizing performance requirements, relevant work measures, differentiated rewards.

Our Vision – What We Want to Do

Continuously improving the built environment for the glory of God.

Our Mission – Why We Exist

Demonstrating the love of Jesus Christ through empowering excellent AEC professionals to provide superior service.

Our Values – How We Will Accomplish This Mission

Our Core Values are the tools we use and the behaviors we exhibit as Employees of Above Group. They describe how we work together to achieve this special place we’re developing and how they make us uniquely successful.

  • Christian Values - We demonstrate humility, honesty, integrity, respect, kindness, and a sense of social responsibility.
  • Uncompromising Quality – We provide excellent results all the time, every time.
  • Buffalo – We take initiative running toward and owning challenges.
  • Extreme Team – We are accountable to each other to continuously grow and succeed.

BIM Coordinator

The Position

The BIM Coordinator for Above Group shall assist the BIM Manager to ensure projects are set up correctly and modeling is set up efficiently to ensure smooth project and process management. This individual shall directly contribute to the Firm and its success through the application of knowledge and technical experience to effectively produce a quality design and ultimate product to the customer. The BIM Coordinator shall multitask, while managing multi-disciplinary support. The BIM Coordinator shall execute project and process management duties as required to ensure quality is always maintained.

General Duties:

  • Assist with coordinating the setup, maintenance, and ongoing updates of project models, templates, and standards in Revit and AutoCAD while implementing workflows, best practices, and the desires of the client.
  • Support project teams in developing accurate, well-coordinated building systems models that improve constructability, reduce rework, and support efficient project delivery.
  • Assist with managing and curating the firm’s BIM content libraries (including families), systems, and schedules. Ensure accuracy, consistency, and current software alignment.
  • Coordinate BIM support for the firm’s visualizations, diagrams, and renderings as needed for internal reviews, client presentations, and marketing efforts.
  • Assist with staffing coordination across multiple projects. Working with project managers and discipline leads to balance workloads and BIM support needs.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, the design team, and constructions teams.
  • Support BIM execution planning.
  • Assist with BIM coordination and working group meetings, applying the IDS (Identify, Discuss, Solve) process to track, communicate, and resolve coordination issues.
  • Assist with compiling BIM-related updates, coordination insights, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.

Key Characteristics of the BIM Coordinator

Called – A strong sense of knowing who you are (i.e., gifts, talents, competencies) and how you are to spend your life. We fulfill our calling by being excellent at what God designed us to be, and we diligently pursue it.

Practice Servant Leadership – Leaders at Above Group are called to serve. We realize that effective leadership starts on the inside. We demonstrate that we are willing to do what others are unwilling to do. We will practice a Servant Leadership character that enriches the lives of others.

A Commitment to Above Group – An understanding of and a commitment to the special purpose, mission, and beliefs of Above Group and will have a value system compatible with our values.

People Abilities – Deep interest and care for people with an understanding of their primary interests, aims, strengths, and motivations.

Working with Customers – A demonstrated ability to accomplish results through collaboration with and development of strong relationships with our customers.

Organizational Skills – An ability to organize his/her own thoughts and work, while continually growing a results-oriented team. The ability to win the confidence of colleagues and office staff demonstrates a well-functioning department.

Insight and Strategy – A focused sense of strategy, (i.e., possessing the knowledge and sixth sense for how to implement our mutual goals). The ability to set realistic objectives and achieve them.

A Sense of Timing – An intuitive sense of timing and appropriateness in relation to people and projects.

Work Capacity – Sufficient physical and emotional energy to deliver the results necessary to advance our mission.

Self-Starter – Creates ideas and follow through without prodding. (Balanced with judgment and knowing when and how to ask for assistance and counsel).

Enthusiasm – A heartfelt passion for the work we do, which displays optimism – but not overselling and overstating.

Character – A level of impeccable integrity that permeates others.

Passion – The Above Group Vision will be irresistible to the right person. People skills, organizational and communication abilities must be truly remarkable, this person will be excellent at vision-casting in a manner that inspires others to join with us and develop solid relationships.

Minimum Requirements

The BIM Coordinator shall meet the following minimum requirements:

  • Associate’s degree in architecture, construction management, drafting, or related field.
  • Minimum of 2-3 years in construction project software management experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience, preferred.
  • Proficient understanding and knowledge in Autodesk Revit, AutoCAD, AEC disciplines, MEPF, and Architectural and Structural Standards.
  • Excellent Communication skills, both oral and written.
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize tasks.
  • Comfortable with traveling (i.e., flights, car services, hotels).
  • Strong work ethic, ability to work independently/self-motivated, as well as in a collaborative team setting, highly organized, and detailed-oriented.
  • Strong project management, strategic planning and problem-solving skills.
  • Able to complete complex tasks with minimal supervision.
  • Proficient knowledge of computers, Microsoft Suite, i.e., Outlook, Word and Excel.
  • Proficient knowledge in Building Information Modeling, and tools.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced office environment.
  • Superior organization skills and dedication to completing projects in a timely manner.
  • Able to lift a minimum of 15-20 pounds.
  • Able to hear to take phone calls as well as to clearly communicate verbally.
  • This is a remote position. Local candidates will be given the option to work in the office, remote or hybrid.
  • U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident of the U.S.

60K - 85K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With two convenient locations in Colorado and growing, OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and work-site location(s). Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available location. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW) in the state of Colorado with the ability to practice independently is required.

Work from or close to home:

WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

Work from or close to home:

Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available location. OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.

jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£68,000 - £88,000 + Benefits | 12 month fixed term contract

Every word we write matters. From what’s in the app, to job ads (like this one), to error messages, to emails, to internal policies, to… you get the idea.

The Writing team isn’t responsible for writing every word though – we’re here to level up Monzo’s writing overall. We have a well-established tone of voice, and people here really care about making sure all our writing is consistently good and works hard for customers. It’ll be your job to keep that quality up through the writing you do. But you’ll also be a champion for great writing by proving the difference it makes, and helping other people to improve their own writing skills.

Our never-ending reason to exist is to improve the overall quality of writing at Monzo. That means a culture where care for language is the norm. Everyone, in every role, should understand how important it is to write in a clear, empathetic way, and they should all have the skills to do it. The outcome of that will be world-leading writing for customers. They’ll trust us because our writing is clear, effective and works hard for them.

You’ll get together with the other writers pretty regularly to review and showcase work, collect feedback and insights from one another and generally just raise the bar for words at Monzo. And as we hinted at already, you’ll live and breathe our tone of voice, which is propped up by 3 guiding principles: straightforward kindness, everyday magic and warm wit.

You’ll be covering our Borrowing Writer while they’re on caregiver leave

This is a 12-month fixed term contract covering for our Writer who’s based in the Borrowing collective. That means you’ll be focused on supporting teams working on things like loans, credit cards, overdrafts and other borrowing and credit related projects.

You’ll work closely with cross-functional squads of engineers, designers, marketers, researchers and so on to make it an amazing experience for existing customers, and bring new people on board.

A typical day could see you

  • collaborating with a Product Designer on some in-app screens
  • collaborating with a Product Marketer on positioning and building messaging toolkits for use across web, growth marketing or CRM
  • sitting in on user research sessions led by the Research team
  • writing error messages with input from engineers
  • editing legal wording alongside our in-house lawyers

Your home will be in WritingAlongside the work you do in Borrowing, you’ll contribute to the Writing discipline. We’re always working on new resources, training and processes to make writing easier for everyone at Monzo.

Writing is part of the wider Marketing team but this role isn’t only about marketing. In fact, that’s a small part of the job. Your remit will be to improve the quality of the writing that touches your part of the business, inside Monzo and out.

This is for you if

  • you understand borrowing and credit products well
  • you’re a dab hand at ‘content design’, ‘UX writing’, ‘product writing’
  • you’re allergic to useless jargon and over-complicated language
  • you know how to use data and research to guide your approach
  • you’re okay bouncing between tasks on a daily basis
  • you’re comfortable questioning a brief and helping people understand why your approach is the right one
  • you’ve done some training or coaching to help other people improve their writing, but this one’s not essential.

This isn’t for you if

  • it’s your first writing job – sorry, but we need someone to hit the ground running
  • you’re a journalist or ad writer
  • you’re only really excited by brand and marketing stuff – that isn’t the focus of this role
  • you prefer to spend most of your time working solo – writing here is a team sport and you’ll need to collaborate with everyone across the company
  • you like lots of top-down direction – you’ll be expected to decide which challenges you tackle with your team, and how to tackle them.

You’ll get

  • the chance to shape the role around what’s good for you, and us
  • very flexible working – we care about what you do, not the minutes you work or where you do it (we love to see our teammates in the office but you don’t have to come in if you don’t want to)
  • a whole load of benefits, including a personal training budget, health insurance, generous caregiving leave and more you can read about here:

Please make sure you give us both a CV and a cover letter. This is a writing job after all; you should want to show us what you can do. A cover letter also helps us understand why you want the job vs a CV which often just tells us why you might be able to do the job.

The Interview Process

Our interview process involves 3 main stages (not including a recruiter call).

  1. Initial call with the Hiring Manager (30mins)
  2. Take home task (to be submitted within 7 days)
  3. A pair of interviews via Google Meet (each interview lasting up to 60 minutes)

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to . You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.

What’s in it for you:

  • £68,000 - £88,800 as a base salary
  • This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK
  • We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.
  • Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences
  • And much more, see our full list of benefitshere

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

About ADVOC8

At ADVOC8, we create experiences that build trust, shift minds and win hearts. Our special sauce? Chemistry, collaboration and an endless supply of curiosity. We're a team of strategic thinkers, creative problem-solvers, thoughtful storytellers and logistical magicians expertly bringing ideas to life from strategy and creative through to production and execution. We work with brands, nonprofits and associations to create experiences that make an impact. And we do this all in a flexible 'work from anywhere' environment where we celebrate differences and encourage each of our 'advocates' to bring their unique perspectives to the table each and every day.

THE ROLE

The Creative Production Manager turns approved designs into something you can touch. This role owns the end-to-end creative production lifecycle across multiple concurrent programs, from graphics tracking and creative timelines to proofs, QC and print, fabrication and swag vendors, ensuring every asset lands on brand, on spec, on time and on budget. Highly organized and fluent in print production, the Creative Production Manager keeps designers, producers, freelancers and vendors clear on what’s next and makes sure nothing reaches a client or vendor unreviewed. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced production professional ready to own outcomes across a portfolio.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Graphics Grid & Asset Management

  • Build and own the Graphics Grid for each program, linked to the workback as the single source of truth for status, specs, files, proofs and approvals
  • Build and maintain a Visual Identity Asset Library for each client so templates, logos and approved files carry from event to event
  • Keep shared drives, including Released Files, organized using established naming and storage practices

Creative Timelines & Approvals

  • Set creative deadlines and approval rounds with the Executive Producer and Production, keeping them current in the master production schedule as plans change
  • Run every approval round to written sign-off, logged with approver and date
  • Co-lead the weekly creative review with the Art Director

Specs, Proofs & Quality Control

  • Gather vendor templates, dielines and specs, and flag designers when items are ready for design
  • Prepare build kits with the Art Director and present production routes (materials, scale, pricing and lead time) with Production
  • Confirm files are print-ready (CMYK, outlined type, embedded images, bleed, trim marks, dielines) and internally reviewed before anything reaches a client or vendor
  • Log revision rounds against print deadlines and coordinate final release with the responsible Production lead

Print, Fabrication & Swag Production

  • Own vendor communication for print, signage, fabrication and swag from quote through delivery, partnering with our in-house gifting and merch team on attendee gifts, executive kits and event swag
  • Track creative production costs against budget and route scope changes to the Account Manager before committing
  • Support onsite as needed with graphics and signage install checks and last-minute print and swag needs

Freelance & Contractor Management

  • Source, vet and schedule freelance creative talent in partnership with the Head of Creative, maintaining a roster of vetted partners with specialties, rates and performance feedback
  • Define scope, deliverables, hours, rates and deadlines before work begins, coordinate agreements and NDAs, and onboard contractors to ADVOC8 ways of working
  • Track contractor hours and spend, flag out-of-scope requests early and ensure complete, organized files at project close

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Act as first-level creative escalation with client design teams, resolving operational questions and escalating creative decisions to the Art Director
  • Communicate risks, dependencies and needed decisions early across Creative, Production and Growth
  • Standardize and improve the Grid, workbacks, intake and QC checklists across accounts to reduce revision rounds and reprints

Professional Development

  • Stay up-to-date on print, signage, fabrication, materials and production technology

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • 4-7+ years of experience in creative production, print production or creative traffic management within an agency, experiential or brand environment; experiential or event experience strongly preferred
  • Deep working knowledge of print production and prepress (CMYK, bleed, trim, dielines, outlined type, proofing and color), with enough fluency in Adobe Creative Cloud and Acrobat to tell when a file is ready for a vendor
  • Proven experience managing print, signage, large-format, fabrication and swag vendors from quote through delivery, including tracking costs against budget and managing scope changes
  • Demonstrated experience building and holding creative timelines and written approval workflows across multiple concurrent programs
  • Experience sourcing, scoping and managing freelance creative talent
  • Highly organized with a systems mindset and strong problem-solving skills; you anticipate production issues before they reach a vendor
  • Clear, confident, client-facing communicator who is collaborative, proactive and solutions-oriented
  • Proficiency in Google Suite, Microsoft PowerPoint and Word, and Acrobat, with hands-on experience in tools such as Slack and Productive
  • Can work flexible hours including some nights and weekends, and is comfortable traveling 15% for onsite graphics and signage install checks
  • On site physical demands:
    • Ability to remain in a stationary position for an extended period of time
    • Ability to lift and/or move boxes and equipment up to 50 lbs. (with assistance)
    • Ability to position self under tables or stages, and/or lower self to floor
  • Passion for experiential marketing, events, brand activations and the craft of making things
  • Aligned with and committed to ADVOC8’s core values; represents them in daily work:
    • Better Together
    • Level Up
    • Hustle Smarter
    • Celebrate Differences
    • Outcome Over Income
    • Protect the Respect
    • Engineer Exceptional Value
    • Embrace Change

Other Requirements

  • Successful completion of applicable background checks

What We Offer

  • Impact: Own how creative production runs across ADVOC8 programs and help standardize the systems behind it
  • Learning: Work at the intersection of Creative and Production on experiential work spanning print, signage, fabrication and swag
  • Environment: Collaborative creative team with direct access to leadership
  • Clients: Bring ideas to life for brands, nonprofits and associations

Location & Logistics

  • Fully remote, full-time role; work from anywhere in the U.S.
  • Onsite travel for install checks and event support as needed
  • Standard business hours with occasional flexibility needed for event timelines

The Role:

SPARC Behavioral Health is seeking an experienced Controller to lead full back office accounting operations, including treasury management, and drive process improvement across a growing, multi-entity healthcare organization. This role owns the monthly close, financial statement reporting, and audit preparation, while leading a Senior Accountant and Payroll Specialist and partnering closely with the CFO on broader finance initiatives. The ideal candidate is hands-on, comfortable in a fast paced environment with evolving systems, and motivated to build stronger processes rather than simply maintain existing ones.

The organization is a private equity backed portfolio company, and this role should expect the reporting cadence, lender covenant requirements, and diligence rigor that come with that ownership structure.

AS the Controller, you will have responsibility for:

  • Own the monthly close process, including journal entries, account reconciliations, and preparation of financial statements
  • Lead treasury and cash management, including cash positioning and bank relationships
  • Own payroll end to end, including processing, compliance, and recordkeeping
  • Lead and mentor a Senior Accountant and a Payroll Specialist, providing review and development support
  • Serve as the organization's NetSuite subject matter expert, maintaining data integrity and troubleshooting system issues
  • Support an active NetSuite systems stabilization effort, including entity structure cleanup and intercompany elimination processes
  • Lead audit preparation and serve as a primary point of contact for external auditors
  • Identify and implement process improvements to increase close efficiency and reporting accuracy, with a goal of driving toward a 10 business day close
  • Maintain and strengthen internal controls across accounting functions
  • Support intercompany accounting and reconciliations across multiple entities
  • Support tax compliance and reporting, including coordination with external tax preparers on income tax provisions, multi-state filings, and any sales/use tax obligations across entities
  • Partner with the CFO on ad hoc financial analysis, technical accounting questions, lender and investor reporting, and special projects
  • Assist with policy documentation and standardization of accounting procedures

Experience

  • BA and CPA required
  • 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 2 years in a Controller or Assistant Controller capacity
  • Hands on NetSuite experience strongly preferred
  • Experience owning or closely overseeing payroll processing, including compliance, recordkeeping, and payroll tax knowledge
  • Strong technical accounting knowledge (GAAP) with demonstrated experience preparing financial statements
  • Experience managing or mentoring staff
  • Prior experience supporting external audits and preparing audit ready documentation
  • Experience in a private equity backed or investor reported environment strongly preferred
  • Healthcare, behavioral health, or multi site services industry experience a plus, including familiarity with multi payer, multi state revenue considerations
  • Track record of improving or building accounting processes, not just executing existing ones
  • Strong communication skills and comfort operating with some ambiguity in a lean finance team
Salary: $150,000 - $160,000

Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. · Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LICSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Our medical staff and clinical psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Full-time clinicians are eligible for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Licensure in Massachusetts as a Psychiatric Nurse Practitioner with experience working with persons who have various behavioral health issues such as, mood disorders, anxiety disorders, personality disorders, substance misuse, and other psychiatric impairments under the supervision of a consulting psychiatrist(s).  We welcome new graduates!

Preferred: Successful completion of PMHNP-BC exam(s).

In this role, you’ll be responsible for translating garment designs, technical specifications, measurements, and approved samples into accurate, production-ready sewing patterns.

You’ll directly report to our Sourcing Manager and work closely with our internal Design and Ops teams, as well as overseas garment manufacturers, to ensure patterns meet fit, construction, measurement, grading, and production requirements. You’ll also help troubleshoot pattern and construction issues during sampling and production, ensuring garments can be manufactured accurately and consistently at scale.

You’ll grow as Fresh Prints grows. You’ll get the support, ownership, and development opportunities needed to learn quickly, grow professionally, and make a meaningful impact.

Responsibilities

  • Develop accurate, production-ready sewing patterns based on technical specifications, measurements, design references, technical drawings, and approved samples.
  • Create and maintain pattern grading across required size ranges, ensuring consistent and proportional fit.
  • Review samples and fitting results and make pattern adjustments to address fit, measurement, and construction issues.
  • Apply knowledge of different fabric types, including woven, knit, stretch, lace, and elastic materials, to ensure patterns are suitable for the intended fabric and construction.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and manufacturers to troubleshoot pattern, fit, sewing, and construction issues during sampling and production.
  • Interpret technical packs, measurement specifications, construction details, sketches, and approved samples and translate them into production-ready patterns.
  • Maintain accurate pattern files, revisions, measurements, and technical documentation, ensuring manufacturers are always working with the correct versions.
  • Prepare and share digital pattern files and relevant technical information with manufacturing partners for production.
  • Communicate asynchronously with overseas manufacturers to clarify pattern and construction requirements and resolve production issues.
  • Identify opportunities to improve pattern development, sampling, and production processes.
  • The unknown - we're always looking for new ways to improve, and we want you to take ownership of projects you believe can create value.

Technical Skills

  • Ideally 3+ years of experience in garment pattern making, preferably within an apparel manufacturing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of garment construction, fitting, measurements, grading, and pattern development.
  • Experience creating production-ready patterns for sewn garments.
  • Proficiency in CAD pattern-making software such as Gerber AccuMark, Lectra, Optitex, or similar systems.
  • Experience with digital pattern grading and pattern modification.
  • Strong understanding of different fabric types and how fabric characteristics affect pattern development, fit, and construction.
  • Ability to interpret technical packs, measurement specifications, construction details, sketches, and approved samples.
  • Experience with apparel sampling and fitting is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with women streetwear apparel is a strong advantage.
  • Familiarity with 3D apparel software such as CLO3D or Browzwear is a plus.
  • Comfortable working with digital files and maintaining organized pattern documentation.

Essential Requirements

  • Strong understanding of garment construction and the ability to identify and resolve pattern-related production issues.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in measurements and pattern development.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple pattern development projects simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with manufacturers and internal stakeholders in a remote environment.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working with limited supervision.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage revisions, deadlines, and multiple garment styles.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable work-from-home setup.
  • Willingness to work remotely with teams and manufacturers across different time zones.

Job Location: Work From Home / Remote

Working Hours: 1:00 PM to 10:00 PM Philippine Time, Monday to Friday

Monthly Salary: Starting at $1000 base per month, depending on experience

At Fresh Prints, we deeply value the long-term contributions of our team. To recognize and celebrate that commitment, we offer a 2-month paid Sabbatical to eligible employees.

Fresh Prints never charges any money during the hiring process. If you’re asked to pay for a job, it’s not real.

Senior Director/ Executive Director, Small Molecule Process Chemistry

Reports To: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

Location: Global (China, Europe and US) 

Employment Type: Full-Time

The Senior Director/Executive Director, Small Molecule Process Chemistryserves as a senior scientific and strategic leader responsible for strengthening Asymchem's global small molecule development capabilities and technical competencies.
This role provides scientific leadership across process chemistry, CMC strategy, technology transfer, manufacturing readiness, commercialization, and regulatory support.

Key Responsibilities

1. Scientific & Technical Leadership

  • Serve as a senior scientific leader and advisor for small molecule API development programs across all development phases, from early development through commercialization.
  • Provide strategic guidance on route scouting, route selection, process optimization, impurity control strategies, crystallization development, and scale-up activities.
  • Lead scientific reviews and risk assessments for challenging synthetic routes and development programs.
  • Support development of robust, scalable, cost-effective, and environmentally sustainable manufacturing processes.
  • Apply advanced expertise in synthetic organic chemistry, catalytic reactions, asymmetric synthesis, process intensification, and enabling technologies.
  • Advise executive leadership on scientific trends, technical investments, and capability expansion opportunities.

2. CMC Strategy & Regulatory Leadership

  • Provide strategic oversight for Drug Substance (DS) CMC development activities.
  • Guide preparation, review, and quality of regulatory submissions, including INDs, NDAs, IMPDs, and global registration dossiers.
  • Support development of phase-appropriate control strategies and lifecycle management plans.
  • Provide expertise in regulatory expectations related to process development, validation, impurity management, and manufacturing control.
  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Analytical Development, and Manufacturing teams to ensure alignment of development and commercialization strategies.

3. TechnologyTransferandCommercialization

  • Advise project teams on commercial route selection, manufacturing readiness, and long-term supply strategies.
  • Support process scale-up, engineering runs, process validation, and commercial launch preparation.
  • Guide technology transfer activities between development and manufacturing organizations across global sites.
  • Promote Quality-by-Design (QbD), risk assessment, and science-based decision-making throughout development.
  • Facilitate collaboration among process chemistry, analytical sciences, engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply organizations.

4. Advanced Impurity & Risk Management Leadership

  • Serve as a scientific resource for mutagenic impurity control strategies and nitrosamine risk assessments.
  • Support internal teams and clients in developing scientifically sound approaches for impurity identification, risk evaluation, mitigation, and regulatory communication.
  • Establish best practices aligned with evolving global regulatory expectations for impurity control and lifecycle management.
  • Contribute to scientific governance related to process safety, product quality, and regulatory compliance.

5. Platform Strategy & Innovation

  • Contribute to the strategic growth and evolution of Asymchem's global small molecule platform.
  • Identify emerging technologies, scientific approaches, and operational capabilities that enhance competitiveness and execution excellence.
  • Support implementation of innovative technologies, including flow chemistry, biocatalysis, automation, digital development tools, advanced process analytics, and manufacturing sciences.
  • Drive harmonization of best practices across development, scale-up, and commercialization activities.

6. Global Technical Integration

  • Promote scientific and operational alignment between U.S., Europeand China development organizations.
  • Establish consistent approaches to process development, technology transfer, technical documentation, and scientific decision-making.
  • Support technical governance and portfolio reviews for strategic programs.
  • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration among global stakeholders.

7. Client-Facing Scientific Leadership

  • Represent Asymchem as a senior scientific leader during client interactions, technical reviews, and strategic discussions.
  • Provide technical assessments related to development feasibility, manufacturing strategy, regulatory risks, and commercialization planning.
  • Partner with Business Development and Project Management teams to strengthen proposals, technical narratives, and differentiated service offerings.
  • Participate in technical due diligence activities and support evaluation of strategic business opportunities.
  • Serve as an executive-level scientific representative during key client meetings and audits.

8. Organizational Development & Mentorship

  • Mentor senior scientists, technical leaders, and project teams across the organization.
  • Contribute to succession planning and capability-building initiatives in process chemistry, CMC, manufacturing sciences, and technology transfer.
  • Support technical training programs and scientific excellence initiatives.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Technical Expertise

  • Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry, Process Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related scientific disciplines.
  • 15-20+ years of experience in pharmaceutical or CDMO process development and CMC leadership.
  • Demonstrated an excellenttrack record of advancing small molecule programs from early development through regulatory approval and commercial launch.
  • Expertise in process chemistry, scale-up, impurity control, crystallization, technology transfer, and process validation.
  • Deep understanding of global regulatory requirements supporting IND, NDA, and commercial product lifecycle management.
  • Recognized expertise in mutagenic impurity and nitrosamine risk management is highly desirable.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary development teams supporting global development and manufacturing operations.
  • Ability to operate effectively across global organizations and time zones.
  • Willingness to travel internationally as business needs require (approximately 25–35%).
  • Mandarin proficiency is a plus, but not required.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

Support accounts payable operations across multiple hotel and corporate entities, including invoice verification and coding, vendor administration, payment processing, reconciliations, AP aging and supplier inquiry resolution.

Job Details

Work Setup: Work from home

Shift/Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

Holidays: U.S. corporate holiday calendar

Responsibilities

  • Process and review high-volume invoices, research duplicate invoices, missing approvals, verify supporting purchase orders and approvals, and assign accurate chart-of-accounts distributions.
  • Maintain vendor data, support creation and updates of suppliers, and investigate duplicate or inactive vendor records.
  • Support AP payment runs, electronic payments, wires, returned checks, stale-dated/voided checks and returned funds as assigned.
  • Reconcile vendor statements, corporate AP items and high-value vendor balances, resolving credits and outstanding differences.
  • Monitor accounts payable aging, process supplier inquiries and respond to AP tickets, including outstanding and escalated matters.
  • Prepare or support AP accruals, payment registers, payment status reports and month-end close documentation.
  • Handle specialized invoice and adjustment workflows such as capital expenditures, insurance, expense reimbursements and sold-property invoices as assigned.
  • Coordinate with hotel and corporate finance colleagues to maintain payment controls, accurate allocations and timely resolution.

Qualifications

  • At least 3 years of accounts payable experience, including invoice processing, general ledger coding and issue resolution or reconciliation.
  • Knowledge of chart-of-accounts allocations and experience with ERP-based accounts payable workflows.
  • Understanding of the procure-to-pay cycle, basic financial controls and vendor communication.
  • Strong Excel, analytics, organization, attention to detail, follow-up and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to follow established controls, manage deadlines, and recognize matters requiring escalation.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Yardi
  • Vendor master setup/maintenance, vendor statement reconciliations, complex AP aging and exception handling.
  • Payment runs, bank wires, virtual card processes, vendor portals or corporate AP month-end reporting.

jobs.description:
Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC/LMHC) 62K-80K/yr

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary:

62K - 80K+

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $62,000 – $80,000 / year

jobs.title: Salesforce Technical Lead
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT THE ROLEFundingo is a loan servicing platform built natively on Salesforce.
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Fundingo is a loan servicing platform built natively on Salesforce. Our customers are lenders and loan servicers who use Fundingo to run their day-to-day operations. Our delivery team works directly with those customers, building custom implementations, integrations, and data migrations that fit Fundingo to how each customer runs their business.

As a Salesforce Technical Lead, you'll set the technical direction for our delivery projects. You'll make the architecture decisions, own our Git-based development process and code standards, review the team's code, and direct the work of the Salesforce developers on each project. You'll also take part in internal strategy discussions and join sales conversations with prospective clients who need integration expertise.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, with development in Apex and Lightning Web Components as the primary focus. You’ll also lead technical design, review code, and guide developers on assigned delivery projects. The balance will vary based on project complexity and team needs.

You'll direct the developers' work on your projects, but this isn't a people-management role: developers don't report to you, and you won't handle things like time-off requests. It is also not an admin or configuration role.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Architecture and technical direction

  • Own the technical design for delivery projects, including automation, integration patterns, and how custom work extends Fundingo without fighting it. Document and communicate these designs so the team and the customer can understand them.
  • Choose the right tool for each requirement, whether that's Apex, Flow, Lightning Web Components, or configuration, and know when not to write code.
  • Weigh speed, scalability, and maintainability against each other, and communicate these considerations to the team.
  • Design integrations with outside systems like payment processors, accounting systems, and document providers that are reliable and easy to support.

Development process and code quality

  • Own the Git-based development workflow for delivery projects, including branching, pull requests, merge rules, and deployment practices, aligned with Fundingo’s company-wide engineering standards.
  • Use and enforce our company's coding standards, naming conventions, and design patterns, and make sure the implementation team follows them.
  • Review pull requests for correctness, security, performance, test quality, and fit with the design. Your feedback should help developers grow, not just get their code merged.

Team leadership and communication

  • Lead the developers' work on each project by assigning and sequencing tasks, pairing with them, unblocking them, and helping them improve their design and debugging skills.
  • Work with the Implementation Specialists and Business Analysts to break customer requirements into well-scoped work, and help project managers estimate, plan, and sequence it.
  • Raise the technical skill level of Fundingo’s developers and Salesforce admins through code reviews, pairing, best-practice guidance, and knowledge sharing.
  • Lead technical discovery and design sessions with customers. Turn business requirements into technical designs, and explain constraints, options, and tradeoffs in plain language.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for customers' IT teams and outside vendors on integrations, data migrations, and escalations.
  • Support sales and leadership by joining conversations with prospective clients about integrations and complex requirements, and by bringing a technical perspective to internal strategy discussions.

Hands-on development and delivery

  • Build scalable and performant implementations using Apex, Lightning Web Components, and other Salesforce tools.
  • Plan and oversee data migrations from legacy systems, including mapping, transformation, validation, and cutover.
  • Lead troubleshooting of production issues in customer orgs using debug logs and customer reports.
  • Support technical go-live readiness, including deployment plans, release coordination, and post-launch documentation.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Required

  • 5 or more years of hands-on Salesforce development with Apex, SOQL, and Lightning Web Components.
  • 2 or more years leading the technical work of other developers on a project team, including assigning and reviewing their work and guiding design decisions.
  • Experience leading the technical side of customer-facing Salesforce projects, from discovery and design through go-live.
  • A track record of making and defending architecture decisions on Salesforce projects using established patterns, such as trigger frameworks and service, selector, and domain layers.
  • Strong command of Salesforce DX, source-tracked development, and sandbox strategy.
  • Expert knowledge of Git, plus experience setting up and enforcing a branching and pull request workflow for one or more development teams.
  • Extensive code review experience and a clear, well-reasoned point of view on code quality, standards, and testing.
  • Mastery of governor limits, bulkification, and performance tuning.
  • Excellent communication skills. You speak clearly and confidently with engineers, project managers, executives, prospective clients, and non-technical business users.
