At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Vice President, Major Accounts/Vice President Sales is a senior sales leader responsible for driving revenue growth through the acquisition of new national accounts and the expansion of existing major and strategic customer relationships. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, this role will lead the strategy and execution of Smart Care Solutions’ enterprise and national account sales initiatives, with direct accountability for developing new business, increasing share of wallet within existing customers, and securing long-term strategic partnerships.

This leader will identify, pursue, and close high-value commercial opportunities with large, multi-location organizations, including quick-service restaurants (QSR), full-service restaurants (FSR), and other customers with significant commercial foodservice equipment service needs. The role will develop executive-level customer relationships, lead complex sales pursuits and negotiations, and collaborate with operations and other internal stakeholders to deliver scalable, profitable service solutions.

As a key member of the commercial organization, the Vice President, Major Accounts will partner closely with the Chief Revenue Officer to execute growth priorities, strengthen Smart Care Solutions’ national market position, and deliver measurable results in revenue, account expansion, new customer acquisition, and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Strategy and Revenue Growth

  • Partner with the Chief Revenue Officer to develop and execute strategies for acquiring new national accounts and expanding existing major customer relationships.
  • Translate commercial growth objectives into actionable sales plans, account strategies, and measurable performance targets.
  • Own the major and national account sales pipeline, ensuring a consistent flow of qualified opportunities and disciplined execution from prospecting through contract close.
  • Identify new markets, customer segments, and strategic opportunities that align with Smart Care Solutions’ capabilities and growth priorities.
  • Develop strategies to increase revenue, service penetration, contract value, and profitability across targeted accounts.
  • Provide the CRO with regular updates on sales performance, pipeline health, forecasted revenue, competitive activity, and progress against growth objectives.

National Account Acquisition and Business Development

  • Lead the pursuit and acquisition of high-value national and enterprise customers, with a focus on large, multi-location restaurant groups, QSR and FSR brands, franchise organizations, and other strategic commercial customers.
  • Develop and execute targeted prospecting strategies to engage senior decision-makers and build relationships with prospective national accounts.
  • Personally lead complex sales opportunities, including discovery, solution development, presentations, proposals, commercial negotiations, and contract execution.
  • Build a sustainable pipeline of strategic opportunities through executive networking, industry relationships, referrals, market intelligence, and proactive business development.
  • Position Smart Care Solutions as a preferred service partner by demonstrating the value of its service capabilities, geographic reach, technical expertise, and ability to support customers across multiple locations.
  • Establish and maintain relationships with senior executives, procurement leaders, facilities executives, and operations decision-makers at targeted organizations.

Major Account Expansion and Strategic Growth

  • Drive incremental revenue within existing major accounts by expanding service agreements, increasing service penetration, and securing business across additional locations, regions, brands, and business units.
  • Develop strategic growth plans for key accounts, identifying opportunities to increase customer value, strengthen relationships, and capture additional business.
  • Lead executive-level business reviews focused on account performance, customer priorities, service opportunities, and future growth.
  • Identify opportunities to expand the scope of existing agreements and develop broader, long-term commercial partnerships.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to address customer needs, resolve escalated commercial issues, and protect account retention and profitability.

Commercial Negotiations and Account Economics

  • Lead complex national account negotiations, including pricing, contract terms, service-level commitments, and multi-location agreements.
  • Develop commercially sound proposals that balance customer requirements, competitive positioning, service delivery capabilities, and profitability.
  • Partner with finance and operations to evaluate deal economics, pricing assumptions, implementation requirements, and financial risks before committing to significant customer agreements.
  • Ensure national account opportunities meet established financial and commercial objectives.
  • Maintain executive-level relationships throughout the sales process and serve as a senior commercial representative for Smart Care Solutions.

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Partner with operations, regional leadership, service delivery, finance, and other internal teams to develop solutions that can be executed consistently across the required geographic footprint.
  • Align customer commitments with operational capabilities, technician capacity, service coverage, and implementation requirements.
  • Coordinate internal resources to support national account onboarding, service expansion, and successful execution of customer agreements.
  • Provide customer and market insights to the CRO and broader leadership team to inform commercial planning and business development priorities.

Sales Performance and Accountability

  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators for new account acquisition, revenue growth, existing account expansion, pipeline development, sales conversion, and profitability.
  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts and communicate risks, opportunities, and expected results to the CRO.
  • Evaluate performance against established objectives and implement strategies to address gaps in pipeline coverage, conversion, or account growth.
  • Develop scalable sales processes and best practices for national account prospecting, strategic selling, negotiation, and account expansion.
  • Deliver measurable results against agreed-upon commercial objectives and contribute to Smart Care Solutions’ overall revenue growth strategy.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience will be considered.
  • 10+ years of progressive sales experience, including leadership responsibility for major accounts, enterprise sales, national account acquisition, or strategic business development.
  • Demonstrated success personally winning large, complex accounts and generating meaningful revenue growth.
  • Proven ability to expand existing customer relationships while consistently developing new business opportunities.
  • Experience selling business-to-business services, service agreements, facilities services, commercial equipment services, or other solutions to large enterprise customers strongly preferred.
  • Experience serving multi-location customers in the restaurant, foodservice, hospitality, facilities management, commercial equipment, or field service industries is advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships with C-suite executives and senior decision-makers and lead complex commercial negotiations.
  • Strong financial and commercial acumen, including pricing strategy, contract profitability, forecasting, and pipeline management.
  • Experience collaborating with operations and other cross-functional teams to develop and execute commercially viable customer solutions.
  • Strong executive communication, strategic planning, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Willingness to travel as required to support customer development, executive relationships, and national account growth.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Sales Leadership: Converts commercial objectives into focused sales strategies and measurable business results.
  • Hunter Mentality: Proactively identifies, pursues, and closes high-value new business opportunities.
  • Enterprise Account Growth: Expands strategic relationships, increases service penetration, and grows long-term account value.
  • Executive Influence: Establishes credibility with senior customer leaders and internal executives.
  • Commercial Acumen: Balances revenue growth, pricing, customer value, and profitability.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Aligns internal teams to deliver customer commitments and profitable growth.
  • Accountability and Execution: Maintains disciplined pipeline management, forecasting, and consistent delivery against targets.

Measures of Success

  • Revenue generated from newly acquired national and strategic accounts.
  • Revenue growth and increased service penetration within existing major accounts.
  • Growth in qualified national account pipeline and conversion of opportunities into executed agreements.
  • Contract profitability and contribution to overall commercial objectives.
  • Expansion of Smart Care Solutions’ relationships with large, multi-location customers.
  • Strength of executive-level customer relationships and long-term account retention.
  • Accuracy of sales forecasting and consistent achievement of agreed-upon growth targets.

About Smart Care

Smart Care is a national repair and service provider for commercial foodservice, refrigeration, and cold storage equipment. Our offering of comprehensive mechanical services includes hot side cooking equipment, stand-alone refrigeration, specialty coffee and beverage, complex rack refrigeration and HVAC.

jobs.description:
At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.
The Privacy Program Optimization Manager is responsible for the engagement health and realized value of Bluesight's PrivacyPro customer portfolio. PrivacyPro helps health systems detect and investigate inappropriate access to patient records, but the product only delivers value when privacy teams actively work their cases, tune their monitoring, and embed PrivacyPro into their compliance workflows. This role exists to make sure that happens across every account, not just the ones that ask for help.

You will own the full book of business at the cohort level: monitoring engagement and program performance across all PrivacyPro customers, identifying accounts drifting toward disengagement before they become renewal risks, and directing the right resource (yourself, a Professional Services specialist, or a Customer Success Manager) to get them back on track. You will also build and run the reporting cadence that keeps our internal teams aligned, including a recurring executive summary and regular updates to CSMs on their accounts.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with hands-on experience running or supporting a healthcare privacy or compliance program. Credentials such as CHPC, CHC, CIPP/US, or RHIA are highly desirable. You can balance portfolio-level oversight with hands-on customer work, and you are comfortable being the subject matter expert in the room with a privacy officer, a compliance investigator, or a chief compliance officer.

Core Responsibilities

    Portfolio & Cohort Management: Own engagement health across the full PrivacyPro customer base. Maintain a portfolio view of which accounts are actively working the product, which are drifting, and which need intervention, and make sure every at-risk account has a named owner and a plan.
    Engagement Metrics & Reporting: Define and maintain the PrivacyPro engagement scorecard (e.g., case review activity, alert response and closure rates, active user trends, workflow adherence). Publish a recurring executive flash summarizing portfolio health, and send regular account-level updates to CSMs so nothing surprises them at renewal.
    Proactive Account Intervention: For accounts missing the mark, run the play: diagnose the gap, re-engage the customer directly or deploy the right internal expert, and establish recurring touchpoints (monthly calls, best-practice reviews) until the account is back on track.
    Professional Services Orchestration: Direct traffic for the privacy Professional Services team's flexible capacity. Proactively scope and assign timeboxed engagements (workflow reviews, case investigation support, privacy health checkups) against the accounts that need them most, alongside the existing CSM-initiated request channel.
    CS & Sales Enablement: Arm CSMs and Account Managers with engagement and adoption context ahead of QBRs, EBRs, and renewal conversations. Flag accounts that are healthy enough for expansion conversations, and be honest about the ones that are not.
    Best Practices & Thought Leadership: Develop and maintain the PrivacyPro Engagement Playbook covering cadences, intervention plays, and communication templates. Lead webinars and customer-facing content that raise the bar on privacy program maturity across the customer base.
    Voice of the Customer: Represent privacy program challenges, workflow friction, and adoption gaps to Product and Engineering, particularly where they affect renewal or expansion risk.

Qualifications

    Education & Credentials

  • Bachelor's degree in health information management, healthcare administration, compliance, or a related field.
  • CHPC, CHC, CIPP/US, or RHIA credentials strongly preferred. Active involvement in privacy and compliance communities (e.g., AHIMA, HCCA) is a plus.

    • Experience

  • 5+ years in healthcare privacy, compliance, or health information management within a hospital or health system.
  • Direct experience running, supporting, or auditing a healthcare privacy program, including access monitoring, breach investigation, and HIPAA compliance workflows.
  • Familiarity with patient privacy monitoring technology, EHR audit logs and access controls, and HIPAA/HITECH regulatory requirements preferred.
  • Experience in customer engagement, account management, or implementation within healthcare or hospital systems.

    • Skills & Competencies

  • Proven ability to build credible relationships with privacy officers, compliance leaders, and health information management teams while delivering measurable value.
  • Strong data analysis skills: comfortable defining metrics, reading engagement dashboards, and turning trends into intervention plans.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills for both customer-facing and executive audiences.
  • Ability to manage a portfolio of accounts and competing priorities while maintaining high attention to detail.

Why Join Us

    Patient privacy violations erode trust, expose health systems to regulatory and legal risk, and harm the patients whose records are compromised, and most privacy programs are under-resourced for the volume of access they need to monitor. In this role you will directly raise the effectiveness of privacy monitoring across a national portfolio of health systems while shaping how Bluesight scales proactive customer engagement across its product lines. You will work alongside privacy SME-led Professional Services experts, an established Customer Success organization, and a proven engagement playbook already delivering results in our CostCheck business.
This position is open to applicants in the continental United States.

Why Bluesight?

Bluesight’s culture is built on innovation and teamwork. There’s room to grow and opportunities to take initiative. You will partner with sharp, motivated teammates looking to disrupt a massive industry—and have fun doing it. We truly believe that where you work and what you do matters. Join us as we revolutionize the hospital pharmacy landscape!

This role partners closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering leaders to translate strategic objectives into pragmatic, scalable, and maintainable technology solutions that align with enterprise architecture standards. Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC) $60K-$85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Prattville, AL

Salary:

60K - 85K+

Work from Home! Competitive, negotiable salary! Work/life balance! Leadership and advancement opportunities!

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With two convenient locations in Colorado and growing, OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and work-site location(s). Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available location. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW) in the state of Colorado with the ability to practice independently is required.

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $60,000 – $85,000 / year

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Join a leading clinician-led behavioral health company today! OptiMindHealth (OMH) is expanding and seeking compassionate psychotherapists to join our team and work remotely from the comfort of their home. Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

· Remote work environment

  • No extra "on call" work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s "work from home" and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients form the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if your prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Responsibilities:

The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional "on-call" responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Interested in benefits?

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

Leadership & Advancement:

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW/LMHC) in the state of Georgia is required, with the ability to practice independently.

Licensure in the state(s) of Massachusetts and Colorado preferred.

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

About Modular Solutions

Founded in 2015, Modular Solutions delivers enterprise-grade technology to the insurance industry. Our integrated platform enables insurers, mutuals, MGAs, and brokers to manage core operations through a single, highly configurable system. Designed for flexibility and long-term growth, our platform supports organizations operating in complex and regulated environments.

Position Summary

We are hiring several Software Developers across our product and platform teams. This posting spans intermediate to senior levels. Final level and team placement will be determined during the interview process based on demonstrated experience, strengths, and business needs.

AI is now a standard part of modern software development. At Modular Solutions, we expect engineers to be comfortable using generative AI tools as part of their daily workflow and to apply strong judgment when reviewing and validating outputs.

Some team members will focus on building production-grade AI-powered capabilities, including LLM integrations and retrieval-based workflows. Others will build core platform features that integrate with and extend these AI services. All developers are expected to collaborate across teams and contribute to high-quality, scalable systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate in an Agile Scrum environment, including sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to deliver features that drive measurable business value.
  • Participate in full SDLC activities, including research, estimation, proofs of concept, code reviews, deployments, and documentation.
  • Write high-quality, performant, testable, and maintainable code.
  • Maintain and develop robust backend systems and REST APIs using .NET Core and Entity Framework, with a strong emphasis on scalability, configurability, and clean service boundaries.
  • Build responsive, user-friendly applications using React and TypeScript.
  • Design and implement extensible integration patterns that enable seamless connectivity with third-party systems and services.
  • Design, build, and operate scalable, cloud-native systems on Azure with a focus on reliability, performance, and observability.
  • Contribute to a domain-driven architecture where flexibility, versioning, extensibility, and long-term maintainability are core design principles.
  • Design, build, and maintain clean, well-documented, production-grade APIs intended for public or partner consumption. This includes thoughtful versioning strategies, backward compatibility considerations, and API lifecycle management.
  • Contribute to AI-powered features where appropriate, including LLM-based workflows and retrieval-driven functionality.
  • Use and evaluate AI developer tooling, including Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, and similar tools as part of daily development workflows. We support flexibility and allow developers to use tools and environments that help them work effectively while maintaining engineering standards.

Required Qualifications

  • A degree, diploma, or certificate in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.
  • 3 or more years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong experience with C# and .NET Core.
  • Experience building modern front-end applications using React and TypeScript.
  • Strong understanding of software design principles, patterns, and clean architecture practices.
  • Comfortable using generative AI developer tools to improve productivity and quality while applying sound engineering judgment and validation practices.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing modular, extensible systems in complex, domain-driven applications where business logic is dynamic and highly configurable.
  • Experience designing clean, maintainable APIs with thoughtful versioning and long-term evolution in mind.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure.
  • Experience building production LLM-powered systems, including retrieval augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, and agent-style workflows.
  • Familiarity with modern AI orchestration and agent frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar tooling.
  • Experience integrating LLM systems into production applications with attention to observability, evaluation, guardrails, and performance considerations.
  • Familiarity with the insurance industry or other complex, regulated business domains is an asset.

Our Technology Stack and Architecture

We primarily build using C# and .NET Core on the backend, with Entity Framework and PostgreSQL for data persistence. Our front-end applications are built with React and TypeScript. We leverage Azure for cloud infrastructure and operate in a service-oriented architecture with well-defined boundaries and clean API contracts.

Our systems are designed around modular, highly configurable components rather than tightly coupled implementations. We emphasize separation of concerns, clean code practices, and maintainable service boundaries. As the platform evolves, we prioritize scalability, observability, and long-term architectural integrity.

Why Join Modular Solutions

We are building a long-term platform in a complex industry. That means solving real architectural problems and delivering software that customers depend on every day. We value engineers who take pride in their work, write clean and well-tested code, and take the time to build things the right way. If you care about quality, reliability, and long-term maintainability, you will find meaningful work here.

We operate as a distributed team, with a preference for Alberta-based employees. We collaborate daily across product, engineering, and domain experts, and we come together periodically for in-person planning and team events. We value autonomy, accountability, and engineers who take ownership of their work.

You will be joining a team that treats software development as a craft, embraces modern tooling, including AI-assisted workflows, and takes pride in building production-grade systems the right way.

What We Offer

  • Be part of a growing company building a modern, enterprise-grade platform for the insurance industry.
  • Work alongside experienced insurance and technology professionals in a collaborative environment.
  • Flexible remote work environment, with a preference for Alberta-based team members, and periodic in-person planning sessions and team events.
  • Extended health, dental, and vision benefits.
  • Access to an Employee and Family Assistance Program.
  • Annual professional development allowance.
  • Additional paid time off beyond standard statutory holidays and vacation.
  • Recognition for meaningful contributions and career milestones.
  • Share Appreciation Rights program so you participate in the company’s long-term success.

To Apply

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience and what excites you about this opportunity. We thank all applicants for their interest; only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

We’re looking for a Talent Community Experience Manager to lead the programs, operations, and engagement strategies that support We Are Rosie’s diverse and inclusive community of independent marketing professionals.

This is a full-time position that can work from anywhere within the United States and will report directly to the Head of Rosie Experience.

This role is focused on building and operating scalable programs that keep our talent community engaged, informed, prepared for opportunities, and connected to the value of being a Rosie. It goes beyond traditional community management, with a focus on the programs, operations, and experiences that support our talent throughout their journey with We Are Rosie.

You’ll own programs and touchpoints across the talent lifecycle — from onboarding and ongoing engagement to learning cohorts, talent readiness, re-engagement, segmentation, and platform experience. You’ll use community signals and data to understand where engagement is strong, where gaps exist, and what programs, communications, or experiences can better support both our talent and business needs.

This role operates at the intersection of talent engagement, community experience, program management, operations, and data. You’ll work closely across Product, Data, Client Experience, Business Development, and Marketing, while overseeing the Community Learning function as part of the broader talent community experience.

Responsibilities

Community Engagement & Experience

  • Own and evolve the Rosie Community experience across onboarding, communications, engagement programs, and ongoing touchpoints, creating a consistent and high-quality talent journey at scale.
  • Maintain and evolve community value proposition messaging across onboarding, communications, and engagement materials based on member feedback and business needs.
  • Build and manage scalable, tiered engagement programs designed around the needs and behaviors of different talent segments.
  • Monitor community engagement and talent segmentation to identify changes in readiness, engagement, and alignment with current opportunities.
  • Develop structured nurture journeys that move talent through defined stages of engagement and readiness.
  • Design and launch re-engagement strategies for dormant or low-engagement talent and measure their effectiveness.
  • Own day-to-day community platform operations and support platform transitions or migrations in partnership with relevant teams, maintaining continuity in communication and setting clear expectations throughout periods of change.
  • Partner with Marketing to develop and distribute audience-appropriate content and communications, providing context around talent segments and their journeys.
  • Own the existing community support model, identifying recurring themes, triaging unresolved issues, and routing persistent gaps to the appropriate teams.

Talent Readiness & Enablement

  • Oversee the end-to-end delivery of Community Learning programs, including course and cohort calendars, logistics, communications, enrollment, and operations, in partnership with the Program Manager, Community Learning.
  • Manage cohort programs day to day, including milestones, enrollment, delivery logistics, communications, and outcome tracking.
  • Own credentialing and talent-signaling processes, ensuring relevant readiness indicators remain current and visible to client-facing teams.
  • Manage logistics and administrative follow-through for approved learning partnerships and provide operational input during evaluation.
  • Help ensure learning programs and positioning remain aligned with active client demand, surfacing gaps or opportunities for strategic review.

Portal Engagement & Experience

  • Serve as a key Community voice into Product, representing talent needs, experiences, and engagement insights in roadmap discussions.
  • Maintain visibility into portal data quality, workflow friction, and engagement gaps and clearly document findings for Product partners.
  • Provide operational and community insights as Product evaluates new tools, integrations, learning resources, and AI-enabled workflows designed to improve the talent experience.

Talent Intelligence

  • Serve as a bridge between data and business stakeholders, helping ensure community and talent insights are understood and actionable.
  • Translate completed analysis from Data partners into clear narratives, recommendations, and potential actions.
  • Connect talent and engagement data to opportunities for improving community programming, readiness, communications, and experience.
  • Distribute relevant talent intelligence and operational context to Client Experience, Business Development, and other key stakeholders.

Cross-Functional Responsibilities

  • Surface talent supply gaps, engagement trends, and emerging community needs to key stakeholders.
  • Track and report progress against quarterly goals, identifying blockers, trends, and trade-offs that require leadership visibility or decision-making.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive program and community workflows and partner with the appropriate teams to scope and implement solutions.
  • Partner closely with Marketing to align communications with talent segmentation, priority roles, supply gaps, and community journeys.
  • Work cross-functionally across Product, Data, Client Experience, Business Development, and Marketing to ensure talent programs support broader business priorities.

Requirements

  • Passion for community-building and creating experiences that feel human.
  • 5+ years of experience in talent community programs, community operations, member experience, talent engagement, program management, or a similar role supporting a professional or workforce-based community.
  • Demonstrated experience owning scalable engagement or lifecycle programs for a professional, talent, member, or marketplace community, including segmentation, communications, re-engagement, and program measurement.
  • 2+ years of experience in cohort-based program management, learning operations, or course/bootcamp delivery, including enrollment, milestones, logistics, communications, and learning calendars end-to-end.
  • Experience managing community or member programs and supporting engagement across different audience segments.
  • Experience leading a platform migration, tool transition, or other significant change-management initiative within a community or member base.
  • Comfortable representing member or user needs to Product teams and translating feedback into clear, actionable input.
  • Comfortable taking completed data analysis from a Data partner and translating it into a clear narrative and actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create community member-facing communications, stakeholder updates, and internal documentation in a brand-aligned and authentic voice.
  • Strong organizational and program-management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • High emotional intelligence and a demonstrated ability to build trust and strong relationships.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment while maintaining a thoughtful, consistent, and high-quality experience.
  • Proactive problem-solving skills and a collaborative mindset.
  • Alignment with We Are Rosie’s core values.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using community and collaboration platforms such as Discord.
  • Experience with learning management systems, particularly Moodle.
  • People management experience, including experience leading, managing, or coordinating employees, contractors, moderators, or other program support resources.
  • Practical experience leveraging automation, agentic workflows, or AI-enabled tools to optimize workflows and improve efficiency.

Perks & Benefits

A yearly stipend for professional and personal development; 25 PTO days + 4 Volunteer PTO days per year; medical, dental, and vision insurance; paid parental leave; remote work stipend; matching 401K; and an opportunity to join a truly incredible team at a company that is building the future of work.

OUR VALUES

Treat People Like People - Seeing the value in all people’s unique lives, experiences, and perspectives is what drives us.

Start With Why - Asking “Why” makes our team curious first so we get to better solutions. When we make a decision, we take the time to explain the “Why”’ behind our actions. Transparency is clear and it’s kind.

Speak With Actions - Trust isn’t given, it’s earned. We prove our reliability and trustworthiness to each other, our clients, and our Rosies by showing up and doing what we say we will — through small interactions and big moves.

Bring Tenacity - The path isn’t always an easy one, but our team chooses to be unwavering in our goal. We’re resilient, determined, and stubborn when necessary. That’s the fire it takes to get things done.

Make it Better - From changing old processes to disrupting the marketing industry, we know there is room to make it better. We strive to find those improvements and push them to reality.

With two convenient locations in Colorado and growing, OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and work-site location(s). The psychotherapist will participate in the integrated care team model at OMH. Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Individual psychotherapy is the most common clinical work performed, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

  • Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.
  • Typically, clinicians work between Mondays – Fridays somewhere between the hours of 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM.

Focus on the patient’s care without the hassle or any additional on-call responsibilities. Simply cover the care for you own patients! Our psychotherapists focus on the patient’s care and our back-office support team handles the rest. This allows our clinicians time to be spent where it should be; with the patients they serve. Each clinician is responsible for clinical care and documentation following treatment sessions. Once that’s complete, our support team will handle all billing, collections, credentialing, etc. Once you leave the office for the day, your time is yours. No additional on-call responsibilities and no time spent wasted dealing with insurance companies.

Full-time clinicians are eligible to participate for medical health benefits. Please speak with the recruitment team to obtain additional specifics on benefits.

OMH is a growing, clinician-led company. Our Site Supervisors are geographically dispersed throughout the areas we work in order to have staff leaders available to every clinician. Talk with our recruitment team today about the advancement opportunities to become senior psychotherapists and/or site supervisors.

Education & Licensure:

Completion of an accredited program with certification and licensure as a Licensed Mental Health Professional (LPC/LMFT/LCSW) in the state of Colorado with the ability to practice independently is required.

about the role

Job Title: Benefit Operations Analyst
Location: Remote based in Romania
Terms: Permanent / Full-Time 40h weekly
Salary band: €17,000 - €18,000
Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9 am - 5:30 pm

The successful candidate will support Kota, one of the UK and Ireland's fastest-growing start-ups, transforming the way employee benefits are delivered and experienced.

About Kota
Kota is on a mission to make insurance and retirement benefits as accessible as modern software - and we're just getting started. Through Kota Platform, the world's first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance product, we're changing how thousands of employees across Europe experience their benefits.

Kota work with some of the most exciting companies in Europe - Carwow, Tines, Zoe, and Remote - and we're backed by top-tier investors including EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone, and Frontline. Founded in 2022, we've raised over €20M and we're growing fast.

The role
This is your chance to join a high-growth fintech at an early stage and make a real impact. We are continuing to grow our Benefit Operations team, as our business and the number of partners expand rapidly in the coming years. As part of the function, you will play a key role in managing customer queries and improving how benefits are delivered across the Kota platform.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a rapidly scaling company, with exposure to customers, insurers, and internal teams across the business. The role will have a broad scope, global reach and plenty of opportunities for growth.

What you'll do

  • Handle new business administration. Set up new employer schemes, facilitate application processing between employers, employees and insurance providers, while also updating our CRM and internal systems
  • Support scheme renewals. Work closely with employers and insurance providers, plus partner with customer success teams to refine processes and improve the customer experience
  • Own policy event administration. Process policy changes including joiners, leavers, dependents, cancellations and amendments; coordinate across internal teams and providers.
  • Interact with customers as part of the support function. Act as the first line of investigation for benefit and policy-related queries, owning issue resolution. Liaise with insurers and providers on escalations, tracking any recurring issues and maintaining high quality documentation.
  • Travel. You will complete your induction and new hire training in Dublin and will visit Dublin once a quarter for meetings and training.

Our Recruitment process
  1. 1st round interview with the Talent Acquisition Team at Otonomee
  2. Language assessment
  3. 2nd round interview with the Kota Team
  4. Final round interview with COO at Kota
  5. Reference checking

your profile

  • 2+ years of experience in operations, insurance, benefits administration, or customer support
  • Strong attention to detail. You can manage multiple workstreams and dive into complexity
  • Clear written communication skills. You thrive when working with different stakeholders
  • Comfort working in fast-paced environments. You are comfortable with ambiguity and evolving processes

jobs.excerpt: Job PostingSick of commuting?  Tired of “hybrid” jobs that are really “in office” jobs in disguise?
jobs.description:
Job Posting

Sick of commuting? Tired of “hybrid” jobs that are really “in office” jobs in disguise? If you’re discovering that you’re more productive at home than in an office, and want to make that arrangement permanent, we may have the position you’re after.

At CarriersEdge, we’re focused on producing great quality products and happy customers. We don’t care about being the coolest company in town, having the most amazing office perks, or the hippest staff. If you’re interested in those things, you’ll hate us.

On the other hand, if you’re not looking for a social group and just want to do great work, then you may be exactly what we’re looking for. We don’t care where you work and we won’t be looking over your shoulder micromanaging you. You’ll have minimal meetings disrupting your week, and plenty of time to focus on doing the best job possible. We’re growing quickly, but not so quickly that things are chaotic.

As part of that growth, we’ve got an opening for an InstructionalContent Writer and Editor.

The ideal candidate has a keen eye for detail, a solid foundation in the skills outlined below, and a passion to continually improve those skills. This isn’t an agency where you’ll get buried under endless client projects, a marketing job where you're writing sales pitches, or contract writing position churning out blog postings.

We’re serving an industry undergoing massive transformation and we need great storytellers who can produce well-researched, accurate, and engaging content to support people through that transformation.

About you

  • You love long-form writing and enjoy all stages of the process, from research to editing.
  • You have a proven ability to turn complex material into easily understood content.
  • You have extensive experience with research and looking at regulations doesn’t make you cringe.
  • You’re able to collaborate effectively as part of a team, but also comfortable completing work on your own.
  • You have extra-sharp communication skills and you’re not afraid to ask questions.
  • You are willing to occasionally travel to and participate in industry events.
  • You can’t stand bad Spelling or Grammar. The incorrect use of capitals in the previous sentence is driving you crazy right now.
  • You’re eager to learn a new industry and are not afraid to learn new tools for content development.

Your typical week

Day to day, you will work with other content writers to develop course material on subjects relating to regulatory changes, human resource topics, and other task-specific skills for the transportation industry.

You will be responsible for the comprehensive outline, storyboard, final test and audio script and will work with translators, graphic designers and voice-over artists to bring the words to life in a final online form using CarriersEdge proprietary tools.

In a normal week, you will spend time researching the subject matter for your current topic, writing storyboards and content, participating in reviews with senior team members, and assembling the various components into a finished product. Through the research-organize-write-review process, your stories will continue to evolve until they create an engaging narrative that can be applied to real world activities.

As part of a remote team, you will connect with team members across the company through Slack, email, and Zoom.

You’ll participate in occasional in-person meetings, attend industry events, and visit customer sites to oversee photoshoots in support of your content creation. You’ll track activities in weekly status reports.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
  • At least 6 years of experience with long-form writing in a professional capacity (e.g., technical writer or educational material/course developer)
  • Demonstrated ability to research subject matter and create stories that include accurate information and details
  • Demonstrated ability to tell a story through your writing that doesn’t rely on regurgitated bullet points
  • Expert knowledge of spelling, grammar and writing style, and the ability to use Microsoft Word styles, tables, tracking and other advanced features
  • Excellent attention to detail, so please find a way to mention soup in your cover letter
  • Ability to adapt your workflow to fit established processes
  • A portfolio of your work. You must be able to produce samples of your past work or projects that demonstrate your skills to be considered for this position.
  • You reside in Canada

Additional notes

  • Principals only, no recruiters please.
  • This role has a salary range of $60,000–$80,000 annually. Actual compensation within this range will be based on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.
  • CarriersEdge provides an inclusive workplace, welcoming and encouraging people of all backgrounds and abilities to apply. Accommodations are available upon requests for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Salary: Open

Working Hours & Conditions: AU business hours

OVERVIEW:

Our client is a premier Australian medical and commercial fitout specialist known for delivering end-to-end design and construction solutions across healthcare, dental, pharmacy, and commercial spaces. As part of their global expansion, they are seeking an experienced Interior Architect / Designer to lead client-facing concept design, space planning, and layout coordination. This critical offshore role serves as the first point of contact for prospective clients—running initial consultations, transforming client briefs into high-impact concept designs, and guiding owners toward commercially sound, highly functional solutions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Client Consultations & Concept Design: Act as the initial primary point of contact for prospective clients; conduct discovery meetings, understand operational needs, and deliver engaging concept presentations that win trust and convert inquiries.
  • Space Planning & Layout Coordination: Develop high-performance space plans for specialized medical environments (e.g., reception, consultation rooms, dental surgeries, sterilization areas, and amenities) with a strong focus on workflow, circulation, and equipment integration.
  • Finish & Material Selection: Specify durable, aesthetically elevated, and compliant materials, finishes, lighting, and custom joinery tailored to healthcare and commercial applications.
  • Commercial Guidance: Confidently advise clients on layout efficiency, material longevity, and buildability, balancing design aesthetics with commercial viability.
  • Design & Documentation Delivery: Produce high-quality concept packages, detailed layout coordination drawings, joinery details, and finishes schedules for internal teams and project managers.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Australian-based project managers, contracts administrators, and external engineering/building consultants to ensure design intent aligns seamlessly with site conditions and construction requirements.

Requirements

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Architecture or Interior Architecture with 4 to 6+ years of professional experience specializing in interior design, spatial planning, and commercial/healthcare fit-outs.
  • Client-Facing Soft Skills: Exceptional spoken and written English with a confident, consultative communication style capable of running live discovery sessions and pitching design concepts to business owners and medical professionals.
  • Core Technical Competencies: Strong spatial intelligence, material/finish knowledge, and practical understanding of interior construction detailing and joinery design.
  • Software Proficiency: Hands-on mastery of industry-standard design tools (e.g., ArchiCAD, AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, Enscape, or similar 3D rendering platforms).
  • Remote Readiness: A reliable home office setup with high-speed internet, a dedicated working space, and the ability to work aligned with Australian business hours.

Preferred Skills: (Nice-To-Have)

  • Previous work on Australian fitout projects.
  • Medical, dental, healthcare or other commercial interior projects.
  • Familiarity with the Australian NCC/BCA, Australian Standards and accessibility requirements relevant to fitout documentation.
  • Experience working remotely with builders, project managers and consultant teams.
  • Experience developing reception designs, detailed joinery packages and coordinated finishes schedules.

We’re hiring a senior writer to produce website and marketing content for our clients, with a focus on complex B2B and enterprise technology. This means product pages, solution pages, industry pages and educational content for companies whose buyers range from the people using the software every day to the executives signing off on it.

We use Claude for a lot of the heavy lifting in content production. You’ll use it to get to a strong first draft fast, then do the work that makes the content good: checking every claim, sharpening the language, protecting what the page needs to rank, and making sure the reader feels understood instead of talked at.

This is a part-time role for 10-20 hours/week. Our ideal candidate has working hours between 10 am and 6 pm EST Monday-Friday.

What you’ll do

  • Write and edit high volumes of website content across reusable page templates, working in sprints with clear weekly deliverables
  • Use Claude and our established content workflows to produce first drafts, then edit them into publishable copy
  • Turn technical products into plain language that a buyer can understand, without losing accuracy
  • Tailor messaging by audience: company size (enterprise, mid-market, small business) and buyer role (daily user, budget owner, executive)
  • Fact-check product and capability claims against source material and subject-matter experts, and flag anything that can’t be verified
  • Optimize content for search and AI answer engines using Clearscope, keyword targets and AEO structure (direct answers, FAQs, scannable formatting)
  • Work with client product marketers and other subject-matter experts, merge their feedback into our structure, and make the case for what should stay and why
  • Present editorial decisions, explaining what changed and why it’s better
  • Partner with designers by delivering headlines and structure early so design and content move in parallel

What you bring

  • 5+ years of B2B content writing, ideally for enterprise software, SaaS or another technical category
  • Strong editing instincts. You can tell when a confident draft is wrong, vague or generic, and you know how to fix it
  • Experience writing with AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT as part of your production process, and a clear point of view on where they help and where they don’t
  • Working knowledge of SEO and AEO: keyword targeting, search intent and structuring content for both people and AI search
  • Comfort learning a complex product or industry quickly, through documentation, demos and interviews
  • The confidence to push back on a client rewrite, and the judgment to know when to give ground
  • Plain, direct writing. No jargon, no filler, no agency-speak
  • Experience managing multiple projects and hitting deadlines on a sprint schedule

Nice to have

  • Background in supply chain, logistics, fintech, legal tech or another operationally complex industry
  • Experience with Clearscope, Ahrefs, Semrush or similar tools
  • Experience writing for global audiences or content that will be translated
  • Experience with Asana, Figma and Google Workspace
  • A journalism or technical writing background

What this role isn’t

This is a writing and editing role. You’ll use Claude every day, but you won’t be responsible for building or maintaining the AI tools and workflows behind it. That work is owned separately so you can focus on the content.

jobs.excerpt: About UsWhen life gets hard, we make it easier!  Libra Solutions helps overcome the burdens created by slow-moving legal processes.
jobs.description:
About Us

When life gets hard, we make it easier! Libra Solutions helps overcome the burdens created by slow-moving legal processes. Combining technical innovation and financial strength, we help speed up cumbersome workflows and ease financial barriers for our customers.

Through the MoveDocs personal injury solutions platform, Libra integrates and streamlines medical, financial, and professional services for personal injury cases. Our mission is to help personal injury victims receive the medical care and personal funding needs they require, and to help streamline the process for the attorneys and medical providers that serve these victims. Libra operates under the MoveDocs, Oasis Financial and Probate Advance brands. We are proud of our mission and passionate about applying technology to the challenge of making healthcare more accessible.

Together, under the Libra Solutions banner, we have relationships with over 50,000 attorneys and over 12,000 healthcare providers nationwide, which gives us an amazing platform to service our customers.

Job description

The Partner Integration Engineer is the technical point person for partners, customers integrating with Libra to submit claims for processing, underwriting, and funding. You own the integration journey end to end, from first technical conversation to a stable production connection, and you are the person both sides trust to know where things stand.

This role moves fluidly between audiences. With a customer's operations or business leaders, you explain what the integration does, what it needs from them, and what happens next in plain language. With their engineers, you go deep on APIs, data mapping, authentication, error handling, and edge cases. In both, you communicate concisely and appropriately as you work in the technical details with engineers and in conceptual business terms with non-technical personnel.

You bring the customer's needs back to Libra as precise, engineering-ready requirements, and you use AI-assisted tools to produce specifications, documentation, and integration guides quickly and accurately. You will rarely have direct authority over the people you need. You succeed through clear thinking, self-organization, follow-through, and the credibility you build with customers and Libra's product and engineering teams.

This position reports to the VP AI Transformation and can be based in any of our office locations in Denver, CO, Huntersville, NC, Rosemont, IL, or Las Vegas, NV. We welcome strong remote candidates, with occasional travel to Las Vegas and customer sites as needed.

Position Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary technical contact for partners integrating with Libra to submit claims for processing, underwriting, and funding
  • Lead technical discovery with each partner: understand their systems, workflows, data, and constraints, and define integration scope, approach, risks, and sequencing
  • Translate between audiences, explain integration requirements, timelines, and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders in plain language, and work through API design, payloads, data mapping, authentication, and error handling with technical counterparts
  • Design practical integration solutions, evaluating trade-offs and recommending the right pattern for each partner's technical maturity
  • Investigate system behavior directly through API calls, database queries, logs, and code review to troubleshoot integration issues and establish accurate baselines
  • Turn customer needs into precise, engineering-ready requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, data flows, and integration specifications, that both engineering teams and AI agents can consume
  • Direct AI-assisted tools to produce specifications, integration guides, diagrams, and customer-facing documentation; validate the output for accuracy, completeness, and edge-case coverage
  • Own the integration plan and keep every party aligned on status, next steps, and blockers through concise written and verbal updates
  • Drive work across Libra's product, engineering, underwriting, and operations teams through influence rather than authority, escalating early and clearly when something is at risk
  • Validate integrations before go-live through testing, data verification, and acceptance against agreed criteria; support customers through launch and stabilization
  • Contribute to Libra's integration knowledge base, patterns, business rules, common issues, and customer-specific context, structured so it is usable by AI agents and engineering teams
  • Identify recurring integration friction and recommend improvements to Libra's APIs, documentation, and onboarding process
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent hands-on software development experience
  • 5+ years in solutions engineering, integration engineering, technical implementation, solutions architecture, or technical product ownership, including direct work with external customers or partners
  • Demonstrated track record of leading third-party integrations from discovery through production
  • Strong knowledge of REST APIs, authentication methods, data formats (JSON, XML, flat files), and integration patterns
  • SQL proficiency for data investigation, integration validation, and troubleshooting
  • Working knowledge of software development sufficient to read and reason about application code and assess technical feasibility independently
  • Exceptional communication skills: concise, structured, and able to adjust depth for executives, operations staff, and engineers
  • Demonstrated experience writing clear technical requirements, specifications, and customer-facing documentation
  • Proficiency using AI-assisted tools, such as Claude or equivalent agentic platforms, to produce specifications, documentation, and diagrams
  • Highly self-organized; able to manage multiple concurrent partner integrations without close direction
  • Proven ability to drive outcomes through influence across teams and organizations where you hold no formal authority
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity; creative problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S.

Preferred Technical Familiarity:

  • Experience with claims, lending, underwriting, healthcare billing, or legal-tech data flows
  • Healthcare or claims data standards such as X12 837/835, HL7, or FHIR
  • API testing and interaction using Postman or Swagger/OpenAPI
  • Microsoft SQL Server for data analysis and query execution
  • Application development experience with C#, .NET, Entity Framework, and React or Angular
  • Experience with the Anthropic API and Claude model family, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or Claude Code or equivalent agentic tools
  • Source control workflows using Git and Bitbucket
  • Proficiency in Jira and Confluence; experience with Draw.io, Lucidchart, or similar diagramming tools

Benefits

We believe taking great care of our customers starts with taking great care of our people. That's why we offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, including a choice of multiple medical plans, dental, vision, and life insurance, a 401(k) with generous company match, flexible spending accounts for medical and dependent expenses, and time off to recharge.
