jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Natera is seeking a Principal AI Engineer to set technical direction for, and hands-on build of, the Vector Store GenAI Platform that powers document intelligence and retrieval across our Real-World Data (RWD) organization. The platform ingests clinical documents from multiple sources, indexes them for high-quality search, and makes that content available to downstream AI workflows and business use cases across oncology and other clinical domains.

This is a principal-level individual contributor role with architecture-plus-build ownership of retrieval, document processing, and ingestion systems. You will define platform strategy and sequencing, ship production code in a cloud environment, raise the reliability and quality of search and retrieval, and prove new approaches through POCs and benchmarks. You will partner with clinical, engineering, and product leaders to turn ambiguous priorities into a clear technical roadmap, establish standards for how retrieval serves agents and re-extraction workflows, and deliver measurable improvements in platform quality and operability—with high autonomy and limited day-to-day direction.

The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on engineering with a track record of owning complex AI platforms end to end. You set direction, implement critical path yourself, and elevate the technical bar across the teams that consume and extend the platform.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own platform architecture and hands-on delivery for the Vector Store GenAI Platform, including search and retrieval, document processing and chunking, ingestion pipelines, and APIs that serve downstream AI workflows.
  • Set technical direction for hybrid search and retrieval quality; evaluate embedding models and retrieval approaches through working implementations, POCs, and benchmarks, and drive adoption of what works in production.
  • Advance document parsing and chunking so clinical content is indexed in a way that supports accurate, structured, and faceted retrieval across common document types.
  • Define and build stable, reproducible retrieval for agent and re-extraction workloads, including durable content identifiers, flexible context assembly, versioned indices, and quality or confidence signals.
  • Strengthen document classification and ingestion visibility so source material is discoverable, operable, and measurable at scale across historical and ongoing data flows.
  • Continuously improve retrieval quality through better deduplication, clinical concept normalization, and exploration of promising retrieval methods where they add clear value.
  • Integrate LLM capabilities into existing production systems with attention to performance, scalability, cost, observability, and safe operation in a regulated environment.
  • Partner with clinical AI, engineering, product, and SME stakeholders to prioritize workstreams, define success metrics, and sequence roadmap investments without disrupting the live platform.
  • Provide principal-level technical leadership through architecture decisions, design reviews, clear documentation, mentoring influence, and pragmatic tradeoffs across accuracy, latency, cost, and delivery timelines.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; an advanced degree or background in a clinical or life sciences discipline is a plus.
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including substantial ownership of production systems at scale.
  • 5+ years building and shipping AI/ML-powered applications in production, with deep hands-on experience in retrieval-augmented systems, vector search, and document-centric AI pipelines—including indexing, retrieval quality, evaluation, and integration with downstream LLM or agent systems.
  • Demonstrated track record as a principal or equivalent IC: setting technical direction for a platform or multi-team capability, making architecture decisions that stick, and personally delivering critical path production code.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Python and modern software engineering practices, including testing, code review, workflow orchestration, and agile delivery in large existing codebases.
  • Experience designing and operating AI systems in cloud environments, with AWS strongly preferred; experience with CI/CD, observability, and production support is expected.
  • Proven ability to work independently as an architecture-plus-build IC—influencing without direct authority, aligning stakeholders, and delivering end-to-end from strategy through integration and rollout—with strong communication across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience with clinical or structured healthcare documents and document-centric search or RAG systems is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or other regulated industries is strongly preferred.
  • Experience designing retrieval interfaces used by agents or multi-step LLM workflows is a plus.

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

Company Description:

Anaergia (TSX: ANRG) is a global leader in offering sustainable solutions for the production of clean energy and the conversion of waste streams to resources. Through a proven portfolio of proprietary technological solutions, Anaergia maximizes the generation of renewable energy, diversion of waste from landfill, and reduction of greenhouse gases for customers across the municipal, industrial, commercial, and agricultural sectors.

Headquartered in Burlington, ON, and through its multiple subsidiaries across North America, Europe, Africa, and Asia, Anaergia is trusted at more than 1,600 installations globally.

Job Overview

The Commissioning Engineer plays a key role in the successful commissioning and start-up of waste-to-energy, renewable energy, and industrial process facilities across North America. Reporting to the Commissioning Manager, the Commissioning Engineer supports and executes commissioning activities from pre-commissioning through start-up, performance testing, and handover.

Working closely with engineering, construction, automation, equipment vendors, sub-contractors, and operations personnel, the Commissioning Engineer ensures systems and equipment are installed, tested, commissioned, documented, and transitioned safely into operation.

The role is responsible for executing commissioning procedures, performing inspections and testing, troubleshooting process and control systems, maintaining commissioning records, and supporting the resolution of technical issues encountered during start-up and performance testing. The successful candidate will possess strong technical knowledge, problem-solving ability, and a commitment to safety, quality, and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development and execution of commissioning plans, procedures, schedules, checklists, and test protocols.
  • Support the development of the commissioning strategy and sequence in coordination with the Project Manager, engineering, construction, automation, vendors, and client.
  • Execute and coordinate onsite commissioning activities from pre-commissioning through start-up, Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), performance testing, and handover activities.
  • Coordinate daily commissioning activities with construction teams, equipment vendors, sub-contractors, and project personnel.
  • Support commissioning coordination meetings and provide updates on progress, clear direction on daily priorities, testing activities, constraints, and required resources.
  • Verify mechanical completion and system readiness prior to commissioning activities.
  • Perform equipment inspections, equipment checkout, calibration verification, loop checks, I/O checks, and functional testing.
  • Coordinate and perform dry and wet commissioning activities for mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, control, automation, and process systems.
  • Support PLC, HMI, SCADA, and control system testing activities during commissioning and start-up.
  • Troubleshoot equipment, instrumentation, control systems, and process-related issues and assist in implementing corrective actions.
  • Work closely with automation engineers and equipment vendors to verify proper system functionality and performance.
  • Prepare and review Risk Assessments, Job Hazard Analyses (JHA), LOTO reviews, and commissioning safety planning activities.
  • Ensure commissioning activities are performed in compliance with project specifications, company procedures, quality requirements, and applicable safety regulations.
  • Document commissioning results and maintain accurate commissioning records, test reports, checklists, and punch-list items.
  • Track and report commissioning progress, open issues, corrective actions, and testing results.
  • Support management of commissioning punch lists and assist in resolving outstanding deficiencies.
  • Coordinate with operations personnel and client representatives during start-up, testing, and handover activities.
  • Support operator training and operational readiness activities.
  • Review and verify as-built documentation, operating manuals, and turnover packages.
  • Assist with preparation of commissioning reports and final handover documentation.
  • Promote a strong safety culture and address or report unsafe conditions and practices.

Required Skills and Experience

Skills

  • Strong understanding of commissioning and startup activities for industrial process facilities.
  • Knowledge of mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, control, and automation systems.
  • Experience performing loop checks, I/O checks, functional testing, equipment checkout, and commissioning activities.
  • Working knowledge of PLC, HMI, SCADA, industrial communication networks, and instrumentation systems.
  • Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, process flow diagrams, electrical drawings, control schematics, and technical documentation.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledge of commissioning safety practices, including LOTO, permit-to-work systems, and risk assessments.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively within multidisciplinary project teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

Experience

  • Minimum 3-5 years of relevant industrial experience, including hands-on commissioning and/or start-up, and operations experience.
  • Experience within renewable energy, biogas, wastewater treatment, waste-to-energy, chemical processing, power generation, or related industrial facilities preferred.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline; equivalent technical diploma and relevant commissioning experience may be considered.

Physical Requirements:

  • Preferred work location is Carlsbad, California. However, remote candidates with relevant commissioning experience will be considered. This position requires travel to project sites throughout North America up to 70%.
  • Ability to work in industrial and construction environments, including climbing ladders, walking on uneven surfaces, and wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Ability to work extended hours during critical start-up and commissioning activities when required.

physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. TMB is the community-driven entertainment company engaging more than 250 million consumers worldwide across streaming TV, social media, web and print. Our portfolio of brands including FailArmy, Family Handyman, People Are Awesome, Reader's Digest, Taste of Home,The Healthy, and The Pet Collective, is powered by content that's inspired and created by our fans. Together our community sparks curiosity, fuels laughter, and inspires people to live big, full, fantastic lives. Learn more about our brands, our data-driven marketing solutions, our award-winning licensing services, and much more at trustedmediabrands.com.

Location:

United States - Remote

About the role:

Trusted Media Brands is seeking a VP of Programmatic & AdOps. You will help to maximize revenue opportunities and optimize efficiencies in our ad tech, SPO, and ad operations. You will work very closely with Ad Operations, Engineering and Ad Product groups.
You are a highly collaborative, and self-motivated leader with extensive experience in Programmatic Operations and Ad Technology.

Responsibilities: your day-day:
  • Work directly with Programmatic vendors on new product releases and rollouts
    • Understanding the evolving technology for programmatic across open auction, PMP, PG - Including things like header bidders, server-side vs client side, and making recommendations/creating test plans
    • Working with ad product manager and tech team to implement
  • Evaluate current and new programmatic vendors and make recommendations/creating test plans
    • Working with ad product manager and tech team to implement
  • Vet new programmatic business/partnership opportunities
    • Deeply understand the “health” of our bidder partners, to help optimize and troubleshoot all connections
  • Understand levers to pull to drive improved results and making recommendations/creating test plans
  • Demonstrate a good pulse of the market and shifting trends, and pivot operations and the ad stack accordingly
  • Work with ad sales to make sure any changes to programmatic can accommodate PMP and PG deals
  • Evaluate video programmatic as part of overall programmatic as well as stand-alone or unique implementation and making recommendations/creating test plans
    • Working with video product manager and tech team to implement
  • Monitor and maintain ad quality across our portfolio of sites including working in an Ad Quality platform and maintain block lists
  • Provide Quality Assurance for all site and app releases by working directly with Product teams to understand release schedules and all updates that have the potential to impact programmatic revenue
    • Maintain Ads.txt files and additional compliance and transparency initiatives
  • Be the technical liaison with product and engineering teams including programmatic representative for all
    • Responsible for header-bidding optimization and updates while working closely with analytics team to monitor impact of all updates
Qualifications: you have:
  • At least 8 years of experience
  • Experience with Google Ad Manager (DFP) or other Ad Servers
  • Understanding of programmatic ecosystems and platforms such as Google, Magnite or Index Exchange
  • Strong knowledge of web debugging with tools such as Charles and Chrome Developer Tools
  • Experience working with Product and Engineering teams including with JIRA is a positive
  • Ability to address problems with a data driven approach: strong Excel skills and experience with BI tools are an advantage
  • Demonstrated experience and success in conducting client meetings
About This Team:

The Programmatic team is a highly collaborative and multi-faceted department that is responsible for growing digital monetization. The department works closely with product, engineering, and sales to grow the digital business. The culture of the team is one of flexibility and who prioritizes tasks accordingly. In addition to being self-driven, team members have a strong sense of accountability as the programmatic business is a larger portion of TMBI's digital revenue. The programmatic team has a pulse of what is happening in the market in terms of monetization strategy and ad technology and disseminates that information internally. Additionally, the team adapts to these constantly changing shifts in trends. Creativity and thinking outside the box are highly promoted!

Our Benefits:

We value our people and offer a collaborative and engaging culture. As a Trusted Media Brands employee, you will enjoy work/life balance, generous time off and comprehensive benefits and programs. Learn more about what life is like working at Trusted Media Brands at

Trusted Media Brands embraces inclusivity and values our diverse community. We are committed to building a team based on qualifications, merit and business need. The Opportunity:

An SAP Basis Administrator manages the underlying technical infrastructure of SAP systems (installation, upgrades, patching, and configuration) to ensure high availability, performance, and security. Key tasks include database management, user administration, transport management (TMS), and troubleshooting, often supporting HANA, ECC, and NetWeaver environments 24/7.

Under this contract any male born after 12/31/1959 must be registered and certify their registration with the Selective Service System or have a waiver from the Selective Service Systems as a condition of employment. Please open internally only as we already have the candidate identified.

Responsibilities:

  • System Administration:Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain WBSCM SAP NetWeaver ABAP/JAVA systems.

  • Performance Tuning:Monitor system performance, perform load balancing, and optimize database and application server resources.

  • Transport Management:Manage the transport management system (TMS) for moving changes between landscapes (Dev, QA, PRD).

  • Database Management:Perform backups, restores, and database monitoring, specifically with SAP HANA, and SQL Server.

  • Troubleshooting:Act as the technical lead in resolving system errors, dumps, and connectivity issues (SAP GUI, network).

Qualifications:

Required:

  • US Citizenship is required.

  • Education:Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • Technical Experience:7 proven experience with SAP Basis administration, including SAP HANA, and SQL Server. Familiarity with Hana Cockpit, Hana Studio. Solution Manager Configuration (Charm, System monitoring, Document Management)

  • Operating Systems:Knowledge of Linux, Unix and Windows server environments. Including familiarity with AWS.

  • Soft Skills:Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work under pressure in a 24/7 environment.

Desired:

  • Knowledge of SAP BTP services and landscape design, Understanding of SAP S/4HANA (Cloud or OnPremise), DevOps principles and API management. BOBJ configuration and administration.

  • SAP Certified Technology Associate - SAP HANA.

  • SAP Certified Technology Associate - System Administration.

-

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. $90,300-$189,600

This is a remote role within a global team that utilizes cutting-edge technology to stay connected with colleagues worldwide. Being a Principal Customer Success Manager at iManage Means…

You will oversee a portfolio of global strategic large law firms, responsible for partnering with these enterprise customers to ensure they maximize the value from their iManage subscriptions. Your primary focus is on identifying and delivering business outcomes that drive retention, loyalty, and satisfaction across all products and services. You will engage closely with field-facing teams—such as Account Executives, Channel, Product, and key executive stakeholders within your client law firms—offering advisory guidance, coordinating activities, and serving as a dedicated advocate to support customer preservation and success.

Throughout the entire customer lifecycle, you will build and strengthen relationships with key stakeholders by demonstrating accountability, authenticity, and adaptability. You will collaborate with Product, Support, Engineering, Cloud Services, Training, and Partner Enablement teams to deliver ongoing value and execute programs that drive adoption of desired outcomes, with a strong emphasis on retention.

Integral to your responsibilities is monitoring and improving net revenue retention (NRR), ensuring that existing customers continue to expand their use of iManage solutions while minimizing churn. By actively identifying qualified leads and expansion opportunities within your accounts, you help drive sustainable revenue growth and reinforce the strategic value of the customer success function. Your role includes orchestrating initiatives that support large law firms in achieving their strategic objectives and ensuring their continued satisfaction with iManage solutions.

iM Responsible For…
  • Client Relationship Management

    • Acting as the trusted central point of contact, bringing in subject matter experts as needed to meet the unique requirements of each law firm.

    • Leveraging account intelligence and industry trends to promote best practices throughout the customer lifecycle for large law firms.
    • Staying ahead of competitive developments within the legal industry to provide strategic guidance and maintain customer satisfaction.
iM Qualified Because I Have…
  • Experience working with a portfolio of enterprise level, high-value strategic customers.
  • A minimum of 10+ years of experience Management Consulting, Relationship Management, or Customer Success in a SaaS environment.
  • Experience managing, working with and presenting to C-Suite stakeholders.
  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Business Administration, Information Management, or the equivalent professional experience.

  • Excellent business communication, organizational and project management skills.

Bonus Points If I Have...

We are looking for a Backend Engineer to build and scale the high-performance systems powering a global Checkout product and next-generation payments infrastructure.

This role focuses on designing APIs, services, and distributed systems that handle payments, settlement, asset conversion, identity verification, and multi-chain transaction routing. You will play a key role in building fault-tolerant, low-latency infrastructure that supports both web2 and web3 use cases at scale.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance APIs and backend services for the payments platform.
  • Develop and evolve systems supporting payments, settlement, transaction routing, asset conversion, and identity/security workflows across multiple chains and providers.
  • Build backend features that directly improve product performance, reliability, and conversion for dApps and partners.
  • Participate in system design, architecture discussions, and incident response to ensure high availability, scalability, and fault tolerance.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code, contributing to code reviews and engineering best practices.
  • Continuously optimize system performance, latency, and reliability across the infrastructure.

Requirements:

  • Strong experience building production-grade backend systems using a modern programming language (TypeScript preferred; Go or Rust acceptable).
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, API design, and database architecture.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure and containerization tools (e.g., AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, and system design.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English (primary working language).

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in payments, fintech infrastructure, or high-throughput transactional systems.
  • Familiarity with blockchain technologies, smart contracts, or DeFi protocols.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and real-time data processing systems.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or technical writing in backend, infrastructure, or crypto domains.
  • Evidence of exceptional achievement in any domain (e.g., competitive programming, open-source, athletics).

Senior Meta Ads Strategist and Media Buyer (Client-Facing)

Job Overview

MVR Digital is hiring a Senior Meta Ads Strategist and Media Buyer to own Meta strategy and execution for a small portfolio of our largest premium and luxury DTC accounts. You will be in Ads Manager daily building, testing, and scaling campaigns. You will also set the strategy and defend it on client calls.

Agency work moves fast. Priorities shift mid-week, platforms change without warning, and a client can ask for a new direction on a Friday. We need someone who adjusts quickly, keeps their accounts organized while doing it, and keeps clients feeling looked after the whole way through.

About MVR Digital

MVR Digital is a performance marketing agency working with premium and luxury DTC and e-commerce brands to grow profitably online. Adweek named us one of the Fastest Growing Agencies. We work across Meta, Google, TikTok, and Connected TV, plus email, creative, and landing pages. The team is fully remote, direct, and focused on results.

Our Values

  • Act Like an Owner
  • Clarity over Complexity
  • Serve Clients’ Best Interest
  • We Win Together, We Lose Together
  • Data-Informed, Human-Led

What Success Looks Like

Your mission is to run 2 to 4 client accounts, each spending $300K+ a month on Meta, so that performance moves toward target without leadership in the daily details. In your first year:

  • By month 4, 80% or more of your accounts are green against their monthly goals
  • Zero client-seen launch errors each quarter
  • Every test closes with a written verdict in the change log
  • By month 3, fewer than 2 media questions a month reach leadership from your clients
  • Clients get a clear answer on urgent requests the same business day

  • Own Meta strategy and daily execution across your accounts: build, structure, budget pacing, testing, and scaling
  • Manage $100K+ per month in Meta spend per account against MER, ROAS, and CPA targets
  • Change course quickly when performance, a client request, or the platform shifts, and tell the client what changed and why
  • Keep every account organized: clean naming, current change logs, documented tests, and pacing you can show at any time
  • Configure and QA tracking yourself: pixel, CAPI, event quality, catalog, and feed health
  • Run structured creative testing. Brief creative, critique what comes back, and connect creative performance to your in-platform decisions
  • Support Google, TikTok, and other channels where they affect your accounts, and hold a point of view on cross-channel budget allocation
  • Lead the Meta portion of client calls. Explain performance clearly, bring a recommendation, and push back when a request will not serve the client

  • Deep Meta expertise: Advantage+, CBO, signal quality, CAPI, and incrementality
  • DTC or e-commerce ownership. Premium or luxury AOV experience is a strong differentiator
  • A track record of managing several high-spend accounts at once without anything slipping

jobs.description:
About ePromos
ePromos Promotional Products, LLC, has been a leading industry distributor in the promotional space for over 20 years! Our award-winning website combined with our sales strategy, service capabilities and enterprise level solutions consistently set us apart.

As a remote-first company, ePromos embraces flexibility, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Our team is composed of passionate professionals who thrive in a fast-paced, performance-driven culture where ideas are valued and innovation is encouraged. Our values are strong with a deep-rooted emphasis on giving back as part of our ePromos Cares mission.

At ePromos, we don’t just sell products—we help build brands. Join us and be part of a company that’s redefining the promotional marketing space through strategic thinking, bold creativity, and a people-first approach.

BASIC FUNCTION SUMMARY:

The Corporate Trainer is responsible for designing, delivering, and evaluating practical learning programs and resources that strengthen employee capability, operational consistency, data integrity, customer experience, and cross-functional collaboration. This role supports Sales, Operations, Marketing, Merchandising, and other business functions as needed.

The Corporate Trainer translates company standards, systems, workflows, and standard operating procedures into practical learning experiences for new and existing employees. Our Corporate Trainer will partner with managers, functional leaders, and subject-matter experts to identify training needs, develop learning content, facilitate instruction, and evaluate learning effectiveness. The role will maintain accessible, engaging training materials and learning resources within appropriate platforms, reflecting the value of organized, practical, and user-friendly internal content.

The following duties are not intended to serve as a comprehensive list of all duties required for this position. The job description is a summary of the major duties and responsibilities. This role may not be required to perform all duties listed and may be expected to perform additional duties as requested.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Duties, Skills, Responsibilities, and Expectations:

Training & Development

  • Lead and coordinate the company’s day-to-day training and development efforts by partnering with functional leaders and subject-matter experts to identify training needs, skill gaps, and knowledge gaps.
  • Develop and facilitate instructor-led, virtual, self-paced, and on-the-job training for new and existing employees.
  • Create role-based onboarding plans, training pathways, refresher training, job aids, process guides, knowledge checks, and assessments tailored to different roles and audiences.

Training Content & Business Processes

  • Develop, organize, maintain, and deliver training content across key company systems, processes, and business functions.
  • Partner with subject-matter experts to translate company processes and SOPs into clear, practical, and effective learning resources.
  • Training areas may include brand standards, data standards, sourcing, order processing, NetSuite, security, sales processes, company-wide processes, Jira, Confluence, and cross-functional workflows.

Training Effectiveness & Continuous Improvement

  • Coordinate training sessions, workshops, coaching opportunities, process reviews, and assessments while monitoring participation, completion, knowledge checks, feedback, and other applicable training metrics.
  • Evaluate training effectiveness using employee and manager feedback, operational metrics, quality findings, and recurring process issues. Identify opportunities to improve training content, learning delivery, process understanding, and knowledge retention.

Employee & HR Support

  • Serve as a member of the HR team and provide day-to-day support to employees and managers on general HR training questions, processes, and resources.
  • Serve as a first point of contact for routine HR training inquiries, provide guidance within established HR processes, and direct employees to the appropriate HR resource when additional support or expertise is needed.
  • Support HR tickets and employee requests through timely follow-up, documentation, and resolution.

Employee Experience & Culture

  • Support employee engagement, culture, and employee experience initiatives in partnership with the HR team. Assist with communications, employee programs, recognition initiatives, events, and other activities designed to strengthen employee connection and engagement.
  • Help ensure employees have access to clear, consistent, and easy-to-understand information about company programs, processes, and resources.

HR Administration & Compliance

  • Support the HR team with maintaining accurate employee records, HR documentation, and required files. Assist with HR reporting, audits, compliance activities, and other administrative processes as needed.
  • Maintain confidentiality and exercise appropriate discretion when handling sensitive employee, payroll, benefits, and company information.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Build strong working relationships with managers, functional leaders, subject-matter experts, and employees across the organization.
  • Partner with departments to understand business needs, translate operational knowledge into effective training, and promote consistent understanding and execution of company processes and expectations.
Special Projects & HR Support
  • Participate in HR projects and organizational initiatives that support employee development, process improvement, compliance, culture, and the overall employee experience.
  • Take on additional HR, training, and organizational projects as needed based on company priorities and evolving business needs.

SUCCESS MEASURES:
Success in this role will be demonstrated through measurable improvements in training effectiveness, employee readiness, process adoption, and knowledge accessibility, including:

  • Training programs are delivered on schedule with strong participation and completion rates for assigned audiences.

  • New hires and employees transitioning into new responsibilities demonstrate improved readiness and proficiency within expected timeframes.

  • Employees demonstrate understanding of key processes, systems, and expectations through knowledge checks, assessments, demonstrations, or other appropriate measures.

  • Participant and manager feedback reflects that training is practical, relevant, accessible, and applicable to day-to-day responsibilities.

  • Training contributes to improved adoption and consistent use of company systems, workflows, SOPs, and required processes.

  • Training initiatives contribute to reductions in recurring errors, data-quality issues, process gaps, and avoidable rework where training is identified as a contributing factor.

  • Training materials, job aids, and resources are current, organized, searchable, and maintained in the appropriate knowledge-management platform.

  • Managers and subject-matter experts actively engage with the Trainer to identify needs, develop content, reinforce learning, and evaluate effectiveness.

  • Training programs are regularly reviewed and adjusted based on learner feedback, manager input, business metrics, process changes, and identified knowledge gaps.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Learning and Development, Human Resources, Business, Communications, Organizational Development, or a related field;
  • 3+ years of experience in corporate training, learning and development, operations training, sales enablement, HR, supply chain, or a related business function.
  • Experience supporting both customer-facing and operational teams in a fast-paced business environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to design and facilitate engaging adult-learning programs for diverse employee populations.
  • Strong working knowledge of instructional design principles, adult learning methodologies, assessment development, and training evaluation.
  • Experience developing and maintaining SOPs, process documentation, job aids, and knowledge-management resources.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, presentation tools, and virtual training platforms.

Payments Product Manager (LATAM, Remote)

Our client, a high-growth consumer subscription company, is hiring a Payments Product Manager to own their payments platform end to end. This is not a greenfield build. You inherit a modern stack — a first-party payments microservice, a payment orchestration layer routing across processors, BNPL, automated dunning, and a self-serve analytics layer — plus a dedicated engineering scrum team. Your job is to push it forward.

Two priorities define the first six months. First, rebill recovery: a meaningful share of subscription rebills fail, and too many of those customers churn for payment reasons, not product reasons. You'll audit the dunning stack, evaluate vendors, and decide whether to optimize, switch, or layer. Second, initial auth rate: routing optimization, network tokenization, express checkout, and continuous experimentation at the checkout layer.

In a given week you'll write a spec, pull your own numbers out of the data warehouse, negotiate a vendor SLA, and present findings to the CFO. There is no payments ops team behind you. When something breaks, you drive resolution. You set the roadmap, you ship, you measure.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in payments product or payments program management, subscription or e-commerce
  • Hands-on experience with payment orchestration platforms and multi-MID routing
  • Dunning and recovery expertise: retry logic, involuntary churn metrics, vendor evaluation
  • Data self-sufficiency in modern BI tools — you don't wait on an analyst
  • Demonstrated AI-native workflow: you actually use LLM and agentic tools in your product work today. This is a minimum qualification, not a preference.
  • Comfortable owning chargebacks, fraud posture, and regulatory compliance context

Mark43’s mission is to empower communities and their governments with new technologies that improve the safety and quality of life for all. We build powerful, scalable, and elegant software that sets a new standard for the tools upon which our first responders rely. Our users are diverse, and we are therefore committed to embracing diversity of thought and experience within our team.

We are looking for a Customer Experience Manager to join our growing team. The Mark43 Customer Experience team is passionate about serving as the client’s voice and demonstrating the value of our product offerings. The main goals of the team are to foster product adoption and user satisfaction, assist with change management, capture and contextualize product feedback for our engineering and product teams, track issue resolution, explain new feature enhancements, drive renewals/expansions, and mitigate/prioritize any pain points before they become critical issues.

This is a client-facing role, and you will be working with your clients regularly both in person and virtually. You will be involved in the full spectrum of post-implementation processes and client care. Much of your day to day will be spent learning about our customers’ unique needs and we expect you to absorb information and eventually demonstrate mastery of a client’s workflows and our product offerings. You will be the trusted advisor for the client and the company will lean on you to advocate for the customer's needs to ensure they are getting what they need to be successful.

Must be located in California  

What you can expect to work on:

  • Advocate for the client to ensure their needs are being met.
  • Participating in pre-implementation activities to establish relationships and domain expertise early in the deployment process.
  • Performing post-implementation tasks, on-site with our clients, while working on a dynamic Customer Experience team.
  • Collaborating with the Customer Support, Account Management and Implementation teams to ensure a smooth post-implementation experience for our clients.
  • Working with our clients to learn and understand their current workflows.
  • Keep diligent records of all client meetings, tasks, and deliverables.
  • Seeking out and nurturing relationships with power-users and influencers within client sites.
  • Tracking user feedback to help influence the product roadmap and maintain communication with clients to resolve product issues.
  • Distributing and ensuring completion of client surveys and ultimately responsible for your clients NPS score.
  • Collaborate internally to solve complex problems and work on a diversity of tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborating with first responders, which is a uniquely satisfying experience.
  • Helping to innovate and test new processes to improve efficiency as well as internal and external customer satisfaction.

 

What we expect from you:

  • 5-10 years of account management, customer success, consulting, project management, and/or customer success experience.
  • Four-year university/college degree preferred.
  • Proven experience participating in a complex project from start to finish.
  • Knowing when to problem solve, either independently or by asking smart questions of your teammates.
  • Outstanding written and oral communication skills - you’ll often be writing materials that will go directly to our clients and will need to adjust internal jargon for external.
  • Detail oriented and the ability to document and track tasks.
  • Excitement about working with cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
  • Ability to multitask and work on multiple projects concurrently.
  • Ability to travel up to 50-80% and comfort working directly from client sites.
  • Willingness to operate outside of assigned projects and pitch in wherever necessary.
  • Interest in working with a public sector client, such as law enforcement (LE), at the local, state, or federal level.
  • Comfortable working remotely.
  • Experience providing (while comfortable also receiving) feedback across levels of leadership and peers.
  • A change champion able to adapt to changing processes and needs while comfortable asking questions and creating dialog.

What you can expect from us:

  • Mentorship from experienced Customer Experience team members.
  • Constant collaboration with numerous Mark43 teams, including Customer Support, Implementation, Product, Engineering, and Executive leadership.
  • Building mission critical and socially responsible software to enable first responders to better serve their communities.
  • A team that respects and embraces your ideas and expertise.
  • Coworkers that are motivated by pursuing excellence, rather than the prospect of personal gain.
  • A workplace dedicated to supporting and bettering public safety and government agencies.
  • An effort to balance autonomy and guidance.
  • The chance to participate in development opportunities, including through services like Udemy, from day one.

Mark43 is approved to hire in Canada, the UK, and 36 U.S. states, including Alabama, Arizona, California (excluding San Francisco), Colorado, Connecticut, Washington D.C., Florida, Georgia, Iowa, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Massachusetts, Maryland, Maine, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, North Carolina, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Vermont, Washington, Wisconsin, and West Virginia. State locations and specifics are subject to change as our hiring requirements shift.

jobs.excerpt: The Manager, ServiceNow Platform is accountable for day-to-day platform prioritization, roadmap coordination, governance, delivery readiness, supportability, and practical business value tracking for Flexential’s ServiceNow platform.
jobs.description:
The Manager, ServiceNow Platform is accountable for day-to-day platform prioritization, roadmap coordination, governance, delivery readiness, supportability, and practical business value tracking for Flexential’s ServiceNow platform.

Reporting to the Vice President of Business Technology, this role translates platform strategy into actionable priorities, coordinates intake and delivery readiness, and ensures stakeholder commitments are visible, sequenced, and supportable. The role may be consulted on adoption planning and impacts but is not accountable for platform adoption.

This position directly manages a team of 4-6 ServiceNow Developers and Administrators and partners closely with development, architecture, operations, security, Strategic Portfolio Management, the Project Management Office, finance, procurement, vendors, and business stakeholders.

The ideal candidate must be a player/coach and be hands-on in this role.

Essential Job Functions

Platform Governance and Standards

  • Define practical standards for ServiceNow intake, prioritization, roadmap management, architecture review, release readiness, documentation, supportability, adoption input, and value tracking.
  • Run ServiceNow governance routines and maintain traceable visibility into decisions, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and escalations for the Platform Director and stakeholders.
  • Establish guardrails that reduce shadow work, unclear ownership, duplicate configuration, unmanaged customization, and unapproved commitments.

Roadmap, Intake and Prioritization

  • Maintain the ServiceNow roadmap based on business priorities, platform strategy, technical considerations, dependencies, risks, releases, and decisions.
  • Ensure work enters through approved intake channels and meets minimum readiness standards before sequencing.
  • Own ServiceNow platform content and communications channels, including the SharePoint site or web page, release notes, and weekly platform updates; stakeholder and program updates will provided by the IT Delivery Manager.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop the ServiceNow team, with clear accountability for technical direction, product priorities, roadmap execution, stakeholder engagement, and platform outcomes.
  • Set expectations for ownership, technical decision discipline, product management, communication, stakeholder management, governance participation, and measurable outcomes.
  • Support hiring, role clarity, performance feedback, development planning, workload balance, and succession planning.
  • Build an accountable team culture that balances speed, quality, platform health, business value, and sustainable operations.

Delivery Readiness and Risk Management

  • Coordinate with development to ensure ServiceNow commitments align to approved decisions, capacity inputs, architecture readiness, release timing, and support readiness.
  • Set minimum readiness expectations for testing, documentation, support handoff, rollback planning, post-release ownership, and adoption-related inputs required by business or change owners.
  • Escalate risks affecting platform health, stakeholder commitments, budget, staffing, compliance, or enterprise outcomes.
  • Serve as a consulted partner on technical debt, integration sprawl, customization risk, support complexity, data quality, and value realization when execution ownership resides with other teams.

Vendor, Metrics and Escalation Ownership

  • Own large program statements of work with vendors, ensuring scope, deliverables, assumptions, dependencies, handoffs, and acceptance criteria align to ServiceNow priorities.
  • Use metrics, usage insights, incident trends, backlog health, vendor performance inputs, and stakeholder feedback to inform prioritization recommendations, statement-of-work adjustments, and resourcing discussions.
  • Set day-to-day governance expectations, require decision traceability, return work that is not ready, manage prioritization within agreed guardrails, and escalate funding, staffing, priority, risk, or exception decisions to the Platform Director.

Job Requirements

Experience

  • 6+ years of experience in enterprise systems, platform management, ServiceNow, enterprise service management, product management, technology delivery, or program coordination.
  • Experience leading technical and product-aligned roles, coaching team members, managing performance, and clarifying ownership in a matrixed environment.
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills and the ability to translate platform, delivery, and risk topics into clear updates, options, and recommendations.
  • Experience partnering with platform owners, architecture, development, security, operations, finance, procurement, the Project Management Office, business stakeholders, and vendors without assuming ownership of partner teams.
  • Ideally, candidates have 5 years of experience as a ServiceNow Senior Developer or Architect.
  • Hands-on leadership experience with ServiceNow modules, platform governance, integrations, automation, reporting, data quality, and release management preferred.
  • Experience in global, infrastructure, operations, data center, construction, or high-growth environments preferred.
  • Ability to apply practical judgment, maintain an enterprise mindset, communicate concise tradeoffs, coach accountability, and follow through without creating unnecessary process burden.
  • Ability to build a team culture that values ownership, collaboration, responsible escalation, continuous improvement, platform health, and measurable outcomes.

Travel

  • Travel requirement: approximately 20%, with the potential to increase based on business needs.

Compensation

Base Pay Range

Annualized salary range offered for this position is estimated to be $132,000 - $145,000 annually. However, the actual pay range depends on each candidate’s experience, location, and qualifications.

Variable Pay

Discretionary annual bonus, based on personal and company performance.

Physical Demands and Special Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job successfully. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, sit, use hands to handle or feel objects, reach with hands and arms, climb stairs, balance, stoop or kneel, talk, and hear.

About Very

Very is a fully distributed technology firm led by expert problem-solvers who create efficient, scalable solutions that move commercial, industrial, and consumer products from pilot to production in record time.

We believe that real innovation happens in the grind, working shoulder to shoulder with clients who are building the future. Our team thrives on that energy. When we’re not helping clients deliver business-critical outcomes, we’re refining our craft and celebrating what it means to do hard things well.

We’ve built a collaborative, tight-knit culture that thrives in both remote and in-person settings. We’ve won numerous workplace awards over the years, including Great Place to Work certification and recognition from Parity.org as a Best Company for Women to Advance.

Our clients include well-known brands like Vizio, Peloton, Clear, iHeart Radio, and Fellowes — all determined to leverage connected devices and AI to drive meaningful impact. Our job is simple: help them win.

About this role

The Engagement Lead is a distinct career track at Very — separate from engineering and program management — built around a single accountability: the outcome of the client engagement.

PMs run the machine. Engagement Leads own the outcome.

This is a client-facing, commercially-minded role. You will personally own 1–3 active client relationships at a time, ensuring that Very is delivering real business value, that engagements are healthy and profitable, and that clients are growing with us. You will operate at high billability (60–80%), meaning you are not overhead — you are contributing directly to the work while simultaneously holding the altitude of the overall engagement.

You will sit at the intersection of client trust, technical delivery, and business development. The best Engagement Leads are builders who have learned to sell, or sellers who have learned to build — people who are as comfortable writing a Statement of Work as they are reviewing a sprint report.

What you’ll own

Client Relationship & Outcomes

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for 1–3 client engagements simultaneously
  • Maintain client trust at the working level — know your stakeholders, understand their business, and be the person they call when something feels off
  • Drive alignment between client expectations and what Very can actually deliver
  • Escalate early and with a recommendation — never let a problem become a surprise
  • We're remote-first, but travel within the US is part of the job — show up in person when it strengthens client relationships & deliverables

Commercial Ownership

  • Own the profitability of your engagements — understand margin, monitor burn, and proactively flag risk
  • Write and negotiate Statements of Work for new phases and follow-on engagements
  • Identify expansion opportunities within existing accounts and close them
  • Participate in the sales process for new opportunities — Very's best Engagement Leads are part of the commercial motion

Delivery Health

  • Accountable for the health of delivery on your engagements — scope, schedule, and quality
  • Make tradeoff calls with confidence; bring options, not just problems
  • On smaller engagements (≤ $250–400K, single workstream, small team): run the cadence yourself — standups, sprint planning, milestone reviews
  • On larger engagements: partner with a PM who runs execution; you shift altitude to steering, scope management, and client strategy

Team & Culture

  • Coach team members on what it means to work in a client services organization — communication, expectation management, escalation
  • Model the standard for how Very engages with clients

What success looks like

In the first 90 days:

  • Named as engagement owner on at least one active client; client and internal team know you own it
  • Strong working relationships established with key client stakeholders
  • Reporting consistently in Program Tactical; no surprises to leadership

In year one:

  • 80%+ of clients renew or expand under your ownership
  • At least one new SOW written and closed without direct leadership involvement
  • Engagements you own are consistently at or below budget with healthy margins
  • Your clients would call you first — not Very leadership — when they have a concern or an idea

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (or equivalent hands-on experience) and time spent working as a practicing engineer earlier in your career
  • Technical fluency sufficient to earn the respect of engineering teams and translate client needs into actionable scope
  • 5+ years of experience in client services, technical program management, or a delivery-facing role at a technology consulting or product company
  • Demonstrated experience owning client relationships — not just supporting them
  • Ability to write and negotiate Statements of Work independently
  • Experience managing project budgets and financial indicators
  • Excellent communication skills — written, verbal, and in the room; able to present to executives and lead difficult conversations
  • Experience with IoT, connected hardware, or complex technical product development strongly preferred

Strongly Preferred

  • Background in electronics hardware, firmware, or embedded systems product development
  • History of working directly with contract manufacturers
  • Experience in a pre-sales or solutions engineering capacity
  • 3+ years in a consultancy or client services environment

Skills We Look For in Every Lead-Level Role

  • Communicates Effectively: Expert-level communication across audiences. Can negotiate for positive outcomes on projects of any complexity. Leans into hard conversations.
  • Owns the Room: Independently resets tone when engagements drift. Decisive, direct, and respectful when recommending a different path.
  • Builds Others Up: Teaches best practices; grows the capabilities of the team around them.
  • Estimates Well: Produces accurate scoping and SOW estimates. Uses experience to pressure-test team estimates.
  • Runs Agile Cleanly: Knows how to break work into tickets, sprints, and epics. Holds teams to rhythm without being bureaucratic.

Compensation & Benefits

Base Compensation: $145,000 – $175,000 commensurate with experience.

Variable Compensation: Up to 20% performance bonus in year one

Perks & Benefits:

  • 401(k) match
  • $200-$250/month cell phone + internet stipend (monthly amount based on level)
  • $600/year home office stipend
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Paid parental leave (95th percentile in the U.S.)
  • Professional development stipend
  • Loaned MacBook Pro
  • Annual team retreat
Why Work for Very

We do not promise an easy ride — we promise meaningful work.

We work hard because our clients’ success depends on it, and we take pride in delivering when others can’t. We collaborate closely, move fast, and stay grounded in results. We take joy in the process — in the problem-solving, the iteration, and the shared wins that come from doing the hard things well.

If you’re looking for a place where every project matters, where the standards are high, and where you’ll grow by pushing yourself and others — welcome to Very.

Interviewing for a new company is a serious time commitment for all parties involved. Please take the time to read this and thoughtfully consider if we would be a good fit for one another. No contractors or agencies. Seriously.

**Note: This role requires the ability to travel within the US as needed for client engagements.

jobs.description:
About the Role

At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint.

Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale.

Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation.

You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences.

What you'll own

    Define the future of OLX’s Group's brand ecosystem

    Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. You'll ensure our brands feel connected where they should, distinctive where they need to be, and consistently recognisable across every customer touchpoint.

  • Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards

  • Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles

  • Multi-brand design systems and asset libraries

  • Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising)

  • Long-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets.

    • Build scalable creative systems powered by AI

    You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high-quality work consistently and efficiently.

    Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand.

    You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation.

    Raise the creative standard across OLX Group

    As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives.

    You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose.

    Translate strategy into brand experiences

    You'll partner closely with Marketing and Brand Strategy from the earliest stages of initiatives, transforming customer insights, research and business priorities into compelling visual systems and brand experiences.

    You'll contribute strategic thinking—not simply execute briefs, helping teams solve complex business challenges through design that strengthens trust, recognition and long-term brand value.

    Drive adoption and influence across the organisation

    Creating great systems is only part of the role, you'll ensure they're embraced.

    You'll build documentation, enablement programmes, design resources and governance models that help global and regional teams confidently apply OLX Group's brand standards.

    You'll influence senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing and Executive Leadership, aligning teams around a shared creative vision and ensuring design has a meaningful voice in strategic decision-making.

    Mentor and elevate the craft

    As a Principal Designer, your influence extends well beyond your own work.

    You'll coach designers through critique, mentoring and collaboration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, systems thinking and continuous improvement. While this isn't a people management role, you'll be recognised as a trusted design leader whose expertise elevates the entire organisation.

What we're looking for

    We're looking for a strategic design leader with exceptional craft, systems thinking and a passion for building brands that scale globally.

    You create brands that people trust

    Your portfolio demonstrates outstanding work across visual identity, typography, layout, storytelling, motion and digital experiences. You understand how to create memorable brands—and how to evolve and steward them over time.

    You think in systems

    You build frameworks, governance models, templates and design systems that enable organisations to produce consistently exceptional work. You know that the best design creates lasting capability, not just individual deliverables.

    You bring strategy to life through Design

    You're comfortable partnering with Marketing, Brand Strategy and executive stakeholders, translating positioning, customer insights and business objectives into creative systems that deliver measurable business impact.

    You're fluent in AI-enabled Design

    You already incorporate AI into your creative practice and understand where emerging technologies create value, and where human judgement remains essential.
    You can translate those insights into scalable workflows that improve quality, speed, experimentation and consistency across teams.

    You influence without authority

    You communicate with clarity, build trusted relationships and bring people together around a shared creative vision. You're equally comfortable presenting to executives, collaborating with marketers or mentoring fellow designers.

    You bring depth of experience

    You'll likely have:

  • 10+ years of experience in brand design, or visual design

  • Experience building or evolving brands at scale across multiple products or markets

  • Expertise in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite

  • Experience with motion design, storytelling, and digital brand experiences

  • Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems

  • Deep familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and workflows

  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

Why join OLX

    OLX operates some of the world's most recognized online marketplaces, connecting millions of people every day to buy, sell, find jobs, discover homes, and build businesses.

    As our Principal Brand Designer, you'll have a unique opportunity to shape the future of multiple global brands while defining how AI and design systems work together to create consistent, high-quality brand experiences at scale.

    This role offers the chance to influence design beyond individual projects to build the frameworks, standards, and creative vision that will guide OLX's brands for years to come.

    If you're excited by solving complex brand challenges, setting the highest creative standards, and pioneering the future of AI-enabled design, we'd love to hear from you.

Hiring Process

    We believe in a transparent and collaborative hiring process that reflects how we work as a team. Here’s what you can expect:
    First Stage
    Portfolio & Design Leadership
    This is a 90-minute session with the Hiring Manager. We’ll dive deep into your portfolio to assess your design craft, strategic thinking, systems mindset, and collaboration skills. This is also an opportunity to showcase your leadership in design and discuss how you approach complex challenges.

    Second Stage
    Multi-Brand Systems & Creative Leadership
    In this 60-minute session, you’ll meet with a senior leader from the Creative team. We’ll explore your ability to build, evolve, and govern brand systems across a complex multi-brand organization. This stage focuses on your creative leadership and how you ensure consistency and innovation across diverse brands.

    Third Stage
    Executive Partnership & Business Impact
    This 45-minute session is with a senior leader from the Marketing team. We’ll assess your leadership presence, ability to form strategic partnerships with Marketing, and your commercial thinking. This is also a chance to discuss how you drive organizational influence and deliver business impact through brand design.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

Data Process Policy

OLX will process your personal data to assess your fit for the applied position. You may optionally consent to store your data for up to 12 months after the application process for consideration in future OLX roles. For more details on how your application data will be processed please check our Privacy Statement.

jobs.description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 19 Oct 2026

At MiniMed, you can begin a lifelong career of exploration and innovation, while helping make a difference in the lives of people living with diabetes around the globe. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation for a more connected, compassionate world.

About the Role

The Senior Manager, Tax Planning, Transfer Pricing & International Tax is a key leadership position responsible for developing and executing the Company's global tax strategy, transfer pricing framework, and tax compliance for jurisdictions outside the United States (“OUS”). This highly visible position will serve as a strategic business partner to Finance, FP&A, Legal, Treasury, Operations, and commercial leaders, providing practical tax guidance on business initiatives, operating-model changes, intercompany arrangements, geographic expansion, acquisitions, divestitures, and other strategic transactions.

The position will lead transfer pricing strategy and OUS compliance; evaluate the tax implications of business initiatives; support legal entity and supply chain changes; and identify tax-efficient structures that align with business objectives while managing risk. The Senior Manager will also monitor global legislative developments and emerging tax regulations, including Pillar Two and other international tax reforms. In addition, the Senior Manager will partner with the Tax Accounting lead to model the effective tax rate, cash tax, and risk objectives and will oversee non-U.S. direct tax matters in partnership with local finance teams and external advisors. The position will translate evolving business facts and tax law into clear recommendations, governance, controls, and timely inputs for tax accounting, compliance, forecasting, and executive decision-making.

This position will lead internal team members and external service providers, develop talent, establish scalable processes, and promote collaboration across the global tax function. This position will report to the Head of Tax.

Key Responsibilities

Tax Planning

  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of MiniMed’s products, legal entities, value chain, intellectual property, manufacturing footprint, intercompany flows, distribution model, and key business initiatives.
  • Lead global tax planning by identifying, modeling, recommending, and implementing practical strategies that support business growth, effective tax rate, cash tax, and risk-management objectives.
  • Advise business and functional leaders on the tax implications of operating-model changes, supply-chain initiatives, manufacturing and sourcing decisions, market entry, legal-entity changes, financing, intellectual property, acquisitions, divestitures, and integrations.

Transfer Pricing

  • Oversee MiniMed’s global transfer pricing framework, including policies, functional analyses, economic studies, intercompany agreements, pricing methodologies, governance, documentation, and audit defense.
  • Partner with Finance and local controllers to establish, monitor, and adjust intercompany prices for products, services, royalties, financing, and other related-party transactions so results remain aligned with business facts, contractual terms, and the arm’s-length principle.
  • Oversee quarterly transfer pricing forecasting and monitoring, explain jurisdictional or entity-level results, coordinate prospective or true-up adjustments, and communicate impacts to Tax Accounting, FP&A, Controllership, and senior leadership.

OUS Compliance

  • Oversee OUS direct tax matters, including tax planning, local-country risk assessments, technical consultations, tax authority inquiries, controversy support, withholding-tax considerations, and coordination of return and payment requirements with internal owners and external advisors.
  • Oversee OUS indirect tax matters, including VAT/GST, sales and use taxes, customs and duties, indirect tax registrations and filings, audit and controversy support, process and control governance, and coordination with local finance teams and external advisors to assess business changes and manage compliance and risk.
  • Monitor and assess OUS legislative, regulatory, treaty, OECD, and global minimum-tax developments; quantify impacts and ensure timely communication to Tax Accounting, Finance, and business stakeholders.
  • Provide input to the quarterly and annual income tax provision, OUS tax rates, enacted-law changes, uncertain tax positions, cash-tax items, Pillar Two considerations, and discrete transactions.
  • Support tax audits and controversies by developing technical positions, coordinating responses, maintaining examination-ready documentation, managing advisors, and recommending resolution strategies.
  • Manage external advisors, project scope, budgets, timelines, deliverables, and technical quality; identify opportunities to improve processes, data, systems, analytics, and internal ownership.
  • Develop team capability through coaching, delegation, feedback, knowledge sharing, and documented procedures while fostering an accountable, inclusive, and collaborative culture.

Must Have: Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • CPA, J.D., LL.M. in Taxation, Master of Taxation, or comparable advanced degree is preferred.
  • 7+ years of progressive U.S. federal and international income tax experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 5+ years with a relevant advanced degree.
  • Significant experience in tax planning and transfer pricing, including policy design, financial modeling, intercompany agreements, operational implementation, documentation, and audit support.
  • Experience leading OUS tax matters across multiple jurisdictions and coordinating with local finance teams and external advisors.
  • Experience in a multinational corporate tax department, public accounting firm, or law firm; medical technology, manufacturing, or regulated-industry experience is preferred.
  • Experience managing large global special projects or teams is preferred.

Nice to Have

  • Technical depth: Strong knowledge of U.S. and international income tax principles, transfer pricing regulations and OECD guidance, tax treaties, withholding taxes, and global tax developments. Familiarity with tax accounting, effective tax rate, cash-tax forecasting, and Pillar Two is highly desirable.

The North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) is one of the largest, most complex agencies in the state, and has approximately 17,000 employees. Description of Work

The Subsidy Data Manager supports the work of the Subsidy Services Compliance Units by performing data management activities that rely heavily on spreadsheet use, the Client Services Data Warehouse, and data entry into NC FAST, the case management and payment system for the Subsidized Child Care Assistance Program. The position provides customer service to internal DCDEE staff and external partners while ensuring the accuracy and completeness of data used for compliance activities and program reporting. It processes and organizes data to fulfill information requests from internal and external customers and supports the operational needs of the compliance units.

The role functions within a structured data and compliance environment, requiring consistent application of established procedures. This position contributes to the accuracy and efficiency of subsidy program oversight.

– Use spreadsheets extensively to organize, track, and analyze data necessary for compliance activities.

– Access and utilize the Client Services Data Warehouse to retrieve and review data supporting Subsidy Compliance Unit work.

– Enter, update, and maintain subsidy case information in NC FAST to support accurate case management and payment processing.

– Provide customer service to internal DCDEE staff and external partners by responding to data‑related inquiries and information requests.

– Generate and prepare data reports to fulfill requests from internal and external customers.

– Maintain organized data files and documentation to support ongoing compliance monitoring processes.

– Collaborate with compliance unit staff to ensure timely and accurate data flow for monitoring activities.

– Identify data inconsistencies and communicate issues for corrective follow‑up within established procedures.

– Support the operational needs of multiple Subsidy Compliance Units by coordinating data entry, data retrieval, and report preparation tasks.

– Ensure confidentiality and appropriate handling of program data in compliance with agency standards.

About the Subsidy Services Provider Compliance Unit:

The Subsidy Services Provider Compliance Unit conducts on‑site monitoring visits to assess whether child care providers comply with state and federal requirements governing subsidized child care programs. The unit evaluates provider records using standardized procedures to ensure accuracy, identify training needs, and strengthen compliance with policies, rules, and regulations. Its work focuses on minimizing audit exceptions, developing corrective action plans, and making referrals to relevant oversight bodies, including Child Care Consultants, Local Purchasing Agencies, CACFP, and Internal Audits. Major functions include selecting a random sample of providers each month, performing on‑site visits, reviewing records for errors, noncompliance, or potential fraud, and coordinating referrals with licensing enforcement and other partner agencies.

AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market.

The timing matters. Abnormal is growing about 50% year over year, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people.   • Own AI Security in your territory. Carry the AI Security quota and run the full sales cycle end to end, from first conversation through close, including significant upsell campaigns across our existing customer base.
