  • Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace.

WHAT YOU’LL SELL

Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability:

  • AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost.
  • AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots.
  • AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions.
  • AI Agent Security: Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended.
  • AI Security Workbench: Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW

Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a track record protecting email for thousands of customers. That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure we capitalize on it while the window is open.

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, primarily selling into Enterprise accounts, with a proven record of winning new logos and expanding accounts.

  • Strong cross-functional instincts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and product leadership, and you will work autonomously between those touchpoints.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Direct experience selling AI security, cloud security, or other emerging security categories.
  • Experience in an overlay, specialist, or advisory role in cybersecurity or AI, or a record of selling into CISOs and security leaders.
  • Experience selling early-availability products and shaping design partner deals.

jobs.excerpt: Firmable's product depends on customer trust in how we handle their data.
jobs.description:
Firmable's product depends on customer trust in how we handle their data. This role is the operational backbone of that trust: the controls you run are what let 1,000+ customers rely on Firmable with their data.

The Role

As our Security Engineer, you'll own the day-to-day execution of the security controls and policies that keep Firmable compliant against SOC 2 (all five TSC) and ISO 27001:2022. You'll report into the Security & Compliance team, fully remote and open globally. This is a hands-on operational role, not a paper-compliance one: you implement, monitor and continuously tighten the controls auditors and customers actually test against.

~90% hands-on execution: control implementation, continuous monitoring, evidence collection, vulnerability and access management.
~10% cross-functional: partnering with engineering on secure cloud config and shaping the program as it scales across frameworks.

What You'll Own

  • SOC 2 & ISO 27001 execution: implement and maintain controls across infrastructure, applications and internal systems; close gaps as they're identified

  • Security policy enforcement: put information security policy into daily practice across engineering and business teams, covering access control, data classification, incident response, vendor risk and change management

  • Continuous control monitoring: recurring access reviews, log reviews, vulnerability scans and patch cadence checks; organise evidence ahead of audits

  • Vulnerability management: triage scanner findings, coordinate remediation with engineering, verify closure

  • Identity & access management: onboarding/offboarding, least-privilege and MFA enforcement, periodic access recertification

  • Monitoring & incident response: watch security alerts and logs, triage and escalate per the incident response plan

  • Risk & vendor management: maintain the risk register and third-party risk assessments, track remediation to closure

  • Audit readiness: prepare evidence for annual assessments and respond to customer security questionnaires

  • Security awareness: run employee training and phishing simulations

  • Secure cloud configuration: partner with engineering on least-privilege IAM, encryption at rest and in transit, and secrets management (AWS)

What We're Looking For

Must haves

  • 2–5 years in security engineering, cloud security or infrastructure security, ideally with direct SOC 2 or ISO 27001 exposure

  • Working knowledge of the SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria and how technical controls map to them

  • Hands-on cloud security fundamentals (AWS preferred): IAM, logging/monitoring, vulnerability scanning

  • Comfortable executing policy day to day (access reviews, evidence collection, remediation tracking), not just writing it

  • Clear written communication and comfortable working async across time zones with a distributed team

Highly valued

  • Familiarity with GRC automation platforms (Vanta, Drata or similar)

  • Relevant certification (Security+, CySA+, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, or progress toward CISA/CISSP)

The Environment

Fully remote, open globally, working closely with a distributed Security and Engineering team across time zones. Real ownership over controls that directly protect customer trust, not a box-ticking exercise. Fast-moving, AI-native product team.

Why This Role

  • Real ownership: the controls you run directly protect the trust 1,000+ customers place in Firmable's data

  • Multi-framework exposure from day one: a live SOC 2 and ISO 27001 program, not a single-framework box-tick

  • Competitive compensation and flexible hours in a fast-moving, AI-native product team

jobs.title: Strategic Alliance Lead - Director
jobs.excerpt: Strategic Alliance Lead (Associate Director or Director) Location(s) – Europe (UK, France or Belgium) or United States (East Coast) Do you get more energy from building something than from maintaining it?
jobs.description:
Strategic Alliance Lead (Associate Director or Director)

Location(s) – Europe (UK, France or Belgium) or United States (East Coast)

Do you get more energy from building something than from maintaining it? Can you sit across the table from a global pharma executive one day and roll your sleeves up with a project team the next? Ready to own a strategically relationship in our business, and write the playbook as you go, rather than inherit someone else's?

At Cerba Research, we are committed to finding the best talent to join our team. We have partnered with Vector Talent to manage the recruitment process for this role. If you're interested in applying, please direct all applications and questions to Vector Talent.

Cerba Research is looking for a Strategic Alliance Lead to take ownership of our most strategic partnerships, preferred-provider relationships, and sole-source alliances across Central and Specialty Laboratory Services. This is a build role: you'll be the executive and operational bridge between Cerba Research and our most important partners; designing the governance, framework, and cross-functional alignment that doesn't fully exist yet, while elevating the team around you into a more strategic way of working.

About Cerba Research

With over 40 years of clinical research expertise, Cerba Research has built a unique offering of services, which includes clinical trial management, specialty lab & biomarkers services and medical devices & diagnostics offerings.

Cerba Research supports clients from research and development all the way through clinical studies and commercialization of therapies. We combine the deep therapeutic understanding and agility of a specialist with the capacity, breadth and global reach of a central lab.

Our extensive experience in central & specialty laboratory services is key to our success, allowing us to provide clients with early scientific insights that optimize protocol development.

We provide key laboratory services to biopharma, government and not-for-profit organizations, supporting clinical trials. Our global accredited laboratory network and connected logistical infrastructure covers the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Australia and Africa.

Our aim is to transform clinical research to deliver the promise of precision and predictive medicine to help people live healthier lives. It's our passion, expertise, and commitment to quality that drive Cerba Research. We want to change the shape of clinical development, and help patients around the world get access to new treatments faster.

Why Join Us?

  • Real Ownership, From Day One – You'll be the named executive lead for a landmark strategic partnership generating multi-million-dollar bookings today, with a clear path to significantly more as the relationship expands.
  • A True Blank Slate – This isn't a role you're inheriting, you're building the governance framework, the relationship model, and the playbook that Cerba Research will use for its most important partnerships going forward.
  • Executive Access – You'll operate at the level of global pharma procurement, vendor management, and clinical leadership.
  • Global Reach, Real Impact – Join a business with 40+ years of clinical research heritage and a global accredited laboratory network spanning the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Australia and Africa.

How You Will Add Value

As Strategic Alliance Lead, you will contribute to:

  • Owning strategic alliance leadership across Cerba Research's highest-value partnerships, sole-source relationships, and preferred-provider agreements
  • Building and running the governance model - QBRs, executive steering committees, escalation pathways; from the ground up
  • Acting as the voice of the customer internally and the voice of Cerba Research externally, translating what each side actually needs into action
  • Driving strategic account growth - new services, new therapeutic areas, and expanded scope, in partnership with Commercial leadership
  • Coaching and elevating the existing portfolio oversight team into a more strategic, alliance-first way of working

Your Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated executive and operational lead for assigned strategic partners, sole-source relationships, and preferred-provider agreements
  • Lead the implementation and onboarding of newly signed strategic partnerships, coordinating cross-functional readiness and governance structures
  • Monitor and ensure compliance with MSA commitments, service levels, and contractual obligations - proactively identifying and closing gaps
  • Define, track, and report KPIs including study award rates, turnaround time, quality indicators, and customer satisfaction, translating them into executive-ready insight
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Procurement, Vendor Management, Clinical Operations, and Executive Leadership
  • Lead resolution of complex operational, quality, or commercial issues affecting strategic partners, coordinating cross-functional teams to close them out
  • Develop and maintain Strategic Alliance Plans covering stakeholder mapping, growth targets, competitive positioning, and expansion opportunities

Travel:

Significant in the early phase of this role, as you build relationships and governance structures in person across our labs and our partners' sites. This typically settles to around 30% once a quarterly governance cadence is established.

Requirements

About You

You've owned a strategic alliance relationship in CRO or central/specialty lab services from the point it was awarded. You're as comfortable in the detail with a project team as you are across the table from a senior procurement or clinical leader. You'd rather build the framework than be handed one.

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business Administration, Clinical Research, or a related field (advanced degree preferred)
  • Minimum 5 years in strategic account management, alliance management, or business operations within CRO, central laboratory, or a related life sciences environment, lab alliance experience preferred, CRO alliance experience essential
  • Demonstrated experience owning a strategic partnership, preferred-provider agreement, or sole-source relationship end to end
  • Comfortable operating in a heavily matrixed organization. You’re able to influence delivery teams and senior leadership in both directions without formal authority over either
  • Executive-level stakeholder engagement experience, ideally including pharma procurement or vendor management
  • A genuine interest in mentorship and team development, this role includes elevating the capability of the wider team
  • Fluent in English

At Cerba HealthCare, we believe that the diversity of people, backgrounds, and perspectives is an essential asset in fulfilling our mission: to improve the health of everyone, everywhere.

We are committed to providing an inclusive work environment that guarantees equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of age, background, sexual orientation, disability, or any other personal characteristic. All talented individuals are encouraged to apply.

jobs.excerpt: 사람들의 삶의 질을 향상시키고자 하는 열정을 기반으로, WSA 는 보청기 업계의 선도 기업으로 성장하고 있습니다.
jobs.description:
사람들의 삶의 질을 향상시키고자 하는 열정을 기반으로, WSA 는 보청기 업계의 선도 기업으로 성장하고 있습니다. 난청인들이 소리를 통해 윤택한 삶을 영위하도록 비즈니스 혁신을 가속화하며 시장을 확대하여 더 많은 사람들에게 더 효과적으로 다가가고자 합니다.

담당 업무

  • 보청기(시그니아/와이덱스) 제품 및 피팅 관련 교육 프로그램 기획 및 운영

  • 내부(Sales/CS/MKT) 및 외부(보청기 센터, 병원 등) 대상 제품 교육 및 실습 진행

  • 신제품 출시 관련 교육 기획 및 실행

  • 교육 콘텐츠(PPT, 매뉴얼 가이드 자료 등) 개발 및 유지관리

  • APAC/Global 교육자료 Localization 및 국내 시장에 맞는 콘텐츠 개발

  • 제품 기능, 피팅, Troubleshooting 등 Technical Support 제공

근무 조건

자격 요건

  • 청각학(Audiology) 학사 이상

  • 보청기 업계 또는 의료기기 교육 경험

  • 교육 및 프레젠테이션 역량

  • 교육 콘텐츠 제작 경험 (PPT, 영상 자료 등)

  • 원활한 커뮤니케이션 및 협업 능력

  • 영어 문서 이해 및 이메일 커뮤니케이션 가능

  • 국내외 외근 및 출장에 결격사유가 없는 자

우대 사항

  • 청능사 자격 보유

  • AI를 활용한 콘텐츠 제작 및 업무 효율화 역량

  • 신제품 Launch Project 경험

  • 영어 회화 가능자

기업소개

WSA 는 보청기 업계에서 가장 저명하고 혁신적인 브랜드들이 모여 Sivantos와 Widex의 합병을 통해 2019년에 설립되었습니다.

WSA 는 난청인들이 소리를 통해 윤택한 삶을 영위하도록 돕는 기술을 개척하는 데 140여 년간의 경험을 통합하여 난청으로 고통 받는 모든 사람들에게 청력의 기적을 돌려주고 성장할 수 있도록 돕고 있습니다.

이러한 과정은 매우 보람 있는 일이며 우리가 하는 모든 일의 원동력입니다. 우리의 목표는 모든 사람들의 삶에서 멋진 사운드를 만들어 잠재력을 이끌어내는 것입니다.

WSA 는 오늘날 전 세계 사람들이 착용하는 보청기 3개 중 1개를 제조하고 있으며, 130개 이상의 시장에서 활동하며 전 세계적으로 12,000명의 직원을 고용하고 있습니다.

The Principal, UX Design owns Summit K12’s product-experience architecture, UX standards, design system, and proportionate validation approach. This is a hands-on functional leadership role accountable for coherent, accessible experiences across the product portfolio, personally delivering complex and consequential design work.
The Principal directs UX design practice through standards, judgment, implementation follow-through, and cross-functional partnership, while the UX Design Lead independently owns assigned experiences. The Principal does not require a separate design management layer or routine approvals. Product Managers retain product priorities, requirements, acceptance, and outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

1. Experience Architecture & Standards

  • Define coherent navigation, information architecture, interaction patterns, and experience principles across student, educator, administrator, and applicable family workflows.
  • Personally design and resolve complex or consequential cross-product experiences using working prototypes and explicit decisions.
  • Make recurring UX debt visible and recommend evidence-based improvements to accountable Product leaders.

2. Design System & Accessibility

  • Own governance, documentation, versioning, and evolution of shared components, patterns, UX writing conventions, and accessible interaction standards.
  • Collaborate with the UX Design Lead on reusable patterns while keeping routine experience decisions close to assigned work.
  • Work with Engineering and QA to verify material accessibility and experience expectations in production.

3. Research, Validation & Implementation

  • Set lean, risk-proportionate research and usability standards; personally execute consequential validation and interpret user evidence.
  • Deliver complete implementation-ready specifications for owned work, including critical states, behaviors, accessibility, and edge cases.
  • Resolve systemic implementation-fidelity gaps and ensure relevant post-release signals inform improvements.

4. Functional Leadership, AI & Capacity

  • Partner with Product leadership to sequence design demand, make capacity tradeoffs visible, and preserve clear product decision rights.
  • Establish approved AI-supported methods for prototypes, research synthesis, documentation, and design checks, with human verification.
  • Work directly with PMs, Engineering, Academic, Creative Studio, and customer-facing functions without introducing unnecessary review gates.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required
  • 7+ years in product or UX design, or equivalent demonstrated capability, including complex production workflows.
  • Expertise in interaction design, information architecture, research, design systems, accessibility, and prototyping.
  • Proven ability to lead through hands-on judgment, clear standards, and cross-functional influence.
  • Ability to make defensible tradeoffs and independently deliver complex experience work.
  • Practical fluency with Figma or equivalent production design tools.
  • Experience using measured usability and product outcomes to guide design priorities.
  • Responsible use and validation of AI-enabled design workflows.

Preferred

  • K-12 EdTech, learning-platform, assessment, reporting, or complex SaaS experience.
  • Experience modernizing legacy platforms and designing for multilingual or varied-accessibility users.

Definition of Success

Portfolio experiences become more coherent, accessible, and effective; complex design work moves through implementation reliably; a reusable design system and practical evidence reduce UX rework.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance with multiple plan options

jobs.description:
As the Engineering Lead, you will lead the team building a newly launched AI-first product with direct revenue impact. Our platform analyzes client communications and engagement signals to help mortgage bankers, the sales professionals who guide clients through home financing, focus on the clients most likely to convert. Your team builds agentic AI applications: systems where agents reason, plan, use tools, and act on their own to drive real business outcomes.

This is a player-coach role. You'll spend real time in the code: shaping architecture, reviewing designs, building critical pieces yourself, and setting the technical bar by example. At the same time, you'll own the health and direction of the team: hiring, growing engineers, setting priorities with product partners, and making sure the team ships things that matter. AI is not a side tool here. You'll use it as a core part of how you and the team design, code, test, debug, review, and ship software.

The ideal candidate is a strong engineer who genuinely wants to lead: someone energized by building a team and a product at the same time, and by defining what AI-native engineering looks like in practice.

This is a rare setup. You get the autonomy, pace, and greenfield ownership of an early-stage startup, backed by the stability, resources, and built-in distribution of an established company. The product just launched, usage is growing, and both the architecture and the team are still being shaped. You won't inherit someone else's team or someone else's technical decisions. You'll build both, and your choices will define how this product and this team work for years. You'll also get access to frontier AI development tools, including AI coding agents like Claude Code, as a core and funded part of how the team works.

About therole

  • Lead a team of engineers building agentic AI capabilities such as agent orchestration, tool calling, retrieval-augmented workflows, and LLM-powered features.

  • Stay hands-on: contribute to architecture, write and review code, and build critical components alongside the team.

  • Own the technical strategy for the platform, balancing speed, scalability, maintainability, and business impact.

  • Set the standard for evaluation, observability, and guardrails for AI agents, ensuring reliability, safety, and measurable quality in production.

  • Hire, coach, and grow engineers, giving clear feedback and creating real growth paths for the team.

  • Partner with product, design, data, and business stakeholders to set priorities and translate ambiguous business needs into a clear roadmap.

  • Define how the team works: engineering practices, AI-native development workflows, code review culture, and delivery cadence.

  • Lead collaboration across distributed engineering teams, including partners in India.

Aboutyou

You're an engineer first and a leader by choice, not by escape from the code. You've shipped real systems, you still love building, and you've discovered that growing a team multiplies your impact more than any individual contribution.

You're serious about AI, both in the product and in how the team works, and you want to lead a team that sets the example for AI-native engineering. You're comfortable in an early-stage environment where requirements evolve and priorities shift, and you bring clarity to the team rather than pass ambiguity down.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, including 2+ years leading engineers as a manager or tech lead.

  • Strong hands-on experience building production software in languages such as C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript.

  • Experience designing and operating full-stack systems across frontend, backend, APIs, and data integrations on cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

  • Track record of hiring, coaching, and growing engineers.

  • Experience owning technical strategy or architecture for a product or platform.

  • Demonstrated ability to work with product and business stakeholders to set priorities and deliver outcomes.

​Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience building with agentic AI frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar), LLM APIs, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool integrations.

  • Experience with LLM application patterns such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agent evaluation harnesses, guardrails, or production monitoring of AI behavior.

  • Experience leading a team through AI-native ways of working, such as AI coding agents, AI-assisted reviews, or multi-agent workflows.

  • Experience building or leading a team in a greenfield or newly formed product environment.

  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, CI/CD, automated testing, and production operations.

Whatyou’llget

Our team members fuel our strategy,innovationand growth, so we ensure the health and well-being of not just you, but your family, too! We goabove and beyondto give you the support you need on an individual level and offer all sorts of ways to help you live your best life. We are proud to offer eligible team members perks and health benefits that will help you have peace of mind. Simply put:We’vegot your back. Check out our full list ofBenefits and Perks.

Rocketis a Detroit-based company made up of businesses that provide simple,fastand trusted digital solutions for complex transactions. The name comes from our flagship business, now known as Rocket Mortgage®, which was founded in 1985. Today,we’rea publicly traded company involved in many different industries, including mortgages, fintech, realestateand more.We’reinsistently different in how we look at the world and are committed to an inclusive workplace where every voice is heard.Apply today to join a team that offers career growth, amazingbenefitsand the chance to work with leading industry professionals.

Launched in 2020, MedTech World began as a bold initiative to position Malta as a bridge connecting startups, investors, service providers, and thought leaders across the Medical and HealthTech space. We now run four summits, across four continents, in four quarters. Each event brings together the most important voices in MedTech and HealthTech to move the industry forward, and we are growing fast.

To lead our UK & European growth, we are looking for a commercially sharp, well-connected, and self-driven sales leader who can open doors, close deals, and work hand-in-hand with our wider team to build something exceptional.

The Role

As Head of UK & Europe, Sales and Business Development, you will own MedTech World's commercial performance across the UK and European markets. This is a senior, hands-on role built for someone who has the experience to operate independently and the instinct to collaborate. You will not be managing a large team from day one. You will be generating pipeline, closing sponsors and partners, and setting the commercial standard for the region.

You will work directly with the CEO and the wider sales and partnerships team, and your work will have a direct and visible impact on the business.

Remote. Open to candidates across the UK and Europe, provided they are eligible to work in their country of residence. Relocation to our Malta HQ is also welcomed and supported.

  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and closing high-value commercial agreements.

  • Commercially sharp, with a proven instinct for identifying opportunities, building pipeline, and closing deals without needing direction.
  • A natural relationship builder, someone who genuinely enjoys the process of earning trust with senior stakeholders, sponsors, and partners over time.
  • A confident and credible communicator, comfortable representing MedTech World in rooms with C-suite executives, investors, and government bodies.

The Clover Care Services organization delivers proactive support and care to our members through our clinical Clover Home Care teams, and quality improvement services to our aligned providers through our practice engagement team. Clover has built one of the most proactive, data-driven health care services platforms and is excited about how technology impacts our ability to bring transformative results to both patients and providers.

Clover Care Services is entering a significant period of clinical growth. As we scale our Clover Care Visit (CCV) team, we need a dedicated leader who can turn an ambitious hiring plan into a reliable, repeatable workforce engine—from recruiting pipeline and onboarding capacity through clinician readiness, productivity, and performance.

As the Director, Workforce Management, you will connect workforce planning, recruiting, onboarding, leadership capacity, and performance management into one operating system, giving the organization clear visibility into whether we are on pace and what needs to change when we are not.

As Director, Workforce Management, you will:

  • Own the CCV workforce plan end to end. Build and run the staffing strategy required to scale the clinician organization, translating long-range growth targets into weekly and monthly hiring, onboarding, and readiness goals.
  • Create visibility from candidate pipeline to “ready to visit.” Establish the operating metrics, forecasting, and reporting needed to understand recruiting conversion, onboarding lead times, attrition, training capacity, and clinician readiness—and surface risks early enough to act.
  • Build a scalable clinician onboarding model. Partner across Clinical, Talent, IT, Operations, and other teams to evolve today’s high-touch onboarding journey into a structured model that can support significantly larger hiring cohorts without sacrificing clinical quality.
  • Build the leadership capacity required to scale. Determine the right model for preceptors, clinical leads, onboarding cohorts, and frontline management so that rapid growth does not create an unsustainable burden on existing clinical leaders.
  • Own workforce performance management. Establish clear, actionable standards and operating rhythms across areas such as attendance, cancellation rates, Clover Assistant Touch, productivity, and normalized performance measures.
  • Make quality and productivity work together. Build performance expectations that reflect accurate, sustainable clinical performance—not simply higher activity—and partner with clinical leaders to ensure workforce decisions support both member experience and quality of care.
  • Turn workforce data into decisions. Build the dashboards, forecasts, and management routines leaders need to understand capacity, identify constraints, allocate resources, and stay ahead of hiring or performance gaps.
  • Create repeatable workforce-management capabilities for CCS. Use the CCV ramp as the first proving ground for processes, tools, and operating models that can later support In-Home Care and other Clover Care Services programs.
  • Operate as a cross-functional leader. Bring together Clinical Activation, clinical leadership, Talent, Operations, Finance, analytics, and other partners around one integrated workforce plan with clear owners, milestones, and escalation paths.

Success in this role looks like:

In your first 90 days, you will:

  • Build a clear baseline of the CCV workforce funnel and translate the 2027 growth target into a measurable workforce plan spanning recruiting, onboarding, training capacity, clinician readiness, and attrition.
  • Identify the biggest risks and bottlenecks in the ramp and establish the metrics, operating cadence, and accountability needed to address them.

Within your first 6 months, you will:

  • Establish a predictable recruiting-to-readiness operating model, including scalable onboarding cohorts, preceptor capacity, and clinical leadership support.
  • Launch workforce dashboards and performance-management routines that enable leaders to anticipate capacity gaps, manage performance, and increase clinician onboarding volume without sacrificing quality.

Over time, you will:

  • Help CCV reach its clinician-capacity goals ahead of the 2027 AEP cycle through a sustainable, data-driven approach to hiring, onboarding, and performance.
  • Build repeatable workforce-management capabilities that can extend beyond CCV to support In-Home Care and other Clover Care Services programs.

You should get in touch if:

  • You have built or led workforce planning, capacity management, clinical operations, field operations, or another complex people-scaling function where success depended on turning ambitious growth targets into an executable operating plan.
  • You are comfortable owning the full workforce funnel—from recruiting demand and hiring pace through onboarding, readiness, productivity, performance, and attrition.
  • You know how to scale a high-touch operating model without sacrificing the quality, judgment, and human support that made it successful.
  • You are highly analytical and can turn workforce data into useful forecasts, metrics, dashboards, and decisions.
  • You know how to balance productivity with quality, accuracy, and member experience when defining and managing performance.
  • You are an effective cross-functional operator who can create alignment and accountability across clinical leaders, recruiters, operators, analysts, and executives.
  • You are comfortable moving between strategy and execution and thrive in environments where the operating model is still being built.
  • You bring experience scaling distributed clinicians, field teams, home-based care, or another operationally complex healthcare workforce.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
  • Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most.

We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare.

From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are anE-Verify company.

Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc.

Product Manager

VA Loan Guaranty (LGY) Program | Full-Time W-2 | Fully Remote (U.S.)

The Problem We're Hiring You to Solve

Every month, your product decisions reach Veterans buying homes, the lenders who close their loans, the servicers who manage them, and the VA staff who stand behind the guaranty.

We are hiring a Product Manager for the modernization of the VA Loan Guaranty (LGY) technology portfolio. The job is translation under pressure: statute, policy, and a sprawling stakeholder ecosystem on one side, a backlog that ships to production every 30 days on the other, while a 20-year-old legacy platform keeps running until the modern one replaces it. If you can hold the Veteran, the lender, and the regulation in your head at the same time, keep reading.

The Opportunity

Most product roles let you invent demand. This one hands you something rarer: a product whose demand is guaranteed by law, which means every ounce of product discipline goes into making the experience better instead of making the funnel bigger.

The LGY portfolio spans the loan guaranty lifecycle: origination-adjacent workflows, servicing oversight and loss mitigation, claims, housing grants, and analytics. The modern platform is Salesforce-centered and configuration-first, supplemented by serverless capabilities in a government cloud. Users include VA program staff and thousands of external lender and servicer users.

The rhythm is fast and formal. Business needs enter through an intake process that produces an executable plan, with refined scope and level of effort, in days. Development runs on a monthly release cadence with an explicit quality bar: acceptance criteria sharp enough to support automated testing, defect detection above 95% before user acceptance testing, and accessibility built into every story. Your requirements are the first link in that quality chain.

You will partner with an Enterprise Solution Architect who owns the designs, an Engineering Lead who owns delivery, and a DevSecOps Lead who owns the platform. You own what gets built, in what order, and why.

What You'll Own

  • The backlog as an instrument of the mission. Turn business needs and policy changes into refined, traceable user stories with acceptance criteria precise enough that engineers build the right thing and testers can automate against it.
  • Intake to executable plan, fast. Drive new needs from raw business intent to a scoped, estimated, committed plan in days, working shoulder to shoulder with architecture and engineering.
  • The roadmap across the portfolio. Sequence modernization, sustainment, and legacy decommissioning, and keep the roadmap credible enough that the customer plans against it.
  • A stakeholder ecosystem, not a stakeholder. Balance VA program officials, field staff, and external lender and servicer users whose interests do not always align.
  • Value in every release. Own prioritization so every 30-day release ships something stakeholders can name, and coordinate user acceptance testing that runs smoothly because the criteria were right from the start.
  • The configure-versus-customize conversation. The program mandates configuration-first solutions. You represent the business value side of those tradeoffs and know when to fight for a custom exception.
  • Decisions informed by data. Ground prioritization in analytics, usage, and operational metrics, and push for instrumentation where it does not exist yet.
  • The transition experience. As functions move from legacy to modern, sequence the change so lenders, servicers, and VA staff are brought along rather than surprised.

AI-Native Product Management

AI is part of how PhoenixTeam works, and product management may have more to gain from it than any other discipline on the program.

We are looking for someone who already uses AI tools as a working part of their practice: analyzing policy and regulation changes to extract requirements impacts in hours instead of weeks, drafting and stress-testing user stories before refinement, synthesizing stakeholder feedback into decision-ready themes, and keeping the backlog coherent as the portfolio grows.

Judgment stays human. You know when AI output misreads a regulation or produces acceptance criteria that sound precise but are not. And boundaries are non-negotiable: federal environments govern what tools may touch government data and systems. Use AI wherever it creates leverage, and understand the security, data, privacy, and authorization boundaries governing where and how it can be used.

What Great Looks Like

Twelve months in, we would expect to see:

  1. Intake is fast and trusted. Needs move from raw intent to committed plans in days, and the customer trusts the scoping because it keeps proving accurate.
  2. Requirements stopped causing rework. Stories flow into development without churn, and ambiguity-driven defects trend toward zero.
  3. Every release has a headline. Stakeholders can name what shipped last month and why it mattered.
  4. UAT is uneventful. The business was engaged all along, not summoned at the end.
  5. The roadmap is the plan of record, and it survives policy changes because you built it to flex.
  6. AI is visibly part of your practice, with policy analysis, story drafting, and feedback synthesis running measurably faster.

What You Bring

We care about evidence more than resumes. Expect us to ask which products you have shaped, what your requirements looked like to the engineers who built from them, and how AI functions in your practice today.

  • A product management record on complex enterprise software, with real users, real stakes, and outcomes rather than ceremonies.
  • Housing finance domain fluency. You can hold your own with business stakeholders on day one. Depth in servicing, loss mitigation, or claims is especially relevant.
  • Requirements craft. You write stories and acceptance criteria that engineers praise and testers can automate against.
  • Federal delivery experience. You treat accessibility, security, and documentation as product constraints to design within, not obstacles to resent.
  • Stakeholder range. You facilitate rooms spanning senior officials, field users, and engineers, and you can say no to a stakeholder and keep the relationship.
  • Evidence-driven prioritization, with stated assumptions when data is thin.
  • Demonstrated AI-in-the-loop practice you can show us concretely.
  • Judgment under ambiguity. You make the call, document the reasoning, and own the outcome.

  • U.S.-based, and able to obtain and maintain a federal Public Trust clearance.

We do not screen on degrees or year counts. If your evidence is strong, we want to talk.

Helpful, Not Required

  • Direct experience with VA Loan Guaranty, VALERI, or other VA benefit programs.
  • FHA, USDA rural housing, or GSE experience, or lender and servicer operations on the commercial side.
  • Product work on Salesforce or a comparable configuration-first platform.
  • Familiarity with MISMO, URLA, Jira and Confluence, or scaled agile.

Leadership Expectations

This role leads through the product. You set direction that architecture, engineering, and the customer align around, present recommendations to federal decision-makers with evidence, and challenge direction that will hurt the program or the Veteran, respectfully and early, including ours. Silent disagreement is a failure mode here, and so is the PM who relays stakeholder requests without shaping them. When priorities conflict, you make the call and own the outcome.

This May Not Be the Role for You If...

You may struggle here if you need someone else to translate policy into requirements, treat product management as ticket administration, avoid telling stakeholders no, wait for complete information before committing, treat compliance as friction rather than product requirements, view AI as a novelty, or stopped learning when you became senior. None of that makes someone a bad product manager. It makes them a bad fit for this particular job.

Why PhoenixTeam

  • You will be among people who speak your language. PhoenixTeam is a woman-owned small business founded and led by housing finance technologists who still do the work, with years embedded inside federal housing programs from loan guaranty to rural housing to mortgage insurance.
  • Direct customer access. Your product judgment reaches the federal decision-makers who act on it.
  • You shape the product, not just the backlog. You define how product management works on this program.
  • AI-native is practice, not positioning. We fund ongoing AI education and development for the entire team.
  • Fully remote,S.-based, permanently.
  • Competitive salary and 100% employer-paid medical insurance.
  • Mission you can explain at dinner. The product you shape supports the home loan benefit for the people who served this country.

Position Requirements

  • Full-time W-2 employment with PhoenixTeam.
  • Must be based in the United States.
  • Fully remote.
  • Work supports the Department of Veterans Affairs Loan Guaranty Service (LGY).
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain the required federal Public Trust clearance. A Secret clearance is not required.

PhoenixTeam is a woman-owned small business focused on federal and commercial housing finance technology.

jobs.title: Coordonnateur.trice junior - ventes et développement des affaires
jobs.excerpt: À propos d’AkinoxAkinox est une entreprise canadienne de santé numérique qui vise à améliorer l’accès des patients aux soins ainsi que la façon dont les organisations de santé les offrent.
jobs.description:
À propos d’Akinox

Akinox est une entreprise canadienne de santé numérique qui vise à améliorer l’accès des patients aux soins ainsi que la façon dont les organisations de santé les offrent. Depuis plus de 15 ans, Akinox collabore avec des organisations de santé et des gouvernements afin de concevoir et d’exploiter des solutions de santé numérique à grande échelle. Nos activités couvrent notamment les soins de première ligne, les soins virtuels, l’accès aux soins et la transformation des processus cliniques.

À propos de CarePath

CarePath transforme des informations cliniques fragmentées en une vue claire et exploitable du patient.

Conçu pour les équipes de soins de première ligne et de santé communautaire, CarePath utilise l’intelligence artificielle pour simplifier l’analyse des dossiers patients, repérer les informations cliniques clés et faciliter la préparation des soins. La solution vise notamment à réduire la charge administrative et clinique liée à l’accueil de nouveaux patients. CarePath entre maintenant dans une phase importante de commercialisation et de développement de sa clientèle.

Le rôle

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) Coordonnateur(trice) junior – Développement des affaires et ventes pour soutenir la croissance de CarePath.

Il s’agit d’un contrat de 6 mois à 30 heures par semaine avec possibilité d’extension. La personne recherchée doit avoir un intérêt marqué envers les ventes, le développement commercial, et la technologie dans le domaine de la santé.

En étroite collaboration avec le Chief Growth Officer et l’Architecte de solutions ventes, vous contribuerez à identifier des clients potentiels, à réaliser des activités de prospection, à soutenir les activités de découverte et de vente ainsi qu’à assurer un suivi efficace des occasions d’affaires afin de les faire progresser.

Vos responsabilités

  • Effectuer chaque semaine de la génération de prospects et de la recherche de comptes assistées par l’IA, en fonction des profils de clients idéaux (ICP) définis.
  • Effectuer des recherches sur les organisations de santé ciblées et identifier les décideurs et personnes-ressources pertinents.
  • Créer et maintenir des listes priorisées de prospects et de démarches de prospection.
  • Effectuer de la prospection par courriel, LinkedIn et téléphone en utilisant les messages et campagnes établis pour CarePath.
  • Identifier et communiquer avec les prospects qualifiés ou ayant déjà démontré un intérêt, effectuer une première qualification et coordonner leur transfert à l’Architecte de solutions ventes pour approfondir la découverte des besoins et les discussions entourant la solution.
  • Consigner avec précision dans HubSpot les activités de prospection, les interactions avec les clients, les notes de rencontre, le statut des prospects et les prochaines étapes.
  • Participer aux activités de découverte client, notamment par la recherche sur les comptes, la préparation des rencontres, la prise de notes et les suivis.
  • Contribuer à la préparation et à la personnalisation de présentations de vente, documents synthèses, études de cas et autres outils de vente et de marketing.
  • Interagir avec les clients et les utilisateurs afin de recueillir des commentaires, résultats, données et observations pouvant être utilisés dans les activités de vente et de marketing.
  • Soutenir les webinaires, conférences, lancements de produits et autres activités de mise en marché, notamment en contribuant aux invitations et aux suivis.
  • Fournir au Chief Growth Officer une mise à jour hebdomadaire concise présentant les activités réalisées, les prospects, les rencontres, l’évolution du pipeline de ventes ainsi que les commentaires pertinents provenant du marché.
  • Participer à d’autres activités liées aux ventes, au développement des affaires et à la mise en marché, selon les besoins.

Profil recherché

Il s’agit d’un poste de début de carrière. Nous ne nous attendons donc pas à ce que vous connaissiez déjà tout du secteur de la santé ou de la vente aux entreprises. Nous recherchons plutôt une personne qui :

  • A minimalement un diplôme secondaire, est actuellement aux études (post-secondaire), récemment diplômée ou se situe approximativement dans les cinq premières années de sa carrière.
  • Est à l’aise de communiquer de manière professionnelle par courriel, téléphone et LinkedIn.
  • Est organisée et en mesure d’assurer un suivi rigoureux et constant des activités de prospection et des prochaines étapes.
  • Est à l’aise d’apprendre et d’utiliser des outils d’intelligence artificielle, des plateformes CRM et des outils numériques de vente.
  • Possède de bonnes aptitudes en recherche et est capable de comprendre rapidement une organisation et d’identifier les bonnes personnes à approcher.
  • Possède de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et peut contribuer à la création de documents professionnels destinés aux clients.
  • Est curieuse, à l’aise de poser des questions et d’interagir avec des professionnels de la santé et des dirigeants d’organisations.
  • Est capable de travailler de manière autonome selon des priorités clairement établies, tout en collaborant étroitement avec une petite équipe.
  • Une expérience avec HubSpot, la vente B2B, le secteur de la santé, la santé numérique, le marketing ou le développement des affaires constitue un atout, mais n’est pas requise.

Ce que vous développerez

Ce rôle vous permettra de participer à l’ensemble du processus de commercialisation d’un produit canadien de santé numérique, de la prospection à la conversion des clients. Vous développerez une expérience pratique en vente B2B, prospection assistée par l’IA, HubSpot et découverte client, tout en collaborant avec des leaders expérimentés. Vous contribuerez également à transformer les besoins et commentaires des clients en stratégies et outils de mise en marché.

------

ENGLISH

About Akinox

Akinox is a Canadian digital health company focused on improving how patients access care and how healthcare organizations deliver it. For more than 15 years, Akinox has worked with healthcare organizations and governments to design and operate digital health solutions at scale. Our work spans primary care, virtual care, patient access and clinical workflow transformation.

About CarePath

CarePath turns fragmented clinical information into a clear, actionable view of the patient.

Designed for primary care and community health teams, CarePath uses artificial intelligence to streamline patient record review, identify key clinical information, and support more efficient care preparation. The solution is designed to reduce the administrative and clinical workload associated with onboarding new patients. CarePath is now entering an important phase of commercialization and customer growth.

The Role

We are looking for an early-career Business Development & Sales Coordinator to support the growth of CarePath.

This is a 6 months contract position at 30 hours per week, with the possibility of extension. We are looking for someone with a strong interest in sales, business development, and technology in the healthcare sector. Working closely with the Chief Growth Officer and Sales Solutions Architect, you will help identify prospective customers, execute outreach, support discovery and sales activities, and ensure opportunities are effectively tracked and advanced.

What You'll Do

  • Conduct weekly AI-assisted lead generation and account research against defined Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs).
  • Research target healthcare organizations and identify relevant decision-makers and contacts.
  • Build and maintain prioritized prospect and outreach lists.
  • Conduct email, LinkedIn and phone outreach using established CarePath messaging and campaigns.
  • Identify and engage with warm leads, conduct initial qualification and coordinate hand-off to the Sales Solutions Architect for deeper discovery and solution discussions.
  • Accurately record outreach, customer interactions, meeting notes, lead status and next steps in HubSpot.
  • Assist with customer discovery, including account research, meeting preparation, note-taking and follow-up.
  • Help prepare and customize sales decks, one-pagers, case studies and other sales and marketing materials.
  • Interact with customers and users to help capture feedback, results, data points and insights that can be used in sales and marketing.
  • Support webinars, conferences, product launches and other go-to-market activities, including invitations and follow-up.
  • Provide a concise weekly update to the Chief Growth Officer covering activity, leads, meetings, pipeline movement and relevant market feedback.
  • Assist with other sales, business development and go-to-market activities as required.

What We're Looking For

This is an early-career role, so we don't expect you to arrive knowing everything about healthcare or enterprise sales. We are looking for someone who is:

  • Has at least a high school diploma and is currently pursuing post-secondary studies, has recently graduated, or is approximately within the first five years of their career.
  • Comfortable communicating professionally by email, phone and LinkedIn.
  • Organized and able to consistently follow through on outreach and next steps.
  • Comfortable learning and using AI tools, CRM platforms and digital sales tools.
  • A strong researcher who can quickly understand an organization and identify the right people to approach.
  • Able to write clearly and help create professional customer-facing materials.
  • Curious and comfortable asking questions and interacting with healthcare professionals and organizational leaders.
  • Able to work independently within clear priorities while collaborating closely with a small team.

Experience with HubSpot, B2B sales, healthcare, digital health, marketing or business development is an asset, but not required.

What You'll Gain

This role will allow you to participate in the entire commercialization process of a Canadian digital health product, from prospecting to customer conversion. You will gain hands-on experience in B2B sales, AI-assisted prospecting, HubSpot, and customer discovery while working alongside experienced leaders. You will also contribute to transforming customer needs and feedback into go-to-market strategies and sales tools.

jobs.description:
SAP MM Consultant – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP MM Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $130,000–$190,000 Annually
Experience Required: 7+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP MM Consultant to lead the implementation, enhancement, and support of enterprise SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions supporting global procurement, inventory management, warehouse operations, and supply chain initiatives. This role focuses on delivering scalable SAP S/4HANA MM solutions that streamline Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes, vendor management, material planning, and inventory optimization across enterprise environments.
You will work closely with procurement teams, supply chain leaders, warehouse operations, finance stakeholders, SAP functional consultants, and technical teams to design and configure SAP MM solutions that improve procurement efficiency, inventory visibility, and operational performance. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in SAP MM configuration, cross-functional integration, and SAP S/4HANA transformation projects while maintaining a strong understanding of end-to-end Procure-to-Pay business processes.

Key Responsibilities
  • Analyze business requirements and design scalable SAP MM solutions supporting procurement and supply chain operations.
  • Configure SAP Materials Management components including Purchasing, Inventory Management, Material Master, Vendor Master, Valuation, and Invoice Verification.
  • Lead end-to-end implementation and enhancement projects across Procure-to-Pay (P2P) business processes.
  • Configure organizational structures including plants, storage locations, purchasing organizations, purchasing groups, valuation areas, and company codes.
  • Configure material types, material groups, account determination, release strategies, valuation classes, and movement types.
  • Design and configure procurement processes including purchase requisitions, purchase orders, contracts, scheduling agreements, RFQs, and source determination.
  • Configure inventory management processes including goods receipts, goods issues, stock transfers, physical inventory, and cycle counting.
  • Collaborate with ABAP developers to prepare Functional Specifications for reports, interfaces, enhancements, workflows, BADIs, User Exits, IDOCs, and forms.
  • Integrate SAP MM with SD, PP, FI/CO, WM, EWM, QM, PM, and Ariba modules.
  • Support SAP S/4HANA migration projects, system upgrades, testing, cutover activities, and post-go-live support.
  • Develop functional documentation including Business Process Documents (BPDs), Functional Specifications, Configuration Documents, and Test Scripts.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and provide ongoing application support.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, solution design workshops, architecture reviews, and continuous process improvement initiatives.

Required Skills
  • Seven or more years of hands-on SAP MM consulting experience supporting enterprise SAP implementations.
  • Strong expertise in SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA Materials Management configuration.
  • Extensive knowledge of Procure-to-Pay (P2P) business processes.
  • Hands-on experience configuring Purchasing, Inventory Management, Invoice Verification, Material Master, Vendor Master, and Procurement processes.
  • Strong experience configuring material types, purchasing document types, release procedures, movement types, valuation classes, account determination, and pricing procedures.
  • Experience configuring procurement processes including RFQs, Contracts, Scheduling Agreements, Purchase Orders, and Vendor Evaluation.
  • Strong understanding of inventory management, warehouse operations, stock transfers, physical inventory, cycle counting, and inventory valuation.
  • Experience integrating SAP MM with FI/CO, SD, PP, QM, WM, EWM, PM, and Ariba.
  • Experience preparing Functional Specifications for ABAP developments including Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms, and Workflows (RICEFW).
  • Familiarity with IDOCs, BAPIs, RFCs, APIs, EDI, and middleware integration technologies.
  • Experience supporting integrations with supplier portals, procurement platforms, warehouse management systems, and third-party logistics providers.
  • Experience with SAP Solution Manager, ChaRM, SAP GUI, and SAP Fiori.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and business process optimization skills.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum or SAP Activate implementation methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience participating in multiple full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation or migration projects.
  • Familiarity with SAP Fiori Apps, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), and SAP Integration Suite.
  • Experience with SAP Ariba, SAP Supplier Lifecycle Management (SLM), and SAP Business Network.
  • Knowledge of SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), Warehouse Management (WM), and Transportation Management (TM).
  • Experience supporting global procurement and supply chain organizations.
  • Familiarity with Material Requirements Planning (MRP), Demand Planning, and Supply Chain Planning processes.
  • Experience integrating SAP with Coupa, Jaggaer, Salesforce, MuleSoft, Boomi, or other enterprise applications.
  • SAP Certified Application Associate or SAP Certified Professional certification in SAP MM or SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement is highly desirable.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing, automotive, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, retail, or consumer goods industries.
  • Knowledge of SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), procurement reporting, and operational analytics is a plus.

Project Environment
You will be joining a global SAP transformation program responsible for modernizing procurement, inventory, and supply chain operations across multiple business units. Current initiatives include:
  • SAP S/4HANA Greenfield and Brownfield implementation projects
  • Enterprise Procure-to-Pay (P2P) process transformation
  • Global procurement standardization and vendor management optimization
  • SAP Ariba and supplier collaboration platform integration
  • Warehouse Management (WM) and Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) modernization
  • Inventory optimization and Material Requirements Planning (MRP) enhancements
  • SAP Fiori application rollout for procurement and warehouse users
  • Enterprise workflow automation for purchasing approvals
  • Cloud-based SAP integrations using SAP BTP and Integration Suite
This is a hands-on functional consulting role where you will contribute to solution architecture, SAP MM configuration, procurement process optimization, system integration, testing, production support, and continuous improvement of enterprise supply chain platforms.
