jobs.excerpt: Company Overview:At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world.
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning, we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career.

Position Summary

In this role, you will have the opportunity to do meaningful work in your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning.

As Director, Industry Practice Lead – Corporate Enterprise, you will serve as Panopto’s trusted domain authority and top-of-funnel growth engine across the enterprise market. Operating as a senior individual contributor reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), you will bridge corporate talent strategy, workforce enablement, and product capability. You will serve as a sought-after expert in L&D and corporate learning, building peer-level trust with Chief Learning Officers, Heads of Talent, and enterprise IT leaders to open new pipeline and articulate how video-based knowledge management transforms workforce productivity.

You'll also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft.

How You’ll Contribute

In this role, you will have the opportunity to…

  • Top-of-Funnel Pipeline Creation & Industry Authority: Represent Panopto as a leading voice at major industry conferences (e.g., ATD, DevLearn, HR Tech), executive roundtables, and panel discussions. Activate your executive network to generate trusted top-of-funnel prospects, raise brand awareness, and open new enterprise pipeline.

  • Strategic Subject Matter Expertise in Deals: Partner with Account Executives on high-profile pre-sales opportunities as an industry peer and product expert. Seamlessly discuss corporate learning trends, business objectives, and Jobs to Be Done (JTBD) to build buyer confidence without carrying direct deal-closing responsibility.

  • Customer Value & Adoption Advisory: Conduct strategic account engagements with existing enterprise customers to evaluate current usage patterns, understand business goals, and prescribe tailored solution strategies that improve adoption, increase platform value, and identify natural expansion opportunities.

  • Domain Frameworks & Product Voice: Develop practitioner-focused domain playbooks, usage frameworks, and industry point-of-view content that elevate field conversations. Synthesize field signals on corporate learning challenges, compliance needs, and AI workflows to advise internal Product and Product Marketing teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 3 Months: Complete a baseline assessment of corporate enterprise buyer priorities, establish an engagement cadence with Sales and Product Marketing, and participate in select high-profile pre-sales strategy discussions.

  • Within 6 Months: Publish initial industry point-of-view content, lead executive engagements at key industry events to build top-of-funnel pipeline, and deliver solution adoption recommendations for top enterprise accounts.

  • Within 1 Year: Drive measurable growth in influenced pipeline, brand presence, and account expansion across Fortune 500 accounts, establishing Panopto as the premier partner for corporate video learning.

  • Your Legacy: Build a scalable, repeatable vertical practice model that elevates Panopto's market authority and defines domain-led growth.

Values in Action

  • Customer First, Always: You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated — and propose solutions, not just reports.

  • Thrive Together: You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people.

  • Elevate the Craft: You hold the bar high on your own work and invest in developing those around you. You treat every project as an opportunity to learn something new.

  • Act with Ownership: You define success by outcomes, not activity. You flag problems early and bring a proposed path forward, not just the problem.

  • Clarity Over Complexity: You default to the simpler solution. Your written communication — internal or external — is direct, specific, and free of filler.

How We Thrive

At Panopto, we believe in simple elegance in everything we do. We do not just talk about accountability; we live it. You will be joining a collaborative team of seasoned Account Executives and Revenue leaders who are deeply embedded in the enterprise sector.

As Director, Industry Practice Lead, you will be the bridge between technical capability and business transformation. You will partner directly with our Account Executives to inspire leaders, demonstrate the value of our platform, and bring our AI-driven video knowledge vision to life. This is an opportunity to serve as a trusted advisor to key buyers, shape our go-to-market strategy, and serve as the voice of the customer back to our Product and Engineering teams.

The Foundation for Success

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Human Resources, Instructional Design, Organizational Development, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

  • Experience: 8+ years of total experience combining corporate domain leadership (e.g., L&D, Enablement, Talent Development) with 3+ years of commercial GTM experience (e.g., Solutions Consulting, Practice Strategy, Value Engineering) in enterprise SaaS.

  • Technical & Product Proficiency: Strong understanding of enterprise learning technology stacks (LMS, LXP, HRIS), video infrastructure, and integration concepts (SSO, API workflows). Ability to demonstrate platform capabilities through an industry and user-outcome lens.

  • Communication & Influence: Proven track record as a conference speaker, executive communicator, or published writer skilled at engaging C-suite executives, HR leaders, and IT buyers.

  • Domain Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of corporate learning metrics, workforce upskilling frameworks, knowledge management challenges, and enterprise procurement dynamics.

  • Travel Commitment: Willingness to travel 25% – 40% for customer engagements, industry conferences, and key field events.

What Sets You Apart

  • Master’s degree or professional certifications (e.g., CPTD, CPTM).

  • Active advisory or leadership roles in major HR and L&D communities (e.g., ATD, Brandon Hall, Bersin, HR Tech).

  • Direct experience leading enterprise learning transformations or adopting AI-driven learning tools at scale.

Join Us

Join Panopto and play a pivotal role in transforming how enterprise organizations capture, share, and scale workforce knowledge. If you are a seasoned L&D and technology leader ready to drive executive engagement and accelerate growth across Fortune 500 accounts, we encourage you to apply.

Total Rewards

The salary range for this position is $160,000 - $200,000 USD per year. This position is also eligible for a bonus as part of the compensation package.

Base pay offered may vary depending on various factors, including, but not limited to: job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other eligibility factors such as geographic location. The Total Rewards package includes competitive base pay and an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs such as health insurance, flexible spending accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. At Panopto, we know that great people make an organization great. We value our people and offer employees benefits that are market competitive for our industry. Learn more about what working at Panopto can mean for you.

At Panopto, our commitment to pay equity and transparency is unwavering. We do not engage in salary negotiations beyond the established range to maintain fairness and prevent potential pay disparities among team members based on negotiation strategies.

Beyond the Requirements: At this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job description you’re reading. Even if you don't feel that you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We're eager to meet people that believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways - not just candidates who check all the boxes. We want people to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay, and do their best work here.

Recruiting Tips: From crafting an impressive resume to presenting your best self during our interviews, we're dedicated to ensuring you feel well-prepared and self-assured as you embark on opportunities at Panopto. Discover some valuableRecruiting Tipsfrom our team.

The standard interview process at Panopto involves several steps, outlined below, to ensure we approach the process thoughtfully and consistently:

Application Review -> Recruiter Call -> Video Interview & Assessment -> Hiring Manager Call -> Interview Loop -> Debrief -> Offer

Our people and culture

Panopto’s mission is to be the leader in visual and audio-based learning in a capture and post-capture world. Our user base is as diverse as the world’s universities and businesses. Panopto’s commitment to fostering a fair, equitable, and inclusive culture empowers each member of our team to express their authentic selves, contribute their distinct perspectives and make a meaningful impact both individually and collectively. This inclusive environment not only encourages creativity and the free exchange of ideas but also harnesses the power of varied viewpoints. As a result, we are better equipped to tackle our most intricate challenges, leveraging the wealth of different experiences and backgrounds within our team. This collaborative spirit empowers us to challenge ideas (not people) recognizing that our shared success relies on collective wisdom. It drives us to continuously improve and innovate, ultimately elevating the quality of our products and services. It’s what sets Panopto apart as a unique and rewarding place to work.

Our purpose

We believe that video can have a transformative effect on learning. So we built a video knowledge management platform that helps businesses and universities improve the way that they train, teach, and share knowledge. Since 2007, we have been a pioneer in video capture software, video management, and inside-video-search technology. Panopto has been adopted by more than 1,600 companies and universities worldwide with over 11 million end users. Today, Panopto’s knowledge management platform is the largest repository of expert learning videos in the world. A proud remote-first company, Panopto is headquartered in Pittsburgh, with offices in London, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Sydney, and has received industry recognition for its innovation, rapid growth, and company culture.

Panopto is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified individuals which will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected criteria, in accordance with applicable law. Panopto is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodation for interviewing or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please provide more detail on how we can further support you by reaching out to the Employee Experience department.

Remote, US: Candidates looking for flexible or remote-friendly positions are encouraged to apply. Panopto is proud to be a remote-first company. Employees in this position are eligible to work remotely.

Remote, International: Candidates looking for flexible or remote-friendly positions are encouraged to apply. Panopto is proud to be a remote-first company. Employees in this position are eligible to work remotely. Still, they may make regular trips to the local international office from time to time, where applicable.

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Panopto AI Use Policy:

Panopto’s AI Use Policy is committed to a hiring process that is thoughtful, fair, and centered on human connection. As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more prevalent in the workplace, we believe that it is important to describe our use of AI in the hiring process, as well as outline to candidates what use of AI is and is not allowed. While AI can be a valuable tool, it cannot replace genuine human interaction or an individual’s unique perspective, experience, and voice.

Company Use of AI:

Panopto may utilize tools to enhance the efficiency, objectivity, and quality of our recruitment and evaluation process. These tools assist our team throughout the hiring lifecycle by focusing on four key areas:

  • Content Creation: Providing a starting point for crafting job descriptions and assisting in building tailored interview questions.

  • Resume Parsing: Analyzing candidate skillsets and resume alignment to efficiently identify qualified candidates.

  • Interview & Assessment Insights: Providing interview transcription, summarization, and identifying key insights from candidate assessments in relation to specific role requirements.

  • Data Organization: Organizing and storing information gathered during assessments to help our team make informed, data-driven decisions.

Ultimately, these tools are used to support—not replace—our team in assessing skills, generating insights, and identifying the best talent for Panopto.

To ensure fairness and transparency:

Human-Centric Decisions: Please be assured that AI tools are used to support our team, and all final hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. Panopto hiring teams will thoroughly review your application and assessment results. AI is not used to make final decisions regarding your candidacy.

Bias Mitigation: We are committed to algorithmic fairness. Our AI-assisted tools undergo regular independent audits to detect and mitigate bias, with the goal of keeping our processes equitable and inclusive. Our methodology aligns with global best practices and regional digital ethics standards to provide every candidate with a fair and merit-based evaluation.

Your Rights & Accommodations: We provide inclusive access for all applicants. If you require a reasonable adjustment due to a disability, or if you prefer a non-automated review of your application, please contact Panopto Talent Attraction. We respect your right to request human intervention; please note that opting for a manual review may impact the standard processing timeline.

Data Privacy and Security:

Your personal data and recordings are processed securely in compliance with global privacy and employment regulations (including EEOC, GDPR, and other local or regional privacy laws, as applicable).

To facilitate our recruitment and evaluation process, limited candidate data may be shared securely with trusted third-party vendors and service providers acting on our behalf. We retain candidate data only as long as necessary to fulfill the recruitment purpose or as required by applicable statutory retention periods. Once this purpose is met, or the retention period expires, your data is securely deleted or anonymized in accordance with our data governance policy.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

Use of AI:

Statement of Transparency:

At Panopto, we embrace the transformative power of AI to enhance productivity and learning. We believe in providing a level playing field where candidates can use modern tools to put their best foot forward, provided those tools support, rather than replace, their authentic voice and expertise. While we encourage the use of AI as a tool for growth and preparation, we require transparency and authenticity to ensure a fair evaluation for all.

Acceptable Use:

  • AI-Assisted Preparation: You are encouraged to use Generative AI (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) as a mock interviewer or coach to refine your speaking points.

  • Research & Knowledge Gathering: Using AI to synthesize industry trends or company background is permitted and viewed as proactive preparation.

  • Career Guidance Tools: Simulation tools that help you practice the STAR method or identify skill gaps are acceptable.

Prohibited Use:

  • Live Interview Assistance: The use of real-time AI "teleprompters," live answer-generators, or deepfake audio/video during Panopto recordings or live sessions is strictly prohibited.

  • Plagiarized Work Samples: Any take-home assignments or portfolios must be your original work. While AI can assist in formatting or brainstorming, the core logic and execution must be yours.

Panopto has a zero-tolerance policy toward the misrepresentation of job-related skills. Consequences of using prohibited tools may result in my immediate disqualification from the hiring process, the withdrawal of any pending offer, or termination of employment if discovered after hire.

Verification of Experience:

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and validate the skills demonstrated during your Panopto submission, Panopto may require the following "Proof of Experience":

  • Work Samples & Portfolios: Candidates may be asked to provide original work samples (e.g., code repositories, design portfolios, case studies) that pre-date the current application.

  • Digital Footprint & Professional Links: We may request links to professional profiles (e.g., LinkedIn, GitHub, Behance) to verify career trajectory and industry contributions.

Disclosures:

  • Live Validation: Any technical skill demonstrated in an asynchronous Panopto recording is subject to a live, "Human-in-the-Loop" technical assessment or deep-dive discussion.

  • Fraud Detection: Please be aware that we utilize metadata analysis and fraud detection tools to ensure the authenticity of all video submissions.

By submitting your application and participating in the recruitment process, you acknowledge and consent to Panopto's use of AI, as well as the acceptable and prohibited uses of AI as a candidate, as described above.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

Scientific Safety Alliance, or SSA, exists to Accelerate Science. Delightfully. SSA is growing at an exceptional rate and is rapidly rising Inc Magazines 2024 and 2025 list of fastest growing privately held companies. In just over three years, SSA has created over $300M in enterprise value through disciplined growth and 21 acquisitions. We are now intentionally building the executive leadership team that will take SSA to $1B+ in enterprise value.

We serve the life sciences world — pharmaceutical, biotech, hospital, and research facilities — by removing operational friction so innovation can move faster. SSA is a 100% founder- and employee-owned company, and ownership is real: performance directly compounds value for every team member.

We operate in the lower middle market, acquiring founder-led, technically specialized businesses that serve the life sciences ecosystem. We move fast — but with rigor, integrity, and respect for sellers.

The next phase requires building one of the top 1% M&A platforms in our space.

The Opportunity: Head of M&A

The Head of Mergers & Acquisitions will lead SSA’s acquisition strategy end-to-end — from deal sourcing and evaluation through diligence, transaction execution, and post-close integration. This executive will play a critical role in shaping SSA’s future by identifying high-quality businesses that strengthen our platform and accelerate our growth.

This role exists to take SSA’s M&A engine to the next level. We closed ~10 acquisitions last year. Our goal is to close 15+ high-quality acquisitions per year with industry-leading speed, efficiency, and seller satisfaction — without sacrificing culture or long-term value.

You will build and lead a world-class M&A function, not just execute deals. This role is about scale, systemization, talent, and strategic vision.

  • Build, lead, and empower a world-class corporate development and M&A team with the talent, systems, and operating cadence required to execute at industry-leading scale and speed
  • Scale deal velocity to 15+ acquisitions per year with consistent quality
  • Define and execute SSA’s acquisition strategy:

    • End-to-end inorganic growth strategy, including vertical ideation, acquisition theses, and execution
    • Identify and develop roadmap into new niche verticals and service adjacencies that align with SSA’s mission and customer base

  • Build and manage a robust pipeline of acquisition targets across SSA’s core service lines

  • Structure and negotiate transactions, including valuation, earn-outs, incentives, and equity participation
  • Partner with internal teams to design and execute integration plans that preserve momentum and culture

  • Expansion of SSA into adjacent and emerging service areas driven by regulatory, scientific, and customer demand trends
  • Efficient, repeatable diligence and integration processes that reduce risk and accelerate value creation
  • A differentiated acquisition strategy that balances scale, specialization, and cultural integrity
  • Strong post-close performance and rapid realization of strategic and operational synergies
  • Strategic optionality created through portfolio design, enabling future organic growth, cross-selling, and geographic expansion
  • Clear executive-level reporting on pipeline health, deal performance, and integration progress
  • Transactions that enhance SSA’s platform strength, culture, and long-term equity value

  • Proven experience building and scaling a world-class M&A function at a highly acquisitive company.
  • Track record of doubling or tripling the size of a business through disciplined acquisition
    (~$50M → $250M+ scale preferred)
  • Deep experience in the lower middle market

jobs.excerpt: WHO ARE WE? Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company.
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

Since day one, we've been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Ethena has become a go-to compliance partner for modern, global organizations.
Beyond training, Ethena unifies core compliance tools, Hotline & Case Management, Policy Bot, and Phishing Simulator, into a single platform, with built-in audit trails and compliance controls teams can trust.
Trusted by teams at companies like Genesco, Asana, Pinterest, and Synaptics, it’s a great time to join us.

How we work

We’re a team that values diversity in all its forms and loves adding new perspectives. We ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and build with empathy, for customers and for each other. We care about craft, we love feedback, and we take ownership. We also embrace humor (yes, the puns are real), because doing serious work doesn’t have to feel so serious.

Who we're looking for

    We’re hiring a Senior Mid-Market Account Manager to drive expansion revenue across a book of Ethena’s mid-market customers. Around 40% of our growth comes from existing customers buying more, and this role carries a big share of that number. You’ll find upsell and cross-sell opportunities, build the business case with your champion, and close.

    You’ll partner closely with our Customer Success Engineers. They handle onboarding, configuration, and the technical work that gets customers live and integrated. That frees you to focus on expansion, catching churn risk early, and building the relationships that keep customers growing with Ethena.

    This is a quota-carrying role with a 70/30 base-to-variable split and accelerators for multi-year deals and above-target performance.

Why Ethena

    Because it’s a need-to-have vs. a nice-to-have. Ethena is an AI platform changing how companies handle compliance, and we’re shipping new products and add-ons at lightning speed. For this role, that means a steady stream of new expansion opportunities in every account you own.   • Champions take your calls because you help them win internally. They call and text you and get your advice on how to move a deal forward. You build the business case, find the budget, and get the deal signed.

  • You learn fast. Our product changes constantly, and you keep up with every launch so you can spot new expansion openings as they come.

jobs.title: Senior Research Scientist, AI & Workforce Intelligence - Remote, 4-Day Work Week
jobs.excerpt: About UsDo meaningful work.  Work from anywhere.  Enjoy a four-day workweek.
jobs.description:
About Us

Do meaningful work. Work from anywhere. Enjoy a four-day workweek.

At Wonderlic, we believe great work and a fulfilling life should go hand in hand. We’re a remote-first company offering a full-time, 32-hour workweek across four days, giving our team more time to focus on what matters at work and beyond it.

Our mission is to create a world where everyone finds and thrives in their best job—and that starts with us. We combine decades of science-based assessment expertise with industrial-organizational (I-O) psychology, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to deliver evidence-based insights that help organizations make smarter employment decisions. Our intuitive assessment solutions empower HR teams to identify top applicants, predict on-the-job performance, and build stronger, more successful workforces.

We’re proud to bring the same thoughtful, evidence-based approach to how we work as we do to the solutions we create. We believe people do their best work when they have the flexibility, support, and time to thrive, both professionally and personally.

What Makes Wonderlic Different?

  • Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the United States.
  • A Four-Day Workweek: Enjoy a full-time schedule of just 32 hours across four days, with more time for life outside of work.
  • Meaningful Time Off: Generous PTO, paid holidays, and a paid company shutdown from December 24 through January 1.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company matching, and 10 weeks of paid new parent leave.
  • Well-Being That Matters: A dedicated wellness benefit to support your overall well-being.

What Sets Us Apart

  • Scientific Excellence: We apply rigorous scientific methodologies to develop assessments that accurately measure individual potential and help organizations make informed talent decisions.
  • Innovation: We continually explore emerging technologies and methodologies, including machine learning and AI, to keep our solutions at the forefront of talent assessment.
  • Lasting Impact: By integrating I-O psychology and evidence-based insights, we help organizations hire more effectively, develop talent, and improve long-term employee success and retention.

Overview:

Wonderlic is seeking a Senior Research Scientist to sit at the precise intersection of I-O psychology and machine learning - someone who has spent time building real systems with real data who cares deeply about what those systems are predicting. This is not a role for an ML engineer who finds people data interesting as a side project, or for an I-O psychologist who has learned to code. We’re looking for someone who has genuinely lived in both worlds and is ready to own the problems that live between them.

Wonderlic built its applied AI/ML team from scratch, developed the Jobs Engine, a first-of-its-kind machine learning system for job analysis at scale, and won the 2025 SIOP Machine Learning Competition. We’re now refining and expanding that work to deliver sharper, richer job analysis insights across thousands of roles. You will own the continued improvement of our jobs engine, the system that ingests labor market data and produces job analysis at scale across thousands of roles, and serve as one of the organization’s experts on how AI should be applied to both employee selection and development.

Your Impact:

As Senior Research Scientist, you will set the scientific and technical direction for how Wonderlic understands work at scale and translates assessment science into AI-powered insight. Your work will directly determine the quality, defensibility, and reach of the inferences our platform makes about jobs and people - inferences that drive hiring decisions, development plans, and coaching conversations for millions of users. You will be the person in the organization who can hold both the I-O science question and the production ML question in the same breath, and answer both.

What You’ll Do

Lead the Continued Development of the Jobs Engine: Own the architecture, integrity, and continuous expansion of Wonderlic’s AI job analysis system, which ingests labor market data from O*NET, LinkedIn, Indeed, and other sources to extrapolate cognitive complexity ratings, norm groups, and occupational interest profiles for thousands of jobs. Build and refine the models that make inferences about work content from unstructured text. Leverage existing occupational taxonomies (e.g., O*NET, ESCO) where appropriate but also expand beyond them. Ensure all outputs are scientifically defensible and scalable as the nature of work evolves.

Act as an Expert on AI Implementation Across the Organization: Partner with product managers, engineers, and I-O psychologists to translate scientific requirements into AI-powered systems and ensure those systems meet the standards the work demands. Advise on which approaches are best suited to specific implementation challenges - assessment interpretation, manager and teams reporting, coaching content - and help teams understand what good looks like before they build and after they ship. Serve as an internal resource on what ML and AI can and cannot do in assessment and organizational contexts, and contribute to Wonderlic’s external scientific credibility.

Drive Scientific Rigor: Apply I-O psychology principles - adverse impact consideration, norm group construction, and evidence-based evaluation standards - to every system you build. Ensure that Wonderlic’s AI products meet professional and legal standards for selection and development tools. Push back when speed is being prioritized at the expense of defensibility, and find pragmatic paths forward when theoretical purity would prevent shipping.

What Success Looks Like: In your first six months, you will have a deep understanding of the jobs engine architecture and shipped at least one meaningful improvement to its coverage, accuracy, or scientific defensibility. You will have established working
relationships with the I-O and Product teams and have a clear roadmap for the continued integration of AI into the platform.

Within a year, you will have materially expanded the jobs engine’s reach and accuracy with demonstrable improvements to its coverage and the quality of inferences it produces. You will have contributed to the continued integration of AI across the platform, and be the person your colleagues go to with the hardest ML-meets-IO-science problems - not because you have every answer, but because you know how to find them.

The long-term marker of success is a jobs engine that provides defensible, scaled job analysis inference across millions of roles using a wide variety of inputs, AI capabilities integrated into the platform in ways that hold up to scientific and professional scrutiny, and a track record of using these technologies to improve people’s understanding of themselves, their work, and their teams. You will also have helped to develop new assessments that leverage emerging technologies which allow for richer and more secure evaluation of individuals.

What We’re Looking For:

Skills & Capabilities:

  • Applied NLP and ML engineering skills: embeddings, semantic search, clustering, text classification, transformer architectures, model tuning and evaluation, all on potentially messy, unstructured data
  • Occupational data modeling: job titles, task statements, skills, competencies, credentials, job families, seniority levels, title normalization, job similarity, role differentiation, and occupational frameworks such as O*NET and ESCO
  • Responsible AI judgment in employment contexts: fairness, explainability, auditability, bias mitigation, human review, and legal and ethical considerations in AI-supported selection and employee development systems
  • Generative AI evaluation skills: rubric-based review, groundedness checks, error analysis, regression testing, and evaluation of LLM-generated job descriptions, work-context summaries, and assessment result contextualization.
  • Product judgment for applied ML systems: balancing accuracy, explainability, automation, expert review, user input, maintainability, uncertainty, and job-specific nuance.
  • Working fluency with assessment and I/O concepts: job relatedness, criterion relationships, adverse impact, norm groups, assessment profiles, and score interpretation.
  • Ability to own ambiguous, high-complexity problems: framing underspecified problems, challenging weak assumptions, learning domain constraints quickly, and driving durable solutions in a small-company environment.

Mindset:

  • You came to I-O psychology because you care about work - what makes it meaningful, who thrives in it, how to measure fit. That hasn’t changed.
  • You have a healthy relationship with “good enough”: you know that perfect is the enemy of shipped, and you have the judgment to know where the line is.
  • You can hold both worlds simultaneously: what does this score mean for a real person, and how do I build the system that generates it.
  • You are genuinely curious about the problems that exist for both employee selection and development, not just tolerant of them.
  • You thrive in an environment that requires creativity and scrappiness: you can work comfortably in a situation where the problems are hard, the team is small, the constraints are many, and the ownership is real.

Qualifications

  • Graduate degree in I-O Psychology, Organizational Psychology, Organizational Development, or closely related field (quantitative focus strongly preferred); doctoral degree a plus
  • Demonstrated ML engineering experience with shipped, production-grade systems - not just research or coursework
  • Experience applying modern NLP methods to behavioral, assessment-based, or labor market data
  • Track record of work that had to be both technically sound and legally/professionally defensible
  • Minimum 3 years of applied industry experience; 5+ years preferred
  • Experience at the intersection of I-O science and algorithmic fairness strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with occupational taxonomies, vocational interests, or cognitive ability frameworks a significant plus

Compensation:

  • $130,000 to $150,000 based on experience and expertise.

Our Policy

Affirmative Action Plan/Equal Employer Opportunity (AAP/EEO) Statement: Research suggests that both the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can make members of some groups (including women, members of the LGBTQIA+ and BIPOC communities, and candidates of less traditional age, education, or background) less likely to apply for jobs when they don’t meet 100% of the qualifications. At Wonderlic, we are in the business of identifying potential, and we encourage all interested candidates to apply. 

Wonderlic is proud to be an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer. Here, diversity is valued and celebrated, and this is what makes us such a successful team. Wonderlic does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, pregnancy status, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, genetic information, age, parental status, military/veteran status, or any other factor protected by law.

In addition, we will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please get in touch with us at  to request an accommodation.

The Center for Biological Diversity, a national 501(c)(3) non-profit organization, believes the welfare of human beings is deeply linked to nature — to the existence of a vast diversity of wild animals, plants and people. We do so through science, law, activism and creative media, with a focus on protecting the lands, waters and climate that humans, other species and all communities need to survive and thrive.

We want those who come after us to inherit a world where the wild is still alive.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a SLED Solutions Architect, you'll be a trusted technical advisor to State, Local, and Education customers in every state east of the Mississippi River: state agencies, counties, cities, special districts, community colleges, and public, private, and research universities. These organizations deliver services residents and students rely on every day, often with lean IT teams, aging systems, fixed fiscal-year budgets, and growing cybersecurity threats.

You'll show them how GitLab's DevSecOps platform and AI capabilities, including the GitLab Duo Agent Platform, help them modernize legacy applications, protect sensitive resident and student data, meet state and sector compliance requirements, and do more with the staff they have. You'll own the technical evaluation and validation stages of the sales cycle, guide customers through proofs of concept and value, and translate platform capabilities into outcomes that agency leaders, CIOs, CISOs, and procurement officers can defend in a budget request or an RFP evaluation.

You'll partner closely with SLED account executives, channel partners, and systems integrators, provide technical guidance from first conversation through successful deployment, and bring the voice of the SLED customer back into Product, Sales, and Marketing.

Location and travel: The territory covers all states east of the Mississippi River. The candidate must reside in the Northeast part of the United States. This role requires up to 50% travel.

  • Work alongside Account Executives to build data driven business cases that quantify delivery bottlenecks, giving customers a defensible basis for budget requests and clear evidence of return on taxpayer investment.
  • Build relationships with CIOs, CISOs, agency directors, enterprise architects, faculty, research computing leaders, and procurement officers so they become advocates for GitLab, including across agencies and campuses that share services.
  • Collaborate with systems integrators and state IT shared-services organizations to scale GitLab adoption across multiple agencies, local governments, or campuses.
  • Serve as the SLED customer advocate internally, channeling feedback on procurement, compliance, and deployment needs to Product, Sales, and Marketing.
  • Stay current on GitLab and related technologies, and create reusable SLED demos, reference architectures, and assets for customers and partners.

What you'll bring

  • Background in technical pre-sales, consulting, or IT roles serving state agencies, local governments, or public, private, and research universities, where you guided customers through evaluations and solution design.
  • Working knowledge of how SLED organizations buy technology: RFP and RFI cycles, cooperative purchasing agreements, statewide contracts, fiscal-year budgeting, and the role of resellers and systems integrators.

  • Openness to learning, seeking feedback, and building new skills, including familiarity with GitLab's Solutions Architect handbook and related resources.

Nice to have

  • Experience with legacy or mainframe modernization programs.
  • Familiarity with AI governance practices in the public sector, such as AI use-case inventories, acceptable-use policies, and risk assessments.

The team is distributed and collaborates asynchronously across time zones using GitLab and our handbook-first practices to share knowledge, reusable examples, and best practices.

About Us

Thimble was an early pioneer in insurtech. We built a digital-first way for small businesses to buy coverage by the job, month or year, and have since delivered more than 200,000 policies across the United States. We started direct-to-consumer as an MGA, but today, we’re focused on growing through brokers and distribution partners, bringing the same simple, fast experience to the agents who serve small businesses. In 2023, Thimble was acquired by Arch Insurance, part of Arch Capital Group Ltd. (Nasdaq: ACGL), an S&P 500 company providing insurance, reinsurance and mortgage insurance worldwide. That gives us something rare: the speed, ownership and culture of a startup, with the balance sheet, stability and long-term commitment of one of the industry’s strongest insurers.
For more information, visit thimble.com.

Our Values

Our unique culture is built around our six core values:

Think Wild, Act Tame

Be relentlessly creative. Question everything. Get to know the rules so well, you can use them in new ways. Be the industry’s compliant radicals.

Green Means GO

Act. Move forward. Learn. You can only make a decision based on the best information you have – so make it.

Own Every Detail

Be ruthlessly precise. Disciplined. Sweat the small stuff.
Simplify, Simplify, Simplify
Get to the point. Make it crystal clear. Cut everything else. It’s our job to make insurance easy – however hard that is for us.

Every Moment Counts

Show up early and ready. Deliver on time or before. Make the most of your time, so others can make the most of theirs.

Stay Human

Treat every person, and their ideas, with respect. Cherish diversity.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Vice President of Broker Distribution to lead Thimble’s next stage of growth within the broker channel. With a proven platform, expanding technology and AI native capabilities, the focus is on scaling our broker and distribution partner network to increase premium. The right leader will define how Thimble shows up and will leave a lasting mark on a business that is scaling.

Reporting directly to the President, you’ll own a clear mandate: grow premium by building and expanding high-quality distribution relationships. With appetite and underwriting set and automated, your focus will be on the market: finding the right partners, getting them producing, and making Thimble the easiest small business market to work with.

    • Be the voice of the partner. Bring partner and customer feedback to Insurance, Underwriting and Product to inform appetite, product and roadmap priorities.

    • Partner with Marketing. Work with Marketing on partner launches, co-marketing and campaigns that drive partner activation and production.

jobs.description:
About VisiQuate

VisiQuate is a healthcare revenue cycle intelligence company. We help health systems and revenue cycle services organizations improve financial performance with analytics, automation and AI. We are building a new generation of AI-native products that work inside our clients' revenue cycle workflows, and we are growing the team that builds them.

The role: run your service line like a general manager

You will own a portfolio of AI-native revenue cycle products as if it were your own business. That means more than features and a backlog. You are accountable for whether your service line wins in the market, delivers cash outcomes for clients, and grows profitably.

In practice, you are the person in the company who knows your area best:

  • The market, the buyers, and every client problem worth solving
  • Every competitor, including what Epic and other EHRs are building, and how we beat them
  • What it costs us to deliver, and what clients will pay
  • Whether each pilot is succeeding, and why
  • How Sales should pitch it and how Marketing should frame it

You lead through influence across Engineering, Data Science, Customer Success, Sales and Marketing. Nobody reports to you on those teams, but your service line's results are yours.

What you'll own

Market and clients

  • Know your market inside and out: segments, buyers, budgets, buying cycles, and the regulatory and payer changes that reshape it.
  • Maintain a living map of client challenges in your area, ranked by the cash and effort at stake, and know which ones we solve today.
  • Spend time in client workflows. Build a client advisory group and keep a steady stream of interviews and site visits.
  • Be the voice of the client inside VisiQuate, backed by evidence rather than anecdotes.

Competition and ecosystem

  • Track every competitor in your space: their products, pricing, wins, losses and direction. Know how we beat each one.
  • Know what Epic, Oracle Health and other EHR vendors are building that overlaps with us, and where we complement rather than compete.
  • Define how we sell into clients on advanced EHRs like Epic: integration paths, marketplace programs, and the case for VisiQuate alongside native tools.
  • Watch payer, clearinghouse and partner moves that create threats or openings. Recommend build, buy or partner when it fits.
  • Run win and loss reviews and turn them into roadmap and positioning changes.

Strategy and economics

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for your service line, from first release through later versions.
  • Build the business case before development, with outcomes measured in cash: cash recovered, avoidable denials, touches per claim, cost to collect, days to resolution.
  • Recommend pricing and packaging for approval by the EVP and Growth leadership. Know the value we create per client and what the market will bear.
  • Know your cost drivers: AI inference, clearinghouse and transaction fees, data and infrastructure, implementation and support effort. Design products and prices that protect margin.
  • Make disciplined trade-offs on client value, differentiation, commercial impact and cost, and say no clearly.

Build and deliver

  • Write specifications, business rules, acceptance criteria and non-functional requirements that work for both engineers and AI development tools.
  • Keep the Product Roadmap current and tie every development task to a roadmap feature.
  • Build on our shared platform and canonical data model, and reuse shared services rather than rebuilding them.
  • Lead Agile delivery with your engineering partners: refinement, planning, demos, release and post-launch measurement.
  • Modernize existing capabilities into new products while protecting the experience of current clients.

AI quality, safety and compliance

  • Set evaluation criteria for AI and agentic features: accuracy, task completion, reliability, latency and cost.
  • Define permissions, escalation and human oversight for agent actions on client systems, such as appeals, rebills, payer portals and EHR updates.
  • Work with Security and Legal on PHI handling, auditability and BAAs.

Pilots and client outcomes

  • Own every pilot in your portfolio end to end: success criteria, data readiness, implementation plan, weekly check-ins and go-live.
  • Prove ROI per client in cash, and turn successful pilots into references and case studies.
  • Own client outcomes through renewal and expansion with Customer Success, including adoption, escalations and the support playbook.

Go-to-market

  • Build demos that client-facing teams use to win, defend and expand accounts.
  • Train Sales on how to pitch your products, handle objections and position against competitors. Join strategic deals when it matters.
  • Work with Marketing on positioning, messaging, launch plans, case studies and thought leadership.
  • Represent your service line externally at client forums, industry events and with analysts.

Business reviews

  • Run a regular business review of your service line: pipeline, revenue, margin, adoption, client outcomes and delivery health.
  • Report to leadership with clear asks, risks and decisions needed.

How you'll work

You run our Product Development Lifecycle with AI built into every phase and a human accountable at every gate. AI should accelerate the lifecycle, not replace its discipline.

  • Use AI for discovery, research synthesis, specifications, prototyping and analysis, and hold its output to enterprise standards.
  • Build working demos and prototypes yourself with AI tools such as Claude Code, so ideas reach clients in days rather than months.
  • For new products, follow our path from concept pitch to demos, a pilot client, go-live and general availability, with the prospect pipeline built in parallel.
  • Keep your service line's product home current in Notion and its roadmap current in GitHub, so anyone in the company can see where things stand.

What success looks like in your first year

  • You can brief the executive team on your market, competitors and EHR landscape without notes.
  • Your service line has an approved strategy, a business case, and a roadmap tied to cash outcomes.
  • At least one pilot is live, measured, and producing a referenceable ROI story.
  • Sales can demo and pitch your products confidently without you in the room.
  • Pricing reflects both client value and our cost to deliver, and margin is tracked.
  • You run a regular business review that leadership uses to make decisions.

Requirements

  • Required: 7+ years of hands-on healthcare revenue cycle experience as a subject matter expert, with depth in one or more of: denials and appeals, patient access and financial clearance, payment integrity and underpayments, A/R follow-up, payer contracts and policy.
  • 8+ years of Product Management on complex SaaS or enterprise products, with clear ownership of business results. Senior Director candidates: experience leading Product Managers and multiple product lines.
  • Working knowledge of 837/835 data, CARC/RARC codes and EHR workflows (Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner).
  • Experience with AI/ML, automation or agentic products, and direct use of AI prototyping tools.
  • Experience owning pricing, packaging or a business case through to revenue.
  • Strong technical fluency to partner with engineers, data scientists and architects.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS economics: adoption, retention, expansion and margin.
  • Comfort in front of clients, Sales and executives, and a mindset that combines speed with rigor.

Our Founding Principles

Successful candidates will value and embrace VisiQuate's Founding Principles:

  • Leadership: We lead by example and by empowering our clients, partners and staff.
  • Optimism: Our glass is decidedly half full, and then some.
  • Curiosity: We approach the who, what, where, when, why and how questions with an inquisitiveness that delights in discovering fresh ideas.
  • Zeal: We approach our work with eagerness, determination and contagious enthusiasm.
  • Integrity: We value conscience, character, truth and honor as fundamental principles.
  • Innovation: We believe in a continuous and relentless pursuit of all that seems unimaginable.
  • Fun: We believe that hard work and fun go hand in hand.
  • Compassion: We lead not only with our heads, but with our hearts.
  • Giving: We gladly give our time and money to causes we believe in.

jobs.description:
Fieldstone A&E - Creating Community

Fieldstone A&E is an industry-leading company with deep roots in home building by providing everything needed for vertical construction, from single-family homes to clubhouses, commercial buildings and everything in between. You will feel like family in our rich company culture that focuses on work/life integration with flexible work capabilities by offering remote, in-office and hybrid situations. We promote many team development opportunities such as daily huddles, virtual and in-person Happy Hour events, Weekly Lunchtime Trivia, and Team-Building events that bring team members together from other locations. Our attractive benefits package includes 401k, profit sharing, and shared health, dental, and vision costs.

With offices located in Metro Detroit and Tampa, we have the flexibility of in-office employment as well as the option for remote. The candidate we’re looking for has an exceptional ability to focus in a bustling team environment, and utilize strong time management skills, while occasionally tending to multiple projects at once, ensuring they are of the highest quality once completed. Our candidate must possess and exhibit a positive, “can-do” attitude even in high-stress situations, with an unwavering commitment to “world-class customer service”. Our company has shifted to an almost fully remote workforce, so we understand the need for a flexible schedule. We’re looking for someone who holds our company values close to heart: being passionate about what they do, are actively open-minded, showing dedication to mastering their craft, and above all, embracing family spirit. If these values describe you, we would love to have you join our team!

Synopsis

The Truss Repair Designer works in partnership with clients, Component Manufacturers, Architects, Engineers, and field personnel to develop clear and accurate repair designs for roof and floor trusses and related engineered wood products. Using photographs, field reports, truss design documents, and construction documents, this role evaluates field conditions and repair needs, prepares repair drawings and supporting calculations, and communicates technical requirements to clients and project partners. The Truss Repair Designer manages multiple repair projects while adhering to applicable building codes, design standards, client requirements, and Fieldstone quality standards.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design repairs for residential and commercial roof and floor trusses and related engineered wood products based on photographs, field reports, truss design documents, and construction documents.
  • Prepare clear and accurate truss repair drawings, details, and supporting calculations for field use and review.
  • Review damaged, altered, or nonconforming truss conditions and develop appropriate repair solutions based on the available field and design information.
  • Review construction documents and truss design drawings for accuracy, design requirements, and code compliance.
  • Determine repair design requirements using structural principles including roof and floor loading, load paths, wood member design, and wood connector design.
  • Calculate and evaluate tributary loads, concentrated loads, and load transfer as applicable to the repair condition.
  • Use MiTek SE and other applicable truss engineering software to analyze truss conditions and develop repair designs.
  • Communicate with clients to obtain missing information, clarify field conditions, answer technical questions, and communicate repair requirements.
  • Communicate with the Architect or Engineer when technical clarification or engineering review is required.
  • Manage multiple repair projects at one time, prioritize workload, and maintain project status in order to meet deadlines.
  • Maintain job-related files utilizing Fieldstone file and folder structure processes and procedures.
  • Consistently apply Fieldstone Quality Control procedures and take ownership of the accuracy and completeness of work.
  • Maintain and comply with Fieldstone and client-specific standards, including CAD, file management, and documentation requirements.
  • Foster a culture of external and internal client service.
  • Other duties may be assigned.

Required Knowledge

  • Knowledge of wood truss systems, truss products, metal plate connected trusses, connectors, and related engineered wood products.
  • Working familiarity with building codes and design standards, including the International Residential Code (IRC), International Building Code (IBC), ASCE 7, National Design Specification (NDS) for Wood Construction, and ANSI/TPI standards.
  • Solid understanding of structural principles including residential and commercial roof and floor loading, load paths, wood member design, and wood connector design.
  • Strong mathematical abilities, including the ability to calculate tributary loads, concentrated loads, and load transfer throughout the building.
  • Ability to read and review blueprints, architectural drawings, construction documents, truss design drawings, and field reports.
  • Knowledge of residential and commercial construction as it relates to truss design and repair conditions.

Required Skills

  • Ability to develop clear, practical truss repair solutions from photographs, field reports, truss design documents, and other available project information.
  • Working knowledge of MiTek SE or similar metal plate connected truss engineering software.
  • Ability to prepare clear repair drawings, details, calculations, and technical documentation.
  • Familiarity with AutoCAD is preferred.
  • Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills for repair drawings, calculations, and client correspondence.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies or missing information that may affect a repair design.
  • Ability to manage and successfully prioritize multiple projects at one time.
  • Ability to work independently and complete assignments in a timely manner with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with clients and project partners regarding technical and field-related repair questions.
  • Consistent ability to successfully meet deadlines.

Required Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in wood truss design and engineering software.
  • Direct experience designing truss repairs is strongly preferred.
  • A degree in civil or structural engineering is preferred but not required.
  • Experienced truss designers with strong practical knowledge are encouraged to apply, as are designers with an engineering background who want to learn truss repair design.
  • Computer-aided drafting experience preferred.

ABOUT THE ROLE

AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market.

The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated entirely to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will own AI Security in your territory, from the first conversation through close, hunting the largest new logos while working alongside the Account Executives who already know our customers best. This is a sales role for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it.

The timing matters. Abnormal is growing about 50% year over year, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up in close to 80% of customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. Demand is outrunning capacity. You will step into a deep pipeline on day one, and you will have real say in how this category gets sold.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own AI Security in your territory. Carry the AI Security quota and run the full sales cycle end to end, from first conversation through close, including significant upsell campaigns across our existing customer base.
  • Hunt the largest new logos. Take Abnormal's AI Security story into the biggest enterprises in the world, and open doors beyond the customers who already trust us.
  • Prioritize ruthlessly. Inbound interest will outpace your calendar. Decide where your time moves the needle, and where it does not.
  • Partner with Account Executives. Work alongside the core team in your territory, equip them to carry AI Security conversations, and step in on the deals that matter most.
  • Go deep on the technology. Hold your own with security and platform teams on behavioral AI, cloud security, and agent security when a customer needs more than a standard pitch.
  • Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, working closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table.
  • Shape the product and the playbook. Feed what you hear in the field back to product leadership in a fast loop, and help build how AI Security gets sold as the suite matures from early availability to GA.
  • Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly, and you will keep pace.

WHAT YOU’LL SELL

Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability:

  • AI Governance: Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost.
  • AI Cloud Security: Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots.
  • AI Employee Guardrails: Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions.
  • AI Agent Security: Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended.
  • AI Security Workbench: Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW

Every security vendor is staking a claim in AI security. Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a track record protecting email for thousands of customers. That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure we capitalize on it while the window is open.

For the right person, that means owning a brand-new motion at the center of a fast-growing company, working directly with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying sales experience, primarily selling into Enterprise accounts, with a proven record of winning new logos and expanding accounts.
  • Technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers.
  • A hunter's drive paired with the judgment to prioritize when demand exceeds capacity.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity. The suite and the motion for selling it are still evolving, and much of the playbook will be written by whoever takes this role on.
  • Strong cross-functional instincts. You will partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and product leadership, and you will work autonomously between those touchpoints.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Direct experience selling AI security, cloud security, or other emerging security categories.
  • Experience in an overlay, specialist, or advisory role in cybersecurity or AI, or a record of selling into CISOs and security leaders.
  • Experience selling early-availability products and shaping design partner deals.
