Process & Governance

  • Establish and enforce data quality standards across all performance marketing activities.

Job Description:

Summary

EnvisionWare is hiring a Principal Architect, Systems & AI to serve as the technical truth layer for a company-wide AI-first transformation. You will own architectural integrity across a portfolio of 40+ products, use AI to map and interrogate the existing codebase, and validate every AI-generated technical claim before it becomes a decision. This role is the guardrail that makes speed safe. You report into the Director of Engineering and act as architecture authority across the internal team and Contour pod. The right candidate has deep systems-thinking capability, practical skepticism about both legacy systems and AI-generated output, and a track record of working close to delivery — not detached from it.

What You'll Own

  • Architectural integrity across all products and major technical changes
  • The architecture approval gate: every design touching system boundaries, auth, payment, or data models requires your sign-off
  • System mapping, dependency analysis, and risk discovery — accelerated by AI but validated by you
  • The modernization roadmap: deciding where to stabilize, modularize, retire, or selectively rewrite
  • Technical guardrails that make AI-assisted development safe at scale

How AI Changes This Role

AI is your force multiplier, not your source of truth. You will use AI to crawl and map unfamiliar codebases, generate dependency views, surface hidden risks, and draft architecture proposals. But every AI-generated technical finding is treated as a hypothesis until you validate it. You set the rules for what AI-generated work requires deeper human review — and you enforce them.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of architecture experience in messy, real-world production environments
  • Legacy modernization expertise — strangler patterns, characterization tests, and the judgment to know when rewrite is justified and when it isn't
  • Multi-stack knowledge: Java, Angular, .NET, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes (or comparable breadth)
  • Ability to understand unfamiliar code quickly and challenge weak assumptions — whether from humans or AI
  • Practical skepticism: you use AI aggressively but trust it only after validation
  • Comfort working close to delivery, code, and teams rather than operating as a detached enterprise architect

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

  • Run an AI-assisted codebase crawl and produce validated system maps and dependency views
  • Classify the portfolio: stabilize, modularize, modernize, retire, or selectively rewrite
  • Define architecture approval rules for cross-boundary changes
  • Validate any AI-generated technical findings before they appear in leadership or roadmap decisions
  • Set the technical guardrails that make AI maturity safe and achievable

ROLE OVERVIEW


LifeStance has an opportunity to become an authoritative content hub for multiple audiences, including patients, current and prospective clinicians, referring providers and industry partners. A formal content strategy that aligns our activities across all owned channels allows LifeStance to convert clinical authority into a durable competitive asset — building trust with key stakeholders before they need us and reinforcing our authority as the leader in outpatient mental health care

Consistent with LifeStance’s values, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may mean participating in projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description.


KEY RESPONSIBILITES

Content Strategy + Editorial Governance

  • Serve as the architect of LifeStance’s editorial ecosystem, leading the evolution and execution of editorial voice, storytelling, and content strategy across channels.
  • Own enterprise content strategy, including content pillars, audience priorities, editorial standards, voice, tone, and storytelling approach.
  • Develop and manage the 12-month content strategy and 90-day execution calendar to ensure content priorities align with business goals, brand strategy, and audience needs.
  • Lead annual content planning with key stakeholders and establish a quarterly review cadence to evaluate priorities, performance, and upcoming needs.
  • Own and evolve the editorial style guide to ensure consistency, clarity, quality, and brand alignment across all content.

Editorial Operations + Coordination

  • Act as the strategic connector across marketing functions to ensure content priorities are aligned, coordinated, and not duplicative.
  • Own the editorial calendar, incorporating input from marketing channels, PR, social, reputation, clinical, growth, business development, and internal stakeholders.
  • Lead editorial planning meetings and manage the formal intake process for cross-functional content and storytelling requests.

  • Keep the 90-day execution calendar current and hold teams accountable to timelines, deliverables, and agreed-upon priorities.

Quality + Editorial Review

  • Maintain LifeStance’s editorial voice and content quality standards across channels and audiences.
  • Review content for strategic fit, brand voice, audience clarity, message consistency, and alignment to business objectives.
  • Ensure content is clear, credible, human, and appropriate for the sensitivity of mental health-related topics.
  • Partner with clinical, legal, compliance, and communications stakeholders as needed to ensure content is accurate, responsible, and aligned to organizational standards.

Thought Leadership Strategy

  • Develop enterprise thought leadership strategy aligned to brand, reputation, clinical expertise, business priorities, and category leadership goals.
  • Identify priority themes, audiences, and moments where LifeStance has a credible voice and differentiated point of view.
  • Partner with clinical leaders, executives, PR, content, social, and marketing teams to translate expertise into compelling external storytelling.
  • Build repeatable thought leadership platforms that support earned media, owned content, sponsored content, speaking opportunities, executive visibility, and clinician storytelling.
  • Create and maintain a pipeline of thought leadership topics, contributors, proof points, and activation opportunities across clinical, operational, executive, and market teams.
  • Ensure thought leadership supports broader goals across brand trust, reputation, referral confidence, clinician pride, recruiting, and category relevance.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as a strategic content and storytelling partner across marketing, PR, clinical, operations, people/talent, business development, M&A, and executive stakeholders.
  • Translate enterprise priorities into audience-relevant messaging, content plans, campaigns, and thought leadership opportunities.
  • Facilitate alignment across functions on editorial priorities, timing, channel strategy, audience needs, and intended outcomes.
  • Build processes that improve collaboration, reduce duplicative work, and ensure content is created with a clear purpose, audience, and performance goal.
  • Partner with stakeholders to ensure content supports patient acquisition, clinician engagement, referral partner credibility, reputation, recruiting, business development, and internal alignment.

Performance + Reporting

  • Own content KPIs, performance reporting, and measurement recommendations across priority channels and content types.
  • Use performance data, audience insights, search behavior, reputation inputs, and stakeholder feedback to inform editorial decisions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve content effectiveness, audience engagement, discoverability, repurposing, and business contribution.
  • Develop reporting that helps leaders understand how content and thought leadership are supporting awareness, trust, engagement, reputation, and growth priorities.

We partner with healthcare organizations to problem solve and deliver revenue cycle improvement services that enable their success, support their patients, and nurture their communities, all while living our values of Commitment, Authenticity, Respect and Excellence (CARE).

The Pro Fee Coder will review clinical documentation to assign and sequence diagnostic and procedural codes for specific patient types to meet the requirements of hospital data or physician data retrieval for billing and reimbursement. Coder I may validate APC calculations to accurately capture the diagnoses/procedures documented in the clinical record for hospitals. The Coder I performs documentation review and assessment for accurate abstracting of clinical data to meet regulatory and compliance requirements. Coder I may interact with client staff and providers.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Select and sequence ICD-10, and/or CPT/HCPCS codes for designated patient types which may include but not limited to: Ancillary (Diagnostic)/ Recurring; Hospital, Clinic; Physician Pro Fee; Technical Fee or Evaluation and Management, any associated chart capturing with any patient type.
  • Review and analyze facility records to ensure that APC assignments and/or Evaluation and Management codes accurately reflect the diagnoses/procedures documented in the clinical record.
  • Abstract clinical data from the record after documentation review to ensure that it is adequate and appropriate to support diagnoses, procedures and discharge disposition is selected.
  • Complete assigned work functions utilizing appropriate resources. May act as a resource with client staff for data integrity, clarification and assistance in understanding and determining appropriate and compliant coding practices including provider queries.
  • Maintain strict patient and provider confidentiality in compliance with all HIPPA Guidelines.
  • Participate in client and Savista staff meetings, trainings, and conference calls as requested and/or required.
  • Maintain current working knowledge of ICD-10 and/or CPT/HCPCS and coding guidelines, government regulations, protocols and third-party requirements regarding coding and/or billing.
  • Participate in continuing education activities to enhance knowledge, skills, and maintain current credentials.

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Candidates must successfully pass pre-employment skills assessment. Required:
  • An active AHIMA (American Health Information Association) credential including but not limited to RHIA, RHIT, CCS, CCA, or an active AAPC (American Academy of Professional Coders) credentials COC (formerly CPC-H), CCS-P, or CPC or related specialty credential.
  • Two years of recent and relevant hands-on coding experience
  • Knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy and physiology, pharmacology, pathophysiology, as well as ICD-10 and CPT/HCPCS code sets
  • Ability to consistently code at 95% threshold for quality while maintaining client-specific and/or Savista production and/or quality standards
  • Proficient computer knowledge including MS Office including the ability to enter data, sort and filter excel files, (Outlook, Word, Excel)
  • Must display excellent interpersonal and problem-solving skills with all levels of internal and external customers

PREFFERED SKILLS:

  • Recent and relevant experience in an active production coding environment strongly preferred
  • Associates degree in HIM or healthcare-related field, or combination of equivalent education and experience
  • Experience using Rcx, Cerner, NextGen (a plus)

Note: Savista is required by state specific laws to include the salary range for this role when hiring a resident in applicable locations. The salary range for this role is from $22.08 - $34.69 an hour. However, specific compensation for the role will vary within the above range based on many factors including but not limited to geographic location, candidate experience, applicable certifications, and skills.

jobs.description:
Job Description

About Agilent


Agilent is a global leader in laboratory and clinical technologies., Wwe are passionate about bringing great science to life. We help scientists, researchers, and clinicians address some of the world’s most important challenges across life science research, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, food, environmental testing, and related markets.


Leveraging more than 50 years of expertise, we develop advanced instruments, software, consumables, and services that enable customers to generate reliable scientific results and improve scientific, economic, and operational outcomes. Our global organization combines deep technical expertise with a commitment to quality, innovation, and customer impact. We work collaboratively with our customers on their journey to make a real difference in human lives. Our culture is founded on trust, respect, and uncompromising integrity, and we pride ourselves on being a dynamic and inclusive workplace that empowers employees and fosters innovation.


The Role


Agilent is seeking a highly experienced global product strategy and innovation leader to help define the future of the laboratory and connect emerging customer, scientific, and technology developments around the world with our product and business strategies.


This individual contributor builds a five- to ten-year perspective, with particular attention to the United States, China, and broader Asian innovation ecosystems. As a recognized internal expert, you will lead high-impact, long-range initiatives, advise senior leadership, and independently address complex challenges across functions with limited support. You will translate global innovation and regional customer insight into actionable priorities for Agilent’s business and product groups.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop a global view of the Lab of the Future. Assess changes in scientific workflows, laboratory operations, customer expectations, competitive dynamics, and technology adoption across geographies and applications. Identify innovations emerging in one market that could reshape laboratory practices worldwide.
  • Establish systematic global innovation sensing through relationships with customers, researchers, start-ups, universities, technology companies, partners, and industry experts. Maintain visibility into the United States, China, broader Asia, Europe, and other strategic regions; identify developments warranting experimentation, partnership, investment, or product action.
  • Partner closely with regional Agilent teams to understand emerging needs, competitors, technologies, and scientific workflows in China and Asia. Translate differences in adoption speed, customer behavior, workflow design, and competitive conditions for global product organizations, and identify opportunities to transfer innovation between regions.
  • Evaluate how AI, machine learning, automation, robotics, and autonomous workflows could change experiment design, instrument operation, data analysis, workflow orchestration, troubleshooting, and service. Assess implications for instruments, software, interfaces, consumables, and services; connect technology choices to meaningful customer and business outcomes.
  • Engage customers globally at the workflow and laboratory level. Identify barriers to productivity, connectivity, and automation that cross product boundaries; distinguish explicit customer requests from emerging needs and turn these observations into clear strategic opportunity areas.
  • Create mechanisms that convert global signals into business-group action. Partner with product leaders on new product concepts, roadmap changes, customer experiments, technology investments, integration priorities, and partnerships. Track strategic opportunities from initial insight through business ownership and execution.
  • Evaluate product and portfolio opportunities for customer value, strategic attractiveness, competitive differentiation, technical feasibility, and global scalability. Develop business cases and recommendations to build, partner, acquire, or invest; identify broader solutions combining Agilent’s instruments, software, automation, services, consumables, and data.
  • Lead initiatives across regional organizations, global product teams, R&D, commercial teams, and senior leadership. Translate between cultural, geographic, and product perspectives to build alignment. Represent Agilent externally with customers, technology partners, researchers, and industry participants.

Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in science, engineering, business, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience. A PhD or equivalent advanced scientific training is strongly preferred; business, strategy, or commercial experience is highly desirable.
  • Typically 8+ years of relevant combined experience across scientific research, product strategy, management consulting, product management, business development, commercialization, or related roles.
  • Strong experience in life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, diagnostics, analytical technologies, or laboratory technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience evaluating new markets or technologies, translating them into strategic recommendations, and working across multiple geographies or global organizations.
  • Experience engaging customers, scientists, technical organizations, and senior business leaders. Experience with emerging technology, AI, digital transformation, or automation is strongly preferred.

Skills and Competencies


  • Scientific and technical fluency, strategic and analytical problem solving, and strong product and customer judgment.
  • Ability to recognize significant technology shifts, distinguish structural change from hype, and synthesize developments across markets.
  • Cross-cultural communication and relationship building; ability to translate regional context into decisions global product teams can act on.
  • Executive communication and influence without direct authority, with comfort operating in ambiguity and across organizational boundaries.
  • Willingness to travel internationally. Mandarin capability is advantageous for engagement with China’s innovation ecosystem but is not required.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely. Applications for this job will be accepted until at least October 19, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted.The full-time equivalent pay range for this position is $163,600.00 - $306,750.00/yr plus eligibility for bonus, stock and benefits. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Full Stack Engineer (Next.js, React, Python, AI & Marketing Tech) – Remote | EST Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours – EST

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients — a fast-growing marketing agency serving 150+ home service businesses — is hiring a hands-on Full Stack Engineer to build internal tools, marketing technology, AI-powered workflows, and automation systems.

This is a builder role, not a strategy-only position.

You’ll work directly across:

  • Full-stack application development
  • Marketing data and attribution
  • Meta Pixel & Conversion API (CAPI)
  • CRM integrations and automation
  • AI-powered marketing workflows
  • Internal dashboards and reporting tools

You’ll collaborate closely with leadership, media buyers, and operators to turn operational challenges into production-ready systems that directly improve campaign performance, lead conversion, and efficiency.

What You’ll Own

Full Stack & Internal Tool Development

  • Build and deploy production-ready internal tools using:
    • Next.js
    • React
    • Python
  • Develop:
    • Marketing dashboards
    • Reporting systems
    • Internal operational tools
    • Workflow automation
  • Replace repetitive manual processes with scalable software solutions
  • Build reliable systems used directly by media buyers and operational teams

Marketing Tracking, Data & Attribution

  • Implement and optimize:
    • Meta Pixel
    • Meta Conversion API (CAPI)
  • Manage:
    • Event tracking
    • Event deduplication
    • Conversion attribution
    • Offline conversion syncing
  • Build data pipelines connecting:
    • Ad platforms
    • Backend systems
    • CRMs
    • Reporting dashboards
  • Ensure campaign data remains accurate and actionable
  • Support reporting across metrics such as:
    • ROAS
    • CPL
    • CAC
    • Conversion rates
    • Lead quality

CRM & Lead Lifecycle Automation

  • Build integrations with CRM platforms such as:
    • GoHighLevel
    • Close CRM
    • HubSpot
    • Similar platforms
  • Connect the full lead lifecycle:
    • Lead capture
    • CRM entry
    • Lead routing
    • Follow-ups
    • Pipeline progression
    • Conversion tracking
  • Build automations using APIs and webhooks
  • Sync CRM outcomes back to advertising platforms for attribution and optimization
  • Maintain data consistency across CRM, marketing, and reporting systems

AI Integration & Automation

  • Integrate AI into real-world marketing workflows
  • Work with APIs such as OpenAI and similar AI platforms
  • Build AI-powered systems for:
    • Ad copy generation
    • Creative generation workflows
    • Lead scoring
    • Lead qualification
    • Campaign analysis
    • Automated reporting and insights
  • Embed AI capabilities into production marketing and operational systems
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual work through intelligent automation

Rapid Development & Iteration

  • Ship working solutions quickly and iterate based on real-world usage
  • Work directly with media buyers to identify campaign bottlenecks
  • Troubleshoot technical issues affecting:
    • Tracking
    • Attribution
    • CRM workflows
    • Reporting
    • Lead conversion
  • Continuously improve internal systems based on campaign data and team feedback

Required Experience & Skills

Non-Negotiables

  • 4–6+ years of hands-on software engineering experience
  • Strong full-stack development experience with:
    • React
    • Next.js
    • Python
  • Proven experience building and deploying production-level applications or internal tools
  • Strong experience with:
    • APIs
    • Webhooks
    • System integrations
    • Automation workflows
  • Active use of AI tools in day-to-day engineering work
  • Hands-on experience in a marketing, advertising, or ad-tech environment
  • Experience with Meta Pixel and/or Conversion API (CAPI), including:
    • Event tracking
    • Deduplication
    • Attribution
  • Experience building marketing dashboards or reporting systems
  • Hands-on CRM integration experience with platforms such as:
    • GoHighLevel
    • Close
    • HubSpot
  • Experience automating:
    • Lead capture
    • Lead routing
    • Pipeline management
    • Conversion tracking
  • Experience connecting advertising platforms with CRM systems for attribution and reporting
  • Strong builder mindset with a bias toward execution

Nice to Have

  • Performance marketing agency experience
  • Experience supporting high-volume paid advertising campaigns
  • Understanding of:
    • ROAS
    • CPL
    • CAC
    • Conversion rates
    • Lead quality
  • Experience with:
    • Zapier
    • Make
    • Similar automation platforms
  • Understanding of marketing data pipelines
  • Familiarity with attribution challenges related to:
    • iOS privacy changes
    • Browser tracking limitations
    • Server-side tracking
  • Experience developing AI-powered internal tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’re an engineer who enjoys building and shipping, not just planning architecture
  • You understand both software engineering and the realities of performance marketing
  • You know how marketing data moves between ad platforms, backend systems, and CRMs
  • You can troubleshoot attribution and tracking problems
  • You’re comfortable integrating APIs and automating complex workflows
  • You actively use AI to improve engineering speed and business processes
  • You can work directly with non-technical teams such as media buyers and marketers
  • You move quickly without sacrificing reliability

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You might start by reviewing tracking data and investigating an attribution discrepancy between Meta Ads and the CRM.

Later, you could build a new Next.js dashboard for media buyers, implement a Python service that scores incoming leads using AI, or create a webhook integration that sends CRM conversion outcomes back through Meta CAPI.

You’ll work closely with media buyers and leadership to identify bottlenecks, build solutions, deploy them, and iterate based on real campaign performance.

In short: you build the technology connecting advertising, CRM, AI, data, and operations — helping the agency run faster and make better marketing decisions.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Internal tools actively adopted by media buyers and operators
  • Accurate Meta Pixel/CAPI tracking and attribution
  • Reliable CRM and advertising-platform data synchronization
  • Reduction in manual marketing and operational workflows
  • Faster campaign reporting and execution
  • Improved lead tracking and conversion visibility
  • Successful deployment of AI-powered workflows
  • Reliability and scalability of production systems

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Build technology directly tied to marketing performance and revenue
  • Work across software engineering + AI + ad tech
  • High ownership over internal products and systems
  • Direct collaboration with leadership and performance marketing teams
  • Opportunity to build AI systems used in real production workflows
  • Work with marketing operations supporting 150+ home service businesses
  • Fully remote environment with significant autonomy

Interview Process

  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

Apply today and build systems that directly improve campaign performance, lead conversion, and operational efficiency.

Kinatico is an Australian and New Zealand technology company listed on the ASX, with direct connections into government and regulatory data sources. Around 10,000 organisations already run on our platform.

Kinatico Compliance is our flagship product. Instead of a static checklist that goes stale the moment anything changes, it resolves what each person must meet from their role, location, jurisdiction, service and cohort, and re-resolves it the moment any of those change. Where a requirement comes from an authority, we monitor it at the source, so a lapse surfaces the moment it happens, not months later at audit.

Most organisations cannot say, with confidence, that every person working under their name is compliant right now. You will be the one who shows them that, and shows them how Kinatico fixes it.

OUR TEAM'S STRENGTH COMES FROM EVERYONE'S INDIVIDUALITY

You bring:

  • Sharp CRM habits, ideally in Salesforce, and comfort with tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator or Firmable
  • A voice people want to keep listening to: clear, warm and credible, with the listening skills to find the real need
  • The resilience to keep your energy up call after call, and the curiosity to keep getting better at it

Certifications in Korn Ferry Sell, Miller Heiman or Challenger Selling will catch our eye. A business or commerce qualification is a nice to have, but what you have actually closed matters more.

DELIVERING THE GOOD, STRIVING FOR THE GREAT

Day to day, you will be:

  • Prospecting relentlessly across high potential sectors like health and aged care, disability, labour hire, resources, government and financial services
  • Getting past the gatekeeper and in front of the actual decision maker
  • Running sharp discovery calls that uncover real risk, then positioning Kinatico Compliance against exactly what you have found
  • Owning the full sales cycle, including remote demos and negotiations, through to signed agreement
  • Keeping your CRM honest and current, because your pipeline is only as good as your data
  • Handing every new client off cleanly to onboarding, and sharing what is working with the rest of the sales team

We build our own AI tools and expect every Kinatican to use them to work smarter and move faster, while owning the calls and outcomes that follow.

ARE YOU READY TO BE A KINATICAN?

Where our passion, talent, delivery and impact collide, our purpose lives. We power insights for better, safer workplaces, helping organisations truly know their people. We are a leader in Reg-Tech across Australia and New Zealand, and we are just getting started.

  • Flexible working: hybrid from our Perth CBD office if you are local, or fully remote if you are based elsewhere in Australia
  • A team that genuinely invests in your growth, with regular development conversations and real room to own your career path
  • A purpose led mission you will feel every day: our technology helps keep workplaces safer and more compliant
  • The stability of an ASX listed organisation with the energy of a high growth Reg-Tech business

At Kinatico, we believe the best teams are built from diverse perspectives and growth mindsets. Research shows that while men apply to roles when they meet around 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented groups often wait until they tick every box. If you are excited about this role but do not meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Let's have a chat and explore the possibilities.

jobs.excerpt: Law360, a LexisNexis company, is an online newswire for business lawyers that covers major litigation, transactions, and regulatory issues.
jobs.description:
Law360, a LexisNexis company, is an online newswire for business lawyers that covers major litigation, transactions, and regulatory issues. Founded in 2004 and acquired by LexisNexis in 2012, Law360 is a cutting-edge organization and one of the fastest-growing subscription news services in the U.S. Our subscribers include the largest law firms in the U.S. and around the world, in-house counsel at major corporations, and key decision-makers in the government sector.

Are you excited to break news on the technologies transforming the legal industry?

Do you enjoy uncovering stories, identifying emerging trends, and delivering insightful journalism on artificial intelligence and legal innovation?

About our Team

Law360® provides breaking legal news and analysis on the most important topics legal professionals, business leaders and regulators need to stay on top of issues, safeguard clients and sharpen their competitive edge. The award-winning journalism of Law360 keeps readers connected to the latest, most essential news and insights across 70+ practice areas, industries and jurisdictions, including federal litigation, business deals, mergers & acquisitions, security and more. Law360, which serves more than 2.7 million readers every day, is owned by LexisNexis Legal & Professional® and part of RELX, a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers.

About the Role

This role can be performed in San Francisco or Los Angeles.

Law360 is seeking a senior reporter to cover the legal industry in California and the wider adoption of legal technology and artificial intelligence across law firms, courts and regulators.

We are looking for an ambitious journalist who thrives on breaking news, spotting emerging trends, and delivering insightful coverage that explains how the technology is reshaping the business and practice of law. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable filing quick-turn stories on major developments in the legal industry and producing deeply reported features and enterprise pieces that put those developments into context.

This reporter will cover one of the most consequential shifts facing the legal industry: the rise of generative AI and the broader transformation of legal services through technology. They should be curious about how AI tools are being adopted, how the technology works, the successes and failures, and what these changes mean for lawyers, clients, courts, regulators, and the economics of the legal profession.

WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

WHO WE ARE

Glossier is a people-powered ecosystem, brought to life by engaging online and offline experiences. In 12 years, we have built an iconic brand that goes far beyond beauty. Our brand is built on trusted emotional connection, empathy, and consistency in how we show up for people every day. We are woven into everyday moments of people’s lives, becoming part of their routines, their self-expression, and their confidence. We are defined not just by what we make, but by how we make people feel and the relationships we build over time. Our north-star values are to be Human, Curious, Playful, and Helpful. We are driven by a shared mission to become the Most Loved Lifestyle Brand in the World.

THE ROLE

The Director of Co-Manufacturing & Procurement is responsible for overseeing Glossier’s purchasing strategy, vendor relationships, and supply chain operations to acquire goods and services cost-effectively. The Director of Co-Manufacturing & Procurement is both strategic and hands-on, with a direct impact on customer satisfaction, margin protection and commercial flexibility. This role works closely with finance, logistics, and commercial as a trusted, strategic partner enabling value and flexibility to support broader business goals.

You will be responsible for all processes and budget with expectations for delivering both short-term and long-term priorities and plans. The right person needs to be a driven yet compassionate leader with the proven ability to successfully motivate, mentor and develop a team to represent Operational Excellence across the Glossier brand. You will work closely with our internal teams to lead and develop a first-class supply chain that supports Glossier’s growth and expansion, both domestically and internationally. Omni-channel beauty industry experience is preferred with a preference for candidates who have previously worked in fragrance, make-up and/or skincare.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & DELIVERABLES

  • Strategic Procurement Planning: Develop and implement procurement plans to support new development and existing portfolio products, ensuring finished goods meet operational and financial goals.
  • Continuous Improvement & Process Excellence: Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the procurement function to enhance efficiency and reduce costs, lead times, and MOQs.
  • Supplier Network Strategy & Qualification: Identify and qualify new suppliers, establishing new vendor partnerships while maintaining current vendor connectivity rooted in quality, transparency, and efficiency.
  • Material Replenishment Strategy: Lead efforts to develop, implement, and manage alternate material replenishment methods that increase inventory turns year over year while supporting 100% customer on-time delivery and lead-time reduction.
  • Risk Management & Market Intelligence: Monitor market trends, supplier performance, and economic conditions to proactively mitigate supply chain risks.
  • Contract Negotiation & Terms: Lead negotiations with suppliers to secure favorable pricing, terms, and conditions for goods and services.
  • MRP & Supplier Performance Management: Improve purchasing efficiencies and supplier performance through MRP optimization, supplier KPIs, and effective vendor management.
  • Supplier Quality & Corrective Action: Monitor supplier scrap rates, obtain corrective actions to reduce supplier-generated scrap in a timely manner, and oversee the resolution of all issues affecting product quality or on-time delivery.
  • Order Tracking & Expediting: Coordinate and track open order updates across all vendor partners to remain informed of delays or potential shipment issues.
  • Day-to-Day Administration & Master Data: Manage PO execution, master data accuracy, BOM creation/management, supplier records, and spend tracking.

KEY INGREDIENTS

  • 10+ Years of Global Supply Chain Leadership
    • Deep expertise leading end-to-end global supply chain, procurement, sourcing, and quality operations in an omni-channel environment.
  • Co-Manufacturing & International Partnership
    • A proven track record of building, launching, and managing highly collaborative relationships with domestic and international contract manufacturers.
  • Systems & Operational Mastery
    • Hands-on experience scaling operations using ERP, WMS, and e-commerce platforms to drive efficiency.
  • Executive Presence & Influence
    • Clear confidence presenting strategic recommendations and directly influencing executive leadership.
  • Financial Acumen

This exceptional content, reach and scope offers advertisers and marketers compelling solutions to effectively reach target audiences. We are always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

The Financial Post is Canada’s leading business news brand and serves the National Post and other Postmedia properties, including the Vancouver Sun, Calgary Herald, Edmonton Journal, Ottawa Citizen and Montreal Gazette.

The Opportunity:

The Financial Post is looking for an experienced, ambitious editor to join our editorial leadership team as National Bureau Chief. Based in Toronto, the National Bureau Chief will play a central role in shaping our coverage of Canadian business and the economy from coast to coast. You will work closely with senior editors in Toronto and regional bureau chiefs across the country to identify the stories that matter and sharpen our national coverage. The role also includes directing a team of reporters in Ontario and Quebec.

This is a role for an editor with strong news judgment who can see beyond the day's headlines, identify the forces driving the news and help reporters produce journalism that is timely, authoritative and valuable to Financial Post readers.

What you'll do:

  • Work with regional bureau chiefs to identify priorities and compile a daily schedule of stories
  • Monitor our sister publications for business and economic coverage that has the potential to resonate with a national audience
  • Direct a team of reporters based in Ontario and Quebec tasked with reporting on their regional economies, including key sectors such as automotive and critical minerals
  • Set coverage priorities; develop story ideas; assign and direct daily stories; and provide timely, constructive editing as needed
  • Contribute to video, podcast and other multimedia offerings as needed
  • Help develop and oversee new editorial products, such as newsletters and in-person events, in Ontario and Quebec
  • Maintain high editorial standards, ensuring regional coverage meets the Financial Post's standards for accuracy, fairness, insight and relevance
  • Work with regional bureau chiefs and senior editors to build national editorial franchises that distinguish the Financial Post and deepen our coverage of Canadian business and the economy
  • Contribute to the broader leadership of the newsroom, assisting the senior editorial team with editorial oversight and other priorities as needed

Who you are:

  • You are an experienced editor with at least five years in a daily newsroom, ideally with a background in business, financial or economic journalism
  • You have excellent news judgment and can quickly identify the stories, trends and developments that matter to our readers
  • You understand the difference between reporting what happened and explaining why it happened, what is driving it and what comes next
  • You are an excellent writer and editor who can work quickly and accurately under tight deadlines
  • You are comfortable working across different formats, from breaking news and daily analysis to explanatory journalism, enterprise reporting and long-form features
  • You have a strong understanding of Canadian business and the economy, and an appetite for developing that knowledge further
  • You are a collaborative leader who knows how to work effectively with reporters, editors and newsroom leaders

Hear why we exist, what we believe in, and who we’re building for:

About the Client

An early-stage healthcare AI company building automation for insurance verification and prior authorization for US surgery centers and hospital systems is looking for an Insurance Verification Specialist to produce structured, checked benefits data and audit the accuracy of its automated output.

Today the company relies on its customers’ verifiers, whose free-text notes are fast but inconsistent and cannot be analyzed at scale. This is the first hire on a small operations and data team, reporting directly to a founder in a lean environment with a 1–2 week onboarding.

About the Role

The Insurance Verification Specialist runs eligibility and benefits checks in US payer portals, calls payers when portal data is missing or unclear, follows prior authorization requests through to approval, and calculates estimated patient responsibility from a written formula. The role also audits the automation’s output against portal and call results, documents payer quirks, and maintains a curated set of checked cases for regression testing. Expected output is about 30 new verifications per day, or 100–200 QA checks per day depending on task mix. Success means every field recorded the same way with evidence attached, unknowns flagged instead of guessed, and mismatches reported with specific, reproducible reasons.

Core Responsibilities

Eligibility & Benefits Verification

  • Run eligibility and benefits checks in US payer portals (UnitedHealthcare, Availity, Waystar, BCBS, Aetna, Cigna, Medicare / Medicare Advantage) for scheduled patients.
  • Record each field in a structured form: plan, network status, deductible and out-of-pocket (individual and family, total and met), copay, coinsurance, and prior-auth requirement.
  • Capture the portal PDF or screenshot as evidence for every verification.
  • Mark incomplete or contradictory portal data as unknown instead of guessing.

Payer Calls & Prior Authorization

  • Call payers to verify benefits when the portal is missing or unclear, and confirm whether a procedure (by CPT code) needs prior authorization.
  • Submit prior authorization requests and follow up until approved before the date of service.
  • Log the rep name, call reference number, and outcome in the structured form for every call.
  • Follow client call scripts and record calls as directed.

Patient Responsibility & Data Quality

  • Calculate estimated patient responsibility using the client’s written formula (allowable, deductible, copay, coinsurance, out-of-pocket cap) and document the steps.
  • Audit automated output against portal or call results and flag each mismatch with a one-line reason: automation error, payer data issue, or ambiguous.
  • Give the engineering team specific, reproducible feedback and report patterns across cases.

Documentation & Quality Standards

  • Document payer portal and phone quirks (where a figure lives, which payers need a call, workarounds) as short how-to notes.
  • Build and maintain a curated set of checked cases across payers and plan types for regression testing.
  • Re-check older cases when payer rules change.

Requirements

Must-Have

  • 2–5 years of hands-on US insurance eligibility and benefits verification and prior authorization in an ASC, hospital, or RCM/BPO setting, at volume (30+ verifications per day)
  • Daily use of US payer portals such as Availity, UnitedHealthcare, Waystar, or NaviNet
  • Outbound payer phone calls for benefits verification and prior authorization follow-up, with call reference numbers logged
  • Ability to explain deductible, coinsurance, copay, and out-of-pocket maximum, and to calculate a patient-responsibility estimate from them
  • HIPAA training and PHI handling experience
  • English at C1+ CEFR (written) and B2+ CEFR (spoken)
  • Availability for synchronous work 10:00 AM – 5:00/6:00 PM Pacific Time

Nice-to-Have

  • Verification experience in surgical specialties: GI, ophthalmology, orthopedics, pain management, or ENT
  • Medicare Advantage and secondary-coverage case experience
  • Experience auditing or QA-ing automated or AI-generated output
  • SQL, data-labeling, or advanced spreadsheet experience
  • Experience working with minimal supervision, such as sole verifier, writing SOPs, or training others

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Based on experience and skills
  • Remote Work: Fully remote—work from anywhere
  • Team Incentives: Recognition for maintaining 100% CRM hygiene and on-time reporting
  • Generous PTO: In accordance with company policy

Who is Parser?

Technology alone does not create impact—the right teams do. Founded in 2018, Parser is a boutique technology services and consulting firm helping global organisations solve complex business challenges through digital transformation, product development and AI enablement.

Our expertise spans software engineering, AI & data, product development, and customer experience, delivered by teams that combine strong technical depth with a consulting mindset.

Why Join Us?

If you are looking for a place where you can think beyond execution, take true ownership of outcomes, influence decisions, and continuously learn alongside top-tier specialists in a truly global environment, we’d love to meet you.

How will you impact?

As a Mid-Level Frontend Engineer, you will own consumer-facing web features end-to-end within a microfrontend ecosystem. Your work directly drives organic acquisition and user experience through web performance optimizations, seamless right-to-left localization, and reliable product delivery.

Your key responsibilities:

Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:

  • Build and ship responsive, mobile-first user interfaces using React, TypeScript, and Next.js across server- and client-rendered applications.
  • Develop reusable design system components supporting multi-country configuration, internationalisation, and right-to-left (RTL) Arabic layouts.
  • Optimize web performance and Core Web Vitals, including bundle size, hydration costs, rendering paths, image/font loading, and caching strategies.

  • Implement reliable analytics tracking, feature flags, and unit, component, and end-to-end testing (using Playwright and Storybook).

Desirable Requirements:

About Emplicit

Emplicit is a results-driven ecommerce agency that combines omnichannel marketing with marketplace management. We partner with consumer brands to grow sales across Amazon (US, CA, UK, EU) and marketplaces such as TikTok Shop, Walmart, and Target. We build strategy, run media, optimize catalogs and content, and deploy advanced reporting and automation to drive measurable ecommerce outcomes.

Role Summary

We're not looking for a relationship babysitter. We're looking for a commercially-minded strategist who understands the Amazon ecosystem, thinks like a Business Director, and isn't afraid to challenge a client's C-suite when the strategy needs to change.

You'll own a portfolio of 18–25 brands — the majority selling on Amazon, with some on Walmart and TikTok Shop. Your job is to retain them, grow them, and turn them into Emplicit advocates. You will be backed by a dedicated, cross-functional pod of Marketing Managers and Coordinators to ensure you can stay focused on high-level strategy, not day-to-day data entry.

That means real relationships. C-suite trust. Proactive conversations before problems surface. Upsells that feel like advice, not a pitch. And the commercial instincts to know when to push and when to listen. AI gives you an edge — but the calls, the trust, and the revenue are yours to win.

Reports to the Director of Client Success & Partnerships.

Remote - US Time Zones

What you’ll own

Client Relationships & Retention

  • Own a portfolio of 18–25 high-growth Amazon, Walmart, and TikTok Shop brands—retaining them, scaling them, and turning them into brand advocates.
  • Build genuine C-suite relationships across every account — the kind of trust that makes clients call you first
  • Multi-thread across 3–5 stakeholders per client — Champion, Decision Maker, Influencer
  • Proactively identify and address churn risk before it becomes a conversation you didn't see coming
  • Convert satisfied clients into public advocates — targeting one case study, testimonial, or referral per key account annually

Revenue & Commercial Growth

  • Identify and close upsell opportunities across your full portfolio — upsells that feel like advice, not a pitch
  • Build Scopes of Work (SOWs) and business cases for service expansions
  • Shift client perception from "cost" to "investment" through data-backed ROI storytelling
  • Own P&L and revenue forecasting for your accounts
  • Lead onboarding for 2+ new brands per month, from handoff through go-live

Strategy & Internal Leadership

  • Run forward-looking QBRs that drive strategy, not just recap performance
  • Challenge client assumptions with a Challenger mindset — prescribe strategic pivots even when it's a hard conversation
  • Direct Marketing Managers and Project Coordinators toward unified client goals — you set the mission, they execute the tactics
  • Orchestrate the onboarding journey for incoming brands, partnering closely with Project Coordinators to build a flawless operational foundation and establish immediate authority with the client.
  • Serve as the ultimate Pod Leader for the cross-functional team assigned to your accounts. You don't just run weekly meetings and monthly reviews; you own the pod's cultural and operational alignment, actively surfacing team-identified upsell leads and transforming them into a healthy pipeline.
  • Partner with our ops team to help shape the AI and automation tools that make this role scalable — from churn-risk flagging to proposal workflows

What success looks like

In your first 90 days

  • Stakeholder roadmaps and Joint Success Plans underway for your full portfolio

● 2+ new brands onboarded per month

  • First upsell opportunities identified and in active proposal stage
  • Genuine relationships established with C-suite contacts at every account

Ongoing KPIs

  • 95%+ client satisfaction across your portfolio
  • 5+ upsell opportunities presented monthly; 2–3 closed per month.

● 2–3 new SOWs completed per month

  • Active multi-threaded relationships across 100% of accounts
  • One public case study, testimonial, or referral per key account annually

Must have

  • You possess high emotional intelligence and excel at turning tense client situations into wins. You don't just manage accounts; you build indispensable strategic partnerships, resulting in industry-leading client retention and advocacy.
  • Amazon fluency: Seller Central, TACoS, BSR, Buy Box — you understand the deep cause-and-effect relationship between these marketplace levers and your client’s bottom line. You are "fluent" because you know how to manipulate these elements to protect client margins, prevent costly listing disruptions, optimize ad spend against total profitability, and strategically scale their market share.
  • You have a proven history of spotting untapped revenue within existing portfolios. You know how to align a client's business goals with our additional services, seamlessly introducing upsells and cross-sells that drive mutual growth.
  • You act as a trusted consultant, not an order-taker. You are comfortable challenging a client’s assumptions, steering them away from poor marketplace strategies, and backing up your recommendations with hard data and industry insights.
  • You operate like the CEO of your book of business. You focus on lagging indicators like net revenue retention (NRR) and portfolio profitability, proactively identifying risks and pivot strategies before they affect the bottom line.
  • You can distill complex Amazon data into clear, high-level narratives for executive stakeholders. Whether you are drafting a watertight SOW or commanding a boardroom QBR, your delivery is polished and persuasive. Crucially, you possess a sharp commercial lens and act as the strategic bridge between the client and our internal delivery teams—masterfully delegating and guiding internal resources to champion the client’s goals while aggressively driving our company’s bottom line.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with Walmart Connect or TikTok Shop advertising
  • Familiarity with tools like Helium 10, Keepa, Intentwise, or Merchant Springs
  • HubSpot power user — CRM hygiene, pipeline management, automations
  • Prior agency experience — you understand the pace and P&L realities

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI productivity tools (like ChatGPT or Claude) beyond basic chat functions. Ideally, you have experience building custom agents, automating workflows, or managing AI-driven projects—or you possess a fierce curiosity to learn how.
  • Experience helping build internal processes, playbooks, or automation workflows from scratch

Compensation & Perks

  • Competitive base salary + performance bonus tied to upsell revenue you generate

● Healthcare (medical/dental/vision)

● 401k with employer match

● Remote, flexible PTO

  • Budget for training & professional development
Salary: $85,000 – $95,000 / year

Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world.

If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting.

About the Team

The Food Safety and Quality Assurance team helps ensure CookUnity’s meals meet food safety, quality, and regulatory standards. Working across Culinary, Supply Chain, Procurement, Nutrition & Standards, Food Science Lab, Legal, Marketing, Design, Product, Engineering, and Operations, the team supports accurate product information and consistent execution across our markets.

The Role

We’re looking for a hands-on Director of Labeling and Nutrition Compliance to lead labeling and nutrition compliance across our meals, ingredient data, product claims, and customer-facing information.

You will own the overall source-to-label process, including governance, performance metrics, third-party laboratory validation, and approval of product and nutrition claims. You will establish technical acceptance criteria, verify data suitability, coordinate cross-functional deliverables, and manage the label and content release process, withholding approval when supporting evidence is insufficient.

This role requires strong technical judgment and the ability to lead within a cross-functional organization. You will establish clear accountability, verify nutrition and labeling information, and ensure teams have practical controls for maintaining compliance as ingredients, recipes, suppliers, systems, and markets evolve.

Within your first 90 days, you will establish technical acceptance criteria and a risk-ranked review baseline, verify a representative set of supplier and market substitutions delivered by Supply Chain, and demonstrate an independently reviewed, controlled release pilot that includes label-to-website reconciliation. You will also align ongoing verification and escalation measures with functional owners, while Supply Chain retains ownership of the data remediation plan and delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Lead CookUnity’s labeling and nutrition compliance program. Establish practical standards consistent with applicable Nutrition Labeling and Education Act (NLEA) requirements for ingredient declarations, allergens, Nutrition Facts, serving sizes, net quantity, claims, required statements, and market-specific labeling, in partnership with Nutrition & Standards.

  • Own the create, review, approve, and distribute (CRAD) labeling process, governance, and consolidated KPI dashboard. Define functional accountability, independent review requirements, approval records, version controls, release criteria, escalation paths, and corrective-action follow-through.

  • Define regulatory and technical requirements for ingredient master data owned by Supply Chain Operations. Lead the specification approval and stakeholder sign-off process, including supplier-item and market specificity, source evidence, approved substitutions, and acceptance criteria.

  • Review and approve ingredient data eligibility for labeling and claims, tracking and escalating unresolved dependencies.

  • Own third-party laboratory validation, including lab qualification, risk-based representative sampling across suppliers and markets, appropriate testing methods, and comparison against approved recipes, portions, declared nutrition, and claim criteria.

  • Investigate laboratory discrepancies and drive verified corrections through the accountable data, recipe, or execution owner.

  • Approve product, nutrition, standards, ingredient, and dietary claims before publication across channels. Require substantiation, approved wording, applicability and conditions, review dates, and change control.

  • Obtain documented Food Science Lab approval of the nutritional basis for claims, required Legal concurrence, and appropriately qualified clinical approval of medically tailored meal criteria.

  • Set risk-based technical review priorities for estimated and generic legacy records. Partner with Supply Chain, which owns data remediation and maintenance, to verify corrections, assess supplier and market equivalence, and confirm impacts on recipes, nutrition values, allergens, and claims.

  • Manage the compliance impact of supplier, ingredient, recipe, process, portion, packaging, and system changes. Require affected products and claims to be reassessed before release, including substitutions and market-specific variants.

  • Establish technical acceptance criteria for labeling and data systems. Partner with Engineering to verify source-to-label and website field mappings, controlled synchronization, and automated completeness, calculation, rounding, and version checks.

  • Require production first-article checks and ongoing label-to-meal verification. Partner with Operations and Supply Chain on approved masters, effective dates, acknowledgment of changes, and removal of obsolete labels and templates.

  • Verify consistency between approved label master data and customer-facing channels, including the CookUnity website, for ingredients, allergens, nutrition values, serving details, and claims.

  • Define website reconciliation criteria and verify publication and correction evidence. Partner with Growth Marketing/SEO, which owns website accuracy, publishing, discrepancy correction, and the website parity KPI, and escalate safety or compliance discrepancies through the incident process.

  • Exercise delegated authority to hold or reject nonconforming label and content releases. Ensure independent review of technical work you prepare and escalate product holds, disposition decisions, and unresolved safety or compliance issues to the VP of FSQA under established procedures.

  • Maintain inspection-ready records and train cross-functional teams on labeling requirements, approval workflows, and operating controls.

  • Maintain the overall CRAD KPI dashboard covering technical data acceptance, Culinary recipe and portion conformity, laboratory-versus-declared accuracy, claims compliance, release performance, defects, and corrective actions. Incorporate Growth Marketing/SEO’s website parity and coverage results, coordinate functional delivery, and escalate gaps while each function owns its evidence, results, and corrective actions.

  • Drive a consistent process in which released products have traceable inputs, supported claims, documented independent review, approved market-specific labels, consistent website content, and verified production execution.

Qualifications

  • Deep, practical experience in food-labeling regulations, nutrition, and standards compliance, including hands-on technical review of packaged food labels, ingredient and allergen declarations, nutrition calculations, and claim substantiation.

  • Strong working knowledge of applicable U.S. FDA food-labeling requirements and the ability to determine when USDA FSIS or other market requirements apply, with qualified specialist support as needed.

  • Experience connecting supplier specifications, ingredient databases, formulations, recipe systems, nutrition analysis, artwork, and production execution through controlled workflows.

  • Sound technical judgment regarding ingredient variability, cooking yields, portioning, laboratory results, and the limitations of calculated nutrition.

  • Ability to translate regulatory and technical requirements into clear acceptance criteria and practical operating controls.

  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional programs, resolving ownership gaps, and implementing change without relying solely on direct reporting authority.

  • Clear written communication, careful documentation, and confidence holding a release when supporting evidence is incomplete.

  • A degree in food science, nutrition, regulatory science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Preferred

  • Experience in multi-site prepared meal operations.

  • Experience with recipe-management systems and supplier-data platforms.

  • Familiarity with Canadian food-labeling requirements.

  • Registered Dietitian credentials. Clinical standards and medically tailored meal criteria require appropriately qualified expertise.

If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time!

We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity. WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

Would you like to join an international team working to improve the future of healthcare? Do you want to enhance the lives of millions of people? Grifols is a global healthcare company that since 1909 has been working to improve the health and well-being of people around the world. We are leaders in plasma-derived medicines and transfusion medicine and develop, produce and market innovative medicines, solutions and services in more than 110 countries and regions.

The role of the Patient Access Liaison (PAL) is to minimize access and reimbursement barriers for patients and providers to Prolastin-C. They will accomplish this by executing the market access reimbursement plan in the assigned geographic area with physicians, office staff and institutional customers. The PAL will work closely with internal and external partners including HCPs and their staff, Market Access, Sales and SP/Hub partners in the field, supporting accounts in resolving reimbursement issues and concerns. The PAL is expected to have a deep working knowledge of both public and private payer policies within their market, as it relates to Prolastin-C coverage and access. This position will serve as subject matter expert on payer/reimbursement matters, patient services and pharmacy processes and requirements. This role covers multiple states in the North Central and South Central regions. For this role to be remote you have to be located near a major airport in one of the following states: North Central: ND, SD, NE, MN, WI, IA, MO. South Central: TX, LA, AR, MS

Primary responsibilities for role:
Proactively educate prescriber office personnel on the Prolastin Direct program and processes to facilitate patient access via in person and virtual interactions
Champion and manage the appropriate utilization of patient support services and reimbursement programs to ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements
Demonstrate deep knowledge in reimbursement and access across patient support offerings and be the subject matter expert in the geography.
Collaborate closely with the payor team to understand payer policies and facilitate patient access.
Ensure providers understand prior authorization requirements, appeals processes and clinical criteria, including technology options for electronic submission of PA, Letter of Medical Necessity, appeals, step edits, formulary exception requests and provides support for other related coverage issues and documentation requirements.
Enhance awareness and understanding of patient support offerings and specialty pharmacy (SP) processes. Ensure these solutions are optimized to support the patient journey and deliver excellent patient and provider experience.
Reactively address patient specific issues and provide issue resolution across geography
Closely collaborate with Hub/SP account management team to directly solve any customer-related issues.
Builds productive, professional relationships with customers in targeted accounts to address market access issues.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Extensive knowledge of medication access channels.
Strong functional knowledge of specialty pharmacy and health insurance and benefits with a demonstrated expert understanding of insurance eligibility benefit verification, prior authorization processes, reimbursement coverage, appealing insurance denials, application of financial assistance, co-pay support and free product programs
Proven ability to thrive in both an independent setting and within a collaborative cross functional environment
Ability to travel and cover large multistate geography territories; > 50% travel required

Education:

BA/BS Degree, Advanced degree or PharmD preferred

Experience:

2 years of rare disease, specialty pharmacy, pharma and/or biopharmaceutical experience.
1- 2 years of experience calling on field-based customers and proven ability to build strong relationships with healthcare professionals.

Depending on the area of assignment, directly related experience or a combination of directly related education and experience and/or competencies may be considered in place of the stated requirements. Example: If a job level requires a Bachelor’s degree plus 4 years of experience, an equivalency could include 8 years of experience, an Associate’s degree with 6 years of experience, or a Master’s degree with 2 years of experience.

The estimated pay scale for the Patient Access Liaison role based remotely in any of the listed states in the job description, is $110,000 to $130,000 per year. Our company has more than tripled over the last 10 years, and you can grow with us!

jobs.title: L1 SOC ANALYST
jobs.excerpt: About The RoleKVG is looking for an L1 SOC Analyst to become the first line of security monitoring for a Microsoft-based environment spanning Moldova, Romania, Ukraine, Germany, Spain, the Philippines, and the United States.
jobs.description:
About The Role

KVG is looking for an L1 SOC Analyst to become the first line of security monitoring for a Microsoft-based environment spanning Moldova, Romania, Ukraine, Germany, Spain, the Philippines, and the United States. You will own the daily triage of alerts in Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender XDR, and the review of the Microsoft 365 email quarantine - deciding what is real, what is noise, and what needs to go up the chain.

This is a structured entry point into security operations. You will work to documented runbooks and a clear action mandate, alongside our Cloud Security Engineer, in an environment with genuine compliance weight behind it (NIST SP 800-171 and CMMC 2.0). We fund your certification path and expect you to grow into L2 analysis.

What You Will Do

  • Monitor and triage incidents in Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender XDR, working in order of severity.
  • Decide whether an alert is a true positive, a false positive, or benign - and write down why.
  • Review the Defender for Office 365 quarantine, handle user-reported phishing, and action release or block decisions.
  • Analyse message headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC results, URLs, and attachments to reach a defensible verdict.
  • Run pre-built KQL queries in Advanced Hunting to work out who and what was affected.
  • Apply runbook-defined containment: revoke sessions, block sign-in, isolate a device, purge a delivered message.
  • Escalate anything beyond your mandate with a clear timeline, the evidence, and what you already did.
  • Keep case records that hold up under audit, and hand over cleanly at the end of each shift.
  • Flag noisy detections and recurring false positives so they can be tuned out.

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • 1+ year in IT support, service desk, systems administration, or a security operations role. Strong candidates with certifications and demonstrable lab work will be considered without commercial security experience.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and a cloud-first or hybrid environment.
  • Networking and mail flow fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, SMTP, MX records, VPN, firewall concepts.
  • Windows and macOS fundamentals - processes, logons, and where the logs live.
  • Understanding of common attack techniques: phishing, credential theft, MFA fatigue, token theft, malware delivery.
  • Professional written and verbal English. Case notes and escalations are written in English.
  • The discipline to follow a runbook exactly, and the judgement to escalate early rather than improvise.

Preffered

  • Hands-on exposure to Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Defender for Office 365, or Entra ID.
  • Ability to read and adapt a KQL query, or basic PowerShell.
  • CompTIA Security+ or Microsoft SC-900.
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Awareness of NIST SP 800-171, CMMC 2.0, or GDPR.

What KVG Offers

  • Funded Microsoft certification path - SC-200 is the target credential for this role, with the exam paid by KVG.
  • A defined progression route from L1 triage to L2 analysis.
  • A single-vendor Microsoft security stack: Sentinel, Defender XDR, Entra ID, Intune, Purview - depth rather than tool sprawl.
  • Direct mentoring from the Cloud Security Engineer rather than an anonymous alert queue.
  • European business-hours coverage with rotational extended-hours support for other regions. This is not a 24/7 shift rotation.

Professional Competencies

Collaborative Spirit | Results Above All | Innovation as a Habit | Creative Freedom | Financial Prudence | Eternal Learner | Daring Adventures | Open Feedback | Integrity in Action | Embrace Change | Accountability

About Us

All Care To You is a Management Service Organization providing our clients with healthcare administrative support. We provide services to Independent Physician Associations, TPAs, and Fiscal Intermediary clients. ACTY is a modern growing company which encourages diverse perspectives. We celebrate curiosity, initiative, drive and a passion for making a difference. We support a culture focused on teamwork, support, and inclusion.
