ACTY offers 100% employer paid medical, vision, dental, and life coverage for our employees. Additional employee paid coverage options available. We also offer paid holidays, birthday off, and unlimited PTO as well as a 401k plan.

Job purpose

The position of UM Outpatient Review Nurse reports to the Director, Case Management. The position of UM Outpatient Review Nurse is part of the Case Management team and is responsible for clinical, quality, and patient outcomes. This position is expected to implement the effectiveness and best practices of Utilization Review and will provide high quality medical review by appropriately applying the State, Federal, health plan and clinical guidelines used to determine medical necessity.

Duties and responsibilities

  • Review authorization requests for medical necessity, determines which requests need Medical Director review, obtains sufficient medical documentation for an informed consent.
  • Process all requests within established time frames.
  • Documents all steps of process in authorization system in the authorization notes.
  • Utilizes CMS and Health Plan Hierarchy criteria.
  • Clinical documentation, specific criteria, and record attachment for referral prior to sending to the Medical Director for review.
  • Retrospective review of services to determine medical necessity.
  • Refer cases to the Medical Director for review of requests that may not meet medical necessity criteria.
  • Process denials within established timeframes.
  • Writes denial letters to meet CMS and Health Plan requirements.
  • Work closely with other MSO team members as necessity requires.
  • Applies the appropriate clinical criteria/guideline, policy, EOC/benefit policy and clinical judgment to render coverage determination/recommendation for the review process.

  • Maintain quality reviews while meeting the established TATs for Urgent, Routines and Retro requests.
  • Maintains Interrater Reliability Rate at least 95% or above.
  • Daily production standard is a minimum of 50-90 referrals/day depending on complexity with accuracy & quality.
  • Makes approval determinations when request meets appropriateness, medical necessity and benefit criteria.
  • Utilizes clinical experience and skills in a collaborative process to assess, plan, implement, coordinate, monitor and evaluate options to facilitate appropriate healthcare services that meet criteria and can be authorized by a nurse level reviewer.
  • Act as clinical resource to all departments.
  • Communicates with health plans, providers, members and other parties to facilitate member care treatment plans.

  • Other duties as needed.

Qualifications

  • A valid CA and Texas/Multi State Registered Nurse license or Licensed Vocational Nurse
  • CM and/or UM training and/or certification. Knowledge of CM standards, UM standards, Clinical Standards of Care, NCQA requirements, CMS guidelines, Milliman guidelines, and InterQual guidelines. Medi-Cal, Commercial and Medicare contracts and benefit interpretation is preferred.
  • Five years+ clinical experience.

  • Must be available to work weekends and holidays, as business needs require.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, exercising judgment and initiative.

  • Proficiency using Outlook, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Microsoft Office (including Word and Excel) and Adobe
  • Must be available to work weekends and holidays, as business needs require.

  • Strong ability in problem-solving
  • Ability to manage self-manage, strong time management skills.
  • Ability to work in an extremely confidential environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Education and Additional Requirements

jobs.excerpt: About NscaleAt Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for the AI revolution.
jobs.description:
About Nscale

At Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for the AI revolution. Nscale is developing cutting-edge, sovereign generative AI solutions powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centers and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads.

The rapid growth of artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented global demand for compute and GPU infrastructure. Positioned at the heart of this transformation, Nscale is delivering the platforms that will enable the next decade of innovation.

Working closely with the world's most advanced AI technology providers — including Microsoft and NVIDIA — Nscale integrates next-generation compute hardware and Next GPU clusters across both partner and self-delivered facilities. This is a unique opportunity to join Nscale's journey, play a pivotal role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company designed to scale rapidly across North America, Europe, and beyond.

About the Role

We are hiring a Manager, Pipeline Engineering to own the engineering of the natural gas transmission pipelines that fuel Nscale's generation campuses, from upstream interconnect to plant fence.

Nscale's Power and Energy group develops behind-the-meter generation colocated with our data center campuses: large reciprocating engine fleets served by dedicated, large-diameter gas transmission pipelines moving hundreds of millions of cubic feet per day. These are not ordinary laterals. The pipeline is also the storage: line pack is the operating inventory that buffers nominations against engine demand, pressure is governed by that inventory balance, and the design of overpressure protection, regulation, and system controls determines whether gigawatts of compute stay online. Much of this work is closer to process engineering than to conventional pipeline design, and this role owns it.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role built for someone who runs with minimal oversight. You will establish the design basis for our pipelines and demonstrate how it ties to our downstream commitments — engine demand, swing, and availability — drive the engineering through hydraulic design, controls philosophy, and construction, and technically manage the third-party engineering firms and pipeline construction contractors doing the work. Lines are in delivery today and new lines will follow, so the role owns both the systems being built now and the reference engineering for what comes next.

You will sit within the Power and Energy technology organization, working alongside the generation engineering and commissioning teams that depend on the gas you deliver. You will be the owner's technical authority on the pipeline scope, directing the work of consultants and contractors rather than simply accepting it, and resolving the design questions where standard midstream practice does not account for a single customer whose demand can swing with AI workloads.

Location: Houston, TX (remote considered within the US, with regular site and vendor travel)

What You'll Be Doing

Pipeline system engineering and design basis

  • Own the design basis for Nscale's gas transmission pipelines: hydraulic design, MAOP and pressure regime, line pack and inventory strategy, routing and sizing philosophy, and expansion provisions for future lines.
  • Perform and direct steady-state and transient hydraulic modeling of the pipeline systems, and own the models as living engineering assets that answer real operating questions: inventory swing, survival time on line pack, ramp response, and curtailment scenarios.
  • Demonstrate explicitly how the pipeline design basis supports downstream commitments: engine fleet demand and turndown, campus availability requirements, and the nominations-versus-consumption balance that governs system pressure.
  • Evaluate gas storage and supply resilience options, including line pack utilization, interconnect diversity, and cross-connection strategies between lines, with clear analysis of the risk each option carries.

Process and controls engineering

  • Own the overpressure protection philosophy across the pipeline systems: regulation, monitor, slam-shut, and relief selection, justified against reliability requirements, industry practice, and regulatory obligations rather than habit.
  • Define the control philosophy at interconnects, letdown stations, and plant interfaces: pressure versus flow control, control interactions with upstream operators' facilities, and the measurement and SCADA provisions needed to run the system on inventory.
  • Apply process safety discipline to the pipeline scope: lead and support HAZOPs and design reviews, own the closure of actions, and carry management of change through design and construction.
  • Engineer the interface into the plant fuel gas systems, coordinating conditioning, letdown, and protection philosophies so pipeline and plant behave as one system.

Regulatory compliance and integrity

  • Own compliance of the pipeline designs with 49 CFR Part 192 and the applicable ASME B31 codes, including the code boundaries between jurisdictional pipeline and plant piping.
  • Establish material, welding, and construction specifications, class location and MAOP documentation, and the records discipline that a traceable, verifiable, and complete basis requires.
  • Lay the foundation for integrity management: baseline assessment planning, pigging and inspection provisions, and mainline valve philosophy, including remote actuation and its treatment in availability analysis.
  • Support commissioning and first gas: purge and pack planning, energization of the measurement and control systems, and readiness reviews in partnership with the commissioning and startup organization.

Third-party technical management

  • Technically manage the engineering consultants supporting the pipeline scope: set the design basis they work to, review and challenge their deliverables, and integrate their output into a coherent whole.
  • Direct pipeline construction contractors on technical matters: specification compliance, field queries, deviation dispositions, and as-built reconciliation.
  • Own the technical interface with upstream pipeline operators and interconnect counterparties: metering station design, control coordination, nominations behavior, and the operating agreements' technical exhibits.
  • Hold third parties to disciplined engineering, testing, and documentation, and know when their standard answer is not good enough for this application.

Standards and cross-functional leadership

  • Develop Nscale's engineering standards, specifications, and reference designs for gas pipelines, so each new line builds on the last instead of starting over.
  • Coordinate with generation engineering on fuel gas requirements, with permitting and land teams on routing and regulatory strategy, and with commercial teams on gas supply and transportation arrangements.

Atuar no desenvolvimento dos negócios de vendas da Rede Chevrolet, apoiando as concessionárias de um Distrito de Minas Gerais com base em Belo Horizonte, na definição de estratégias comerciais, na gestão de indicadores e na identificação de oportunidades para expansão de resultados, participação de mercado e rentabilidade.

jobs.description:
About Nscale

Nscale is the vertically integrated AI cloud engineered for AI. We own and operate the full stack — energy, data centres, GPU superclusters, orchestration, and AI services — delivering high-performance infrastructure to AI-native companies, enterprises, and governments across Europe and the US. We are deploying GPU capacity at hyperscale, operating some of the densest, most advanced AI infrastructure in the world.

At Nscale, our Deployment team plays a critical role in bringing new AI data center capacity online safely, on schedule, and to spec. We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About the Role

We're looking for a Project Manager to deliver low-voltage scopes across Nscale's AI data center deployments. You'll own the day-to-day delivery of assigned projects from kickoff through turnover, managing schedule, budget, vendors, quality, and stakeholder updates. You'll work closely with Senior Project Managers, Low Voltage Deployment Engineers, Construction, Network Infrastructure, and Commissioning to deliver on time, on budget, and to spec.

This is a hands-on delivery role. You'll spend your time running projects, coordinating contractors, resolving issues in the field, and keeping your team and partner groups clearly informed, with support and escalation paths through senior project leadership.

This is a remote role based in the United States, with approximately 30–40% travel for site kickoffs, critical milestones, and field oversight.

Experience required: 4+ years of project management experience, including 2+ years supporting or delivering data center, mission-critical, telecom, or low-voltage construction projects.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Manage the lifecycle of assigned low-voltage projects, including scope confirmation, baseline schedule, budget tracking, execution, and closeout.
  • Build and maintain project schedules, tracking milestones, critical path, dependencies, and look-ahead plans.
  • Track project budgets and forecasts, including cost tracking, change order processing, and invoice validation, escalating variances to senior project leadership.
  • Maintain risk and issue registers, help drive mitigation plans, and raise concerns early when schedule, cost, or quality is at risk.
  • Run one or more concurrent projects with clear ownership and accountability, growing toward a broader multi-site portfolio.
  • Coordinate low-voltage contractors and integrators through scope review, onboarding, mobilization, and daily execution, and support bid leveling as needed.
  • Hold vendors accountable to scope, schedule, safety, workmanship, and documentation requirements, and share field observations on vendor performance and material lead times with Procurement and Supply Chain.
  • Support or lead site kickoffs, walkdowns, and regular coordination meetings with field teams and contractors.
  • Oversee delivery of structured cabling (copper and fiber), high-density fiber and MPO trunking, labeling, and related low-voltage systems, and coordinate with the General Contractor on cable pathways (tray and ladder rack).
  • Manage RFIs, submittals, QA/QC inspections, test and certification results, punch lists, and as-built documentation.
  • Prepare complete, accurate closeout packages for a clean turnover to Commissioning and Operations.
  • Promote a strong safety culture and ensure contractors comply with site safety requirements.
  • Coordinate handoffs and dependencies with Construction, Network Infrastructure, AI Infrastructure Deployment, Engineering, Commissioning, Supply Chain, and Procurement.
  • Run project meetings that turn discussions into clear decisions, owners, and due dates.
  • Work with Low Voltage Deployment Engineers to align plans with design intent and field realities.
  • Provide clear, accurate weekly reporting on project status, milestones, cost, risks, and decisions using the team's standard tools and KPIs, keeping Jira and team trackers current and reliable.
  • Capture lessons learned and suggest improvements to templates, processes, and tooling as the organization scales.

About You

  • Experience. 4+ years of project management experience, including 2+ years supporting or delivering data center, mission-critical, telecom, or low-voltage construction projects.
  • Delivery ownership. Hands-on experience managing project schedules, budgets, change orders, and subcontractor performance. You take accountability for your projects and see them through to closeout.
  • Low-voltage knowledge. Working knowledge of structured cabling and fiber systems, including installation, testing, and certification practices.
  • Technical fluency. Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and scopes of work.
  • Tools. Experience with scheduling and project tools such as Smartsheet, MS Project, or Primavera P6, plus Jira or similar tracking tools.
  • Field-ready problem solving. You're comfortable on site and work through problems quickly with contractors and field teams.
  • Organization and judgment. You keep plans, budgets, and documentation accurate as conditions change, and you know when to make a call and when to escalate.
  • Communication. You give concise, honest updates to field teams, engineers, vendors, and leadership, and you raise risks before they become surprises.
  • Collaboration. You build trust with engineers, construction leads, vendors, and partner teams.
  • Growth mindset. You're eager to learn from senior project leaders and take on larger, more complex scopes over time.

Nice to Have

  • Experience on hyperscale, cloud, HPC, or AI infrastructure deployments.
  • BICSI certification (e.g., Installer, Technician, or RCDD) and familiarity with TIA-568 and TIA-942 standards.
  • Experience working on projects across multiple sites or regions.

Why This Role Matters

Every GPU cluster Nscale brings online depends on the low-voltage infrastructure underneath it. In this role, you'll directly contribute to how quickly and reliably we deliver AI capacity to our customers, while building the experience and relationships to grow with our deployment program across sites and regions.

What We Can Offer You

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

  • Highly competitive package, including base salary and equity, with reviews every 12 months.
  • Join one of the fastest-growing tech startups: your chance to push boundaries, collaborate with brilliant minds, and make your mark on cutting-edge AI.
  • Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions, including a clear path toward Senior Project Manager. Grow by trying new things, leading, challenging the status quo, and owning your impact, always with our full support.
  • Human-first flexibility. We treat you as humans first. Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.
  • Join our thriving remote-first team. Geography is no barrier to impact or connection. We build seamless virtual collaboration, empowering you wherever you work.

Equal Opportunities Statement

At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enrich our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

The AVP, Strategy & Executive Operations serves as Chief of Staff and trusted advisor to the Head of Distribution and as a member of the Distribution Executive Leadership Team. The Chief of Staff serves as a strategic advisor and force multiplier to the Head of Distribution, shaping the leadership processes through which executive leaders align on strategy, priorities, business performance, and enterprise decisions. The role creates organizational leverage by connecting priorities across functions, anticipating risks and dependencies, improving decision quality, and ensuring leaders have the insights and alignment needed to drive business outcomes. The Head of Distribution and functional executives retain accountability for strategic choices, resource decisions, operational execution, and business results. Acting as a strategic extension of the Head of Distribution, this role synthesizes information, frames complex issues anticipates and surfaces risks and opportunities, facilitates alignment, and ensures executive commitments receive appropriate follow-through and enables effective executive decision-making across a highly matrixed organization.


The Chief of Staff does not assume accountability for business results, functional execution, project delivery, or organizational decision rights. Functional leaders remain accountable for strategy execution and outcomes. The Chief of Staff creates value through strategic insight, organizational alignment, executive decision support, and proactive identification of risks and opportunities.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:


Executive partnership and leadership effectiveness: Serve as a trusted advisor to the Head of Distribution; anticipate leadership needs, prepare executive briefings and decision materials, coordinate sensitive cross-functional matters, and facilitate follow-through on executive commitments and help focus leadership attention on the highest value opportunities, risks, and decisions.


Strategic planning process: Design and facilitate the annual and ongoing strategic planning process. Coordinate inputs from executive leaders, structure planning discussions, document strategic choices, and integrate functional plans into a coherent Distribution agenda while leaders retain ownership of strategy and execution.


Executive governance and operating cadence: Establish and manage leadership meetings, business reviews, planning forums, agendas, decision logs, escalation paths, and accountability tracking that enable organizational alignment, transparency, and effective execution. Cross-functional alignment: Facilitate coordination across Exclusive Agency, Personal Auto, Commercial Auto, Lead Generation, Direct to Consumer, Marketing, and Distribution Enablement, as well as Finance, Product, Underwriting, Claims, Operations, Technology, and other enterprise partners by connecting priorities, resolving ambiguity, identifying dependencies, and ensuring critical decisions and information flow effectively across organizational boundaries.


Performance insights and decision support: Coordinate executive scorecards and business performance reviews; synthesize financial, operational, customer, and distribution information; identify trends, emerging risks, opportunities, trade-offs, and strategic implications requiring leadership attention.


Strategic portfolio visibility: Maintains an integrated view of major initiatives, strategic priorities, critical dependencies, organizational friction points, and emerging risks. Proactively identify potential collisions, surface issues early, and facilitate executive dialogue to enable timely decisions and course correction.


Executive communication: Support consistent communication of Distribution priorities and leadership decisions across functions and enterprise stakeholders; prepare executive narratives, updates, and presentations.


Organizational effectiveness: Creates organizational leverage for the Head of Distribution by connecting priorities, aligning stakeholders, reducing complexity, accelerating decision-making, and ensuring leadership attention remains focused on the issues most critical to business performance and growth.

jobs.description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.


Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.


Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.


As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.


We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.


About the Role

Beckett is the trusted authority in sports card and collectibles grading, pricing, and marketplace services. Our platform is mid-transformation: a new generation of NestJS/TypeScript microservices and Next.js frontends is actively replacing a prior generation of Java/Spring Boot services, while two large legacy PHP monoliths still power critical grading and e-commerce workflows. Getting this migration right — without disrupting the business — is the defining technical challenge of the next few years.

As a Staff Software Engineer, your influence extends beyond your team to the technology organization. You have expertise in the entirety of your team's products and services — how they interact and how data flows between them — and you're building the same understanding of adjacent systems. You lead projects of moderate-to-significant scope over one-to-two-quarter horizons, design for the platform's future rather than just the next feature, and are recognized by peers and leaders as an authority in your domain.

What You'll Do

Set technical direction

  • Own the architecture of your team's domain end to end: services, data flows, integration points, and failure modes across the full portfolio (e.g., NestJS services, their Postgres/MySQL data stores, the legacy systems they front, and the frontends they serve).

  • Design products and services that allow for iterative, autonomous development and future scaling, deliberately reducing the friction of future changes — service boundaries, contract design, data ownership, and migration paths.

  • Lead high-stakes modernization work: defining strangler patterns around the PHP monolith, sequencing Java→TypeScript service replacements, and ensuring byte-compatible, low-risk cutovers.

  • Build a working understanding of adjacent systems and products across the org — grading, marketplace, CRM, payments, identity, data/ETL — and use it to catch cross-system risks early.

  • Set the bar for security, testing, observability, and operational excellence, and use operational data to drive stability and performance improvements.

  • Lead the adoption of AI-assisted engineering across the tech org: establish standards and guardrails for AI coding tools (code review expectations, testing requirements, security and IP hygiene), identify where AI agents can accelerate the modernization effort (legacy code comprehension, test generation, migration scaffolding), and measure the impact.

Lead Delivery

  • Successfully lead projects of moderate scope and/or complexity spanning 1–2 quarters, coordinating engineers, stakeholders, and dependencies to a predictable landing.

  • Plan and develop using an explicit value-vs-cost framework, so urgency and prioritization are easily understood by both the team and stakeholders.

  • Identify and communicate blockers and delays within your team to the right stakeholders before they become surprises.

Multiply the Organization

  • Foster a culture of knowledge sharing and documentation within your team and with business stakeholders — initiate and facilitate meaningful discussions around complex issues.

  • Build strong relationships with teammates, your manager, business stakeholders, and senior engineers across the organization.

  • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, pairing, and feedback; foster a culture where feedback is sought out and used as a tool for growth.

  • Raise the org's collective AI fluency: share proven workflows, prompts, and agent configurations; coach engineers on when AI tooling helps and when it misleads; and keep the team current as the tooling landscape evolves.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including demonstrated technical leadership of multi-engineer, multi-quarter projects.

  • Expert-level backend engineering in TypeScript/Node.js and/or Java, with the range to be effective across our polyglot estate (TypeScript, Java 21, PHP, Python, C#).

  • Full-stack range: hands-on production experience across the entire stack — modern React/Next.js frontends, API and service layers, relational data stores, and the infrastructure they run on — with the judgment to design and review at every layer, even where others do the bulk of the implementation.

  • Proven experience modernizing legacy systems: strangler-fig migrations, service extraction from monoliths, or platform re-architecture under live traffic.

  • Deep relational database expertise (PostgreSQL, MySQL): data modeling, migrations, performance, and the realities of shared-database coupling between services.

  • Strong distributed-systems fundamentals: service boundaries, API/contract design (REST, GraphQL, gRPC), messaging (SQS), idempotency, and failure handling.

  • Production AWS depth — ECS, Lambda, networking, IAM — and infrastructure-as-code fluency (AWS CDK and/or Terraform).

  • A track record of raising engineering standards: testing strategy, observability, documentation, and incident response.

  • Strong, hands-on background in AI tooling and usage: daily fluency with AI coding assistants and agentic tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or similar), experience integrating them into team workflows (CI, code review, documentation), and mature judgment about verification, security, and the limits of AI-generated code.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication with technical and business audiences alike.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with frontend architecture at scale (design systems, micro-frontends, performance budgets) or mobile (React Native/Expo).

  • Experience with e-commerce, marketplace, payments, or high-traffic consumer platforms.

  • Data platform exposure (Snowflake, ETL pipelines, dimensional modeling) or applied ML (computer vision).

  • Experience building LLM-powered features or platforms: LLM API integration (Anthropic/OpenAI), retrieval-augmented generation, evals, or agent frameworks (e.g., MCP) — and shipping them to production responsibly.

  • Interest in sports cards, gaming, or collectibles!

This role is responsible for performing business analysis, gathering stakeholder requirements for analytics development to support association efforts to best understand and serve our members. This role includes assisting the Enterprise Data Management team with the collection of data around web analytics and member engagement. The role assists with data transformation in Microsoft Fabric and data presentation in Microsoft Power BI for analysis and reporting.

In addition, this role will work with the Enterprise Data Management team to recommend and implement new technologies and/or workflows in support of EDUCAUSE’s evolving needs, ensuring we adapt as we gain new insights and understanding through our work. Finally, this role also supports relevant, ad hoc data requests and acts as a backup for other teammates, providing business continuity for the Enterprise Data Management team in support of EDUCAUSE.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Business Intelligence Analytics

  • Develop Microsoft Power BI reports and dashboards that identify trends, patterns, and insights that empower data-driven decision making for Membership and the greater association.
  • Create, maintain, and modify data models and dashboards using Microsoft Fabric and Power BI, assisting with analysis and reporting in adjacent systems when required.
  • Develop AI‑assisted analytics capabilities that enable natural language exploration of enterprise data models and reports.
  • Perform data analysis to inform planning and development of business intelligence resources and reports, improving data awareness around member engagement and related revenue.
  • Create ad-hoc data reports for stakeholders using SQL and Microsoft Office suite products, including Excel and SharePoint.
  • Work with integrated data from other systems to assist EDUCAUSE staff with survey analysis, email marketing lists, data quality efforts, etc.

Analytics Engineering

  • Assist with research and validation of data pipelines and integrations, surfacing data through a medallion architecture established in Microsoft Fabric.
  • Assist with design, development, and maintenance of data models and SQL schema artifacts to support reporting requirements.
  • Design agentic AI interfaces that facilitate analytics report development, application code review, and SQL performance optimizations.
  • Work with the Enterprise Data Management team to monitor and maintain data pipelines in the Microsoft Fabric environment, ensuring critical membership engagement data is highly available and accurate for reporting.
  • Support the Enterprise Data Management team with development of new data sources and ingestion pipelines to ensure accurate and timely availability of member engagement data.

Business Analysis

  • Collaborate directly with stakeholders across the association to maintain business knowledge, identify and translate business needs into requirements, and ensure we design data products that satisfy association needs.
  • Negotiate and document project scope, risks, and assumptions for use with business stakeholders and team members.
  • Actively communicate with stakeholders, internal and external to the team, about expected project scope and delivery timelines, being proactive when communicating updates and changes around expectations.
  • Identify opportunities and propose recommendations based on data-driven insights gained while working with member data, EDUCAUSE staff, and related stakeholders.
  • Support process improvement, ensuring data collection and analysis efforts stay aligned strategically with current and upcoming association goals.

Association Service and Support

  • Respond to data support tickets within 24 hours, as assigned by the Senior Director of Enterprise Data Management.
  • Represent EDUCAUSE in a professional manner at all times; engage with co-workers in a civil, caring, respectful way; and advance the mission and vision of EDUCAUSE
  • Participate in EDUCAUSE events and activities as needed.
  • Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education and Experience

  • Required- 3-5 years of professional experience with SQL databases, designing schemas, dynamic data views, data definitions, and developing queries for reporting and analysis, demonstrating an expert-level knowledge of SQL. Experience with Microsoft Azure data services is preferred.
  • Required- 2-5 years experience with Microsoft Power BI, analyzing data, developing data models and designing business intelligence dashboards and reports.
  • Required-2-5 years experience with data collection, preparation, transformation, modeling, reporting and analysis.
  • Preferred-Experience defining or applying engagement-related scoring systems to evaluate member engagement.
  • Preferred-Experience identifying at-risk members for year-over-year activities that tie into potential revenue losses, such as at-risk renewals.
  • Preferred-Experience performing market share analysis to surface insights from organizational and individual member demographics and engagement data.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Demonstrated communication skills to bridge business stakeholders with technical teams to achieve meaningful outcomes.
  • Demonstrated understanding of association-related business processes and operations, including Membership, Marketing, and Finance data.
  • Ability and desire to identify problems, propose solutions, and be an active partner in problem solving.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies and technical skills quickly
  • Proficient with SQL, Excel, and other software languages and platforms to analyze, interpret, and securely share data.

Competencies

  • Analytical- Synthesizes complex or diverse information; Collects and researches data; Uses intuition and experience to complement data; Designs work flows and procedures.
  • Judgement- Displays willingness to make decisions; Exhibits sound and accurate judgment; Supports and explains reasoning for decisions; Includes appropriate people in decision-making process; Makes timely decisions.
  • Planning/Organizing- Prioritizes and plans work activities; Uses time efficiently; Plans for additional resources; Sets goals and objectives; Organizes or schedules other people and their tasks; Develops realistic action plans.
  • Interpersonal Skills- Focuses on solving conflict, not blaming; Maintains confidentiality; Listens to others without interrupting; Keeps emotions under control; Remains open to others' ideas and tries new things.
  • Innovation- Displays original thinking and creativity; Meets challenges with resourcefulness; Generates suggestions for improving work; Develops innovative approaches and ideas; Presents ideas and information in a manner that gets others' attention.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

TOTAL COMPENSATION

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title: Solutions Engineer

Group: Solutions Engineering Team

Location: UAE

Company Overview:

Quvia is the first AI-powered quality of experience (QoE) management platform for things that move, like ships and planes, transforming connectivity and digital experiences even in the most remote and hard-to-reach places. The Quvia platform uses AI and machine learning to seamlessly blend any combination of connectivity, regardless of provider, orbit or network, into one, vendor-neutral environment. It then delivers comprehensive, end-to-end analytics and dynamic network orchestration that optimizes for the best possible QoE and end-user experiences. Today, Quvia works with world-leading, Fortune 500 companies in aviation, cruise, shipping and more.

Why Quvia?

  • Founded in 2019, Quvia is a fast-growing, Series A tech startup passionate about making connectivity and digital experiences better for everyone, everywhere.
  • Our industry-first solutions are already addressing major challenges for companies in the aviation and cruise industries – and we're just getting started.
  • Quvia is headquartered in the greater Miami region, with offices in the UK and India, and remote teams around the world.
  • As an early-stage company, all Quvia employees have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our growth trajectory, and the future of the industries we serve.
  • Quvia is backed by Columbia Capital, a respected venture capital firm founded in 1989 that has raised over $5 Bn of fund commitments.

About the Role

The Solutions Engineer is the technical bridge between our customers and our engineering and operations teams, assessing a customer's current network, capturing new technical requirements and pain points, and converting them into solution designs that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will own the journey from qualification through proof of concept to production. This role demands deep networking fundamentals across terrestrial and satellite environments, hands-on expertise in software-defined networking (SDN) and multi-vendor SD-WAN technologies, scripting and DevOps capability, and the judgement to evaluate emerging technologies and design solutions that scale.

Working on this technology, you will have the opportunity to make a major impact on the implementation and quality of Quvia's next-generation products. Our environment cultivates innovation and rapid product iteration within a creative solution space, and we need a dedicated, organized, and efficient professional who thrives on being integral to a fast-paced startup. As an excellent communicator, you will set appropriate expectations, keep stakeholders apprised of progress and action items, manage project plans, balance workloads, and ensure we meet our commitments; all while navigating the complexities of large enterprise customers. Above all, you will think creatively through complex problems and design and implement solutions that address customer pain points and generate economic benefits, enabling us to publish a clear ROI for every customer.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with sales to assess a customer’s current network, capture new technical requirements and pain points, and convert them into tailored solution designs with clear, measurable business outcomes.
  • Design, test and deploy multi path traffic orchestration systems across satellite, and terrestrial environments in customer networks using Quvia products and third party integrations. This will require the setup of a customer profile at edge, cloud and datacenters/POPs.
  • Lead proof of concepts end to end: define success criteria, design, hardware specifications, installation, configuration and testing of Quvia systems. Responsible for troubleshooting complex issues with customer, QA and Engineering teams, and own the handoff from POC to production.
  • Use scripting and DevOps practices to streamline solution delivery – configuration templating, workflow automation and tooling that supports demos, POCs and repeatable deployments.
  • Act as a technical advisor to customers, offering guidance on best practices and optimal usage of terrestrial and satellite communication systems, and presenting status updates and health metrics to customer stakeholders.
  • Conduct training sessions and workshops for customers and internal teams on the operation and maintenance of Quvia products and their value proposition.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including sales, product management, systems, engineering, QA, and service delivery, to ensure successful project execution. Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for all solutions and services provided. Complete a successful handoff to all relevant teams at the end of the project.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of network engineering experience across terrestrial and/or satellite communications, including multi-link architecture.
  • Deep networking fundamentals, including routing and switching, network security, wireless, and datacenter networking.
  • Hands-on experience with software-defined networking (SDN) and multi-vendor SD-WAN and Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) platforms such as Fortinet, VMware VeloCloud, Cisco (Meraki/Viptela), Cradlepoint (Ericsson), Palo Alto, or similar enterprise solutions.
  • Scripting and DevOps experience in a networking context – Python, REST APIs, configuration orchestration, zero-touch provisioning and workflow automation.
  • A track record of leading customer-facing POCs, deployments or migrations (for example, from traditional WAN architectures to SD-WAN) in large enterprise environments.
  • Proven ability to convert a customer’s current network, new technical requirements and pain points into business outcomes, and to articulate that value to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven knowledge and understanding of managing virtual infrastructure using VMware vSphere, Hyper-V, or KVM, and a thorough understanding of computer hardware and operating systems.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to lead customer conversations at both engineering and executive level.
  • Commercial awareness: the ability to spot opportunities to reduce cost, simplify delivery, and open new market segments through better solution design.
  • Project management experience and the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Satellite communication (SATCOM) systems knowledge and experience is a plus.
  • Experience with cloud-hosted networking and security (e.g. Azure- or AWS-hosted NGFW) is a plus.

What We'll Offer

  • Competitive Salary
  • Performance related bonus
  • Competitive Health Benefits including optical and dental plan
  • Pension Scheme
  • 30 days Paid Time Off
  • Paid Public Holidays
  • Share Options
  • Monthly phone allowance

Quvia will never ask to interview job applicants via text message or ask for personal banking information as part of the interview process. Quvia will never ask job applicants or new hires to send money or deposit checks for the company. In case of doubt, please contact us directly at

All employment opportunities are provided without regard to race, religion, sex (including sexual orientation and transgender status), pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager - Servicing (US Remote)

Why this Role Matters:

The Senior Product Manager - Servicing will own the product experience across Greenbox Capital’s servicing ecosystem, including both the tools used by internal team members and the experiences used by our customers.

This role is responsible for understanding business problems, customer needs, operational workflows, and team-member pain points, then translating those insights into scalable product solutions that improve efficiency, usability, and business outcomes.

You will serve as the architect of business impact, defining the problems we should solve, shaping the future-state experience, establishing requirements and success measures, and partnering closely with Technology to bring those solutions to life.

Salesforce is currently a key internal platform supporting servicing and may expand into additional areas of the business over time. While Salesforce experience is valuable, this is not a Salesforce administrator or technical architecture role. We are looking for a strong product leader who knows how to solve business problems from both the customer and team-member perspective.

In addition to owning the servicing experience, this role will support other strategic initiatives across the company through Greenbox Capital’s product pod structure.

This role reports to the Chief Operating Officer and works closely with Technology, Operations, Underwriting, Risk, Sales, Data, and other business teams.

What Success Looks Like:

Here’s how your time might break down (actual time can shift depending on business needs):

  • Servicing Product & Experience Ownership - Owning the roadmap and experience across customer-facing servicing capabilities and internal team-member tools
  • Product Discovery & Delivery - Identifying the right problems to solve and moving initiatives from discovery through development, launch, and iteration
  • Business Process & Workflow Optimization - Redesigning workflows, reducing friction, and identifying opportunities to simplify, automate, or improve how work gets done
  • Cross-Functional Product Leadership - Partnering across Product, Technology, Operations, Underwriting, Risk, Sales, and Data to solve high-priority business problems
  • Product Adoption & Business Impact - Ensuring new capabilities are adopted, used effectively, and produce measurable improvements in customer and business outcomes

How you’ll be measured:

Servicing Product & Experience Ownership:

  • Own and evolve the product roadmap for Greenbox Capital’s servicing experience
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer journeys, team-member workflows, operational challenges, and business needs
  • Define product priorities based on customer value, operational impact, business outcomes, effort, and strategic importance
  • Design future-state experiences and workflows that simplify processes and improve outcomes
  • Ensure internal tools and customer-facing experiences work cohesively across the servicing lifecycle

Product Discovery & Delivery:

  • Lead product initiatives from problem identification and discovery through launch and iteration
  • Conduct discovery with customers, team members, and business stakeholders to understand root problems before defining solutions
  • Translate complex business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measures of success
  • Maintain backlog clarity and establish thoughtful prioritization across competing initiatives
  • Partner closely with Technology throughout development, QA, release readiness, and implementation
  • Evaluate product performance after launch and drive continuous improvement based on data and user feedback

Business Process & Workflow Optimization:

  • Identify friction, unnecessary complexity, manual work, and breakdowns within servicing and operational workflows
  • Determine when processes should be redesigned, simplified, automated, or enabled through technology
  • Design scalable future-state workflows in partnership with business and Technology stakeholders
  • Identify opportunities to improve or expand the use of Salesforce and other platforms
  • Ensure new solutions integrate effectively with existing systems, data, and operational processes
  • Balance immediate business needs with longer-term scalability

Cross-Functional Product Leadership:

  • Partner with Operations, Underwriting, Risk, Sales, Technology, Data, and other teams to solve priority business problems
  • Support strategic initiatives outside the core servicing roadmap through Greenbox Capital’s product pod structure
  • Create alignment around problem definition, requirements, priorities, trade-offs, and success measures
  • Communicate product direction and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Challenge assumptions and help teams distinguish between symptoms, root causes, and the right solution

Product Adoption & Business Impact:

  • Define clear success measures for major product initiatives
  • Monitor adoption, workflow utilization, customer experience, operational performance, and relevant business outcomes
  • Partner with stakeholders on UAT, training, documentation, release communication, and change adoption
  • Identify where released capabilities are not producing the intended outcomes and determine what needs to change
  • Continuously improve the product based on user behavior, feedback, operational data, and business performance

You’re a Strong Fit if You:

  • Think about product through the lens of the customer, the team member, and the business outcome
  • Naturally seek to understand the problem before jumping to a solution
  • Can take messy, ambiguous business challenges and turn them into structured product opportunities
  • Understand how operational workflows, technology, data, and customer experience intersect
  • Know how to distinguish between improving an existing process and designing a better future-state process
  • Can translate business needs into clear requirements that Technology teams can execute
  • Are comfortable challenging assumptions and asking why a process exists before automating it
  • Balance strategic product thinking with hands-on execution
  • Prioritize based on impact rather than simply responding to the loudest stakeholder
  • Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Use data, user feedback, and business context to make product decisions
  • Are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities and business needs evolve
  • Demonstrate strong ownership and accountability from problem identification through business outcome
  • Adapt well in a distributed team environment and collaborate effectively across functions

What You’ve Done Before:

  • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
  • Minimum 5 years of product management experience delivering complex software or technology-enabled products
  • Demonstrated experience translating customer, user, and business problems into scalable product solutions
  • Experience leading product initiatives through discovery, requirements definition, prioritization, development, launch, and iteration
  • Experience working closely with engineering or Technology teams throughout the product lifecycle
  • Experience improving operational workflows, business systems, or internal tools
  • Experience using data and customer or user feedback to inform product decisions
  • Experience managing competing priorities and maintaining a clear product backlog or roadmap
  • Experience working with Salesforce as a product or business platform preferred
  • Experience building products that serve both internal users and external customers preferred
  • Experience in fintech, lending, servicing, payments, alternative finance, or another operationally complex environment preferred
  • Experience working within cross-functional product pods or similar delivery models preferred

Tools and Expertise You’ll Bring:

  • Product strategy and roadmap development
  • Product discovery and problem definition
  • Customer journey and user workflow analysis
  • Business process and future-state workflow design
  • Product requirements and user story development
  • Backlog management and prioritization
  • Agile or Scrum product development methodologies
  • Internal tools and customer-facing product experiences
  • Salesforce-based product environments
  • Workflow automation and operational systems design
  • Product analytics and data-informed decision-making
  • UAT, release readiness, and product adoption
  • Analytics platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Sigma, Looker, or Databricks
  • SDLC and product management tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Linear, or Shortcut
  • Vendor, platform, and integration management

What to Expect from Our Interview Process

We believe in a respectful, efficient, and transparent hiring experience. Here’s what you can expect (subject to changes depending on role):

Step 1: Initial Phone Screen

Step 2: Recruiter Interview

Step 3: Interview with Chief Operating Officer

Step 4: Product / Business Working Session

Step 5: Cross-Functional Leadership Interviews

Step 6: References, Offer & Background Check

What's In It For You:

💸 Competitive Pay - We know your worth and we pay accordingly.

🌴 Flexible PTO - Work hard, rest well. Take the time you need to recharge.

🏡 Remote - Fully remote within the U.S., working Eastern Time hours to keep everyone aligned.

🩺 Full Benefits Package - Health, dental, vision, 401K with employer match

🧠 Smart, Supportive Teammates - Collaborate with sharp minds who are kind, driven and uphold our core values: Wear Green First, Pull the Thread, Move the Needle, Courage Over Comfort, Think Bold, Win Together, and Own the Outcome

What success looks like in this role:

Position Overview 

  • The Delivery Manager is responsible for leading managed infrastructure and workload automation services across multiple technology disciplines. This role provides operational leadership for Workload Automation and the Incident Response Team (IRT), a first-level Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) function responsible for monitoring, triage, incident response, technical coordination and service restoration across supported environments. 
  • The role requires a strong working knowledge of enterprise infrastructure and workload automation technologies, including Control-M, AutoSys, Tivoli and other applicable workload automation platforms, Windows, Linux, backup and restore, storage, databases, and cloud platforms such as OCI, AWS and Microsoft Azure. The individual must be able to effectively lead technical teams, manage operational risks and escalations, and communicate technical issues and business impact to clients and stakeholders. 
  • Automation is a core component of this role. The successful candidate should have demonstrated experience identifying opportunities to automate repeatable operational activities, reduce manual intervention, improve reliability and drive measurable improvements in service delivery. 
  • The ideal candidate should enjoy working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, exercise sound business judgment, and apply strong problem-solving and collaboration skills across a complex organization. 
  • Recruit, develop, inspire and retain a high-performing operations and engineering team while promoting accountability, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. 

Business and Industry Skills 

  • Demonstrates working knowledge across infrastructure operations, workload automation, SRE practices and managed services delivery. Stays current with relevant IT infrastructure, cloud, automation and service-management technologies, ITIL practices and vendor offerings. 
  • Communicates in an open, candid, clear, complete and consistent manner. Listens well, conveys technical and business information in easily understood formats, and demonstrates professionalism in formal and informal interactions. 
  • Understands the meaning and implications of key operational and financial indicators and uses data to identify issues, evaluate service performance and develop practical improvement plans. 
  • Collaborates effectively across technology towers, client teams, account leadership, engineering teams and third-party suppliers to drive service outcomes. 

Responsibilities 

Managed Service Delivery 

  • Manage day-to-day delivery of infrastructure, workload automation and Incident Response Team services. 
  • Ensure achievement of SLA, KPI, availability, quality and operational performance objectives. 
  • Provide leadership during service-impacting incidents and escalations, ensuring the appropriate technical resources and stakeholders are engaged. 
  • Drive operational accountability across technology teams and ensure issues are followed through to resolution. 
  • Identify recurring operational issues and partner with engineering teams to implement permanent corrective actions. 
  • Maintain appropriate staffing, skills, coverage, documentation and operational readiness across supported services. 
  • Manage relationships with clients, internal stakeholders, technology partners and third-party suppliers. 
  • Validate that staffing levels, skill levels and other resources align with contractual, financial and solution requirements. 
  • Identify resource or capability gaps and document associated risks, mitigation plans and contingencies. 

Incident Response / SRE Operations 

  • Provide leadership for the Incident Response Team, supporting first and second-level SRE and infrastructure operations. 
  • Ensure effective monitoring, event management, incident triage, escalation, troubleshooting and service-restoration processes. 
  • Coordinate support across Windows, Linux, backup and restore, storage, database, cloud and other infrastructure technologies. 
  • Promote proactive operations by identifying repeat incidents, alert noise, manual activities and opportunities for improved monitoring and automation. 
  • Partner with engineering and technology tower teams for complex incidents, problem management, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement. 

Workload Automation 

  • Provide service delivery leadership for enterprise workload automation and job-scheduling platforms, including Control-M, AutoSys, Tivoli and other applicable workload automation technologies. 
  • Apply a working understanding of workload scheduling concepts, dependencies, job failures, batch processing, alerting, escalation and operational recovery. 
  • Ensure workload automation incidents and failures are appropriately prioritized, investigated, escalated and communicated. 
  • Work with technical teams to improve workload reliability and reduce repetitive manual intervention. 
  • Support continuous improvement of workload automation processes, monitoring, support procedures and operational controls. 

Automation and Continuous Improvement 

  • Champion an automation-first approach to operational service delivery. 
  • Identify repetitive support activities, manual processes and recurring incidents that are candidates for automation. 
  • Partner with engineering teams to develop and implement automation that reduces manual effort, improves service reliability and accelerates incident resolution. 
  • Apply a working understanding of common infrastructure automation, scripting, orchestration and Infrastructure as Code concepts. 
  • Track the operational benefits of automation initiatives and continuously identify additional opportunities for improvement. 
  • Promote standardization, documentation, knowledge management and reusable operational processes across teams. 

Service Governance and Commercial Support 

  • Review service performance, risks, resource needs and improvement opportunities with account and client stakeholders. 
  • Support account management and bid teams by reviewing relevant service-delivery requirements, staffing assumptions, operational risks and solution dependencies when requested. 
  • Participate in governance and service-review activities to maintain a shared understanding of operational expectations, performance and priorities. 


You will be successful in this role if you have:

Skills, Experience & Qualifications 

  • Progressive experience in IT infrastructure operations, managed services, service delivery, SRE, workload automation or enterprise operations. 
  • Previous experience leading multidisciplinary technical or operations teams. 
  • Demonstrated experience managing services in environments involving Windows, Linux, storage, backup and recovery, database and cloud technologies. 
  • BA/BS degree and 5+ years’ relevant experience OR equivalent combination of education and relevant experience 2 years’ leadership experience

Preferred Skills:

  • Hands-on knowledge of Control-M System Administration.

A large share of the work involves LLM-powered product features: an AI agent that calls tools to read and write real project data, and pipelines that pull structured data out of messy documents.

Location:LATAM 100% Remote. Working hours are based on the US Central Time Zone. Minimum 6-hour overlap.

About us:

Abstra is a fast-growing, Nearshore Tech Talent services company, providing top Latin American tech talent to U.S. companies and beyond. Founded by U.S.-bred engineers with over 15 years of experience, Abstra specializes in sourcing skilled professionals across a wide range of technologies to meet our clients’ needs, driving innovation and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

• Build and ship full-stack features.

• Create fast proof-of-concept work for demos and client feedback.
• Extend the AI agent: add and maintain tools with typed input and output schemas, refine system
prompts, and keep model outputs grounded in data from the database.
• Measure LLM behavior with evaluation suites and use the results to guide changes to prompts,
tools and models. Changes should be backed by evals, not hunches.
• Improve document extraction and classification pipelines for PDFs, Excel, Word, and CSV files,

including the LLM-assisted steps.

• Build data-heavy UI: tables, charts, maps and streaming chat interfaces.
• Write tests at every layer (pytest, Vitest, Playwright) and review teammates' pull requests.
• Contribute to infrastructure as code and CI/CD when your features need it.

Required experience:
• 3–5+ years of professional software engineering, with full-stack features shipped to production.
• Strong object-oriented design. You can model a complex domain with clear classes, sensible boundaries, and composition, and you know when inheritance is the wrong tool. Comfortable with SOLID principles, common design patterns, and refactoring legacy code toward a cleaner structure.

• LLMs and ML as product features. You've built and shipped at least one feature where an LLM or ML model is part of what the product does for customers. Using AI coding assistants doesn't count toward this.

Specifically:

- Tool or function calling, and structured outputs validated against schemas.
- Prompt design, versioning, and checking outputs against source data to limit hallucinations.
- Evaluating model behavior with test sets or eval suites, and handling cost, latency, and failure modes.
- Streaming LLM responses to a user interface.

• Python backend: production experience with FastAPI or a similar framework, Pydantic, async Python, and SQLAlchemy (or a comparable ORM) with migrations.
• Relational databases: strong PostgreSQL skills, including schema design, query performance, and data integrity.
• React and TypeScript: production experience with modern hooks-based React, server-state management (TanStack Query or similar), and building complex, data-dense interfaces.
• Testing: you write automated tests by habit, both unit and integration, on the backend and the frontend.
• Cloud and delivery: working experience with AWS, Docker, Git-based pull request workflows, and CI/CD pipelines.
• Hands-on experience with pydantic-ai, the Vercel AI SDK, or comparable agent and LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or the OpenAI Agents SDK.
• Retrieval and RAG systems: embeddings, vector search (pgvector or similar), and hybrid retrieval.
• Document AI: PDF and table extraction, OCR, and classifying semi-structured data.
• Classical ML or applied statistics: regression, estimation, and working with confidence ranges.

• Terraform and AWS App Runner or ECS.

• Geospatial work: Shapely, PostGIS, or Leaflet-style mapping.
• Domain exposure to real estate, construction, finance, or proptech, such as cost estimating or pro forma modeling.
• Security-minded engineering: multi-tenant data isolation, authorization models, and secrets handling.

• Communication: professional working English, and you can work independently in a small remote team. That means clear written updates, good pull request descriptions, and raising blockers early.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation paid in USD.
  • 20 days of paid time off (PTO) per year.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and career development.
  • Company-provided equipment.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and multicultural work environment.
  • The opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects alongside a talented and supportive team.

Pre-Employment Verification
As part of our standard onboarding process, candidates who successfully complete the interview process and accept an employment offer will be required to complete an employment verification check, and background check. This process will confirm job titles and dates of employment with two previous employers and is a standard requirement for all new employees joining the company.

jobs.excerpt: Build the Data Infrastructure That Powers Insights from SpaceXplore is a highly differentiated, venture-backed commercial space company.
jobs.description:
Build the Data Infrastructure That Powers Insights from Space

Xplore is a highly differentiated, venture-backed commercial space company. We design, build, and operate satellites and sensors that collect high-fidelity Earth observation data, enabling insights that support social, economic, environmental, and security outcomes across the globe.

Every image we collect is trillions of spectral data points - revealing the physical and chemical state of Earth in ways conventional imaging cannot. Our multi-sensor satellite captures and combines multi-modal remote sensing data with edge computing and high-throughput communications capabilities to generate spatial insights for our customers around the world.

In this position, you will play a role in developing and scaling the software that powers our data processing pipelines. You will be responsible for building robust, scalable systems that support low latency satellite tasking, telemetry, data automation, and image processing workflows. You’ll take ownership of complex technical challenges, ensuring high performance, reliability, and efficiency in delivering space-based data solutions.

The Mission

We are hiring a Senior Full Stack Developer to lead the design and development of scalable data infrastructure powering Xplore’s satellite operations and Earth observation platform.

Preferred Job Locations

Resident In State of Illinois: Remote with min. 6 – 8 multi-day trips to Xplore HQ per year.

Resident In State of Massachusetts: Remote with min. 6 – 8 multi-day trips to Xplore HQ per year.

What You Will Build

  • Satellite operations and data processing pipelines
  • Integrations with global ground station networks
  • Robust, scalable systems supporting satellite tasking, telemetry, and data automation
  • Image processing workflows for Earth observation data
  • High-performance, reliable data solutions delivering space-based insights
  • What You Will Own

Data Pipeline Architecture & Development

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable cloud-native data pipelines
  • Architect event-driven systems and high-volume data processing infrastructure
  • Optimize cloud-based infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (ECS, S3, SQS)
  • Develop containerized application deployments and real-time data pipelines

Satellite Operations & Integrations

  • Build and maintain integrations with global ground station networks
  • Develop satellite tasking, telemetry, and command software
  • Automate data ingestion, processing, and delivery workflows
  • Support image processing pipelines for hyperspectral Earth observation data

System Ownership & Execution

  • Independently lead development efforts and ship high-quality code
  • Manage shifting priorities in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment
  • Take technical ownership from architecture through deployment
  • Collaborate with spacecraft, payload, and mission engineering teams to ensure flight readiness

Your work will directly influence our ability to collect, process, and deliver high-fidelity Earth observation data from orbit.

Requirements

  • U.S. Citizen or Lawful Permanent Resident
  • Educational Background:Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Professional Experience: At least 5 years of hands-on experience in software development, focusing on cloud-native applications, distributed systems, and backend infrastructure.

Proficiency in:

  • Kotlin and TypeScript, with Python experience
  • Amazon Web Services, especially ECS, S3, and SQS
  • Containerized applications
  • Real-time data pipelines
  • System Architecture Knowledge: Strong background in designing, scaling, and optimizing cloud-based infrastructure, event-driven systems, and high-volume data processing.

Ownership & Execution: Ability to independently lead development efforts, ship high-quality code, and manage shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment. The ideal candidate brings strong technical chops and a quiet confidence—ready to step up and lead when the moment calls for it, and equally ready to listen and learn.

You’ll Impress Us Even More If You Have

  • Experience with Rust
  • Experience with Ray Data Pipelines
  • Astrodynamics, GNC, or physics experience for satellite simulations
  • Experience in migration of systems to new languages/frameworks/infrastructures and high-level knowledge of multiple languages and frameworks to assist in migration efforts

Additional Requirements

  • Availability to support critical integration, testing, or launch activities outside standard working hours when required

Why This Role Is Different

  • You will build data infrastructure that powers real spacecraft operations
  • You will work across cloud, edge, and satellite data domains
  • You will build mission-critical pipelines that process data collected from orbit
  • You will work in a high-agency engineering environment where ownership matters
  • Your software will connect space hardware to real-world Earth observation insights

This is a builder’s role.

What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)

  • You have taken technical ownership of one or more data pipeline systems supporting satellite tasking, telemetry, or image processing.
  • You have built or meaningfully improved scalable cloud-native data pipelines that deliver Earth observation data reliably and efficiently.
  • You have resolved early integration challenges between ground station networks, satellite operations software, and cloud infrastructure.
  • You have delivered production-ready pipeline improvements that directly support active satellite missions.
  • You have built automation, monitoring, or validation tooling that improves data engineering velocity and reliability.
  • You have become a trusted technical contributor across spacecraft, payload, and software teams, helping shape data architecture for future missions.

Benefits

Pay Range, Compensation and Benefits: USD $130k – $180k / per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your Total Rewards at Xplore. As an employee, you will also receive access to comprehensive 100% company-funded medical, vision, and dental coverage, life and ADD insurance for you and your qualified dependents, and various other company perks such as free beverages and snacks, weekly team lunches, regular team outings, and special rewards. Additionally, Xplore offers an equity incentive plan (ESOP) for qualified full-time employees.

The HSA qualified health plan is available for full-time employees working 30 hours or more per week.

Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays) Each full-time employee earns PTO at a rate of 1.33 days per month, and a minimum of 13 paid federal holidays are provided each year for full-time employees. Note: Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law.

Who Thrives at Xplore

Xplore is built around curious, driven engineers and builders who want to put real hardware in space and see it work.

Our team members:

  • Are energized by building, launching, and operating spacecraft
  • Enjoy tackling hard technical problems that require creativity, persistence, and teamwork
  • Thrive in an environment surrounded by high-performing peers who push each other to do their best work
  • Take pride in designing systems that move from idea to hardware to orbit
  • Approach challenges with intellectual curiosity, collaboration, and a strong sense of ownership
  • Inside the office, we push each other to become better engineers and better problem-solvers every day. Curiosity doesn’t stop when the workday ends—space is an exciting field, and new ideas tend to surface in hallway conversations, over whiteboards, or while debugging hardware late in the lab.
  • We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Humor, creativity, and curiosity are part of the culture.
  • Outside of work you’ll find teammates who play music, experiment with hydroponics, train for endurance races, build elaborate LEGO creations, explore geocaching trails, photograph national parks, and pursue all kinds of technical and creative hobbies.
  • We’re a tight-knit group that loves what we do—and the people we do it with.

Why Join Now

  • Spacecraft already on orbit
  • Constellation scaling underway
  • Expanding government and commercial demand
  • Next-generation mission architecture in development

The engineers who join at this stage will define how Xplore operates for the next decade.

If you’re ready to build the data infrastructure that powers spacecraft operations, process petabytes of Earth observation data, and architect systems that scale—we want to talk.

More About Xplore

Please click for company website

EEO/Additional Requirements

Xplore is an equal opportunity employer; employment with Xplore is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

This employer participates in E-Verify. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. All persons hired will be required to be a U.S. citizen, a lawful permanent resident of the U.S., or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
