jobs.description:
Job Title: Integration Engineer

Location: Remote, UK

Reports to: Head of Integration (UK)

Work schedule: Mon – Fri, 37.5 hours per week

Who are VitalHub?

VitalHub aspire to accelerate the delivery of digital transformation at scale, supporting healthcare organisations internationally to improve how they capture and analyse data. This helps enhance patient flow and enables better coordination of care across planned and unplanned services, mental health, workforce, and compliance. From patient-facing apps and in-hospital flow management to national system control centres supporting the provision of healthcare services across US, UK, Canada, Middle East & Australia, our solutions exist to deliver an eco-system of joined-up technical infrastructure and centralised data integration.

The Opportunity:

The Integration Engineer is responsible for delivering and supporting healthcare integration solutions connecting the company’s products with customer and third-party systems.

Working across assigned products and customer projects, the role delivers technical integration activities throughout the project lifecycle. This includes technical discovery, interface configuration and development, testing, deployment, go-live, documentation, and transition into business-as-usual support. The role combines professional services delivery with core integration engineering, including contributing to the development of new host-system interfaces, reusable integration patterns, and code-first development and deployment practices. The role also contributes to the investigation and resolution of support issues affecting deployed integrations.

Working with an appropriate level of autonomy based on experience and the complexity of the work, the Integration Engineer collaborates with Senior Integration Engineers, project teams, customers, and internal stakeholders to ensure that integration solutions are reliable, maintainable, secure, and supportable.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain a good understanding of the integration capabilities, supported workflows, technical dependencies, and deployment patterns associated with assigned products.
  • Deliver assigned integration activities and manage defined technical work packages across customer projects, coordinating priorities, dependencies, risks, and delivery milestones with Senior Integration Engineers and the relevant project teams.
  • Work with Sales and Customer Success teams to understand customer requirements and provide technical input to the definition of integration deliverables associated with the sale and implementation of the company’s products.
  • Contribute to technical estimates, implementation approaches, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and delivery plans for proposed integration work.
  • Provide technical input to Statements of Work, helping to ensure that relevant scope, deliverables, responsibilities, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and exclusions are understood and documented.
  • Identify potential changes to agreed scope and communicate these to Senior Integration Engineers, Project Managers, and other relevant stakeholders for assessment.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Business Analysts, Product teams, customer technical teams, and third-party suppliers to define, plan, and deliver integration requirements.
  • Deliver assigned technical integration work throughout the project lifecycle, from discovery and design through to development, testing, deployment, cutover, go-live, and operational handover.
  • Design, configure, develop, test, and deploy healthcare interfaces using Mirth Connect, BridgeLink, or other Mirth Connect-based integration engines and associated technologies.
  • Configure and extend established integration patterns connecting the company’s products with Patient Administration Systems, Electronic Patient Records, Electronic Medical Records, Radiology Information Systems, and other clinical or administrative systems.
  • Contribute to the development of new integration solutions for previously unsupported host systems, message types, workflows, or technical requirements, translating business and clinical needs into reliable, secure, maintainable, and supportable solutions.
  • Develop and maintain integrations using healthcare interoperability standards and technologies, particularly HL7 v2, REST APIs, JSON, XML, and related data exchange patterns.
  • Plan and support interface testing with internal teams, customers, and third-party suppliers, including connectivity, message validation, system integration, user acceptance, regression, and production verification activities.
  • Undertake and support deployment, cutover, go-live, and post-go-live assurance activities in accordance with agreed plans, ensuring that dependencies, risks, verification steps, and rollback arrangements are understood and appropriately escalated.
  • Participate in planned out-of-hours deployments, cutovers, go-live activities, and other time-critical implementation work where required, working with project teams to plan these activities and minimise their frequency and impact.
  • Investigate and resolve issues affecting deployed integrations, using messages, logs, code, configuration, databases, APIs, and other technical evidence to identify root causes and implement appropriate resolutions, escalating complex, high-risk, or unfamiliar issues where required.
  • Produce and maintain appropriate technical documentation throughout the project and development lifecycle, including solution designs, interface specifications, data mappings, test evidence, deployment and rollback plans, and operational handover materials.
  • Contribute to the development and documentation of reusable integration patterns, shared components, host-system capabilities, deployment requirements, known constraints, and support considerations for use across future customer implementations.
  • Contribute to the organisation’s adoption of code-first integration development, including externally managed JavaScript, reusable modules, source control, peer review, command-line tooling, automated testing, and repeatable deployment processes.
  • Participate in peer reviews of integration designs, configurations, and code, acting on constructive feedback and contributing to the maintenance of appropriate technical and quality standards.
  • Share technical knowledge and experience with colleagues, contributing to the development of capability across the wider team.
  • Participate confidently in customer meetings, technical workshops, delivery planning sessions, project discussions, and incident investigations, communicating technical information clearly to relevant stakeholders.
  • Plan and manage assigned work across customer delivery, core engineering, documentation, and support priorities, communicating progress, risks, dependencies, and required decisions to Senior Integration Engineers and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Attend customer or third-party locations for face-to-face meetings, technical workshops, deployment activities, or issue resolution where there is a specific business or delivery requirement.
  • Provide reasonable transitional support to Implementation and other internal teams where activities relate to existing customer commitments, legacy solutions, or the effective transfer of responsibilities, knowledge, and documentation into the appropriate operational team.
  • Support the identification, documentation, and progressive transition of legacy activities that do not form part of the Integration Engineering team’s intended long-term responsibilities.
  • Work in accordance with relevant information governance, data protection, security, clinical safety, quality, and change management requirements, while contributing to the continuous improvement of the company’s products, integration capabilities, and delivery practices.
  • Embrace and demonstrate the company’s vision and values.

Essential Experience:

  • Demonstrable professional experience developing, configuring, testing, deploying, or supporting system interfaces using an integration platform, middleware technology, or custom integration solution.
  • Good practical understanding of systems integration concepts and common integration patterns, including message-based, API-based, or event-driven integration.
  • Experience working with structured data formats and system-to-system data exchange, such as JSON, XML, delimited data, or comparable formats.
  • Practical understanding of interface processing concepts, including data transformation, validation, routing, acknowledgements, error handling, retries, logging, and monitoring.
  • Experience developing or supporting API-based integrations using technologies and formats such as REST, JSON, HTTP, and associated authentication and error-handling patterns.
  • Experience delivering assigned technical integration activities or defined work packages through relevant stages of the project or development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and operational handover.
  • Practical experience using a programming or scripting language to transform data, implement processing logic, automate technical activities, or support system integration.
  • Ability and willingness to apply existing development skills to JavaScript-based interface development within Mirth Connect-based technologies.
  • Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL, including the ability to query data and investigate database-related integration issues.
  • Strong diagnostic, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with experience investigating technical issues using logs, data, configuration, code, database queries, API responses, or other diagnostic evidence.
  • Ability to manage assigned technical activities and defined work packages, organising priorities and communicating progress, risks, dependencies, and required decisions to relevant colleagues and stakeholders.
  • Ability to identify potential technical risks, dependencies, constraints, and scope changes and escalate them appropriately.
  • Experience collaborating with technical and non-technical stakeholders to understand requirements, resolve issues, and coordinate delivery activities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical matters clearly and professionally and produce accurate, structured, and maintainable documentation.
  • A structured and quality-focused approach to technical design, development, testing, deployment, change control, and operational handover.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team, seeking guidance or additional expertise when appropriate.
  • Ability and willingness to learn healthcare integration standards, workflows, systems, and terminology, including HL7 v2 and the company’s Mirth Connect-based integration technologies.
  • Willingness and ability to adopt source-controlled, code-first development and deployment practices.
  • Willingness to participate in occasional planned out-of-hours implementation activities, with appropriate flexibility and time off in lieu in accordance with company arrangements.
  • Willingness to undertake occasional UK travel where a specific customer or business requirement cannot reasonably be met remotely.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience developing, configuring, deploying, or supporting interfaces using Mirth Connect, BridgeLink, another Mirth Connect-based integration engine, or a comparable integration platform.
  • Experience working within healthcare integration, the NHS, other UK healthcare providers, or a similarly regulated environment.
  • Working knowledge of HL7 v2, including commonly used message structures, segments, fields, trigger events, acknowledgements, and message-processing patterns.
  • Knowledge of NHS clinical and administrative workflows, terminology, information governance requirements, and interoperability practices.
  • Experience integrating with healthcare host systems, including Patient Administration Systems, Electronic Patient Records, Electronic Medical Records, Radiology Information Systems, Laboratory Information Management Systems, and other clinical or administrative platforms.
  • Knowledge of FHIR, including FHIR resources, profiles, terminology, RESTful interactions, and implementation considerations.
  • Development or scripting experience using JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, or another language relevant to integration development.
  • Experience working with Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Linux-based environments, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience using Git-based source control, Visual Studio Code, command-line development tools, and collaborative development practices such as branching, pull requests, and code reviews.
  • Experience using Azure DevOps or comparable development lifecycle tooling, including work item management, repositories, build processes, and deployment pipelines.
  • Experience with continuous integration, automated testing, automated deployment, configuration management, or infrastructure-as-code principles.
  • Experience developing interfaces using code-first practices, including externally managed code, reusable modules, source-controlled configuration, command-line tooling, or automated deployment.
  • Understanding of integration security practices, including TLS, certificates, API authentication, secrets management, encryption, and secure transfer protocols.
  • Knowledge of additional healthcare interoperability standards, technologies, or formats, such as DICOM, CDA, IHE profiles, NHS APIs, or NHS messaging standards.
  • Experience contributing to reusable integration frameworks, shared components, common libraries, coding standards, technical documentation, or engineering best practices.
  • Relevant qualifications or certifications in software engineering, systems integration, healthcare interoperability, cloud technologies, databases, or a related technical discipline.

Our Interview Process:

  1. Telephone interview with the Talent Team – Pre-screening & Qualification
  2. Virtual interview with the Line Manager & Team Member – Competency Interview
  3. Virtual interview with the Line Manager, VP of Engineering & Head of HR (UK)

As an equal opportunities’ employer, VitalHub is committed to the equal treatment of all current and prospective employees and does not condone discrimination based on age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, or marriage and civil partnership.

We aspire to have a diverse and inclusive workplace and strongly encourage suitably qualified applicants from a wide range of backgrounds to apply and join VitalHub. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let the Talent Team know.

Senior Full Stack Engineer

College Board – Technology

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position.

About Technology at College Board:

We are a mission-driven engineering team building and evolving the technology that powers and protects the future of learning. Our systems support highly trusted education programs used by millions of students each year, operating at significant scale and public responsibility. Today, we are focused on designing and delivering a critical new initiative that extends our platform in meaningful ways: blending foundational system work with thoughtful experimentation as we adapt to emerging technologies and new learner needs. We combine modern, cloud-native engineering practices with years of platform modernization, security hardening, and large-scale digital delivery, operating as an experiment factory that tests assumptions and iterates based on evidence rather than tradition. What makes this team distinct is the rare combination of meaningful public impact, platform-scale technical challenges, and the freedom to shape how mission-critical systems are built and evolved.

About the Team

The Deliver team is responsible for building and operating the core products that deliver high-stakes digital assessments to millions of students each year. Today, this includes supporting flagship programs such as the SAT and AP exams, while advancing the technology that enables secure, reliable, and scalable test delivery across a wide range of devices and environments. The team focuses on delivering high-integrity proctoring and assessment experiences, ensuring performance, security, and consistency for students and educators at scale.

Our responsibilities span two primary domains:

We own the end-to-end student testing experience, including:

  • Bluebook – the student-facing desktop application used to take digital exams
  • Mission Control – a large-scale, AWS-based backend that supports authentication, test delivery, telemetry, resilience, and security
  • Test & Results Packaging – systems that ingest, digitize, secure, package, and deliver test content to students through the Bluebook client

Together, these systems must operate with extreme reliability, security, and performance at national scale. We also build the tools educators rely on during live testing, a new product consisting of desktop and mobile experiences that allow proctors to:

  • Monitor student progress in real time
  • Detect and investigate anomalies
  • Troubleshoot student issues on test day

This work directly impacts test integrity, educator confidence, and student outcomes.

About the Opportunity

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer in Deliver team, you will play a key role in building and delivering web applications and cloud services that power College Board’s next generation digital experiences. You will develop scalable, performant, and reliable solutions, contributing to design, implementation, testing, and technical documentation, while working closely with cross-functional teams.

College Board, a not-for-profit organization dedicated to expanding access to education, builds technology that serves students, educators, and institutions at scale. Working within the Technology group and in partnership with product, design, and operations teams, the Senior Full Stack Engineer will develop solutions that are fast, fault-tolerant, and easy to maintain.

This role requires strong expertise in modern full stack development (React, TypeScript, and Node.js), along with experience building serverless and container-based applications on AWS. You will build user-facing features and back-end services that perform consistently as usage grows.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working with serverless and event-driven architectures and enjoys integrating front-end experiences with cloud services. You will contribute to systems built on modular, scalable architectures, and support delivery through CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and modern DevOps practices.

In this role, you have:

Design and Development (60%)

  • Design and deliver high-quality user-facing features and back-end services using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and AWS, with a focus on scalability and reliability
  • Translate product requirements into well-structured, testable components, driving features from concept to production
  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code (IaC) using AWS CDK
  • Prototype and validate new ideas quickly while keeping codebases clean and extensible
  • Contribute to shared patterns, components, and documentation to improve consistency and reuse
  • Optimize application performance, reliability, and security

Team Operations & Success (30%)

  • Collaborate in Agile teams, contributing to sprint planning, execution, and delivery
  • Participate in code reviews and design discussions, helping maintain strong engineering standards
  • Partner with product, design, and platform teams to deliver reliable user experiences
  • Write and maintain automated tests using Playwright
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues
  • Follow established CI/CD, testing, and DevOps practices to ship high-quality code quickly

Learning & Sharing (10%)

  • Stay current with web technologies, AWS services, and secure application design
  • Build a solid understanding of our customers’ business processes and operations
  • Share knowledge and contribute to improving team practices and engineering quality
  • Mentor junior developers and support growth within the team

About you, you have:

  • 7+ years of experience in full stack development, building, testing, and managing web-based applications
  • At least 3 years of recent, hands-on experience with React, TypeScript, Node.js, and AWS
  • Experience building serverless applications on AWS, including services such as Lambda, API Gateway, SNS, SQS, EventBridge, S3, Step Functions, IAM, CloudFront, WAF, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and DynamoDB
  • Experience building applications using modular, component-driven architectures
  • Experience with AWS CDK to define infrastructure as code and integrate it into deployment pipelines for environment-specific deploys
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including reusable workflows shared across services, improving consistency and reducing duplicated pipeline maintenance across teams
  • Experience with automated testing, ideally Playwright
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Grafana) including metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting to diagnose and resolve production issues
  • Experience working in Agile environments with strong collaboration skills
  • Strong problem-solving ability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies
  • Bachelor’s and/or master’s degree in computer science, systems engineering, information systems, or a similar field (preferred)

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck- we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $153,000 - $166,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

About Us

WebRTC.ventures is one of the few software development agencies in the world dedicated exclusively to real-time applications. Originally founded as AgilityFeat in 2010, we began specializing in WebRTC in 2015. We are headquartered in Charlottesville, VA, with a QA/testing center in Panama City, Panama, and a remote office in Bogotá, Colombia. With primary operations in North and South America, we serve clients around the globe. Our team has always been remote, which fuels our passion for real-time communications.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Elixir developer who has shipped substantial production software and now directs AI coding agents for most implementation work, writing code directly where judgment requires it. This is a hands-on, client-facing product engineering role. You will understand the problem, decide which parts agents should build and which need your direct attention, and own the delivery of reliable software.

Fluent English is a must. B2+ or above is required for daily written and spoken client and team communication.

What you’ll own

  • Translate customer or market needs and high-level ideas into product decisions, clear specifications, acceptance criteria, and achievable weekly delivery goals.
  • Own architecture and implementation of Elixir-based applications, including integrations, APIs, data models, scalability, performance, security, and maintainability.
  • Set up and operate autonomous coding-agent workflows: plan tasks, run parallel agents where useful, preserve context and state, recover failed or interrupted work, and manage execution cost and limits.
  • Build a dependable delivery loop from specification/PRD to tracked issues, agent implementation, automated tests, CI, independent QA/security review, pull requests, and controlled merges and releases.
  • Use engineering judgment to challenge agent output, diagnose difficult problems, validate behavior end-to-end, and prevent regressions; write code directly when it is the best way to solve a problem.
  • Communicate daily and proactively with the client and team: surface risks early, propose trade-offs and solutions, demonstrate working increments, and maintain visible progress without waiting for instructions.
  • Continuously improve the agent harness, development standards, observability, and quality gates so the workflow becomes faster, safer, and less dependent on manual supervision.

What success looks like

  • Each sprint ends with working, verified software the client can see.
  • Agents make progress on prepared work between your reviews.
  • Fast delivery that holds up on quality and security.

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience delivering and maintaining production applications, with strong debugging, architecture, and software-design fundamentals.
  • 2+ years of hands-on Elixir development experience on real applications; ability to reason confidently about Elixir code and its runtime. Phoenix, OTP, and Ecto experience are highly relevant.

  • Ability to operate multi-step agent workflows with testing, review, retries, and human approval gates; ownership of the correctness and security of shipped results.
  • Strong full-stack or backend engineering skills: APIs, databases, Git, automated testing, CI/CD, and cloud-hosted production systems.
  • Product mindset and independent judgment: able to understand users, prioritize useful outcomes, make architecture trade-offs, and deliver with minimal direction.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, proactive client communication, and ability to work remotely with your own equipment during 9 AM–5 PM Eastern Time.

Additional desired qualifications

  • An existing autonomous “software factory” or agent harness you can demonstrate, including issue orchestration, isolated workspaces, QA/review agents, and persistent execution state.
  • Experience with AWS, JavaScript/TypeScript or Node.js, and modern DevOps and observability practices.

Chainguard delivers the industry's most secure container images: minimal, zero-CVE, rebuilt daily from source. This role sits on our Package and Image Automation team, part of Sustaining Automation, the group that owns the automation underpinning our entire image factory. As we scale the number of ecosystems and images we support, this team builds and maintains the systems that keep packages and images current, tested, and building cleanly with as little manual intervention as possible.

As a Software Engineer, you'll be a hands-on contributor to a small, focused squad, building systems and AI-powered tooling that raise the reliability and speed of our automation. You'll have real opportunity to help shape the direction of the squad's roadmap, especially given its small size.

jobs.description:
技术环境

核心生产环境运行于 AWS / EKS，服务于 7×24 小时数字资产交易业务，对系统可用性、实时性、安全性、变更质量和故障恢复能力有较高要求。

岗位职责

  • 负责 7×24 小时核心交易业务的生产稳定性保障，覆盖交易链路、行情服务及相关基础设施；参与重大生产故障的应急响应，及时完成问题定位、风险控制、服务恢复和故障复盘，保障交易连续性和用户资产安全。
  • 负责 AWS 及 EKS/Kubernetes 生产基础设施的建设和持续优化，涵盖云架构、网络、高可用、容量规划及容灾，以及 Kubernetes 集群升级、节点生命周期、调度与资源管理、Ingress/负载均衡、DNS、存储和弹性伸缩等；持续优化云资源使用效率和成本，并从稳定性、安全性和可运维性角度参与业务技术架构设计。
  • 建设和持续完善可观测性与生产稳定性体系（Metrics、Logs、Tracing、Alerting、SLI/SLO、Incident Response、Postmortem），提升生产问题的发现、定位和恢复效率，并与研发团队共同解决系统瓶颈、单点风险及架构层面的长期稳定性问题。
  • 推动 IaC、CI/CD 和自动化运维体系建设（Terraform/Terragrunt、GitHub Actions、Ansible 等），实现基础设施和应用交付的标准化、自动化，并完善变更评审、发布、验证和回滚机制，降低生产变更风险。
  • 负责或协同完成 MySQL、Redis、Kafka 等核心数据及中间件服务的生产运维，包括高可用、监控、容量规划、备份恢复、性能优化及故障处理。
  • 推动 AWS、Kubernetes 及生产环境安全治理，包括最小权限和访问控制（IAM/RBAC）、网络隔离、容器及镜像安全、密钥与敏感信息管理（Secrets/KMS）、漏洞治理和安全审计，并协同相关团队完成安全事件响应。

任职要求

  • 计算机或相关专业统招本科及以上学历，5 年以上 DevOps、SRE、云基础设施或相关工作经验；具备中大型生产环境的一线运维、变更管理和复杂故障处理经验，兼具基础设施架构设计和实际落地能力，能够独立推进相关方案的实施和持续优化，并具备较强的风险意识和跨团队协作能力。
  • 具备扎实的 Linux、网络和容器技术基础，以及生产级 Kubernetes/EKS 实践经验，能够独立完成集群建设、升级、调优，以及 Pod、Node、网络和集群层面的复杂故障排查；了解 Java、Go 等常见应用的运行环境和基本排障方法。
  • 具备 AWS 生产环境建设和运维经验，熟悉核心云服务（IAM、VPC、EC2、EKS、ALB/NLB、Route 53、S3、CloudWatch 等），理解多可用区、高可用、网络隔离、最小权限、弹性伸缩、容量规划及成本治理等设计原则，具备生产基础设施架构设计、风险评估和故障排查能力。
  • 具备较强的 IaC、CI/CD 和自动化能力，有相关工具（Terraform/Terragrunt、GitHub Actions、Ansible 等）的实际使用经验；熟练使用脚本语言（Bash、Python 等），能够通过自动化提高基础设施和应用交付的可靠性。
  • 具备生产级可观测性和稳定性治理经验，熟悉相关技术栈（Prometheus、Grafana、ELK/Loki、OpenTelemetry 等），理解 Metrics、Logs、Tracing、SLI/SLO、告警治理、容量规划和容灾机制。
  • 熟悉 MySQL、Redis、Kafka 等常见数据及中间件服务的基本生产运维，并具备实际的安全运维或 DevSecOps 经验（AWS IAM、Kubernetes RBAC、网络安全、主机及容器安全、Secrets/KMS、漏洞治理、安全审计等），具备生产安全风险识别和处置能力。
  • 具备 Web3 / Crypto 行业生产环境运维经验，对区块链及链上业务的基本运行机制有一定理解，能够结合数字资产交易业务识别和处理相关的稳定性与安全风险。

加分项

  • 有数字资产交易所、证券、金融交易、支付等高可用实时系统生产环境经验者优先。
  • 有大规模或高流量 Kubernetes/EKS 生产环境，以及 AWS 多账号治理、跨 Region 容灾或灾备演练实践经验者优先。
  • 有较深入的云原生、云安全或成本治理实践经验者优先（如 Karpenter、Argo CD/Flux、OpenTelemetry、eBPF、FinOps 等）。

公司概述

Davion Labs 现诚邀一位具备丰富云基础设施和生产稳定性经验的高级运维 / SRE 工程师（Senior Cloud Infrastructure & SRE Engineer）加入 ApeX Protocol 核心团队。

ApeX Protocol 是领先的去中心化交易平台（DEX），核心业务 7×24 小时持续运行，对系统的稳定性、安全性、实时性及故障恢复能力有较高要求。生产基础设施以 AWS、EKS/Kubernetes（K8s） 为核心，并通过自动化、可观测性和稳定性治理持续提升系统可靠性。

在这个岗位上，您将深度参与云基础设施建设、Kubernetes 平台、IaC/CI/CD、可观测性、生产稳定性及安全治理。我们希望您既具备基础设施架构设计和系统性思考能力，也保持较强的实际落地能力，能够深入生产环境处理复杂问题，并推动问题从应急响应走向长期改进。

我们期待您具备 Web3 / Crypto 行业生产环境经验，理解链上业务的基本运行机制，并能够与研发团队紧密协作，共同建设稳定、安全、高效且具备良好扩展能力的交易基础设施。

jobs.title: Senior Radar Systems Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Umbra is an American space technology company delivering advanced systems, from sensors to spacecraft, that empower customers worldwide with unmatched access to critical information from space.
jobs.description:
Umbra is an American space technology company delivering advanced systems, from sensors to spacecraft, that empower customers worldwide with unmatched access to critical information from space. Our mission is simple and ambitious: redefine space—for people, systems, and missions in every domain. Umbra’s ecosystem operates through three business units: Remote Sensing (the data), Space Systems (the components), and Mission Solutions (the platforms).Together, our teams develop capabilities that deliver persistent access, resilient performance, and mission-ready solutions, advancing U.S. space leadership while keeping the world safe and informed.

About the Team

Remote Sensing – The Data

Remote Sensing is where Umbra got its start, and our agile Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) constellation remains the most capable on the market. We transform satellite data into real-world, actionable insights that strengthen U.S. national security and intelligence, support disaster response, and advance scientific discovery. Our team delivers data at scale with unmatched quality, persistence, and the speed and responsiveness our partners demand.

If you want to work on cutting-edge space technology that’s redefining what’s possible in remote sensing, you belong here at Umbra.

About the JobWe are actively seeking a skilled and motivated individual to join Umbra's Radar Processing Group as a Senior Software Engineer. In this pivotal role, you will play a crucial part in the development of our processing pipelines. Your responsibilities will not only encompass the development and implementation of high-quality, robust software solutions but also involve maintaining and refining production-level services that are essential for the seamless operation of our entire processing chain. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge projects that have a direct impact on our technological advancements and overall mission.

Our preference is for this position to be based in one of our offices in Santa Barbara/Goleta, CA, Arlington, VA, or Reston, VA. However, we will also consider highly qualified remote candidates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and improve radar algorithms including: MTI, Passive RF, and SAR.
  • Write production quality software with unit and integration testing.
  • Support commercial and government teams in modeling, simulation, mission design, and systems analyses for current and future architecture.
  • Monitor, evaluate and improve production throughput for cost and timeliness efficiency.
  • Build, test, and maintain applications that run our satellites and tackle a variety of problems, including automating spacecraft operations, mission scheduling, command and telemetry pipeline, mission data pipeline, and anomaly response.
  • Provide key software architecture expertise to cross-functional engineering and product teams.
  • Help establish and adhere to DevOps practices that ensure that customer and satellite-operational needs are met with quality and performance.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in writing algorithms specifically for SAR image processing.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a related STEM field (such as electrical engineering, physics, or computer science).
  • 5+ years of professional experience in signal / image processing development.
  • 5-8+ years of professional experience with Matlab or Python.
  • Experience with version control software, preferably Git.
  • Demonstrated foundational understanding of software architecture, event-driven micro-services, interface design, and automated testing patterns.
  • Experience with database-backed applications and relational database concepts.
  • Experience with parallel processing and HPC.



Desired Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in a relevant STEM field.
  • Proficiency in parallel processing and high-performance computing (HPC).
  • Excellent communications skills, ability and desire to work collaboratively in a team environment, and willingness to learn new skills and technology.
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-paced development environment.
  • Proven experience in machine learning.
  • 10+ years experience with Python's scientific stack: Numpy, Scipy, and Numba.
  • Excited to share knowledge and experience across the engineering team.
  • Experience designing, developing, and testing intuitive and well-documented RESTful APIs.
  • Experience with C/C++, Rust, CUDA.
  • Significant background with SAR processing.

Benefits

  • Flexible Time Off, Sick, Family & Medical Leave
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, LTD, STD (employer funded)
  • Vol Life, Critical Illness, Accidental, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance (employee funded)
  • 401k with 3% non-elective company contribution
  • Stock Options
  • Free parking in the building
  • Free lunch in office daily

Umbra is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Employment Eligibility Verification

In compliance with federal laws, all hired persons will be required to verify their identity and eligibility to work in the United States by completing the required Employment Eligibility Verification Form (I-9 Form) upon hire.

ITAR/EAR Requirements

This position may include access to technology and/or data that is subject to U.S. export controls pursuant to ITAR and EAR. To comply with federal export controls, all persons hired must be a U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. lawful permanent resident, refugee or asylee as defined by 8 U.S.C. § 1324b(a)(3), or must otherwise be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or U.S. Department of Commerce as applicable.

Pay Transparency
This job posting may cover multiple career levels. To ensure greater transparency, we provide base salary ranges for all roles, regardless of location. Our standard pay ranges are based on the role’s function and level, benchmarked against similar growth-stage companies. Compensation may vary based on geographical location, as certain regions may have different cost-of-living factors. The final offer will also be influenced by the candidate's skills, responsibilities, and relevant experience.

Compensation Range

The Compensation Range for this role is $170,000 - $200,000 DOE.

jobs.description:
Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. We provide the world’s best end-to-end software supply chain security solution, combining the only proactive protection against malicious open source, the only enterprise grade SBOM management and the leading open source dependency management platform. This empowers enterprises to create and maintain secure, quality, and innovative software at scale.
As founders of Nexus Repository and stewards of Maven Central, the world’s largest repository of Java open-source software, we are software pioneers and our open source expertise is unmatched. We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development.
More than 2,000 organizations, including 70% of the Fortune 100 and 15 million software developers, rely on Sonatype to optimize their software supply chains.

Sonatype is a fast-growing software company helping companies manage their open-source software supply chains. As a subscription-based business, our success hinges on our ability to renew and expand existing customer accounts. Fortunately, our customers trust Sonatype and value our solutions. This trust is demonstrated by our 90%+ renewal rate -- one of the highest renewal rates in the software subscription industry. As we grow, we must maintain and even increase this rate.

What we are seeking

jobs.title: Director, Cloud Infrastructure
jobs.excerpt: Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together.
jobs.description:
Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team.

Director, Cloud Infrastructure

We're hiring a Director of Cloud Infrastructure to join Convene Hospitality Group's (CHG) Technology organization. It's a hands-on role with an AI-native mindset. There are no direct reports today. You’ll lead through the platform, redesigning how we deploy and setting the standards our product and corporate engineering teams build on. You'll also run the cloud, AI, and venue infrastructure under our portfolio of brands, from client-facing experiences to the systems that keep our nearly 40 venues running. This is a rebuild. You design it and you build it.

Today, deployments are manual and happen about once a sprint. That's the starting line. You'll rethink how we ship so that deployments are unlocked, safe, secure, and governed.

You'll have high autonomy and real decision-making power over the tools we use and how we build. We're committed to AWS and will build deeply on it. Most of what sits on top is fair game: CI tooling, pipeline design, orchestration patterns, and source control.A decision like Bitbucket versus GitHub is a live call, and it's yours to make. Legacy migration follows the decisions. You make the call, then you do the move. This role will have a lot of influence.

You distinguish activity from progress, documentation from bureaucracy and optimism from an executable commitment. You create enough structure to make work predictable, adapt it to the size of the project, and remain personally accountable for getting decisions made and outcomes delivered.

At Pula, we are radically restructuring agricultural insurance, using technology to insure the previously unbanked, uninsured, untapped market of 1.5 billion smallholders worldwide.

We work in over 14 countries across Africa and Asia, and by 2020, we have facilitated crop insurance cover to over 4.7 million farmers across Kenya, India, Rwanda, Uganda, Nigeria, Mali, Senegal, Zambia, Ethiopia, Madagascar, Tanzania, and Malawi. Since raising our Series A our operations have expanded globally including now Asia and Latin America.

Pula is fast-paced, constantly adapting to new opportunities and challenges. We are a high performance, multi-cultural team. We expect our team to value performance, results and professionalism.

At Pula, we are:

  • Obsessed with results:We are responsible for our future and therefore we get things done!
  • Connect the Dots: We continuously identify different customer needs & business problems and build solutions that deliver value.
  • Have a Can do Attitude! We dare to do things differently to make things work.
  • We have each others’ back: We look out for each other & we share high quality, timely feedback that makes us better.

Position Overview

As a Data Analyst (Data Engineering & AI Workflows) at Pula, you will clean, validate and move the field and geospatial data that powers our insurance products, farmer profiling and compliance projects. You will build and maintain the pipelines that take raw survey data from collection to delivery, and set up AI-assisted workflows that make data cleaning, quality checks and document extraction faster and repeatable. You will work closely with the Associate Manager, Data, the analyst team and the field teams across concurrent country projects. We are looking for someone who writes production-quality code, thinks in systems rather than one-off scripts, and documents their work so others can run it.

Responsibilities

Data cleaning and quality control

  • Clean, standardise and validate large field datasets (farmer registrations, surveys, polygons, photos) collected through ODK and in-house tools.
  • Run data quality checks on each batch following our gate-based DQC framework and SOPs, and resolve flagged issues with analysts and field teams.
  • Reconcile collected data against master lists and reference data
  • Distinguish real data problems from defects in the checks themselves, and fix the checks when they are wrong.
  • Identify gaps in current quality check SOPs and recommend improvements.

Data engineering and pipelines

  • Build and maintain ETL pipelines that move data from collection tools and PostgreSQL/PostGIS

databases to analysis outputs and client deliverables.

  • Schedule and monitor automated jobs (e.g. on cloud servers or GitHub Actions), with logging, incremental loads and clear failure alerts.
  • Design and document data schemas, validation rules and data dictionaries for new country projects.
  • Write clean, version-controlled, tested Python and SQL that other team members can run and maintain.
  • Process geospatial data (field boundaries, GPS points, administrative layers) and support compliance checks such as EUDR polygon validation.

AI workflows and automation

  • Set up and maintain AI-assisted workflows using LLM tools (e.g. Claude, Claude Code, OpenAI or similar) for data cleaning, quality checks, report drafting and repetitive analyst tasks.
  • Build document and image extraction pipelines (OCR and LLM-based) for sources such as land certificates, forms and field photos, with verification steps to measure accuracy.
  • Write and maintain prompts, reusable skills, project context files and runbooks so AI workflows give consistent, auditable results.
  • Evaluate when AI is the right tool versus a deterministic script, and track cost, accuracy and data privacy risks of each approach.
  • Train analysts to use AI tools safely and effectively in their daily work.

Analysis, reporting and improvement

  • Use data analytics and project knowledge to identify risks and issues within projects, and propose practical solutions.
  • Prepare dashboards, reports and delivery files for internal teams, partners and clients.
  • Develop new processes and procedures to improve project operations, and evaluate their effectiveness once implemented.
  • Draft technical documentation, SOPs and training materials, and train analysts and field staff on new systems.
  • Keep the manager informed through regular daily, weekly, and ad-hoc updates.
  • Demonstrate honesty and transparency, and communicate directly and openly, giving feedback constructively.

Requirements

Education and experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Information Systems, Economics, Geoinformatics, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in data analysis or data engineering, preferably in a fast-paced NGO or agri-tech environment.
  • Demonstrated experience cleaning large, messy field or survey datasets end to end.
  • A portfolio, GitHub profile or work samples showing pipelines or automations you have built.

Technical skills

  • Strong Python (required), including pandas and scripting for automation; R is a plus.
  • Strong SQL (required), with experience in PostgreSQL; PostGIS is a plus.
  • Experience building and scheduling ETL pipelines, using Git, and working on Linux or cloud servers (e.g. AWS EC2).
  • Hands-on experience using LLMs and AI tools in real workflows (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, coding assistants, LLM APIs), including prompt design and checking AI outputs for accuracy.
  • Familiarity with mobile data collection tools such as ODK, KoboToolbox, CommCare, or SurveyCTO.

Nice to have

  • Experience building agentic or multi-step AI workflows (e.g. Claude Code, MCP connectors, LangChain or similar), or running self-hosted/open-source models.
  • Experience with OCR and document extraction (e.g. Tesseract, PaddleOCR, cloud vision APIs).
  • Experience with geospatial tools (GeoPandas, QGIS, Google Earth Engine) or EUDR/deforestation compliance data.
  • Experience with orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, GitHub Actions) or Docker.

jobs.excerpt: About the roleDeeter Analytics is a privately held investment research and trading firm managing its own capital across global public markets.
jobs.description:
About the role

Deeter Analytics is a privately held investment research and trading firm managing its own capital across global public markets. We pair sharp human judgment with modern AI to act on a distinctive way of seeing markets, and we run a concentrated, thesis-driven book that moves as the world does.

We’re hiring a Head of Risk to own everything that happens after a position goes on. You’ll know positions and the reasoning behind them, read the book daily against the firm’s current views, and say plainly when something no longer belongs: a view that has run its course, two positions that contradict each other, an exposure that accumulated without anyone deciding to have it. You’ll own the firm’s picture of its own exposures and define what we need to see to manage them. You report directly to the principal.

This is an individual contributor seat, built from scratch: no team to manage, no outside investors to report to, and no inherited framework. The work is yours to do, not to delegate.

What you’ll own

  • The map of the book. A living inventory of every position: why it’s on, what would take it off, and what it’s exposed to, by name, theme and factor.

  • Thesis hygiene. A daily read of positions against the firm’s current views, with stale, contradictory or mis-sized positions flagged the day they happen.

  • The clean-up. Positions nobody is watching, residual pieces of old trades, exposures that drifted. You find them and get them resolved.

  • Exposure and scenario views sized to how we actually trade, in terms the principal will act on.

  • Counterparty, financing and operational exposures across our brokers and platforms: known, sized, and on the same map as the positions.

  • What we need to see. You define the data and views this seat requires and the tech team builds to your spec.

  • The daily note. One short, decision-ready view each day: what changed, what’s stale, what needs a decision.

What this is not

Not a PM or trader seat, and not a path to one. Not a quant seat. Not the desk’s housekeeping; execution and position maintenance stay with the trading desk. You won’t run a view of your own or be asked where markets are going; you’ll be asked whether the book is consistent with the principal’s view and the evidence behind it. You don’t set limits and there is no risk committee; the principal decides. What you have is a direct line.

Who you are

We hire for demonstrated judgment and how you think, not for pedigree. You’ve done this job (at a fund, a family office, a prop desk, or on the risk side of a bank) and you know what a clean risk process looks like because you’ve run one. We look for evidence that you are:

  • Careful by temperament. Loose ends bother you.

  • Fluent in risk, allergic to taking it. You understand positioning, derivatives, factor exposure, liquidity and counterparty risk well enough to see what a discretionary book is really exposed to, and you have no wish to express a view of your own.

  • Comfortable with a principal who changes direction fast. You don’t need the world to be orderly; you make the book orderly inside a fast-moving process.

  • A plain communicator. You say “this doesn’t belong anymore” in one sentence and back it with the numbers in the next.

  • Low ego, truth-seeking, and driven. Quick to update when the facts change, and unbothered by telling an experienced principal that a position is stale.

How you work

  • Self-directed. Nobody will hand you a limits framework or a risk committee. You’ll define the process.

  • Hands on. You do the work yourself, every day.

  • Builder minded. You can specify, and ideally prototype, what you need to see (Python, SQL or spreadsheets) rather than waiting for a system.

  • Proportionate. You know which exposures matter for a book like ours and which are institutional theatre, and you spend your attention accordingly.

  • AI-native. Fluent with modern AI tools for surveillance, synthesis and reporting, with a trust-but-verify discipline on their output.

  • Fast and collaborative. You operate at the speed of markets, work closely with the trading desk and the tech team, and make the people around you sharper.

Core skills

  • Book reading. Seeing a concentrated book as a set of exposures rather than a list of tickers.

  • Thesis-to-position mapping. Translating a discretionary view into what should and shouldn’t be on, and keeping that mapping current.

  • Scenario thinking. Factor, theme and liquidity scenarios that produce decisions, not reports.

  • Counterparty and operational awareness. Knowing where a book is exposed beyond the positions themselves, and keeping that in view.

  • Data specification. Knowing what a risk function needs from position, broker and internal data, and asking for it precisely.

  • Operating discipline. Daily rhythm, documentation that survives you, and follow-through on every flag until it’s resolved.

What we offer

  • A direct line to the principal and a seat beside the decisions your work protects.

  • A well-capitalized firm with a distinctive approach to markets and a clean slate to define how risk works here.

  • A small, discreet team that values intellectual honesty, independent judgment and speed over hierarchy and process.

  • Upside tied to how much cleaner and better-protected the book is because you exist.

  • Remote; US market hours.
